**Position Summary**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The
 **Senior Associate, Technology Adoption** 
 supports the planning, successful deployment, adoption and measurement of Global Procurement technology adoption initiatives. This role helps stakeholders adopt digital capabilities across procurement processes by coordinating readiness activities, developing enablement resources, tracking adoption metrics, and partnering with business and technology teams to improve user experience and value realization.
   

  

 This role plays a key part in ensuring employees have the tools, knowledge, and support needed to successfully adopt new digital capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Adoption Support**
* Support execution of adoption plans, readiness and implementation activities for Global Procurement digital initiatives.
* Coordinate launch preparation for new capabilities, including stakeholder readiness, communications, training logistics, and support materials.
* Contribute to change management activities that help procurement users understand, adopt, and sustain new ways of working.


**Training \& Enablement**
* Develop training materials, job aids, FAQs, knowledge articles, and quick\-reference guides tailored to procurement users and process needs.
* Support end\-user training sessions, office hours, and adoption forums in partnership with business and technology stakeholders.
* Maintain learning content and adoption documentation so users have accurate, current, and easy\-to\-use resources.
* Monitor training completion, learner feedback, and effectiveness indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.


**Communications**
* Prepare clear launch, readiness, and adoption communications for procurement technology initiatives.
* Support stakeholder engagement and change communication activities to reinforce key messages and expected ways of working.
* Coordinate adoption campaigns and awareness activities that encourage consistent tool usage.
* Maintain adoption resources on SharePoint and other collaboration platforms.


**User Support**
* Collect user feedback, identify adoption barriers, and summarize recurring themes for action.
* Coordinate issue resolution and user support follow\-ups with technology, process, and business teams.
* Monitor support trends and recommend practical improvements to adoption, usability, and stakeholder experience.


**Analytics \& Reporting**
* Track adoption indicators such as usage rates, training completion, stakeholder readiness, user feedback, support trends, and adoption barriers.
* Develop reports and status updates that communicate adoption progress, risks, and opportunities.
* Analyze adoption data and stakeholder insights to recommend targeted actions that improve engagement and sustained usage.
* Support value realization reporting by connecting adoption outcomes to process improvements and user experience benefits.


**Project Coordination**

* Coordinate meetings, action items, risks, dependencies, and deliverables across business and technology teams.
* Maintain project documentation, decision logs, stakeholder trackers, and adoption\-related materials.


**Required Skills And Capabilities**
* Supports technology adoption and change management activities that enable successful implementation, stakeholder readiness, and sustained usage.
* Develops training, learning resources, and enablement materials that improve user proficiency and adoption of digital procurement solutions.
* Collaborates effectively with business and technology stakeholders to understand needs, address challenges, and support adoption outcomes.
* Applies data analysis and reporting skills to monitor usage, readiness, training effectiveness, support trends, and value realization indicators.
* Uses project coordination skills to manage workstream activities, timelines, action items, documentation, and stakeholder follow\-ups.
* Demonstrates proficiency in Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, analytics tools, and digital ways of working.
* Applies continuous improvement principles to enhance user experience, increase adoption, and simplify procurement processes.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with procurement technology platforms or Source\-to\-Pay processes, including supplier enablement, purchasing, contracting, or analytics use cases.
* Exposure to tools such as Power BI, SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, learning platforms, or digital adoption platforms.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools, automation, process improvement, or enterprise digital transformation programs.
* Basic understanding of change management, stakeholder engagement, communications planning, and adoption measurement methods.

* Builds effective working relationships with cross\-functional and global teams to support shared objectives.

* Adapts quickly in a dynamic environment with evolving business priorities and technologies.
* Engages stakeholders with a customer\-focused mindset and a collaborative approach.
* Demonstrates strong organization, attention to detail, and accountability while managing multiple priorities.
* Takes initiative to deliver high\-quality outcomes and improve processes, tools, and ways of working.

* Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.

 Are you pedantic about code quality ?
   

  

 If so, we are looking for an individual like you to join a team of world class developers and help us write highest quality code which is readable, maintainable and can give our customers a bug free experience.
   

  

 Amazon is a premier place to build and deploy world class software
   

  

 Amazon has come a long way since opening on the World Wide Web in July 1995\. Today, we operate retail websites in multiple countries across geographies, offering products in many categories (books, media, digital, electronics etc.) worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history! The Amazon.com brand has become synonymous with a superior level of convenience, selection, low prices, and customer service.
   

  

 Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. There are a variety of ways in which we acquire items from vendors to our warehouses, ship items from one location to another, and several intermediate locations through which the package travels before reaching the customer. There are millions of such packages, each with different attributes, and different delivery requirements. What results is a highly dense graph of source, intermediate and destination nodes, with arcs between them representing possible paths for packages, with different costs and times along each arc. Accounting for all these constraints, and maximizing the number of shipments shipped, while minimizing cost, providing a variety of delivery options and maximizing delivery performance is Transportation Engineering's primary focus.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are a highly agile and self driven team of talented and motivated engineers based out of Delhi. We are at the heart of Amazon transportation and are responsible for managing entire package lifecycle. Team owns the orchestration of transportation requests, state management, proactive deviation management at network level, progress tracker operations like delivery to locker, cancel and notification of transportation events to downstream clients. Come join the team that sets a high bar for software development and operational excellence practices. We use Amazon wide tools and processes to a large extent, and we also contribute to the Amazon wide arsenal of tools that all businesses use to be more effective. We are early adopters of new tools and technologies, before they become mandatory.

description:

 Are you looking to become a leader in a global operation with hundreds of managers and thousands of employees?  As a Regional Manager of Central Flow, you will have the opportunity to manage and develop a team of flow leads who are tasked with the most analytical and impactful function of running Outbound Flow for Fulfillment Centers across Amazon. In the job you would be required to exercise superior analytical and problem solving skills as well as people management skills. You will be expected to work with the senior leadership of multiple Fulfillment Centers and set expectation on the support that central flow would provide and need from them. You would be responsible to work with cross functional teams in developing tools, standards and best practices and will co\-ordinate the efforts with multiple Fulfillment centers across IN. You are expected to have a steep learning curve in learning pick flow settings, collate settings and other flow related tools and become a subject matter expert in flow management. You will need to be very knowledgeable in Excel as this team will depend on multiple tools based on the software.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of Amazon Central Flow Leads.
* Understand and teach detailed flow concepts related to outbound flow operations in Amazon’s fulfillment centers.
* Continuously improve processes and procedures related to OB Flow Operations
* Continuously monitor performance of FCs that are attributable to Central Flow and take corrective steps whenever required to optimize outbound productivity performance and Customer Experience.
* Remove barriers for Central Flow Leads by developing tools and automate manual business processes.
* Monitor and audit if standard processes are followed for every FC and take corrective action to change or modify standards if needed due to change in external or internal processes related to FC.

* Develop performance goals and objectives to achieve customer promise expectations and ensure accuracy and quality.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Day\-to\-day activities include monitoring and directing shipment volumes through Outbound processes, balancing workloads across pack paths and promises, directing labor resources to high\-need areas, tracking key metrics (throughput, backlog, dwells, CPT compliance), and reviewing process settings for accurate pick prioritization. Internal stakeholders include FC Operations teams, Area Managers, S\&OP, ACES, PE, and analytics teams. The customers are FC operations leaders who rely on flow recommendations to meet customer delivery promises and maintain cost and DEA targets.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The INFC Central Flow team is the centralized "air traffic control" for Amazon's Outbound fulfillment operations across India, Australia, and Singapore (1P \& 3P FCs). The team's mission is to optimize FC workflows by centralizing and standardizing shift planning and execution while automating critical decision points. The culture is built on deep partnership with tech, ACES, PE, and analytics teams to drive proactive operational improvements. The team monitors ExSD risk, TRB, and productivity, providing real\-time recommendations to maintain benchmark standards. The team embodies a fast\-paced, data\-driven, and collaborative environment focused on preventing bottlenecks and ensuring packages flow smoothly to meet customer promises.

title: Executive Food Safety Management System Documentation And Compliance
description:
Sunshine Vegetables is hiring an Executive — FSMS, Documentation \& Compliance for the IQF plant at Sikandrabad, Bulandshahr.
 



  





 We hold FSSC 22000 and FSSAI certification. Keeping a certificate is not a project with an end date — it is a daily discipline of record integrity, and it is where most certified plants quietly slip. A document at the wrong revision on the line, a monitoring record signed in arrears, an internal audit that ran late: none of it shows until an auditor pulls the file.
 



  





 This role exists so that never happens here. It is deliberately separate from the Head of Quality, because one person cannot maintain the document set and clear product for dispatch on the same day.
 



  





 What the role owns:
 



  





 \- Document control. Current revisions in use at the point of work, obsolete copies withdrawn, change history intact
 



 \- The record architecture — monitoring records, verification records, retention schedules — complete, legible and retrievable on demand
 



 \- Traceability and mock recall. Trace a batch from a named contract farmer's field to a dispatched carton within four hours, and prove it twice a year
 



 \- The internal audit programme on schedule, and the CAPA register closed to timeline rather than closed on paper
 



 \- Management review, HACCP annual review, and surveillance audit readiness maintained continuously, not assembled the week before
 



 \- Regulatory and customer compliance — FSSAI Schedule 4 Part II, labelling and legal metrology, buyer questionnaires and specification files
 



  





 What we are looking for:
 



  





 \- 5–10 years in food manufacturing QA, degree in Food Technology or Microbiology
 



 \- You have maintained a certified FSMS through at least one surveillance audit cycle, hands\-on with the documentation
 



 \- Certified internal auditor against FSSC 22000 or an equivalent scheme
 



 \- You write clearly in English and you are exacting about detail. Half this job is writing; the other half is noticing
 



  





 What will make you stand out:
 



  





 \- Experience extending a certified scope over a new line
 



 \- Frozen, chilled or fresh vegetable processing
 



 \- Export documentation for EU or Gulf buyers, or customer audit handling for a QSR or retail account
 



  





 Compensation as per experience. On\-site at Sikandrabad; relocation support available.
 



  





 CV to sagardeswal@sunshinevegetables.com or WhatsApp \+91 80779 24395\.

 • Edit and fact\-check AI\-generated drafts against source material — you're accountable for accuracy, not just fluency
 



 • Organize documentation in our workspace tools and keep information architecture clean and findable
 



 • Partner closely with PMs and engineers to fill documentation gaps and flag when a PRD lacks the detail needed to write accurate docs
 



 • Continuously push on documentation methodology and tooling as our products evolve
 



  





**Skills** 




 • Strong written communication — this is a writing\-first role; verbal fluency alone won't cut it

 • Working understanding of project management and workspace tools (Confluence, Jira, Notion, or similar)
 



 • Genuine curiosity about systems and process — an instinct to automate the repeatable parts of a workflow
 



 • Comfortable with ambiguity and moving quickly
 



  





**Experience and Qualifications**

 Zoca builds AI agents that local service businesses hire to run the parts of the business the owner cannot get to. More than 1,000 businesses use Zoca today. We started in beauty and wellness and are backed by Accel, Elevation Capital, Better Capital and GTM Fund.
   

  

 Discovery is the agent that runs a business’s online presence: its Google Business Profile, website, service pages, blogs, Google posts and reviews. It publishes on behalf of thousands of businesses every week, many of them in the same cities.
   

  

**The terrain**
 How does content written by a machine, for a business the machine only knows through data, become genuinely useful to a person searching nearby? How does it rank, and keep ranking, when the same machine is writing for the business down the street? Nobody at Zoca owns that question today. Engineers own the pipeline. Nobody owns what comes out of it.
   

  

 You would inherit a working pipeline from keywords to topics to published pages and posts, a per\-business context layer we call Brain that holds services, staff, tone and house rules, a live connection to every business’s Google Business Profile and Search Console, every review those businesses have received, and engineers who want someone to argue with about what the pipeline should produce. Over a thousand live businesses across many cities means a natural experiment running every day, if someone reads it.
   

  

**What We Know So Far**
 Google treats content produced at volume to manipulate ranking as spam, whoever wrote it. Fluent, generic content has become free, and specific, local, useful content has not. Many businesses in the same city want the same topics. And from the outside, a page that never got indexed, a page on the wrong topic, and a badly written page all look the same.
   

  

 What we do not know, and have opinions on that we will share after we hear yours: what separates two businesses’ content in the same zip code beyond the facts about each. How much business\-specific data moves ranking compared to the prose. Which content types are worth producing at all. Where a human belongs in the loop and where a human is a bottleneck dressed up as quality. And how you know a page is good before Google tells you two months later.
   

  

**What You Would Own**
* The definition of good. A rubric a person and a model can both apply, with pages that pass, pages that fail, and why.
* The weekly read. A sample of what shipped, across cities and business types, scored against the rubric, with every failure turned into a named class rather than a one\-off fix.
* The eval set. The pages the pipeline is measured against before anything goes live, and the automated judge engineering builds from it.
* Local intent, per business type. What someone searching for a lash studio wants to read is not what someone searching for a med spa wants. You decide what we produce for each, and what we stop producing.
* The outcome numbers. Pages indexed, pages earning impressions, keywords ranked, clicks, and calls and bookings we can trace back to a page. Not output volume. Where those numbers should be is yours to argue.


 If you find yourself writing blogs, something upstream is broken, and that is the thing to fix.
   

  

**Who You Probably Are**
* You have personally made local pages rank for hundreds of small businesses, at an agency or on a marketplace, and can explain exactly what did it.
* You write well and can say precisely why a paragraph is bad, in one sentence.
* You read Search Console before you form an opinion.
* You have worked with model\-generated content and hold a view of it that is neither hype nor contempt.
* You can write a rubric, argue with an engineer about an eval, and lose the argument gracefully when the data says so.
* You have real experience with US local search, wherever you sit.


 This is not a content calendar role, a people\-management role, a brand copy role or a social media role. It reports into product, works daily with the pipeline engineers, and starts with no team.

**Bangalore \| Full time \| 1 to 4 Years Experience****English, Hindi \& Kannada** **If you can find the 5 seconds everyone needs to see, read on.**
You know when a 30 minute speech has **one moment worth watching?**
We’re looking for a **Video Editor** who can find it, cut it, and make people stop scrolling.
This isn’t just about knowing Premiere Pro.  

It’s about having the editing instinct to know **what stays, what goes, where the cut lands, when the music hits, and what keeps someone watching.**
You understand political storytelling, short form content, internet culture, and how content moves online.### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Edit political content for **Instagram Reels, YouTube, Facebook, X \& WhatsApp**
* Turn speeches, interviews, rallies, event footage, explainers and campaign videos into sharp, engaging, platform native content
* Watch long form footage and identify the strongest **hooks, moments and soundbites**
* Create cuts, transitions, subtitles, text animations, graphics, motion and visual effects that add to the story
* Get the **pace, context and visual language** right for every platform
* Adapt videos across different formats, durations, aspect ratios and languages
* Work closely with writers, graphic designers, photographers, strategists and campaign teams
* Handle multiple edits and priorities without letting quality or attention to detail slip
* Deliver high quality work on tight deadlines

* **1 to 4 years** of experience as a Video Editor, preferably in political campaigns, digital media, advertising, news or other high volume content environments
* Strong command of **Adobe Premiere Pro \& After Effects**
* Knowledge of **DaVinci Resolve** is a plus
* Strong understanding of **Reels, Shorts, YouTube and social first video**
* Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, music, typography and visual composition
* Ability to take raw footage and figure out **what the story actually is**
* Ability to work quickly in a fast moving, deadline heavy environment
* Strong command of **English, Hindi \& Kannada**, including the political and cultural context behind the content
* Comfortable making creative decisions independently and adapting to changing priorities

### **WHAT WILL SET YOU APART**

* You’ve edited **political campaigns, news or public facing content** before
* Strong motion graphics and animation skills
* You understand **internet culture, memes and emerging formats**
* You have a sharp eye for **colour, sound design and visual storytelling**
* You can spot a killer clip before someone has to tell you it’s a killer clip
* Your portfolio demonstrates **social first editing instincts**, not just technical skills

### **THE SKILL WE’RE REALLY HIRING FOR**

**Editing judgement.**
Knowing that the 30 minute speech has **one line that changes everything.**
Knowing when to cut.
Knowing when to hold.
Knowing when the music should hit.
Knowing what makes someone watch till the end.
We’re hiring the person who knows:**“This is the moment.”**### **WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**


This is not:**Import footage**  **make cuts**  **export**  **next.**
Politics moves fast. News breaks. Narratives change.
A clip that matters at **2 PM might be irrelevant by 6 PM.**
You’ll need to work with **speed, pressure, ambiguity and real time creative decisions.**### **WHY JOIN US?**


You’ll work at the intersection of **politics, video, culture and the internet.**
You’ll work alongside campaign strategists, writers, designers, social media teams and political professionals, creating content that is actually part of the conversation.**Your edits won’t just sit in a folder.****People will see them.**### **HOW TO APPLY**

**Don’t just send us your CV. Show us what you can do.**
Send your **CV \+ showreel/portfolio** to:**mailto:contact@designboxed.com****Bonus points for:*** 3 to 5 edits you’re genuinely proud of
* Political, news, advertising or digital campaign work

If you can take raw footage, find the story, and turn it into something people actually want to watch,**we want to see your work.**

title: Manager - Trainer
description:
****Position Title****
 Manager \- Trainer
   

  

****Purpose of Role****
 To build and run TEPCO's site training capability — developing and executing the training modules for mechanized, assembly\-line transmission construction with core purpose of optimizing man days in all the phases of construction, and, most importantly,
 **driving their adoption on the ground** 
 so that gangs work to the new method with confidence, consistency and pace.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities**
**Training design \& Content development**
* Conduct change management workshops with Projects, Gang Leaders \& all workers.
* Develop and maintain training modules for the assembly\-line methodology and mechanized construction techniques (e.g. DAGP erection, drone\-based stringing), covering each sub\-gang role across foundation, erection and stringing.
* Build simple, field\-usable
* Training materials
* SOPs,
* Visual work instructions
* job aids
* Toolbox\-talk content
* Videos and Demonstrations
* Equipment Operating Guides
* Quick Reference Cards
* Translate technical procedures into practical site level instructions suitable for workforce with varying literacy and experience levels.


**Adoption on site — the core of the role**
* Run structured on\-site induction and hands\-on training at mobilization , and refresher training at the start of each project.
* Work alongside gangs at the work\-front to embed the assembly\-line method, coach on cycle\-time discipline, and troubleshoot resistance or bottlenecks as they arise.
* Partner with the Project Manager, Mechanization leads and vertical teams to sequence training with the execution plan, so training enables the schedule rather than interrupting it.
* Identify and develop experienced workers as peer trainers, creating a self\-sustaining training capability at site.
* Identify high potential workers and prepare succession plans for critical gang and equipment operator positions.
* Enhancing schedule adherence through the effective adoption of mechanized construction methodologies.


**Measurement and improvement**
* Track training coverage, competency levels, and the link between training and on\-ground productivity (progress toward the man\-days/km target).
* Create a competency grading system (Beginner, skilled , advanced, export) to support workforce planning.
* Feed field observations back into module design, continuously improving both the method and the training.
* Establish the foundations of a repeatable, scalable training programme that can be rolled out to future TEPCO sites and, in time, a team.
* Create a train the trainer program to build scalable internal capabilities across all our projects.
* Monitor cycle times and identify operational inefficiencies impacting productivity.
* Conduct RCA of productivity analysis attributable to manpower skill gaps and implement corrective action/developmental plans


**Safety plus Quality Training \& Compliance**
* Ensuring all compliance w.r.t. QHSE pre\-requisites viz. required TPI of all machines, running essential checks on SOP requirements, Training w.r.t. safety aspects.
* Ensure all workers are trained and certified for critical construction activities before deployment.
* Conduct regular safety awareness sessions and practical demonstrations.
* Track effectiveness of safety training through reduction in unsafe acts, near misses, and incidents.
* Develop quality\-focused skill assessments and certification standards for critical activities.


****Position Demands****
 Frequent Travel to Project Sites

 Behavioural \- Achievement Orientation
   

  

 Behavioural \- Altrocentric Leadership
   

  

 Behavioural \- Initiative

 Functional \- Financial

 6 months to 1 year, with potential to continue post\-launch based on performance

 Director of Clinical Innovation and Medical Director
 



**What you'll do:** 
  
 



*Clinical guidelines \& protocols:* 
  
 


* Support development and documentation of clinical guidelines — screening protocols, contraindication checklists, and treatment pathways
* Help map patient segmentation logic (clinical stage, care history, symptom and comorbidity modifiers) into usable guideline structures
* Research and compare Indian and international clinical guidance to identify gaps and inform local protocol decisions



*Patient scenarios \& workflow:* 
  
 


* Map real\-world patient scenarios and journeys to stress\-test clinical workflows before launch
* Support design of the consultation flow — visit structure, screening gates, and escalation pathways

*Physician panel \& training:* 
  
 


* Support physician panel recruitment — sourcing, screening, and onboarding doctors into the network
* Help build and coordinate training curriculum and protocol onboarding for incoming panel doctors

*Location: Hyderabad* 




  





**About the Role:** 




  





 We are looking for a Composites \& Structures Technician to build airframe and structural components for our unmanned aerial platforms. You will work directly with the design team on mould layup, resin systems and finishing, taking parts from raw material to flight\-ready structure with responsibility for strength, weight and surface quality. This is a hands\-on shop\-floor role in a fast\-paced R\&D environment, with shift\-based working.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 • Perform hand layup, wet layup and vacuum bagging of composite structures (carbon fibre, fibreglass, aramid)
 



 • Prepare, maintain and release moulds/tooling for layup operations
 



 • Mix and apply resins, hardeners and matrix systems per process specifications and ratios
 



 • Monitor curing cycles (oven/autoclave) and ensure process compliance
 



 • Trim, sand and surface\-finish composite parts to specified tolerance and finish standards
 



 • Bond and assemble composite sub\-structures using structural adhesives and bonding techniques
 



 • Inspect parts for defects (voids, delamination, porosity, dry spots) and rework as needed
 



 • Support related machining and cutting operations on composite and structural parts using standard shop tools
 



 • Maintain tooling, consumables and workshop housekeeping/safety standards
 



 • Work with the design team on manufacturability and process improvement
 



  





**Requirements** 




  





 • Hands\-on experience in composite layup (hand layup/wet layup, vacuum bagging)
 



 • Working knowledge of resins, matrix systems, hardeners and mixing ratios
 



 • Experience with mould preparation, release agents and mould maintenance
 



 • Skilled in surface finishing — sanding, filling, trimming to specified finish
 



 • Familiarity with basic machining and hand tools
 



 • Ability to read engineering drawings and process sheets
 



 • ITI, Diploma or equivalent in Mechanical/Production/Composite Engineering
 



 • Willingness to work in shifts and in a fast\-paced, R\&D\-driven environment
 



 • Willingness to join as soon as possible
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Experience with prepreg composites or autoclave curing

title: Copywriter - Real Estate
description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW** 





 We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Copywriter to join our in\-house marketing team at Roswalt Realty. The individual will craft compelling copy across brand and project campaigns — digital, social, websites, brochures, emailers, WhatsApp, print and other marketing collateral.
 





 The right candidate has strong writing skills, storytelling instinct, an eye for detail, and the ability to translate project USPs into persuasive communication across multiple formats within tight deadlines.
 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 — 
 
 Develop copy for brand and project campaigns across the Roswalt Realty portfolio.
 




 — 
 
 Write for digital, social media, websites, brochures, emailers, WhatsApp, print and other marketing collateral.
 




 — 
 
 Create headlines, taglines, campaign concepts, video / reel scripts and long\-form content.
 




 — 
 
 Understand project USPs, buyer profiles and target audiences to create relevant and persuasive communication.
 




 — 
 
 Collaborate closely with the marketing, design, digital and social\-media teams.
 




 — 
 
 Proofread every piece of communication; ensure consistency of tone, voice and brand quality across all channels.
 




 — 
 
 Maintain a content bank, campaign copy library and a project\-wise messaging framework.
 




 — 
 
 Support pre\-launch, launch and sustenance campaigns for each project.
 




  





**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS** 




 — 
 
 2–3 years of hands\-on experience as a Copywriter or Content Writer.
 




 — 
 
 Real estate experience preferred; experience in luxury, lifestyle or an advertising agency will also be considered.
 




 — 
 
 Excellent command of written English with strong grammar and storytelling skills.
 




 — 
 
 Ability to work across multiple formats — ad copy, long\-form, social, brochures, scripts — while managing deadlines.
 




 — 
 
 A strong portfolio of previous work is essential (must be shared at application stage).
 




 — 
 
 Sensibility for luxury / premium tone; ability to adapt tone across mid\-market and luxury projects.
 




 — 
 
 Comfortable with feedback rounds; able to sharpen copy without losing the original idea.
 




 — 
 
 Comfortable with a 6\-day working week reporting from Oshiwara, Mumbai.
 




  





**KEY SKILLS** 





 Ad Copywriting  •  Brand Copywriting  •  Long\-Form Writing  •  Social Copy  •  Campaign Concepts  •  Taglines \& Headlines  •  Video / Reel Scripts  •  Brochure \& Print Copy  •  WhatsApp \& Emailer Copy  •  Storytelling  •  Proofreading  •  Brand Consistency  •  Luxury Tone  •  Real Estate Marketing
 




  





**KEY OBJECTIVE OF THE ROLE** 





 To produce high\-quality, brand\-consistent copy across every format — digital, social, print, video, brochures and beyond — that translates each project’s USPs into persuasive communication and builds narrative equity for the Roswalt Realty portfolio.

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
At Please See//, words aren’t just copy, they’re entry points into worlds. They carry meaning, rhythm, memory, and identity. We’re looking for a Senior Copywriter who can help us give brands not just something to say, but a way to sound alive, across platforms, moments, and moods.
 



 This is more than just a writing role. You’ll help shape brand voices, guide narratives, and work alongside strategists, designers, and filmmakers to build brands that people want to follow, feel, and belong to.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Write everything from brand manifestos and tone\-of\-voice guides to campaigns, social captions, packaging lines, and film scripts
* Shape and evolve distinctive brand voices, and carry them across touchpoints without losing the nuance
* Translate strategy into storytelling, bringing insight and instinct into every line
* Work closely with art directors, motion designers, and creative leads to craft integrated ideas
* Contribute to naming, messaging frameworks, product storytelling, and branded content
* Present your thinking with clarity, whether in a room full of creatives or across from a client
* Mentor junior writers and support them with clear, thoughtful feedback
* Stay sensitive to culture \- and know when to speak with edge, restraint, humour, or softness



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 5\+ years of writing experience in branding, digital, advertising, or content\-driven studios
* You’ve written for multiple mediums, web, video, packaging, campaigns, social, pitch decks, IRL spaces
* You understand the architecture of a brand — and how to find the voice that fits
* You don’t just write lines, you think in stories, you design in tone
* You’re collaborative, curious, detail\-obsessed \- and you take your craft seriously, not your ego
* Bonus: experience working with creative strategists, filmmakers, or cross\-cultural brands

**The Technical Writer is responsible for converting, migrating, formatting, and maintaining technical documentation from legacy formats, primarily PDF documents and, where applicable, Adobe FrameMaker source files, into Microsoft Word in accordance with Baker Hughes documentation standards, templates, and style guidelines. The role involves ensuring document accuracy, formatting consistency, content integrity, and compliance with established documentation requirements. * Experience working with PDF\-based technical documentation.

title: Senior Medical Information Writer
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
   

  

 Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
   

  

**Job Description**
**THE POSITION:**
 At EVERSANA, our integrated life sciences compliance team is taking a leading role in helping some of the most scientifically advanced Biopharma and research companies around the world to innovate novel therapies for rare, ultra\-rare and a range of critical therapeutic areas including Oncology, Neurology, Immuno\-oncology, Immunology, etc. This role is within the EVERSANA Compliance team, reporting directly to the Director, Medical Content Development and Medical Review. This person will also collaborate very closely with other team members within the EVERSANA Compliance Business Unit (Medical Information (MI), and Medical Affairs).
   

  

 This position will support various types of clients including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, digital therapeutics, and over\-the\-counter companies. This position is responsible for MI content development\-related client engagements.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Role: Monitoring and Documentation Officer

 Job Purpose
 





 The Monitoring and Documentation Officer will support the effective implementation, tracking, documentation, reporting, and knowledge management processes of the Transform Schools programme. S/He/They will be responsible for collecting quality data by following established processes, maintaining accurate programme records, tracking implementation progress, coordinating routine data collection, compiling field evidence, developing written and photo\-based case studies, and documenting programme learnings, insights, success stories, and best practices.
 




  






 Key Responsibilities
 



1. Programme Monitoring and Tracking


* Develop Project Management and Evaluation Plan (PMEP) and track programme activities against approved work plans and implementation timelines.
* Maintain updated records of school visits, trainings, meetings, workshops, assessments, and field activities.
* Support programme teams in collecting routine implementation data from districts, schools, and field staff.
* Ensure timely consolidation of activity reports and progress updates from field teams.
* Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual programme progress summaries.



  






 2\. Documentation and Knowledge Management
 



* Develop and maintain organised documentation systems (digital and physical) for programme records.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of data collection, processing, and reporting to support evidence\-based decision\-making and knowledge sharing..
* Compile training reports, meeting minutes, attendance records, field visit reports, photographs, case studies, and other supporting evidence.
* Document programme learnings, best practices, innovations, and field\-level experiences.
* Draft success stories, human\-interest stories, and short programme briefs for internal and external communication.
* Support the preparation of donor documentation and programme communication materials.


- 


  






 3\. Data Compilation, Record Management and Analysis
 



* Compile quantitative and qualitative programme data received from field teams.
* Ensure completeness and consistency of data entries before submission to the central programme team.
* Maintain updated databases and trackers for programme activities and outputs.
* Support data cleaning, verification, and analysis using EXCEL, PYTHON, R, etc., in coordination with programme and M\&E teams.
* Ensure safe storage and retrieval of programme records and supporting documents.
* Lead the design, management, and continuous improvement of digital data collection systems to ensure timely, accurate, and efficient programme data capture.



  






 4\. Reporting Support
 



* Support the preparation of periodic programme reports by collating field inputs and documentation.
* Coordinate with programme teams to obtain timely updates and supporting evidence for reporting requirements.
* Assist in formatting reports, presentations, annexures, and documentation packages.
* Ensure that all reports are submitted within agreed timelines and in the required format.



  






 Essential Requirements 
 



* Bachelor's degree in social sciences, education, public administration, development studies, statistics, economics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in programme monitoring, documentation, reporting, MIS, or administrative support in the education or development sector.
* Experience in maintaining programme records, compiling reports, and managing documentation systems.

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
In billions of syringes and in every second car worldwide, Datwyler components make an important contribution to the safety of patients and drivers. The high\-tech company focuses on high\-quality, system\-critical elastomer components and holds leading positions in attractive global markets such as healthcare, mobility, connectivity, general industry and food \& beverage. With over 25 production sites on four continents, sales in more than 100 countries and over 8,000 employees, the company, headquartered in Switzerland, generates annual sales of more than CHF 1,000 million.
   

  

 Our employees are the heart of Datwyler \- we treat each other with respect, trust and appreciation. We have strong roots and values that have been well established in our 100\-year corporate history. Become part of our great team as a...
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The responsibility of the Assistant Manager Regulatory Affairs is to support customers’ requests regarding referencing of Datwyler Drug Master Files for drug approvals, facilitate washing validations, ensure provision of standards, etc.
   

  

**Main Tasks \& Responsibilities**
* Responsible to assess customers requests for Letters of Authorization (LOA) to reference Drug Master Files (DMFs)
* Issue LOA drafts for US\-FDA, Health Canada and NMPA China.
* Maintain LOA data base, prepare analysis and share with the sales teams as required
* Prepare weekly data packages for DMFs \& support RA Manager for the annual reports of all DMFs
* Responsible for the availability of annual washing validation reports of all healthcare sites, review reports and transform into submissions formats.
* Arrange samples and testing data required for submission
* Support RA Manager in preparation of dossiers and preparing response to the Health Authorities
* Manage timely notarization and legalization of quality certificates/ documents
* Maintain ISO database \& support Datwyler employees in obtaining working copies of standards
* Track list of standards for updates / revisions \& support implementation of revised standards regarding CDS \& COAs
* Demonstrate competence pertaining to regulatory knowledge like pharamcopoeial requirements (USP, EP, JP, ChP), regulatory guidelines issued by EU, USA, China, Canada, ICH \& other health authorities
* Keep abreast with the new updates from Health Authorities like FDA warning letters, authorization of innovative products, etc.
* Provide regulatory support to Datwyler employees and customers
* Participate in different internal projects for regulatory support
* Update internal trainings for employees


**Skills \& Technical Competences \& Behaviors**
* Master or Bachelor degree in a scientific discipline (chemistry, biochemistry, biomedical sciences, biology, …) \+3 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs or R\&D or QA/QC in pharmaceutical packaging components or pharmaceutical industry
* Willing to develop detailed regulatory knowledge about packaging components, specifically rubber but also aluminium
* Entertaining frequent internal contacts with colleagues in various departments (R\&D, Sales, Quality, ..) and in various parts of the world (Europe, China, USA)
* Skilled in eCTD dossier preparation \& technical writing
* Punctual in maintenance and storage of regulatory files and documents
* Partially working from home office (after training period)
* Only sporadic traveling (less than 5 % of working time)
* Good spoken and written English


**Be yourself at Datwyler**
 We are convinced that people make the difference. At Datwyler, you will experience diversity and a wide range of career opportunities that only an international company can provide. Together, we are increasing our agility, accelerating digitalization and fostering sustainability. For motivated and talented employees, we offer interesting development opportunities with training and assignments in a global environment. With us, you can contribute with all of your creativity and all your ideas.
   

  

 www.datwyler.com

title: Technical writer.
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

 **Job Summary**

**The Technical Writer is responsible for converting, migrating, formatting, and maintaining technical documentation from legacy formats, primarily PDF documents and, where applicable, Adobe FrameMaker source files, into Microsoft Word in accordance with Baker Hughes documentation standards, templates, and style guidelines. The role involves ensuring document accuracy, formatting consistency, content integrity, and compliance with established documentation requirements. The Technical Writer will support documentation modernization initiatives and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver high\-quality technical publications.**

 **Minimum Requirements**


A successful candidate will have:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Technical Writing, English, Journalism, Mass Communication, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution, OR equivalent professional experience.
* A minimum of five (5\) years of experience in technical writing, document conversion, content migration, or technical documentation management.
* Strong command of the English language, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly and accurately.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Word, including styles, templates, section breaks, page layouts, tables, captions, headers and footers, cross\-references, and document formatting.
* Experience working with PDF\-based technical documentation.
* Experience converting and formatting technical documents in Microsoft Word while maintaining content accuracy and consistency.
* Basic familiarity with Adobe FrameMaker is desirable but not mandatory.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, SnagIt, or similar documentation tools.
* Proficiency in Simplified Technical English (STE) is desirable.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs, wiring diagrams, and schematic diagrams.
* Experience collaborating with SMEs to validate technical content and resolve documentation issues.
* Experience working effectively in global teams with flexible schedules.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify and resolve document formatting and content issues.
* Fundamental project management skills, including the ability to manage priorities and meet established deadlines.

**Responsibilities**


* Migrating and converting technical documentation from PDF and, where required, Adobe FrameMaker formats into Microsoft Word in accordance with Baker Hughes documentation standards, templates, and style guidelines.
* Applying approved Baker Hughes document templates, formatting standards, branding requirements, and style conventions to all converted documents.
* Preserving document structure, formatting, tables, images, captions, numbering schemes, headers and footers, and technical content during the conversion process.
* Reviewing converted documents to identify and correct formatting inconsistencies, layout issues, broken references, and content discrepancies.
* Standardizing document formatting and structure to ensure consistency across technical manuals, procedures, forms, and supporting documentation.
* Performing quality assurance reviews to ensure documentation accuracy, completeness, usability, and compliance with established standards.
* Collaborating with SMEs, reviewers, and stakeholders to validate technical content and resolve documentation\-related issues.
* Creating, updating, and maintaining technical manuals, service procedures, work instructions, forms, and related technical publications.
* Editing and optimizing graphics, screenshots, and visual content using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, SnagIt, or similar tools.
* Interpreting engineering drawings, BOMs, wiring diagrams, and schematic diagrams to support document updates and validation activities.
* Supporting documentation modernization and standardization initiatives through the migration of legacy content into approved Microsoft Word formats.
* Maintaining document repositories and ensuring version control, consistency, and traceability of documentation updates.
* Identifying opportunities to improve document quality, conversion processes, and documentation workflows.
* Managing assigned documentation deliverables in accordance with project schedules, priorities, and quality expectations.
* Focusing on technical accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement of documentation deliverables and processes.

title: Communication Officer
description:
**About the Organization** 




  





**IPE Global Limited** 
 is an international development consulting group providing expert technical assistance and solutions for equitable development and sustainable growth in developing countries. The group’s areas of expertise includes Social \& Economic Empowerment, Health, Nutrition and Water, Sanitation \& Hygiene (WASH), Urban Development, Education and Skills Development, Economic \& Public Financial Management, Monitoring, Evaluation \& Learning, Infrastructure and Engineering Development, Governance, Private Sector Development, Tourism Heritage and Conservation, Environment and Climate Change, Agriculture Development, Forest Governance, Grant and Fund Management and Information Technology \& e\-Governance.
 



  





 We are an ISO 9001:2015 \& ISO 27001:2013 certified and CMMI® Level 3 company. Over the last 18 years, IPE Global has successfully implemented 750 projects in over 100 countries, across 5 major continents. IPE Global has 800 full time professional staff and over 1000 empanelled consultants working on various projects across the globe, in different locations. The group partners with multilateral \& bilateral agencies including DFID, USAID, The World Bank, DANIDA, KfW, ADB, etc., governments, the private sector, not\-for\-profit entities and philanthropic organisations like BMGF, MasterCard Foundation, Children’s Investment Fund Foundation (CIFF), etc. in anchoring development agenda for sustained and equitable growth.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  




* Excellent content writing skills are essential
* Manage and update the corporate website and coordination with vendor
* Provide necessary support in developing various marketing collaterals, reports, documents, designing and printing of internal publications, posters, presentations, films etc. for various occasions/meetings.
* Strategic direction for conceptualisation and content creation for Internal \& External Monthly Newsletters
* Manage the internal communications effectively.
* Identify stories and issues that best highlight IPE Global’s Actions.
* Basic Design knowledge to create in\-house newsletter, one\-pagers flyers, e\-mail campaigns, info\-graphics, Posters, etc. would be preferred.
* Manage and Review all corporate websites on a daily basis and take all necessary steps to ensure that the content remains informative, accurate and up\-to\-date.
* Organise logistics for press conferences, roundtables, trainings, workshops /interviews and other media/visibility events organised by IPE Global or with Partner organizations.
* Ability to write, edit and proofread content various communications materials like brochures, flyers etc.
* Ability to convey information clearly and concisely to others
* Personal initiative and dynamism; ability to work both independently and in a team, with the ability to set priorities, and work to tight deadlines



  





**Education Qualification** 




  




* Formal Education Advanced University Degree (preferably Masters) in the field of Mass communication/journalism
* Masters /Graduation in English is preferable



  





**Qualification** 




  




* Minimum of 3\-4 years’ experience professional experience in communications, copy writing and copy editing.
* Prior experience of handling and managing website
* Strong Editorial experience / experience in writing copy and press releases (work samples may be requested)
* Proven writing and journalism experience. Analytical and conceptual thinking and ability to express in clear, crisp language.
* Experience in working in development issues
* Good communication skills, a willingness to cooperate and strategic approach

title: Content Writer- BFSI
description:
***Content Writer – BFSI***




***Location:* 
 Kirti Nagar, Delhi** 




***Work Mode:* 
 Work From Office** 




***Employment Type:* 
 Full\-Time** 




  





***About the Role:***




 We are looking for a skilled and research\-oriented
 *BFSI Content Writer* 
 to create high\-quality, accurate, and engaging content across banking, financial services, insurance, investments, fintech, and personal finance.
 



  





***Roles \& Responsibilities:***




 • Develop 3–4 content deliverables per day, including blogs, articles, website pages, guides, and other written assets.
 



 • Conduct in\-depth research on BFSI topics and create accurate, engaging, and well\-structured content.
 



 • Write on topics including banking, loans, credit cards, investments, insurance, personal finance, fintech, taxation, and financial products.
 



 • Understand and follow content briefs, brand guidelines, tone of voice, and client requirements.
 



 • Simplify complex financial concepts and terminology into clear, reader\-friendly content.
 



 • Apply SEO best practices, keyword integration, search intent, and content optimization techniques.
 



 • Ensure content is original, grammatically accurate, factually correct, and well\-researched.
 



 • Collaborate with editors, SEO teams, account managers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely delivery.
 



 • Incorporate editorial and client feedback while maintaining content quality.
 



 • Manage assigned content projects and meet deadlines and quality standards.
 



 • Stay updated with BFSI industry trends, financial products, market developments, and relevant regulatory changes.
 



 • Proofread and fact\-check content before submission.
 



  





***Requirements:***




 • 1–3 years of experience in content writing, preferably in BFSI, finance, banking, fintech, insurance, or related domains.
 



 • Strong command of English grammar, vocabulary, and written communication.
 



 • Good understanding of BFSI concepts and financial terminology.
 



 • Strong research, fact\-checking, and analytical skills.
 



 • Familiarity with SEO content writing and basic SEO principles.
 



 • Ability to simplify complex financial information for a general audience.
 



 • Strong time management and ability to handle multiple assignments.
 



  





***Preferred Experience:***




 Candidates with experience working on content for banks, NBFCs, insurance companies, fintech platforms, investment/wealth management platforms, lending or credit products, and personal finance websites will be preferred.

title: Communication, Advocacy and Partnership Consultant, Gandhinagar/Gujarat, India, Remote with travel, 15 months, Nationals
description:
UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.
   

  

 At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.
   

  

 UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.
   

  

 Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.
   

  

**For every child, the right to advocacy.**
**How can you make a difference?**
 At UNICEF Gujarat field office, communication, advocacy and partnership is working with stakeholders to advance child rights priorities and strengthen public, institutional and stakeholder engagement for issues impacting adolescents and young people. These efforts aim to address gaps in visibility, public discourse, policy attention, social mobilization and partnership\-building around key programme priorities, including health, nutrition, education, child protection, climate action, gender equality, adolescent participation and youth engagement.
   

  

 The UNICEF Gujarat Field Office in delivering outcomes aligned with the UNICEF Strategic Plan through:
   

  

* Convening: Engaging key stakeholders and influencers, including government departments, media, legislators, civil society, youth and adolescent platforms, CSR partners, private sector actors, academia, and digital influencers to advance child rights priorities in Gujarat.
* Converging: Facilitating programme integration and joint action across relevant government departments, UNICEF programme sections and partners by translating programme evidence, field insights and state priorities into strategic advocacy, communication and partnership initiatives.
* Catalyzing: Driving public discourse, policy attention, stakeholder action and resource mobilization, both financial and non\-financial, to support priority child rights issues and strengthen visibility, partnerships and advocacy outcomes for children and young people in Gujarat.


 The UNICEF Gujarat office is looking for consultant who will provide specialized, time\-bound technical support to develop and deliver a defined set of communication, advocacy, stakeholder engagement and documentation products that strengthen UNICEF Gujarat's visibility, public discourse, evidence\-based advocacy and partnership engagement around identified child rights priorities.
   

  

 If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here:
 ***Communication, Advocacy and Partnership Consultant \- External TOR.pdf***
***To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have...***
**Minimum Requirements**
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Communications, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Public Relations or another relevant discipline.

- Work Experience:

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in strategic communication, advocacy, media engagement, development communication, public relations or related areas.
* Demonstrated experience developing communication and advocacy products for government, development organizations, UN agencies, NGOs or comparable institutions.
* Experience in stakeholder engagement and partnership development.
* Experience in developing human\-interest stories, social media content and documentation products.
* Knowledge/Expertise/Skills:
+ Strong knowledge of strategic communication, advocacy, media engagement, social and behaviour change communication, and development communication.
+ Demonstrated skills in stakeholder mapping, partnership analysis, media database development, influencer mapping and CSR/private\-sector engagement.
+ Excellent writing, editing, documentation and storytelling skills, including experience preparing human\-interest stories, social media content, reports, briefs and advocacy materials.
+ Strong coordination, interpersonal and analytical skills, with the ability to consult multiple stakeholders and deliver quality outputs within agreed timelines.
+ Proficiency in MS Office applications and familiarity with digital and social media platforms, content planning tools and basic data management.
+ Language Requirements:
- Fluency in English and Hindi is required.
- Working knowledge of Gujarati will be an asset, particularly for stakeholder engagement, field documentation and review of state\-level communication materials.


* Desirables:
+ Prior experience working with UNICEF, UN agencies, government departments, development partners or civil society organisations will be an advantage.
+ Experience working in Gujarat or with state\-level stakeholders, media networks, youth platforms, CSR partners or private\-sector entities is desirable.
+ Experience in developing visually engaging communication products, social media packages, advocacy briefs, campaign materials or knowledge documentation will be an asset.


**For every Child, you demonstrate...**
 UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values
   

  

 UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio\-economic background, minority, or any other status.
   

  

 UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility \| UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance.
   

  

 UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18\). UNICEF has a zero\-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. UNICEF is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks, and will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially.
   

  

**Qualified candidates are invited to submit the following documents via the online recruitment portal, TMS (Talent Management System):**
* An up\-to\-date TMS profile and curriculum vitae (CV)
* Cover letter
* A separate financial proposal (only acceptable in the format of the linked template): TMC0005630 Financial proposal template.xlsx

title: Senior Technical Consultant, India Safe Water (EAII Advisors)
description:
**Description**
 This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
   

  

****About EAII****
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here:
   

  

****About Evidence Action****
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel\-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

****Requirements****
 The consultant will examine two related but distinct areas:
   

  

 (i) the MVS landscape, including its scale, infrastructure characteristics, operating models and existing water\-treatment arrangements; and
   

  

 (ii) the electrochlorinator landscape, including technologies, existing deployments, economics and potential use cases across rural water systems .
   

  

 The goal of this consultancy is two fold:
   

  

* Develop a detailed understanding of the MVS landscape, including its scale, major scheme archetypes, infrastructure and operating characteristics, existing treatment arrangements, and resulting gaps or opportunities for safe\-water interventions particularly in Evidence Action's priority states (AP, Bihar, Odisha, Rajasthan).
* Assess the EC market and determine the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs could represent a viable rural chlorination solution \- addressing ECs' fit within a broader rural chlorination technology option including tablet\-based dozers and other chlorination options.


 The final output should help Evidence Action decide whether, where and how to invest in ECs and/or other technologies to meet the water treatment needs of MVS in rural India. This would include analysis on the minimum technical, operational, financial and institutional conditions required for this type of intervention. Specific workstreams include:
   

  

**Estimating MVS Market Size and Identifying Key Market Segments**
* Conduct landscape analysis to estimate the total rural population served by MVS; verify estimates for EvAc priority states (AP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Odisha) via qualitative interviews and/or field visits as necessary
* Building on the analysis above, analyze the MVS infrastructure landscape to determine major market segments; identify key elements of each market segment that have relevance to water treatment, including system size/capacity, number of villages/population served, source and infrastructure configuration, existing treatment arrangements, and operating/O\&M models; estimate the size of major market segments in EvAc priority states


**Analysis of Water Treatment Solutions Relevant to MVS, Including ECs**
* Conduct landscape analysis to map water treatment solutions already in place to serve MVS across rural India; document best practices and key learnings from implementation to date; including functionality, operational and O\&M considerations where evidence is available
* Develop a market analysis documenting currently available water treatment solutions that would meet the needs of MVS systems (whether they are being implemented currently or not). While estimates for all of rural India would be useful, a focus on Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha and Rajasthan is a priority
* Develop a comparison model to assess key attributes of each water treatment solution, including cost, consumable requirements, maintenance requirements and implementation track record. Separately, develop a deeper analysis of the EC market, documenting currently available and late\-stage EC models, suppliers, existing deployments, performance, costs and operational requirements across relevant rural water\-system use cases, including but not limited to MVS
* Develop analysis to identify the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs are likely to be viable or non\-viable across different rural water\-system configurations, and identify the use cases where ECs appear most promising


**Recommendations for Strategic Intervention Pathways in EA ISW Priority States**
* Using findings from all analysis areas described above, develop summary recommendations for EvAc on potential opportunities within the MVS landscape and on whether, where and how ECs could expand EA's rural chlorination technology options, including scale\-up pathways, with a focus on EA ISW priority geographies. A recommendation to defer, limit, or not pursue ECs will be considered valid if supported by the evidence
* Recommendations should explicitly state which MVS segments and/or EC use cases, geographies, delivery models and risk controls are strategic for further testing or scale\-up


**Requirements**
* 15\+ years of experience with a focus on strategy, market shaping and/or management consulting; existing experience in the water/WASH sector preferred, but not required
* Experience assessing water\-treatment technologies, including technical fit, costs, maintenance and operating requirements; chlorination/EC experience preferred.
* Strong relationships or credibility with government, WASH institutions, implementers and sector experts in India.
* No existing commercial relationship with any of the EC vendors being evaluated
* Experience communicating technical material to non\-technical audiences, including donors, boards, or senior leadership


**Position Location**
**This is a 6\-month consultancy engagement,** 
 with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.
   

  

 We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
   

  

**Consultancy Fees:** 
 Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
   

  

**All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.**

 You can grow from German HITL/content quality into

 roles.

 The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability \& Technology (iFOREST), is looking for an experienced and dynamic professional to support \& lead the organisation’s research initiatives and policy engagement in the Industrial transition and decarbonization.
 



 A successful applicant must have a proven aptitude for analytical research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, and excellent communication skills with government, industry and related agencies. The candidate should ideally have sound
 **technical and policy knowledge and experience knowledge of working in Energy Efficiency, Energy management, Boiler\-based industries, and MSME sectors such as\- Food \& beverages, Textile, Chemicals, Pharma etc. Overall knowledge of industrial decarbonization is desirable.** 




  





**Location** 
 : Sector 132, Noida, India
 



**Required Experience** 
 : 5\+ years
 



  





***About iFOREST***




 iFOREST is an independent not\-for\-profit research and innovation organisation that was established in 2019 to identify, promote and scale up solutions for pressing environment\-development challenges in India and other developing countries in Asia and Africa.
 



 Our work is rooted in regional priorities to accelerate environmental actions at the sub\-national level and to improve national policies and plans to support it. Our mission is to address the unique needs of regions by leveraging our resources and expertise to scale up national action and make a global impact. We use our regional knowledge to inform national policy and plans and strengthen international collaboration.
 



 To achieve our goals, we conduct independent evidence\-based research, develop new knowledge and innovative solutions, convene stakeholders to increase awareness and build consensus, and partner with think tanks, civil society, government agencies, philanthropies and industry to scale up solutions.
 



***The Industrial Decarbonization Programmme***




 The Industrial Decarbonization Programme is a part of iFOREST’s flagship initiative on Enabling Energy Transitions. The objective of the programme is to steer a green industry transition to support green growth and green jobs, while improving local environmental conditions and achieving climate goals. The focus is on conducing evidence\-based research, including modelling studies to develop comprehensive roadmaps, identify policy solutions and provide technical support for industrial decarbonisation in sectors like steel, fertilizer, cement, bricks and at\-risk MSME sectors, as a transition in these sectors will affect the largest number of consumers and enterprises.
 



 The Programme is strongly focused on technical research and stakeholder engagement (especially with government departments/agencies and the industry) to achieve a green transition of fossil fuel\-dependent factories that are associated with various industries.
 



***The Role***




 The Programme Associate will be responsible for the execution of research and engagement outputs pertaining to industrial decarbonisation across boiler based industries and MSME sector. This would entail conducting impactful research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, with the support of a dedicated team. In addition, they would also be expected to identify new areas of work to support institutional goals.
 



  





 Specific tasks to be undertaken are:
 



**Support and execute the research initiatives of the Programme.** 



* Contribute to designing research assignments, including developing research strategy and methodology as well as identifying specific activities and tasks.
* Conduct in\-depth primary and secondary research including quantitative and qualitative assessments.
* Remain updated with the latest tools and techniques for executing qualitative and quantitative research.
* Write research documents, including analytical reports and policy papers based on evidence.
* Mentor young researchers in in the team in executing research assignments.
* Stay abreast with the latest developments and debates in the sector.



  





**Lead the outreach and communication** 



* Design and manage a comprehensive outreach strategy for the programme as well as for projects therein.
* Enable the generation of policy\-research partnerships with government, industry and other stakeholders.
* Author and review articles and other forms of communication materials suitable for the public, government stakeholders, and donors.
* Build and leverage relationships to design and conduct roundtables, convenings, and report release meetings with government, industry, civil society, media, etc.



  





**Additional duties** 



* Contribute to shaping the overall strategy for the programme, aligned with institutional priorities, sector\-specific issues and ongoing work of other key institutions.
* Identify new pathways, initiatives, and partnerships that contribute to programmatic goals.
* Support development of new concept notes, proposals, theory of change and budgets for projects/interventions that further institutional objectives.
* Contribute to the institution’s brand building by representing iFOREST on various public platforms.
* Execute any related assignments that may arise in relation to the tasks or for further enhancement of the programme.



  





***Qualification \& Work Experience***



* A Bachelors or
 **Master's in engineering is a must, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Energy System, and Environmental or related streams.**
* The candidate must have experience of research and work on
 **Energy efficiency; Energy Management; Boiler\-based industries and efficiency of MSME sectors, such as\- Food and Beverages, Textile, Chemicals, Pharma, etc.**
* Knowledge of industrial decarbonization strategies is also a must.
* A
 **minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience** 
 in industrial research, advisory, or consulting is required.

 .
