title: Writing Apprentice
description:
Writing Apprenticeship
 



 Location: Gurgaon
 



  





**About Athena**




 Athena is India’s largest and fastest\-growing organization in the premium undergraduate study\-abroad space. Founded a decade ago by two Princeton graduates, Poshak Agrawal and Rahul Subramaniam, Athena is headquartered in Gurgaon with offices in Mumbai and Bangalore, and has catered to students from over 26 countries.
 



 Athena’s vision is to help students become the best version of themselves. Through our transformative and holistic life\-coaching programs, we encourage students to embrace both depth and breadth—sciences and humanities—and apply their knowledge to address local and global challenges.
 



 Our flagship program has guided students to secure admissions into the world’s most prestigious universities, including Harvard, Princeton, Yale, Stanford, Cambridge, MIT, Brown, Cornell, University of Pennsylvania, and University of Chicago, among many others.
 



 With a legacy as pioneers in the study\-abroad process and a culture rooted in creativity, openness, and growth, Athena offers the perfect platform for individuals looking to build a lasting career in education and consulting.
 



 Learn more:
 
 Athena Education
 




  





**About the Role**




 As a Writing Apprentice at Athena, you will work closely with our Writing team to bring creativity, structure, and individuality to students’ college essays and creative projects.
 



 This apprenticeship is designed for early\-career candidates who have a strong flair for writing and editing and are looking to build hands\-on experience in a highly creative and dynamic educational environment. You will learn how to understand a student's story, identify compelling narratives, and translate their experiences into powerful written pieces.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 As a Writing Apprentice, you will support the Writing team across different aspects of the student essay and creative process, including:
 


* Work closely with experienced writers to understand students' backgrounds, experiences, interests, and aspirations and help translate these into compelling narratives.
* Support the ideation, outlining, editing, and refinement of college essays for applications to leading global universities.
* Review drafts for content, structure, clarity, grammar, tone, and overall storytelling.
* Brainstorm creative approaches and narratives that help bring out each student's individual voice.
* Assist students with creative projects such as theatre scripts, book writing, storytelling, and poetry.
* Support the team in conducting creative workshops focused on writing, communication, and storytelling.
* Contribute to internal and external writing requirements, including company communication and public relations content.
* Support the team with student interactions and counseling wherever required.
* Learn and gradually take greater ownership of writing projects based on performance and readiness.



  





**Key Skills \& Qualifications**



* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).
* Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably from a leading institution in India or abroad.
* Candidates from English Literature, Liberal Arts, Humanities, Journalism, Creative Writing, Communications, or related backgrounds are encouraged to apply.
* Prior internships or experience in writing, editing, publishing, journalism, content, or creative projects would be an advantage.
* Strong organizational skills, adaptability, and eagerness to learn.
* A proactive, detail\-oriented, and collaborative mindset, with eagerness to master the art of client management.



  





**Why Join Us?**



* Impact: Shape the journeys of some of the country’s brightest students – the pioneers of tomorrow. Your work will contribute directly to helping ambitious students articulate their stories and aspirations as they apply to some of the world's leading universities.
* Learning \& Growth: Work alongside experienced writers and mentors while developing your skills across college essays, storytelling, editing, creative writing, and student mentorship.
* Culture: Join a young, dynamic, and multicultural team from across the globe. We are ambitious, adventurous, and sometimes funny.
* Community: Work in an environment that values intellectual curiosity, independence, and creativity – plus, we love sharing food!
* Stipend \& Conversion Opportunity: The apprenticeship is an opportunity to understand Athena's Writing function deeply, develop professionally, and demonstrate your ability to take on greater ownership. Receive a competitive stipend during your tenure!



  





 This is more than an internship – it’s an apprenticeship. Perform well, and you can secure a full\-time opportunity with Athena.

title: Global Learning & Talent Development Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
**About Us**
 Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.
   

  

 For the better. Together.
   

  

 Are you ready to take the next step in your career? As a Global Talent and Organization Development Senior (m/f/d) at Hellmann Worldwide Logistics, you will play a key role in shaping our global HR landscape. This position offers a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting HR transformation journey—where you take ownership, drive innovation, and collaborate with a team of passionate professionals.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Learning strategy and capability building
   

  

* Develop and deliver a global learning and capability\-building strategy aligned with business priorities and our people strategy.
* Run learning needs analyses and identify capability gaps across functions, regions and talent groups.
* Build capability frameworks and learning roadmaps that support organizational growth and transformation.
* Translate business requirements into practical, sustainable learning solutions.


 Learning design and development
   

  

* Design, develop and continuously improve learning solutions for classroom, virtual, hybrid and self\-paced digital formats.
* Create facilitator guides, participant materials, toolkits, assessments, videos, e\-learning modules and blended programs.
* Apply modern instructional design methods and adult learning principles to keep learning engaging and effective.
* Keep content scalable, learner\-centered and globally relevant, while allowing for local adaptation.


 Talent and leadership development
   

  

* Design and manage global talent and leadership development programs, including offers for emerging leaders, high potentials and critical talent groups.
* Build career development pathways and learning journeys that support career growth and internal mobility.
* Partner with stakeholders on succession\-related development and targeted capability building.
* Support onboarding, upskilling and reskilling as part of an integrated talent approach.


 Organizational development
   

  

* Contribute to organizational development work such as capability modeling, role architecture and organizational effectiveness.
* Support the design of career frameworks and organizational capability assessments.
* Bring a learning lens to change and transformation initiatives.


 Learning technology and measurement
   

  

* Work with our HRIS and technology teams to make the most of our learning management system and other learning technologies.
* Manage learning content deployment, learner experience, reporting and analytics.
* Measure learning effectiveness through data, feedback and business impact, and act on what you find.
* Track external trends and emerging technologies to keep our learning ecosystem current.


**About You**
 Must\-have
   

  

* At least five years of experience in learning and development, talent development, instructional design or a related field.
* Experience designing and delivering global learning and talent programs in a multinational organization.
* A track record of building learning solutions across classroom, virtual, hybrid and digital channels.
* Experience designing leadership development or talent acceleration programs.
* Experience building learning journeys, development pathways or career frameworks.
* Experience working with a learning management system.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design methods, for example ADDIE, SAM, design thinking or learning experience design, and a solid grounding in adult learning theory.
* A degree in HR, organizational psychology, education, learning sciences, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, and a global, intercultural mindset.
* The ability to balance strategic work with hands\-on execution.


 Nice\-to\-have
   

  

* Certification in instructional design, learning experience design, adult learning, facilitation, coaching or leadership development.
* Familiarity with learning analytics and evaluation frameworks such as Kirkpatrick.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning solutions and adaptive learning platforms.
* Experience developing large\-scale global leadership academies or enterprise reskilling initiatives.
* Knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning or change management methodologies.
* Familiarity with skills\-based talent management and career architecture frameworks.
* Additional language skills beyond English.


**How You Work**
 We are looking for someone whose way of working reflects our values:
   

  

* Caring. You build trusted relationships, listen well and keep learners and colleagues at the center of what you design.
* Entrepreneurial. You take ownership, show initiative and stay focused on the impact your work has on the business.
* Forward\-Thinking. You bring curiosity and a digital mindset, and you keep improving how we learn and develop.
* Reliable. You deliver quality work on time, follow through on commitments and measure whether it worked.


 Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!
   

  

 If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY!

title: Content Writer
description:
**Role Overview** 




**We are looking for a strong Content \& Creative Ideation professional to lead content development and communication across Baidyanath Ayurveda and Goodcare.** 
 This is not a traditional content\-writing role. The person will be expected to develop ideas, campaign concepts, brand narratives and platform\-specific content across social media, creative, video, digital campaigns, performance marketing, websites, marketplaces and other consumer touchpoints.
 



 The ideal candidate should understand how modern consumer brands communicate digitally and should be able to balance brand storytelling with content that drives engagement, consideration and conversion.
 



**Preferred Experience / Brand Exposure** 




 Preferred candidates will have worked with a leading creative or digital agency handling FMCG, Health \& Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Nutrition or D2C brands, or have direct brand\-side experience with digitally forward consumer brands.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Content Strategy \& Ideation** 



* Develop the content approach for Baidyanath Ayurveda and Goodcare while keeping the identity, audience and communication style of both brands distinct.
* Generate campaign ideas, content properties, social concepts, creative hooks and communication narratives aligned with brand and business objectives.
* Translate marketing briefs into strong communication ideas and executable content.
* Identify relevant consumer trends, cultural moments, health/wellness conversations and occasions that the brands can participate in.
* Build recurring and ownable content formats rather than relying only on topical or product\-led posts.
* Develop content themes across Ayurveda, health, wellness, beauty, lifestyle, nutrition, FMCG and preventive healthcare.



**2\. Social Media Content Management** 



* Own ideation and copy development across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Develop monthly content calendars, post concepts, captions, carousel stories, Reels/Shorts ideas, product communication, educational content, engagement content and moment marketing.
* Adapt communication by platform, audience and objective rather than replicating the same content across channels.
* Work with social, design and video teams to ensure content is execution\-ready and delivered on time.



**3\. Short\-form Content** 



* Develop concepts and scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, influencer content, UGC videos, performance ads, product demonstrations, expert\-led videos and testimonials.
* Create strong hooks and scripts using a clear structure such as Hook \> Story \> Product Integration \> Benefit \> CTA.
* Simplify health, wellness and product benefits into engaging, consumer\-friendly communication.



**4\. Long\-form Content** 



* Develop and/or manage website content, product pages, blogs, SEO articles, campaign landing pages, brand stories, educational articles and product education.
* Create marketplace A\+ content, brochures, catalogues, longer video scripts, leadership/founder communication, thought\-leadership content and CRM/WhatsApp/Email communication.
* Maintain factual accuracy while ensuring the language remains simple, relevant and engaging for the intended audience.



**5\. Creative Ideation \& Copywriting** 



* Work closely with designers and creative teams to develop campaign key visuals, headlines, taglines, digital ads, performance creatives, marketplace banners, website banners, POSM and BTL communication.
* Contribute to packaging communication and print communication where required.
* Operate as an ideator, not only as a copywriter receiving briefs: originate the idea and then work with design/video teams to bring it alive.



**6\. Brand Tonality Management** 




**Baidyanath Ayurveda:** 
 Trust, heritage, Ayurveda expertise, efficacy, family wellness, preventive healthcare and credibility. The communication should make a legacy Ayurvedic brand feel contemporary and relevant without losing its authority.
 



**Goodcare:** 
 Modern, digital\-forward, conversational, younger, lifestyle\-oriented, benefit\-driven and social\-first.
 



**7\. Campaign Development** 



* Partner with the cross\-functional team on new product launches, seasonal campaigns, category\-building, product education, influencer campaigns, performance campaigns, marketplace campaigns, festive campaigns and brand\-building initiatives.
* Translate one central campaign thought into multiple formats across social, video, digital, commerce and offline touchpoints.



**8\. Content Calendar, Governance \& Coordination** 



* Develop and manage monthly and quarterly content calendars with visibility of upcoming campaigns, business priorities and product launches.
* Coordinate with activation, social, design, performance, e\-commerce, marketplace, product/R\&D and agency teams.
* Maintain consistency in messaging and tonality across touchpoints and keep a repository of approved content, product claims and creative assets.
* Track performance of major content formats and use learnings to improve future communication.



**9\. Performance \& Commerce Content** 



* Develop communication for Meta ads, Google/YouTube creatives, marketplace ads, D2C website campaigns, retargeting, problem\-solution communication and promotional campaigns.
* Understand the difference between Brand Content, Engagement Content, Performance Content and Commerce Content, and tailor the writing accordingly.



**10\. Trend \& Competition Tracking** 



* Regularly study digital\-first FMCG, wellness, beauty and D2C brands to identify emerging formats, consumer language, category trends and creative opportunities.
* Bring relevant learnings into Baidyanath and Goodcare without copying competitor communication.



**Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 8\-10 years of experience in content, creative strategy, copywriting, digital content or brand communication.
* Preferably from a digital/creative agency environment handling FMCG, Health \& Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Nutrition or D2C brands.
* Alternatively, strong brand\-side experience with a digitally driven consumer brand.
* Prior experience on social\-first and/or D2C brands is strongly preferred.



**Must\-Have Skills** 



* Excellent written English with strong command over headlines, hooks and short\-form copy.
* Ability to simplify complex health/product information without diluting the core benefit.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and digital\-first consumer communication.
* Experience writing short\-form video scripts and developing campaign ideas beyond executional copy.
* Strong storytelling, presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple brands and projects simultaneously.
* Comfort working closely with designers, editors, agencies, social teams and performance teams.
* Strong attention to detail and brand consistency.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Understanding of Ayurveda, wellness, nutrition, beauty or healthcare categories.
* Knowledge of Hindi and/or Bengali will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of SEO and marketplace content such as Amazon A\+.
* Understanding of influencer, UGC and performance content.
* Ability to interpret basic social and content performance metrics.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* An ideator first and writer second.
* Naturally curious about brands, consumers, culture and digital trends.
* Comfortable generating multiple creative routes for one brief.
* Able to spot a strong hook, campaign thought or storytelling angle.
* Equally comfortable writing a five\-word headline and a long\-form article.
* Capable of challenging repetitive or predictable content.
* Commercially aware and understands that content must support brand and business growth.



**This is not a role for someone whose experience is primarily limited to SEO blogs or generic social\-media captions.** 




**The candidate should be able to answer: “What should the brand say, why should the consumer care, and what is the most interesting way to say it?”** 




**Key Deliverables / KPIs** 



* Quality and originality of content ideas and campaign thinking.
* Improvement in social engagement and overall content effectiveness.
* Quality of short\-form video concepts and scripts.
* Consistency and distinctiveness of Baidyanath and Goodcare brand tonality.
* Timeliness of content planning and delivery.
* Reduction in repetitive/generic communication.
* Contribution to product launches, digital campaigns and commerce requirements.
* Ability to convert marketing briefs into execution\-ready creative ideas.



**Portfolio Requirement** 




 Candidates should submit a portfolio containing examples of:
 


* Social media campaigns and content properties
* Reels / short\-form video scripts
* Campaign concepts and key creative ideas
* Headlines / digital advertisements
* Long\-form writing
* Brand launches or integrated campaigns

**About Khan Academy**
 Khan Academy is a fast\-paced, nonprofit startup on a mission to provide a free, world\-class education for anyone, anywhere. We already reach millions of students every month and are growing rapidly. We’re building a library of world\-class instructional and practice resources that empowers learners. Whether they’re studying matrices, mitosis, or multivariable calculus, we want to offer students the resources to realize that they can learn anything.
   

  

**About Khan Academy India**
 Khan Academy India aims to deliver a world class user experience to learners in India that is locally relevant and is enabled by a strong on\-the\-ground team and operations. Our learning system is mastery based, which allows students to master key concepts at a pace that’s right for them before moving on to more challenging content. From serving under 500,000 learners in 2016, we are now serving almost 4 million learners a month across our websites, apps and youtube channels. These learners include both independent learners accessing us at home and teacher directed learners in schools. Our focus is to reach the underserved by making our content accessible in local languages. Khan Academy is already available in Hindi, Hinglish, Kannada, Gujarati, Tamil, Marathi and Punjabi.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Partner Operations and Support team at Khan Academy India sits at the intersection of various state teams, constantly receiving a wealth of valuable, on\-the\-ground information, ranging from local best practices to powerful testimonials from students, teachers, principals, and government officials. Currently, much of this qualitative data sits with the respective state program teams, and we risk losing these valuable insights over time.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Documentation and Learning Coordinator to streamline our knowledge management. In this role, you will act as our internal knowledge hub, synthesizing qualitative insights into structured, easily accessible repositories. You will ensure that when our team prepares for a critical stakeholder meeting (such as with state leadership), we have the necessary best practices and success stories well organized and easy to use. Furthermore, you will champion the dissemination of this knowledge across the team and proactively identify gaps in our current understanding to help us continuously improve.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To**
* Collate and Ogranize: Collate and maintain a structured repository of best practices, key initiatives, and implementation challenges across programmes, enabling systematic cross\-programme knowledge exchange.
* Repository Management: Build, organize, and maintain a highly intuitive knowledge repository. Categorize information into meaningful buckets so it is easily searchable and immediately useful for team members preparing for state leadership meetings or strategic planning.
* Internal Communication \& Storytelling: Effectively disseminate key learnings to the wider team. Translate synthesized data into engaging written communications (emails, newsletters), presentation decks, and active contributions during weekly team meetings.
* Gap Analysis \& Problem Solving: Critically evaluate the information we are collecting to identify missing pieces or blind spots in our programmatic understanding. Proactively communicate these gaps to the relevant state teams and create necessary resources to bridge them.


**About You**
 You are someone with:
   

  

* Experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in program coordination, knowledge management, or qualitative research. Experience in the Indian education sector is an added advantage.
* Strong Information Synthesizing Capabilities: You have a proven ability to sift through large amounts of unstructured, qualitative information, connect the dots, and distill it into clear, meaningful themes and actionable insights.
* Strong Communication Skills: You possess outstanding written and verbal communication skills. You know how to tailor your message, whether you are writing an executive email, designing a presentation deck, or speaking in a cross\-functional meeting.
* Problem Solving Aptitude: You don't just passively collect data, you analyze it. You have the critical thinking skills required to spot what is missing and the initiative to ask the right questions to fill those gaps.
* Systemic and organized approach: You have a natural affinity for creating systems and structure. (Proficiency in MS Office, G\-Suite is a must)
* A willingness to roll up your sleeves and help the team get work done as we are growing

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
Senior Copywriter — CRM, Product \& App (AI\-first)
 



 Team: Brand
 



 Works with: CRM \& Retention, Product UX, App Merchandise, CX
 



 Experience: 3\+ years
 



 Location: Indiranagar, Bangalore (In\-office)
 



  





**WHY DOES THIS ROLE EXIST?** 




 More of what we say to an existing pet parent goes out through CRM than through any campaign we’ll ever run. Push, email, in\-app, WhatsApp—it is our highest\-volume writing by a distance, and it’s the easiest place in the business for a voice to quietly go flat.
 



 It’s also where the money is. A pet parent who stays is worth more than one we win twice. Retention is a writing problem more often than anyone admits—the right words to the right cohort at the right moment, over and over.
 



 And the words don’t stop when the notification is tapped. The push lands, the app opens, and the same person now reads a home screen, a banner, an empty cart, an error, or a checkout button. If the message sounded like a friend and the app sounds like a form, we’ve lost the thread.
 



 Whoever writes the first line should have a hand in the next one.
 



 So, this role is CRM at its core, with two deliberate extensions: the product surfaces the message opens into and the app storefront it lands on.
 



  





**YOUR MISSION, SHOULD YOU CHOOSE TO ACCEPT** 




 • Think deeply about what pet parents would like, especially those who already trust us
 



 • Own every word we send an existing pet parent across push, email, in\-app and WhatsApp
 



 • Write to the cohort: new user, first order, repeat and lapsed
 



 • Map and write complete journeys across onboarding, retention, re\-engagement and win\-back
 



 • Carry the voice past the tap into onboarding screens, empty states, errors, confirmations and CTAs
 



 • Make the app storefront read like a shop someone wants to walk through, not a grid of SKUs
 



 • Test constantly, read the numbers and kill what loses—including the one you were proud of
 



 • Use AI to draft at volume, set up processes and ensure brand adherence at scale
 



 • Maintain a consistent brand personality across every channel and screen
 



 • Spot and avoid thnigs lyk thise
 



 • Collaborate with multiple internal teams to expedite the marketing team’s creative output
 



 • Create a tangible impact on the lives of pets and pet parents
 



 • Be around pets—a lot
 



  





**WHAT YOU’LL OWN** 



1. CRM \& lifecycle copy



 Every lifecycle surface—push, email, in\-app, WhatsApp and SMS. Each message should be written for the cohort and have a clear objective. A first\-time parent three days in and a subscription lapse at ninety days are not the same person and should not receive the same sentence.
 



 2\.Journeys, not sends
 



 Onboarding, retention, re\-engagement and win\-back. Map the whole arc, then write it. A brilliant one\-off inside a broken flow is still a broken flow.
 



 3\.Optimisation \& testing
 



 Own an always\-on testing calendar across subject lines, hooks, CTAs, framing and length. Read the results and act on them. Retire what underperforms instead of letting it run simply because it exists.
 



 4\.AI\-first production
 



 Generate cohort variants at volume, then edit hard. Build prompt and template systems so quality is repeatable and doesn’t live only in your head.
 



 5\.Product UX writing
 



 Own the screens our messages open into: onboarding and account setup, empty states, error and edge\-case copy, confirmations, permissions, subscription and vet\-consult flows, and button labels.
 



 The writing should be short, clear, kind and unmistakably us. You’ll work with Product UX designers inside their files and flows—not on a document thrown over the wall. When a pattern repeats, you’ll write it once and add it to the UX copy library so it stays written.
 



 6\.App merchandising \& category copy
 



 Own the storefront: home screen and banner copy, collection and category names, shelf and carousel titles, in\-app sale and campaign framing, and PDP support copy where it moves the needle.
 



 Merchandising is a weekly rhythm, not a weekly rewrite. Template recurring asks so this remains a corner of the week—not the entire week.
 



  





 Support \& service content
 



 Work with the CX team on macros, canned replies, help\-centre copy and FAQs.
 



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




 • At least 3 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, retention or UX copywriting
 



 • Real exposure to product or in\-app writing, even if it wasn’t part of your job title
 



 • Comfort working in Figma, inside a flow and alongside a designer
 



 • Proficiency in spoken and written English
 



 • Strong attention to punctuation, grammar and spelling
 



 • Creativity with both words and ideas
 



 • Awareness of current trends and news
 



 • An understanding of the tone required for different audiences
 



 • Experience writing for different mediums and channels, especially short\-form and character\-limited formats
 



 • Real AI fluency
 



 • An understanding of how marketing campaigns are developed, with the ability to contribute insights and words that create coherent, impactful brand campaigns
 



 • Comfort being the only writer in a room of designers, PMs and merchandisers—and holding the line on voice
 



  





 Location: Indiranagar, Bangalore
 



 Work mode: In\-office

title: Solutions Engineer - Sr Staff, DFT/ Design for Test
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Applications Engineer, DFT
* Product Specialist, Design for Test
* Customer Solutions Engineer, Semiconductor DFT
* Technical Solutions Engineer, TestMAX
* DFT Tools Engineer


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years deep in semiconductor design, and you know that getting a chip to tape\-out is only half the story. The other half is making sure it can actually be tested at scale, in volume, without blowing up the schedule or the yield. You understand DFT not as a checkbox but as a discipline that makes or breaks manufacturability, and you have the hands\-on experience with scan insertion, ATPG, and tool flows to prove it.
   

  

 You are comfortable sitting across from a customer's design team, listening to their constraints, their timeline pressures, their tool frustrations, and walking out with a plan that turns those constraints into a working solution. You do not just demo tools, you configure them, script around their edges, and make them fit the problem. TCL, Python, Perl are not languages you look up, they are tools you reach for without thinking.
   

  

 You translate well. Between customer requirements and R\&D roadmaps. Between technical depth and executive summaries. Between what the tool can do today and what the customer needs by next quarter. At Synopsys, you will work on DFT solutions that shape how the industry builds and tests silicon, and the customers you support will remember the difference you made.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Work directly with semiconductor customers to understand their DFT challenges, design constraints, and tool flow requirements, then translate those into technical solutions using Synopsys DFT tools including TestMAX Manager
* Configure, customize, and deploy DFT tool flows tailored to customer designs, including scan insertion, ATPG, and verification using TestMAX ATPG, Formality, and VCS
* Deliver hands\-on technical demos and proof\-of\-concept implementations that show customers exactly how the toolset solves their specific design and test problems
* Script automation solutions in TCL, Python, or Perl to streamline customer workflows, improve tool adoption, and address gaps in existing flows
* Collaborate with Account teams to gather requirements, align on customer priorities, and provide regular technical updates throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Partner with R\&D to surface customer feedback, reproduce tool issues, and influence product roadmap decisions based on real\-world design challenges
* Stay current on DFT methodologies, semiconductor design trends, and emerging test strategies to ensure the solutions you deliver remain relevant and scalable


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to achieve faster time\-to\-market by delivering DFT solutions that reduce design iterations and improve test coverage
* Increase adoption and satisfaction with Synopsys DFT tools by making them work seamlessly within customer design environments
* Strengthen customer relationships and retention by becoming the trusted technical advisor who understands their design challenges and delivers results
* Influence the direction of Synopsys DFT product development by bringing real customer requirements and pain points directly to R\&D
* Improve silicon yield and manufacturability across the industry by helping customers implement robust, scalable DFT methodologies
* Reduce customer support escalations by proactively solving tool flow issues and building automation that prevents common failure modes
* Protect and grow Synopsys' leadership position in semiconductor design by ensuring customers see measurable value from the toolset


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Master's degree (M.Tech or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
* 8 to 12 years of hands\-on experience in semiconductor design, DFT engineering, or related domains with direct exposure to VLSI design principles and design flows
* Deep working knowledge of Design for Testability methodologies, including scan insertion, ATPG, and DFT verification techniques
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as TCL, Python, or Perl for automation, tool customization, and workflow optimization
* Direct experience with semiconductor design tools and flows, exposure to TestMAX Manager, Formality, VCS, or TestMAX ATPG is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with customers, gather technical requirements, and deliver solutions that meet both technical and business objectives
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a track record of diagnosing complex tool or design issues and finding practical paths forward


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a messy design problem, and sketch out a tool flow solution on a whiteboard that makes sense to both the engineer and their manager
* You do not wait for perfect documentation or complete specs, you ask the right questions, fill in the gaps, and move forward with what you have
* You are comfortable being the bridge between customer frustration and R\&D priorities, translating "this does not work" into reproducible cases and actionable feedback
* You stay curious about what is changing in DFT, test strategies, and semiconductor design, and you bring that knowledge into the solutions you build
* You follow through, when you commit to a customer deliverable or a timeline, you make it happen or communicate early when something shifts
* You are technical enough to debug a tool flow issue yourself and collaborative enough to know when to pull in the right expert from another team


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join a team of Product Engineers and Product Specialists focused on advancing semiconductor design methodologies and delivering measurable value to customers. This team works closely with Application Engineers and R\&D to ensure customer needs are met with solutions that are reliable, scalable, and grounded in real\-world design challenges. The work you do here protects Synopsys' reputation for excellence in the semiconductor industry and directly influences how customers experience and adopt our DFT toolset.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
   

  

 \#TPG

**What’s The Role**
 Technical Asset Support (TAS) is a key enabler for the accelerated delivery of Shell’s Asset Management System and will help us to reach our ultimate potential in Downstream Manufacturing, Integrated Gas and Upstream. TAS provides high quality and cost\-competitive technical resources who are not physically present at site yet are an integral part of asset teams delivering value through end\-to\-end SEAM / AMS work processes.
   

  

 As an Associate Engineer \- Digital \& Drw Mgmt, you will support engineering document and drawing management in the energy industry by reviewing redline markups, updating and quality\-checking technical drawings and documents, and ensuring compliance with document control standards. It requires experience with AVEVA P\&ID, MicroStation, EDMS, and SharePoint, along with the ability to interpret P\&IDs, isometrics, and other engineering drawings, manage metadata, validate data quality, and support intelligent P\&ID conversion and maintenance activities.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Review red line markup (RLM) changes in technical drawings, collaborating with team members, incorporating revisions, and contributing to overall work quality. Work in EDMS (Doc Management tool).
* Proficient in interpreting and understanding corrections, redline markups, and updates across related engineering drawings.
* Proficient in AVEVA P\&ID as an end user with strong practical working experience.
* Ability to read, understand, and interpret P\&IDs, Isometrics, Plot Plans, and General Arrangement (GA) drawings.
* Strong knowledge of AVEVA P\&ID application, including object attributes, relationships, and validation checks.
* Generate and analyze engineering reports, line lists, equipment lists, valve lists, and other project deliverables from the AVEVA P\&ID database.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve AVEVA P\&ID application issues related to drawing connectivity, database attributes, validation errors, and reporting inconsistencies.
* Experience in preparing engineering documentation, drawing evidence, and technical records to support Root Cause Analysis (Why\-Why Analysis) and incident investigations.
* Developed automated workflows and reports to enhance engineering productivity and data integrity.
* Experience working in critical assessment and quality review environments, ensuring high accuracy and compliance.
* Hands\-on experience in conversion projects from non\-intelligent (legacy) to intelligent P\&IDs, including data structuring and tagging.
* Ability to analyze, extract, and interpret reports generated from AVEVA P\&ID for quality control and data validation.
* Good understanding of engineering data consistency, tagging philosophy, and metadata management within P\&ID systems.
* Interpret and validate Process \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs) based on process engineering principles, plant operations, and maintenance requirements.
* Identify discrepancies between P\&IDs, PFDs, Isometrics, Cause \& Effect diagrams, and other engineering documents.
* Perform engineering data validation to ensure compliance with asset tagging standards, drawing standards, and engineering best practices.
* Understand process flow, equipment functions, piping systems, control philosophy, and instrumentation represented in P\&IDs.
* Analyze the impact of proposed changes on equipment, piping systems, instrumentation, and associated engineering data.


**What You Bring**
* A graduate engineering degree with 3\+ years of relevant industry standard experience in combination of Process, mechanical, instrumentation \& electrical disciplines.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during peak workloads and provide flexible support across related processes within team scope.
* Hands\-on experience with AVEVA P\&ID and MicroStation is mandatory.
* Performed data validation, consistency checks, and quality assurance of P\&ID deliverables.
* Support Team Leads with drawing\-related queries and technical support needs, including training site staff on software and request tools, and assisting with pilot tests and demonstrations.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to deliver analytical solutions are essential.
* Strong stakeholder management and time management skills are required.
* Candidates should demonstrate strong learning agility and a growth mindset.
* Excellent communication skills and a quick learner. Be a good team player. Ability to prioritize and ensure delivery of priorities for the area of responsibility. Flexible and adaptable to change, with a track record of demonstrating initiative, analytical capabilities and problem\-solving.
* Ability to apply engineering best practices, codes, and standards to identify issues, recommend improvements, and implement solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder management with business interface exposure
* Strong interpersonal leadership skills are critical due to the requirement for effective communication of complex issues across multiple offices and teams.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects and programs simultaneously.
* Ability to independently, resourcefully, and creatively research and implement new solutions.
* Ability to engage and effectively communicate at all levels inside and outside Shell and within different cultural settings.
* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to challenge and ability to build internal and external relationships based on trust and to integrate across multiple functions.

 You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. title: Supervisor, Real Assets Operations Skills Development
description:
**About Citco**

 For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com .
   

  

**About The Team \& Business Line**

 As part of the Real Assets Operations Skills Development team, you will help build accounting, technical and operational capabilities across our Real Assets business through training, onboarding and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Your Role:**
* Develop, maintain and periodically update training materials, process guides and onboarding documentation in line with curriculum standards and guidance from the (Assistant) / Vice President and Subject Matter Experts.

* Deliver onboarding, introductory and process\-level training covering operational procedures, recurring tasks, documentation standards and system navigation.
* Provide day\-to\-day onboarding support to new joiners, helping them navigate training materials, process documentation and operational resources.
* Maintain training records, attendance logs, feedback trackers, version control and completion monitoring, and support scheduling and invitations for training programmes.
* Maintain approved training and process documentation within designated knowledge management repositories, ensuring information remains accurate and accessible.
* Monitor recurring operational errors, training challenges and documentation gaps, and escalate recurring training needs, quality concerns and recommendations to the (Assistant) / Vice President.
* Maintain a proactive internal customer focus, provide practical support to trainees, reviewers and managers.
* Perform other duties as required to support the Company's business needs.


**Qualifications**
**About You:**
* Degree in Business, Finance or a related discipline desirable; part\-qualified or working towards an ACA, CA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent professional designation an advantage.
* Minimum 6 years of private and/or public accounting experience, ideally including exposure to Real Assets and Fund Accounting.
* Working understanding of SPV accounting, real estate structures, operational processes, reporting cycles and review expectations.
* Experience delivering onboarding and process\-level training and supporting structured knowledge transfer, with the ability to explain operational and system processes clearly.
* Experience developing, updating and maintaining training materials, process documentation and knowledge\-sharing resources to established standards.
* Well\-organised, with strong attention to detail in maintaining training records, version control, attendance and completion tracking.
* Ability to identify content gaps, recurring training needs and process inconsistencies and escalate them appropriately.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, facilitation and business writing skills, with the ability to collaborate with Subject Matter Experts, Operations teams and Learning \& Development; solid Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills, and exposure to fund accounting systems (Yardi and/or Investran an advantage).

We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. **What's the opportunity?**

You will be using your functional skills, in\-depth product knowledge, and understanding of customer needs to identify pain points and provide a solution by effectively configuring product features and functionality within the Zenoti application. If you love to work collaboratively with the internal teams and our customers to help them succeed in their business, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Requirements**

* Working in the adoption services team, you will partner with customers to lead the implementations for feature add\-ons and enhancements to customer's Zenoti solution.
* Work with customers to understand their business requirements, define scope, plan and implement enhancements and adoption of Zenoti software features to streamline their operations and drive increased revenue.
* Independently handle customer adoption procedures while delivering excellent customer service.
* Lead demos, training, conduct walk\-throughs and solution reviews through excellent customer presentations.
* Drive proofs of concept and pilots for high\-priority and complex customers.
* Proactively identify and mitigate significant risks, unknowns, and issues to the implementation plan. Address customer issues and concerns in a timely manner to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Stay up\-to\-date on Zenoti product knowledge, business workflow, process and market positioning.
* Maintain thorough documentation and follow organizational processes to ensure successful implementation of Zenoti software features and products.
* Work and communicate across groups and articulate the needs for compliance and risk management.

* 10 years of experience in Implementation and support of Enterprise SaaS products.
* Strong software background and ability to master product functionality, boil down complex requirements into coherent and viable product design and configure software solutions.
* Strong business consulting experience or equivalent in an external customer facing role.
* Proven fast learner of enterprise applications, experience in implementing cloud solutions.
* Ability to communicate in business terms with non\-technical customer stakeholders, and translate their requirements into business solutions.
* Experience driving technical discussions, discovery workshops with customers, mapping business requirements to product functionality, for maximum customer impact and understanding.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in the areas of requirements and solution documentation.
* Ability to manage and work across multiple projects. Experience working with remote teams across different time zones
* Strong ability to demo/train and deliver excellent customer presentations.
* Strong logical, analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to learn new skills and operate in a fast\-paced and changing environment.
* Good to have knowledge of accounting principles, inventory management, and business processes optimization.
* Experience in the wellness/spa industry is a plus.
* Eagerness to learn about the opportunities and challenges driving revenue in the health and wellness industry.

title: Senior Copy Editor
description:
**The Team:** 
 Morningstar DBRS’s Research group provides independent analysis on individual securities, funds, markets, and portfolios. The Research group also provides data on hundreds of thousands of investment offerings, including stocks, mutual funds, and similar vehicles, along with real\-time global market data on millions of equities, indexes, futures, options, commodities, and precious metals, in addition to foreign exchange and Treasury markets. Morningstar DBRS is one of the largest independent sources of fund, equity, and credit data and research in the world, and our advocacy for investors’ interests is the foundation of our company.
   

  

**The Role:** 
 Morningstar DBRS’s structured credit research and ratings subsidiary, a Nationally Recognized Statistical Ratings Organization (NRSRO), is seeking an experienced editor to proofread, fact check, and polish complex financial reports for our investor clients. Our goal is to help investors evaluate structured finance investments, including commercial and residential mortgage\-backed securities, as well as asset\-backed securities. With Morningstar DBRS, structured finance investors have access to high\-quality ratings, investment research, surveillance services, data, and technology solutions. This position is based in our Mumbai, India, office.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Proofread and edit articles and monthly reports for accuracy, sentence structure, organization, grammar, punctuation, and spelling.
* Proofread, fact check, and edit presale reports for mortgage\-backed and asset\-backed securitizations.
* Ensure all reports adhere to Morningstar DBRS style standards.
* Work collaboratively to ensure high\-quality, error\-free content that achieves Morningstar DBRS’s mission to provide fundamental insight and analysis to help investors make decisions.
* Assist in other duties as needed, including editing marketing and compliance materials and correspondence with clients.


**Requirements**
* A bachelor’s degree in English, journalism, communications, or a related field.
* A minimum of four years of experience as a writer or editor with a credit\-ratings agency, general business and financial publication, or structured\-finance industry publication.
* Proven writing skills, including the ability to write a compelling lede, succinct conclusion, titles, headlines, and subheads.
* Ability to significantly rewrite copy to ensure organization is logical and easy to follow.
* Strong proofreading and editing skills as proven through the successful completion of Morningstar DBRS’s editing tests.
* Ability to do basic math calculations, including calculating percentages.
* Familiarity of Associated Press style and willingness to learn Morningstar DBRS style.
* Ability to handle multiple editing jobs simultaneously and meet strict deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint is a plus.


 Submit writing samples, along with a resume/CV and cover letter. Applications submitted without all three items will not be considered.
   

  

**Morningstar DBRS is an equal opportunity employer.**
**About Us**
 Morningstar DBRS is a leading provider of independent rating services and opinions for corporate and sovereign entities, financial institutions, and project and structured finance instruments globally. Rating more than 4,000 issuers and 60,000 securities, it is one of the top four credit rating agencies in the world.
   

  

 Morningstar DBRS empowers investor success by bringing more transparency and a much\-needed diversity of opinion in the credit rating industry. Our approach and size allow us to be nimble enough to respond to customers' needs in their local markets, but large enough to provide the necessary expertise and resources they require. Market innovators choose to work with us because of our agility, tech\-forward approach, and exceptional customer service.
   

  

 Morningstar DBRS is the next generation of credit ratings.
   

  

 If you receive and accept an offer from us, we require that personal and any related investments be disclosed confidentiality to our Compliance team (days vary by region). These investments will be reviewed to ensure they meet Code of Ethics requirements. If any conflicts of interest are identified, then you will be required to liquidate those holdings immediately. In addition, dependent on your department and location of work certain employee accounts must be held with an approved broker (for example all, U.S. employee accounts). If this applies and your account(s) are not with an approved broker, you will be required to move your holdings to an approved broker.
   

  

 Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in\-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in\-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

 → You can take a brief and turn it into an idea.

**And yes — your ideas will actually be heard.**

**We're looking for someone who can think good ideas.** 




**If you have a sharp mind, a curious personality and a slightly unhealthy relationship with words...** 




**We'd like to hear from you.**

title: Associate - Technical Content | HigherEducation
description:
**upGrad Private Limited \- www.upgrad.com** 




  





**About Us \-** 




 upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry\-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. Our mission is to create a new digital\-first learning experience to deliver tangible career impact to individuals at scale. upGrad currently offers programs in Data Science, Machine Learning, Product Management, Digital Marketing, and Entrepreneurship, etc. upGrad is looking for people passionate about management and education to help design learning programs for working professionals to stay sharp and stay relevant and help build the careers of tomorrow.
 



  





**Designation** 
 – Associate \- Technical Content (HigherEducation)
 



**Work Location** 
 – Pune
 



**Work Mode** 
 – In\-Office
 



  





**Job Overview \-** 




 We are looking for a technically strong, deeply curious
 **Associate \- Technical Content Research \& Learning** 
 to work closely with the creator. This is not a traditional social\-media or YouTube\-operations role. The primary responsibility is to research technical topics deeply, identify what is worth teaching, and help convert complex engineering concepts into accurate, engaging, and pedagogically sound content. The role will span three areas:
 **Technical Content Research for YouTube, Content Strategy and Curriculum Planning** 
 , and designing the learning journey for learners who move from videos into structured courses on the LMS. The ideal candidate should have excellent hands\-on command of DSA, strong software\-engineering fundamentals, and the curiosity to independently understand unfamiliar systems and technologies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \-** 




**Technical Content Research \-** 



* Research DSA, software engineering, system design, backend, databases, distributed systems, AI engineering, and other relevant technology topics for upcoming videos.
* Go beyond surface\-level internet research: read documentation, engineering blogs, papers, codebases, interview discussions, benchmarks, and credible technical sources to build accurate context.
* Break down difficult concepts from first principles and identify the misconceptions, edge cases, examples, analogies, and practical insights that would make a topic genuinely useful to learners.
* Validate technical accuracy of ideas, examples, code snippets, diagrams, and claims before they are used in content.
* Build research briefs for each video containing the core question, audience confusion, key concepts, examples, counter\-intuitive insights, references, and recommended teaching flow.



  





**Content Strategy \& Ideation \-** 



* Identify high\-value topics based on learner problems, interview preparation needs, software\-engineering relevance, emerging technology shifts, and gaps in existing educational content.
* Help build weekly and monthly content calendars across DSA, System Design / Software Engineering, and AI Engineering.
* Study strong technology educators, creators, courses, communities, and content formats to understand what makes technical education clear, engaging, and differentiated.
* Work with the creator to turn research into strong video ideas, hooks, outlines, series, and long\-term content pillars without compromising technical depth.
* Use YouTube performance data and learner feedback to identify which topics, explanations, formats, and series should be expanded, changed, or discontinued.



  





**Learning Design \& LMS Pedagogy \-** 



* Design the learning journey for students who discover a topic on YouTube and continue learning it on the LMS.
* Convert broad topics into structured modules, lessons, prerequisites, practice exercises, checkpoints, assignments, projects, and revision paths.
* Design pedagogy that moves learners from intuition to understanding to implementation to practice, rather than simply organising a collection of videos.
* Create or review DSA problem sets, examples, coding exercises, concept checks, and assessments aligned with the learning objective of each module.
* Identify where learners are likely to struggle and design scaffolding, hints, worked examples, prerequisite refreshers, and progressive difficulty accordingly.
* Ensure continuity between free YouTube content and deeper LMS learning so that the transition feels natural and valuable.



  





**Collaboration \& Execution \-** 



* Work closely with the creator during ideation, research, outlining, and curriculum design.
* Coordinate with video editors, designers, platform teams, or other collaborators when technical context is needed for execution.
* Maintain organised research repositories, source lists, topic backlogs, curriculum documents, and content calendars.
* Stay consistently curious about new engineering ideas, tools, architectures, research, and discussions across the software industry.



  





**What We Are Looking For \-** 



* Excellent hands\-on understanding of Data Structures \& Algorithms. You should be comfortable solving problems, explaining multiple approaches, analysing time and space complexity, and teaching the reasoning behind a solution.
* Strong computer\-science and software\-engineering fundamentals. Familiarity with areas such as operating systems, databases, networking, backend engineering, APIs, caching, concurrency, and distributed systems is highly desirable.
* Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technical topics independently and go deep enough to explain them accurately.
* Excellent research instincts: you should know how to distinguish a useful primary source from superficial or recycled content.
* Ability to simplify complex topics without oversimplifying or losing technical correctness.
* Strong written communication and structured thinking. You should be able to turn messy research into a clear learning narrative.
* Genuine interest in teaching and understanding how people learn technical subjects.
* High ownership, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and comfort working in an environment where ideas are frequently challenged and improved.



  





**Preferred Background \-** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated technical ability.
* 0\-3 years of experience in software engineering, technical education, competitive programming, developer content, curriculum design, or a closely related field.
* Prior experience with LeetCode / interview\-style DSA, competitive programming, teaching, mentoring, technical blogging, open\-source work, or building software projects will be a strong advantage.
* Experience creating educational content is useful, but deep technical ability and research quality matter more than prior social\-media experience.



  





**This Role May Be a Great Fit If \-** 



* You enjoy spending an hour understanding why a system behaves a certain way rather than stopping at the first explanation you find.
* You can solve a DSA problem and are equally interested in explaining the thought process that leads to the solution.
* You routinely ask questions such as “why does this work?”, “when would this fail?”, “what changes at scale?”, and “how would I teach this to someone seeing it for the first time?”.
* You would enjoy helping build not just individual videos, but an entire technology\-learning ecosystem around a creator\-led channel.



  





**What Success Looks Like \-** 



* Consistently publishes technically accurate, differentiated, and well\-researched content.
* Video ideas are driven by real learner problems and strong technical insight rather than generic trend\-chasing.
* Learners can move naturally from a YouTube video into a structured LMS path that deepens their understanding and gives them meaningful practice.
* Research, curriculum, and content systems become repeatable enough for to scale without reducing quality.



  





**Why Join Us ?** 



* Help build a technology education brand from an early stage and directly influence what and how thousands of engineers learn.
* Work across content, engineering, research, and learning design rather than being restricted to a conventional content role.
* Get significant ownership over research, curriculum, and new learning formats.
* Work on topics across DSA, Software Engineering, System Design, and AI Engineering while continuously deepening your own technical understanding.

**Job Summary:**
 We are seeking a talented and motivated Application Engineer (Product Selection and Quotation) to join our dynamic team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:** 
**Project quotation and costing**
 You will prepare accurate quotations for engineered systems, equipment packages and project\-based enquiries.
   

  

 You will review customer specifications, drawings, P\&IDs, Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and Requests for Quotation (RFQs) to determine the most suitable technical solution.
   

  

 You will prepare detailed cost estimates covering equipment, accessories, fabrication, testing, commissioning and logistics.
   

  

 You will work closely with our parent manufacturing factories to obtain pricing, lead times and technical clarifications.
   

  

 You will ensure quotations comply with pricing guidelines, margin expectations and approval processes.
   

  

**Technical support**
 You will provide pre\-sales technical support to Sales teams and Sector Managers throughout the quotation process.
   

  

 You will recommend technical solutions based on customer applications, process requirements and operating conditions.
   

  

 You will prepare technical bid documentation, compliance statements and product submissions.
   

  

 You will support customer discussions, both virtually and onsite where required, to clarify technical requirements and project scope.
   

  

**Project scoping and risk assessment**
 You will review customer requirements to establish project scope, assumptions and exclusions.
   

  

 You will assess technical, commercial and operational risks that may impact project delivery.
   

  

 You will highlight significant risks and recommend appropriate mitigation or escalation where required.
   

  

**Cross\-functional collaboration**
 You will collaborate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales Support and local assembly teams to establish realistic manufacturing and delivery timelines.
   

  

 You will work with Product Specialists and Engineering teams on customised or non\-standard solutions.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary liaison with our parent manufacturing factories for technical enquiries, product selection and quotation support.
   

  

**Documentation and process management**
 You will ensure quotations comply with internal procedures, document control requirements and ISO 9001 quality standards.
   

  

 You will maintain quotation records, pricing information and standard quotation templates.
   

  

 You will monitor quotation progress, conversion rates and win/loss trends to support business reporting and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will contribute to improving quotation processes, templates, tools and costing methodologies.
   

  

**Project handover**
 You will prepare complete project handover documentation for confirmed orders, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), configurations, drawings, schedules and commercial information.
   

  

 You will work with internal stakeholders to support a smooth transition from quotation to order fulfilment and project execution.
   

  

**Continuous improvement**
 You will contribute to process improvement initiatives and support cross\-functional projects as required.
   

  

**Who you’ll be working with
   

  

 Internal stakeholders**
 You will work closely with Sales teams and Sector Managers to develop technical and commercially competitive proposals.
   

  

 You will collaborate with fellow Application Engineers within the regional Project Quotation Team.
   

  

 You will partner with Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales Support, Product Specialists and local assembly teams to ensure successful project outcomes.
   

  

 You will liaise with our parent manufacturing factories on technical solutions, pricing and delivery commitments.
   

  

**External stakeholders**

**Skills \& Experience**

* Drive automation initiatives using AI and digital tools to streamline existing processes, improve efficiency, and enhance overall productivity.
* Identify process gaps, analyse information, and proactively provide solutions to improve operational effectiveness and customer responsiveness.


**Qualifications**

* Communication
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Personal attributes**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering accurate and timely work.
* A structured and organised approach with strong commercial awareness.
* Confidence working collaboratively across multicultural and cross\-functional teams.
* A proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability and commitment to delivering high\-quality outcomes.


**At Watson\-Marlow, we believe in taking care of our colleagues. We offer a generous benefits package, including:**

**Everyone is Included at Spirax Group**

For us, that means supportive teams and strong relationships where everyone’s contribution is valued \- across social and cultural backgrounds, ethnicities, ages, genders, gender identities, abilities, neurodiversity, sexual orientation, religious beliefs, and everything else that makes us human and unique.

title: Editor
description:
**About The Role**
 The Editor (AVSEC Focus) is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and editorial integrity of aviation security–relevant intelligence content produced across the MedAire and International SOS environment a 24/7 operational environment. The role plays a critical governance and quality control function in Aviation Security (AVSEC) alerting, ensuring alignment with MedAire Aviation Alert Reporting Thresholds and the AVSEC Alert Quick Reference Guide, and broader editorial standards. The Editor works in close alignment with International SOS analysts and editors and is expected to be technologically proficient with MedAire’s Content Management System (CMS). The Editor supports operational delivery by maintaining high editorial standards, ensuring outputs are clear, consistent, and actionable for operational and client use, and contributing to the continuous improvement of content quality across aviation security products.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Edit and publish aviation security alerts, advisories, and assessments in line with AVSEC thresholds and editorial standards.
* Apply the AVSEC Alert Quick Reference Guide to ensure correct alert staging, formatting, and lifecycle continuity.
* Act as a quality gatekeeper for AVSEC content, preventing duplication or misclassification.
* Draft and edit short advisories for breaking aviation security events and ensure timely delivery to clients.
* Ensure consistency of aviation security outputs across service lines and alignment with MedAire standards
* Maintain alignment to a certain extent with International SOS editors and regional security teams.
* Maintain reporting discipline, including adherence to daily workflows, publishing timelines, and operational requirements
* Provide editorial feedback and support to Security Specialists and analysts, including structured feedback
* Support training and development of team members to improve content quality and reporting standards
* Respond to client queries related to aviation security content as required, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and professionalism in all outputs
* Provide editorial oversight across multiple content formats, including written and multimedia deliverables
* Collaborate closely with global editorial, aviation, and regional security teams to ensure alignment and consistency.
* Apply sound editorial judgement to prioritise, escalate, and manage content during fast\-moving or high impact aviation security events.
* Builds strong working relationships across teams and regions; communicates proactively and supports collaboration in high\-pressure environments.
* Produces clear, concise, and well\-structured outputs tailored to operational and client needs; ensures consistency and quality of all content.
* Applies critical thinking and judgement to prioritise information and assess relevance during fast\-moving aviation security events.
* Uses CMS and operational tools effectively to manage and deliver aviation security content in line with required standards.


**CMS \& Technology Requirements**
* Strong working knowledge of MedAire’s CMS (Umbraco), or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to edit, preview, publish, update, and maintain aviation security content accurately.
* Adherence to CMS governance, alert lifecycle management, and quality assurance controls.
* High level of digital literacy and confidence working under time pressure.
* Confident use of digital tools in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive operational environment.


**About You**
**Required Skills and Knowledge:**
* High proficiency in copy\-editing and proof\-reading, particularly for time\-sensitive security content.
* Strong understanding of aviation security concepts including airspace, airports, operational risk and alerting discipline.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear and actionable content.
* Strong attention to detail and analytical judgement.
* Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks in a 24/7 operational environment
* Advanced digital literacy, including content management systems and Microsoft Office tools
* Ability to collaborate across regions and functions, and cross\-functional teams.
* Integrated cultural sensitivity considerations into operations, communications, and client interactions.


**Required Qualifications**
* Undergraduate degree in journalism, international relations, security studies, or related field.
* International experience and multimedia exposure preferred.
* Additional training or certification in aviation security, intelligence, or risk analysis preferred.


**Required Languages**
* Fluent in English
* Additional languages are an advantage


**Travel / Rotation Requirements**
* Ability to work in a rotating shift pattern aligned with 24/7 operations, including weekends and public holidays
* Ability to support high\-tempo operational periods during global aviation security events


**Experience**
* Significant editorial experience, ideally in a news, intelligence, or current affairs environment.
* Experience working with breaking news or time\-sensitive alerting environments.
* Experience producing content for a professional or operational audience
* Exposure to global security issues, preferably related to aviation or geopolitical risk
* Experience using content management systems and structured reporting formats
* Experience contributing to quality improvement initiatives in content delivery

description:

 Your public health expertise is more valuable than ever — and not just in clinics or government offices. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs to build smarter, safer AI models. We're looking for Masters in Public Health (MPH) graduates to help ensure that AI systems provide accurate, evidence\-based health information grounded in scientific consensus and ethical guidelines.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your domain knowledge directly shapes how millions of people will interact with AI on critical health topics.

* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions — Write rigorous, step\-by\-step responses that synthesize peer\-reviewed research, epidemiological data, and authoritative guidelines from sources like the CDC and WHO
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated health advice and policy recommendations for factual accuracy, potential bias, and adherence to ethical standards — flagging misinformation and logical gaps
* Refine AI Reasoning — Provide structured feedback that helps models distinguish correlation from causation, communicate health risks clearly, and adapt messaging to diverse populations


**Who You Are**
* Holds a Masters in Public Health (MPH), MSPH, or closely related graduate degree
* Strong foundational knowledge in at least two of: Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Environmental Health, or Health Policy
* Able to translate complex health data into clear, culturally sensitive, and actionable written content

* No prior AI experience required — we'll get you up to speed


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or research review workflows
* Proficiency with data analysis tools such as R, SAS, or Stata
* Background in health communication, clinical research coordination, or public health surveillance


**Why Join Us**
* Work on high\-impact AI projects with leading research labs and teams
* Fully remote and asynchronous — work on your own schedule, 10–40 hours/week
* Freelance flexibility: high autonomy, global reach, and meaningful variety in your work
* Directly contribute to making AI safer and more accurate on topics that affect public health worldwide
