title: Digital Learning consultant
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Way of Working Definition:** 
 Help translate our Project Management process into clearly defined ways of working, ensuring clarity on how ServiceNow SPM enables the execution of the process.
* **Training Content Creation:** 
 Design and build digital learning content to enable clear communication of expected ways of working to the ServiceNow SPM user community. This includes the primary user guide and other formats such as simulations, guided walkthroughs etc. This should be customized based on the user persona.
* **Digital Learning Experience \& Certification:** 
 Define and build structured paths, per persona, for the user community in Learning. This should ensure that they are confident in how they should utilize the tool and maximize use of key features. You will plan and execute a program of certification that enables a progressive learning path and assure user competence. Ensure accessibility, consistency, and compliance with Learning best practice.
* **Learning Governance \& Quality Management:** 
 Lead the creation and maintenance of learning governance. This should include the roles and responsibilities of all Triumph leaders and the publication of an end to end process that control how new content creation or change is triggered and managed ( new feature delivery, changes to way of working, response to user feedback etc ).
* **User Adoption / Satisfaction** 
 : Help drive user adoption of the tool by regularly engaging with the user community for their feedback and translating them into improved learning experiences.



  





**Key Interlocks:** 



* **Global Process Leadership (GPL) Teams:** 
 The GPL teams own their processes and are responsible for defining the overall, expected way of working in ServiceNow SPM. You will support them by translating this into appropriate training materials. Note: the GPLs delegate the
 
 detailed feature definition
 
 to the Epic Owners.
* **Triumph Epic Owners:** 
 The epic owners (also known as Workstream leaders) are responsible for specific elements of SPM functionality (Resource Management, Financial Management etc). They request new capability (including specification of features/user stories and UAT) and are responsible for their elements delivering business requirements. You will work closely with them on the details of the training materials.
* **Triumph Program Manager:** 
 The Program Manager will ensure that your work helps drives the expected capability improvements and business benefits. They will also ensure that all program resources are mobilized to work with you effectively.
* **ServiceNow SPM Product Manager:** 
 The Product Manager helps you to understand that "why" and "what" (strategy, use cases, roadmap), while you will define the "how" (effective learning methods, documentation) to ensure user adoption.
* **SPM Delivery Manager:** 
 The Delivery Manager controls the delivery of new tooling capability. You will work closely with them to understand what new features are being delivered and when, enabling you to plan and execute training content design and delivery.
* **SPM Support \& Communications Manager** 
 : You will coordinate with the Support \& Communications Manager in 2 ways. Firstly, they will help you to communicate with the user community in the most effective way and they will ensure you receive feedback from the user community based on support requests.
* **SPM User Adoption Manager:** 
 The User Adoption Manager is overall responsible for driving increases in user adoption and project quality. You will work hand in hand with them to ensure that the digital learning experience meets their needs and that feedback from the user community is funneled to you.



  





**Success Criteria:** 



* All training materials represent the current ways of working and are updated in line with each iteration release (where appropriate).
* Training materials are available in both English and French (note: French team members will provide the translation).
* New features are communicated and appropriate training delivered, minimizing business disruption.
* Increased user adoption and project quality (to be measured by User Adoption Manager).
* High user satisfaction scores in user surveys, relating to training content and delivery.
* Reduction in tool usage errors and support requests.
* High\-quality, engaging, and consistent training assets published Learning.
* 95% \+ of user community completing learning paths ( per persona ) and gaining SPM certification.

title: Consultant — Enterprise Change & Transformation
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
   

  

 At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
   

  

**We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.**
 The Enterprise Change \& Transformation Consultant builds organizations' capacity to change continuously — not just to land a single initiative. Rather than executing one\-off communication and training plans for a discrete rollout, this role helps clients stand up durable change capability: Centers of Excellence, self\-service playbooks, and manager\-led change practices that make the organization resilient to constant transformation, well beyond any one project's go\-live date.
   

  

 Consistent with AHEAD's Consultant capability tier, this role is the engine of an engagement: day\-to\-day contact for analyst\- and manager\-level client stakeholders, and owner of a discrete enterprise change and transformation deliverable or workstream. The Consultant structures sub\-problems, develops hypotheses, and produces client\-ready work with limited supervision, while beginning to informally coach Associates.
   

  

**What's New In This Role**
 From Project\-Based to Capability Building
   

  

 This role moves beyond writing communication plans and hosting training sessions for a single software rollout or restructure. The focus shifts to establishing internal Centers of Excellence, coaching line managers to lead their own teams through constant shifts, and creating scalable self\-service playbooks so the entire organization becomes resilient to ongoing transformation — not just the current project.
   

  

 From Activity Metrics to Value Realization
   

  

 Success is no longer measured by output metrics such as emails sent, town halls hosted, or training modules completed. The Consultant uses data and analytics to prove actual behavioral change, tracks real business outcomes, and measures value realization long after a project's go\-live date.
   

  

 Integration of Artificial Intelligence
   

  

 Rather than relying entirely on manual stakeholder mapping, generic templates, and human\-crafted messaging, the Consultant utilizes enterprise AI tools to draft communications, analyze employee feedback sentiment, map impact data rapidly, and scale day\-to\-day practitioner workflows.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Enterprise Change Capability \& Transformation
   

  

* Support the design and stand\-up of client Centers of Excellence (CoE) for change, including governance, playbooks, and role definitions that let the client sustain change practice after AHEAD's engagement ends.
* Coach line managers to lead their own teams through continuous, overlapping shifts, building manager\-led change capability rather than centralizing it with the project team.
* Develop scalable, self\-service change playbooks, toolkits, and templates that business units can apply independently to future transformations.
* Apply OCM theories and models, such as Prosci and ADKAR, to develop and conduct OCM assessments and plans, adapted for an enterprise, continuous\-change context rather than a single rollout.
* Analyze change impacts across processes, systems, culture, and people; identify affected stakeholders and understand their needs, concerns, and influence across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Support the development of digital transformation roadmaps and lead defined workstreams that translate business needs into actionable change, adoption, and implementation plans.
* Provide change management guidance to project teams and business partners, with an emphasis on building their independent change capability.


 Value Realization \& Outcome Measurement
   

  

* Design and track outcome\-based metrics — behavioral adoption, productivity, and business KPIs — rather than activity metrics such as communications sent or sessions hosted.
* Use data and analytics to demonstrate actual behavioral change resulting from transformation initiatives, and to identify where adoption is stalling.
* Establish stakeholder feedback mechanisms, analyze feedback, and recommend adjustments to the change management strategy based on evidence, not activity completion.
* Support the identification and tracking of KPIs, surveys, and reports that measure business value realization well beyond a project's go\-live date.
* Build basic financial and business\-case components (cost/benefit, ROI/TCO inputs) that tie change outcomes to the commercial story.


 AI\-Enabled Change Practice
   

  

* Utilize enterprise AI tools to draft stakeholder communications, accelerating and improving the quality of first\-draft messaging.
* Apply AI\-based sentiment analysis to employee feedback to surface adoption risk and stakeholder concerns faster than manual review allows.
* Use AI\-assisted tools to rapidly map change impact and stakeholder data across large or overlapping initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to scale day\-to\-day practitioner workflows (stakeholder mapping, reporting, content drafting) using enterprise AI tools, in place of fully manual methods.


 Engagement \& Practice Contribution
   

  

* Manage assigned deliverables and support enterprise change and digital transformation initiatives as part of larger project engagements, exercising judgment with appropriate oversight.
* Manage communication across multiple stakeholder groups, including senior leadership, and facilitate team meetings and presentations.
* Structure sub\-problems within a workstream into a clear analytical workplan, identifying the right analyses, inputs, and sequence of work, and explain to a Manager why the approach answers the client's question.
* Develop preliminary hypotheses with guidance from a Senior Consultant or Manager, design analyses that test them, and update the hypothesis when the data disagrees.
* Develop a working understanding of project economics on assigned engagements — billing rates, team composition, utilization targets, and margin structure.
* Informally coach Associates on the engagement, improving how they structure work, review output, and explain their thinking.
* Support at least one practice\-building initiative by producing reusable content (playbooks, frameworks, case studies) adopted by other teams.
* Own research and analysis for at least one thought\-leadership workstream, contributing analytical content to a published point of view or white paper.
* Identify follow\-on opportunities on current engagements and surface client needs to engagement leadership; contribute to 1–2 proposals or pursuits per year, owning sections of the response with guidance.


**Core Skills \& Capabilities**
* Strong understanding of change management fundamentals and enterprise change capability\-building, backed by at least 3 years of hands\-on OCM or transformation experience.
* Ability to design and stand up scalable change capability (Centers of Excellence, self\-service playbooks, manager\-led practices) rather than only executing a project\-specific plan.
* Ability to define and track outcome\- and value\-based metrics, distinct from activity metrics, and to connect change adoption to business results.
* Working proficiency with enterprise AI tools for communications drafting, sentiment analysis, and impact/stakeholder mapping, applied with sound judgment.
* Proficiency in the Prosci ADKAR methodology, with the ability to apply Prosci tools and frameworks to assess change readiness, build change plans, and drive adoption.
* Strong project management, critical thinking, problem\-solving, data analysis, and information\-structuring skills.
* Ability to support digital transformation roadmapping and lead defined initiative workstreams in partnership with client stakeholders and project teams.
* Working knowledge of project economics — billing rates, utilization, and margin — sufficient to support scope and staffing conversations with engagement leadership.


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Client relationship management, including building trust, managing expectations, and serving as a credible advisor to business and IT stakeholders at the analyst and manager level.
* Business acumen, with the ability to understand client industries, operating models, and strategic priorities to frame recommendations in business terms.
* Executive presence and polished presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to senior leadership and diverse audiences.
* Analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable workstreams and defensible hypotheses.
* Effective time management and prioritization across multiple workstreams, deliverables, and competing deadlines in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Collaborative teaming skills, working effectively within cross\-functional project teams and adapting style to diverse team and client cultures.
* Informal coaching and feedback skills — makes junior team members better through the way work is structured, reviewed, and explained, without formal management authority.
* Proficiency with core consulting toolkits (e.g., PowerPoint, Excel, Word) and enterprise AI tools to produce polished deliverables, executive\-ready presentations, and data\-driven analyses.
* Adaptability and sound judgment when navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and evolving client needs across engagements.


**Required Qualifications**
* Minimum 3 years of recent, relevant Organizational Change Management (OCM) or enterprise transformation experience, including supporting, driving, and facilitating change as part of a project or transformation; 5\-8 years of overall professional experience consistent with AHEAD's Consultant capability tier.
* Demonstrated success delivering client services in a collaborative, dynamic, and fast\-paced environment.
* Previous experience supporting organizational change efforts of varying scale and complexity; experience building change capability (CoEs, playbooks, manager coaching) is a plus.
* Experience using data and analytics to measure adoption or business outcomes, beyond activity\-based reporting, is a plus.
* Familiarity or hands\-on experience with enterprise AI tools applied to communications, sentiment analysis, or stakeholder/impact mapping is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to own a discrete deliverable or workstream with limited supervision, and to informally coach or support junior team members.
* Prosci certification required.
* Willing and able to travel to client sites as needed for project delivery, approximately 25%.


**Growth Path**
 This role sits at the Consultant tier of AHEAD's Career GPS capability ladder. Growth into Senior Consultant is marked by leading multiple workstreams in parallel, shaping approach and workplans rather than executing tasks handed down, actively coaching juniors, owning client sub\-relationships, and
   

  

 proactively identifying and escalating delivery risks — increasingly applied to enterprise\-scale change capability rather than single\-project change management
   

  

**Why AHEAD**
 Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
   

  

 We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

title: Process Integration Development (PID) Engineer – Advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) Integration
description:
Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India's first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata Group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission "To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust."
 



  





**Job Description** 




 We are seeking an experienced Process Integration Development (PID) Engineer – MEOL/BEOL Integration for advanced CMOS technologies at 28nm and below, including FinFET nodes. This role is responsible for driving advanced CMOS Process Integration Development, with primary ownership of advanced interconnects (MEOL/BEOL) process integration, enabling technology development, device performance optimization, yield enhancement, and manufacturing readiness.
 



 The successful candidate will drive advanced MEOL/BEOL process integration while working across MEOL/BEOL integration, process\-device interactions, silicon characterization, DOE development, process optimization, technology qualification, technology transfer, and high\-volume manufacturing ramp. The role requires close collaboration with Process Module, Device, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
 



 At Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL), the Technology Development organization is responsible for developing, qualifying, and transferring various technology platforms from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing, enabling world\-class semiconductor technologies and manufacturing excellence.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Own advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) process integration for advanced CMOS technologies (28nm and below), including silicide formation, self\-aligned contacts (SAC), local interconnects, via integration, Cu dual\-damascene processing, low\-k dielectric integration, barrier/liner engineering, RC optimization, and interconnect reliability to achieve target device performance, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Develop and optimize CMOS Process Integration technologies for 28nm and below technology nodes by driving process\-device interactions, DOE\-driven silicon learning, process characterization, and process window optimization.
* Analyze process integration trade\-offs using strong semiconductor device physics to optimize transistor characteristics, including Vt, Id, Ioff, DIBL, SS, mobility, matching, variability, and reliability, while achieving target device performance and manufacturability.
* Support technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp activities, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Drive manufacturing excellence through defect reduction, process capability enhancement, process robustness, and yield ramp activities using SPC, Cp/Cpk analysis, defect Pareto analysis, excursion investigations, and root\-cause analysis to improve process stability, device performance, and yield.

* Strong expertise in advanced CMOS Process Integration for 28nm and below technology nodes, with solid understanding of MEOL and BEOL integration, process\-device interactions, and semiconductor manufacturing.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with proven experience in DOE development, process characterization, statistical analysis, process window optimization, silicon learning, and root\-cause analysis of process, device, yield, and reliability issues.
* Proven experience in technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Demonstrated track record in yield improvement, defect reduction, SPC, Cp/Cpk enhancement, excursion management, process robustness, and high\-volume manufacturing support for advanced semiconductor technologies.
* Ability to correlate inline metrology, WAT/PCM, electrical characterization, defectivity, physical analysis, reliability, and yield data to identify integration risks, process sensitivities, and process optimization opportunities.
* Experience with TCAD, JMP, Python, statistical tools, and advanced data analytics (AI/ML methodologies) is a plus.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills with Device, Process Module, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
* Strong communication, technical presentation, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to drive innovation, continuous improvement, and technical decision\-making in a fast\-paced semiconductor technology development environment.



**Qualifications** 



* M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 3\+ to 10 years of experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 7\+ to 15 years of experience.

title: Content Writing Intern
description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing content function, and this internship is the entry point into that function.  
We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans custom software development, AI implementation, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.  
This is an entry\-level writing role with a specific, practical purpose. It is not a social media role and it is not a generalist marketing role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.

What This Role Exists to Do  
Technology is complicated. Our job is to make it clear. This role exists to support the production of written content that explains what 2Base does, what problems we solve, and why that matters to the people we work with. The output is blog posts that earn attention, social copies that are actually read, and supporting content that helps the marketing function move.  
You will work from structured briefs, receive direct feedback on every draft, and build a practical foundation in technology content writing. The audience is technical leaders and business decision\-makers at mid\-market companies. Writing that is clear, specific, and free of noise. That is the standard you will be working towards and learning to meet.

What You Will Own  
First drafts of blog posts on technology topics including software development, AI implementation, digital transformation, and IT services written from structured briefs provided by the Marketing Manager  
Social media copies for the 2Base LinkedIn page and other channels, produced to brief and reviewed before publishing  
Research for content briefs – gathering background, understanding the topic, and returning with enough substance to write from  
Supporting long\-form content production: contributing sections, drafts, and revisions under direction  
Proofreading and editing your own drafts against 2Base brand voice guidelines before submitting

What You Will Not Own  
Content strategy and editorial planning: the Marketing Manager sets the direction and you execute within it  
Publishing decisions: a separate team member manages scheduling and publishing  
Visual design of content assets: the design function owns this  
SEO keyword selection: the SEO specialist sets this and you write within it  
Campaign strategy or audience definition  
Client\-facing communications of any kind

Requirements  
Experience  
Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience. Internship experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, or technical writing counts.  
Has written something anything that demonstrates the ability to put ideas into clear, readable sentences. College submissions, personal blogs, LinkedIn posts, college magazine articles, or internship work all qualify.  
Has used AI writing tools and understands both their value and their limits. AI is a tool in this role, not the writer.  
Background in engineering, computer science, or information technology is preferred. Graduates from other streams with demonstrated interest in technology topics are also considered.

Writing Ability  
Writes clearly in English. Not without errors that improves with practice – but with a clear structure and a readable point.  
Can read a brief and produce something that addresses it, rather than writing whatever comes to mind  
Accepts feedback and revises drafts without treating the edit as personal criticism  
Does not pad. Does not repeat the same point in different words to fill length.

Mindset  
Genuinely curious about technology topics: not faking interest to get the job, but actually reading and thinking about what software, AI, and digital infrastructure do in the real world  
Comfortable not knowing things and asking questions before writing rather than guessing  
Fast enough to produce a first draft within a day of receiving a brief, knowing it will be edited  
Treats writing as a skill to develop, not a talent they either have or do not have

What We Are Not Looking For  
Candidates who cannot write a coherent paragraph in English independently  
Candidates whose primary interest is social media management, graphic design, or video content, who see this as the nearest available opening  
Candidates who use AI tools as the primary author with only light editing and no independent writing ability  
Candidates who expect senior\-level scope, autonomy, or compensation from Day 1  
Candidates who apply without reading the role description and do not include a writing sample

An Honest Note on This Role  
This role joins a marketing function that is still building. You will not step into a well\-established content operation. You will work within a documented brand voice and a defined content direction, but the volume, pace, and iteration rhythm are things you will grow into alongside the team.

If you want to start a career in technology content writing and you are prepared to put in the work to learn how a B2B technology company communicates with senior buyers, this is a structured entry point. If you are looking for a creative writing role or a social media job, it is not.

To apply: send your CV and one writing sample. A blog post, a college article, a LinkedIn post, or anything else you have written that shows us how you think. If you do not have a writing sample, write 200 words on any technology topic that interests you and send it with your application. Send to: talents@2basetechnologies.com

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Experience:** 0–4 Years  
**Qualification:** Any Degree  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month

**About Zorba Estates**

Zorba Estates is a Bengaluru\-based real estate company providing professional property solutions to **buyers, sellers, property owners, and investors**.

We support clients throughout the property transaction process, including **property documentation, client onboarding, document verification, coordination, legal support, and transaction follow\-ups**.

Our goal is to provide clients with a **smooth, transparent, and professional real estate experience** through proper documentation, timely communication, and effective coordination.

**Job Overview :**

We are looking for a **Property Documentation Executive** to manage property\-related documentation, client onboarding, document collection, legal coordination, client communication, and transaction follow\-ups.

The candidate will coordinate with **buyers, sellers, property owners, legal professionals, and internal teams** to ensure that all required documentation and transaction activities are completed accurately and on time.

**Key Responsibilities :**  
**Property Documentation**

* Prepare and assist in drafting **Sale Deeds, Agreements, and other property\-related documents**.
* Collect and organize property documents from owners, sellers, and buyers.
* Check documents for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Coordinate with the legal team for document review and corrections.
* Maintain proper physical and digital records of property documents.

**Client Onboarding**

* Handle onboarding of **buyers, sellers, and property owners**.
* Collect required client and property information.
* Verify that the required documents have been submitted.
* Explain documentation requirements and next steps to clients.
* Maintain updated client and property records.

**Client Communication**

* Communicate with clients through **phone calls, WhatsApp, and email**.
* Provide updates regarding documentation and transaction status.
* Respond to client queries and coordinate with the appropriate team.
* Send professional emails requesting documents, approvals, signatures, and other requirements.

**Buyer, Seller \& Owner Coordination**

* Coordinate between **buyers, sellers, property owners, legal teams, and internal teams**.
* Follow up for pending documents, signatures, approvals, and information.
* Coordinate document sharing and other transaction\-related activities.
* Ensure smooth communication between all parties.

**Legal Documentation Support**

* Assist with preliminary checking of property documents.
* Coordinate with legal professionals for **property document verification**.
* Identify missing information or documentation and escalate issues to the concerned team.
* Assist in preparing documents required for property transactions.

**Follow\-Up \& Record Management**

* Maintain regular follow\-ups with clients and stakeholders.
* Track pending documentation and transaction activities.
* Update CRM, Excel, or internal systems regularly.
* Maintain confidential and organized records of client and property documents.
* Ensure assigned documentation activities are completed within timelines.

**Requirements**

* Any Degree.
* 0–4 years of experience in **property documentation, real estate operations, documentation, CRM, administration, or client coordination**.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Word, MS Excel, Email, and CRM**.
* Ability to handle confidential documents professionally.
* Knowledge of property documentation and real estate transactions will be an advantage.

**Freshers with good communication, documentation, and coordination skills are welcome to apply.**

Key Skills

**Property Documentation \| Sale Deed Drafting \| Agreement Drafting \| Document Verification \| Client Onboarding \| Legal Coordination \| Client Communication \| Email Communication \| Follow\-Up \| CRM \| MS Excel \| Real Estate Operations**

Why Join Zorba Estates?

* Practical exposure to **real estate transactions and property documentation**.
* Opportunity to work with buyers, sellers, property owners, and legal professionals.
* Learn real estate documentation and transaction processes.
* Develop professional skills in client coordination and operations.
* Career growth opportunities within Zorba Estates.

**Apply Now**

If you are **detail\-oriented, organized, good at communication and follow\-ups**, and interested in building a career in real estate documentation, apply for the **Property Documentation Executive** position at Zorba Estates.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance

description:
Introduction 
 We are looking for a Content Writer with exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong storytelling ability, and a deep sense of empathy.
You will work closely with the Sales/Operations Team to understand patient cases, medical conditions, treatment requirements, financial situations, and other relevant information, and convert these details into clear, emotionally engaging crowdfunding campaigns.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling sensitive medical stories and should be able to balance emotional storytelling with factual accuracy and responsible communication . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Write compelling, emotion-driven medical crowdfunding campaign stories based on information and case details provided by the Sales/Operations Team. Create high-quality long-form campaign content, typically 300500 words , that clearly communicates the patient's medical condition, treatment requirements, financial need, and urgency. Manage multiple campaign stories simultaneously while meeting defined turnaround times and daily content targets. Adapt writing styles based on different patient cases, medical conditions, audiences, and fundraising requirements.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills , with strong command of English. Strong storytelling ability and the ability to create emotionally engaging content. Ability to understand and simplify complex information, particularly medical and financial details. Strong attention to detail and commitment to factual accuracy. Ability to write clearly, concisely, and empathetically. Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and manage multiple assignments simultaneously. Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification. English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Media, or related backgrounds preferred. A highly motivated self-starter with a willingness to learn and take ownership. Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Operations, and other internal teams. description:
Job Title 
 PM - Planning and Documentation - Interior Fit-out Projects 
 
 Experience 
 7-8 years 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Planning and Documentation Engineer to support our interior fit-out projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining project schedules, creating and managing project documentation, and ensuring effective communication of project information across all stakeholders. This role requires a methodical and detail-oriented individual who can effectively manage the planning and documentation aspects of complex interior fitout projects. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills combined with excellent communication abilities to liaise with various project stakeholders. They should be able to work independently, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing project needs. A proactive approach to identifying and resolving potential issues through effective planning and documentation is essential for success in this position. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop, update, and maintain detailed project schedules using specialized software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project) for interior fit-out projects. Create and manage project documentation systems, ensuring all documents are properly organized, version-controlled, and easily accessible to relevant team members. Coordinate with Senior project managers, site engineers, and other team members to gather and consolidate project information. Prepare and distribute regular project status reports, highlighting progress, milestones, and potential issues. Assist in the development of project execution plans, including work breakdown structures and resource allocation plans. Monitor project progress against the baseline schedule, identifying and reporting on potential delays or conflicts. Manage the RFI (Request for Information) process, ensuring timely responses and proper documentation. Oversee the submittal process, tracking approvals and maintaining an up-to-date log. Assist in change order management, documenting changes and their impact on project timelines and budgets. Prepare meeting minutes and action item lists for project meetings. Develop and maintain project dashboards and KPI reports for management review. Collaborate with the quality control team to ensure proper documentation of quality assurance processes. Support the closeout process by compiling and organizing all necessary project documentation. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field. 7-8 years of experience in planning and documentation for construction or interior fit-out projects. Proficiency in project management and scheduling software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project). Strong knowledge of construction documentation processes and best practices. Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications. Experience with document control systems and processes. 
 
 Desired Skills 
 Familiarity with Building Information Modeling (BIM) and its applications in project planning. Knowledge of lean construction principles and their application to project scheduling. Experience with cloud-based project management and collaboration tools. Understanding of risk management and its integration into project planning. Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM) techniques. Knowledge of local building codes and regulations relevant to interior fitouts. Experience with data visualization tools for creating project dashboards. Understanding of LEED or other sustainable building certification documentation requirements. 
 
 Location 
 On-site -Pune, MH 
 
 Scheduled Weekly Hours 
 48

Processes

Risk Management
  
* Mitigate possible risk and escalate to relevant stakeholders on potential identified risks.
* Ensure timely implementation and adherence to the Operational Risk Framework.
* Ensure Control Sample Test reviews are performed in a timely manner.
* Ensure all audit issues are handled in timely and appropriate manner.


Governance
  
* The maintenance of a robust control environment to ensure:
* The execution of documentation is approved by LDU in accordance with the Bank’s policies and the Credit Documentation Process \- General Roles and Responsibilities therefore ensuring the Bank is not exposed to unnecessary legal, commercial or regulatory risks.
* The timely processing of documentation and handover of condition precedent documentation to enable limit activation and collateral RWA to optimise revenue generation / return on tangible equity. Ensure the timely processing of any deferred conditions precedent / subsequent.


Regulatory \& Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

Key stakeholders

* Global Credit Markets
* Credit Risk Approvers / Analysts
* Client Managers
* Legal
* Credit Documentation Unit (CDU) / Credit Risk Control (CRC)

Skills and Experience
  
  

* Manage Conduct
* Manage Risk
* Manage People
* Products and Processes
* Bank Lending
* Business Partnering
* Process Management


Qualifications
  
  

* Degree in legal, finance or business administration studies
* Legal qualification or equivalent extensive work experience.
* Languages: English
* Relevant experience in a similar finance documentation and transaction management role in the relevant market enabling day\-to\-day responsibilities to be carried out with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-moving, demanding environment whilst maintaining high quality output, good analytical skills, risk\-based approach and excellent attention to detail. Strong organisational and prioritising skills are essential.
* Strong team player with excellent communication skills in order to effectively liaise with and develop close working relationships with stakeholders and business partners, across various jurisdictions.
* Good level of experience of international loan and security documentation (including LMA, LSTA, APLMA).
* Good level of knowledge of the Bank’s products (including Project \& Export Finance, Leveraged \& Acquisition Finance, Shipping, Subscription Finance, Commercial Real Estate) in relation to documentation.
* Detailed knowledge of the Bank’s relevant policies and procedures.
* Ability to quickly assimilate complex syndication and bilateral lending deals and product structures.
* Good knowledge of minimum acceptance criteria and collateral verification requirements.
* Good knowledge of the Bank’s standard template documentation.
* Good level of drafting and negotiation skills.


About Standard Chartered
  
  

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. title: Executive, E-Lab Documentation
description:
**About Apotex Inc.**
 Apotex is a Canadian\-based global health company. We improve everyday access to affordable, innovative medicines and health products for millions of people worldwide, with a broad portfolio of generic, biosimilar, innovative branded pharmaceuticals and consumer health products. Headquartered in Toronto, with regional offices globally, including in the United States, Mexico and India, we are the largest Canadian\-based pharmaceutical company and a health partner of choice for the Americas for pharmaceutical licensing and product acquisitions.
   

  

 For more information visit: www.apotex.com .
   

  

**Job Summary**
* The Executive is responsible for execution of LIMS change controls within Apotex Corporate structure.
* Maintenance of the Global laboratory documentation and data management systems, including the creation, revision of analytical test methods and In\-Process Manufacturing \& Packaging CofAs, LIMS CofAs and Test Profiles used in the testing \& release of commercial and R\&D products. LIMS static data for R\&D and commercial products, and the assessment of changes for impact to LIMS static data.
* Act as a technical resource and responsible to escalate any critical issues identified during implementation and review of change controls pertaining to LIMS static data changes.


 Responsible for product launch readiness and implementation of tech transfer packages for NPD, PLCM, MLCM and site transfers
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Create, revise and review specifications LIMS documents (CofA, Test Profiles)] and Analytical Test Methods for solid dosage, liquid dosage and raw material products in the corporate document management system in response to ongoing change control activities to support Global product transfers and apply harmonized testing policies for Apotex laboratories.
* Perform peer review of documentation and LIMS static data changes for accuracy and compliance with departmental, corporate and regulatory guidelines, and provide feedback as required.
* Issue document numbers for new specifications and analytical test methods.
* Route electronic documents through document management and laboratory information management systems to secure history
* Review new products and map testing requirements to existing analysis inventory list.
* Liaise with QC and R\&D labs, GIS, Global QC LIMS Business Support, Quality, internal \& external consultants on new developments \& cross\-divisional changes for configuration, code, reports and projects.
* Evaluate and initiate change controls in support of the creation/revision of specification documents, methods, LIMS master data and LIMS code/configuration.
* Update appropriate corporate document management and change control systems to reflect revision history for new \& revised lab documents
* Ensure the timely posting of LIMS CofAs and Test Profiles to the corporate document collections \& to external customers as required.
* Develop \& maintain expert working knowledge of LIMS functionality through on\-going project implementations.
* Coordinate tech transfers from R\&D to the commercial environment, including management of activities for the creation of Water\-mark and release commercial specifications.
* Ensure timely publishing of all specifications once regulatory NOC approval has been received.
* Perform all work in compliance with current SODs, GSOPs \& GMPs.
* Support LIMS projects and initiatives. Represent R\&D and QC LIMS static data/document configuration at cross\-functional LIMS meetings.
* Develop and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external customers.
* Manage hard copies of LIMS impact sheets, peer review forms and verification forms for timely storage and availability.
* Scheduling and monitoring of LIMS Review day to day activities.
* Work in a safe manner collaborating as a team member to achieve all outcomes.
* Demonstrate Behaviours that exhibit our organizational Values: Collaboration, Courage, Perseverance, and Passion.
* Ensure personal adherence with all compliance programs including the Global Business Ethics and Compliance Program, Global Quality policies and procedures, Safety and Environment policies, and HR policies.
* Create a culture which values trust and provides the opportunity for Employee development and growth in pursuit of our purpose and demonstrating our core Values – Collaboration, Courage, Perseverance and Passion.
* All other duties as assigned.


**Job Requirements** 
  

  

* Education
+ Master’s degree in Pharmacy

* Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
+ Experience with Microsoft Office applications. SAP, LIMS, TrackWise an added advantage.
+ Knowledge of GMPs governing documentation in the pharmaceutical industry.
+ SAP experiences an asset.
+ Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite applications.
+ Demonstrated leadership skills.
+ Demonstrated decision\-making ability with strong problem solving skills.
+ Expert knowledge of all compendia process as it relates to publication and monitoring of changes in the USP, BP and EP.
+ Strong knowledge of the ICH guidelines.
+ Strong knowledge of regulatory guidelines for FDA and Health Canada.
+ Ability to interpret and independently apply broad testing guidelines as per compendia (USP, BP and EP).
+ Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills with a customer focus.
+ Ability to coordinate and complete projects with strict deadlines.
+ Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team\-based environment.
+ Ability to adapt in a rapidly changing environment.


  

  

* Experience
+ Minimum 4\-8 years in the pharmaceutical industry with an emphasis on Quality Control, Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and analytical data interpretation


 At Apotex, we are committed to fostering a welcoming andaccessible work environment, where all everyone feels valued, respected, and supported to succeed.
   

  

 We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities as part of its recruitment process. If you are contacted to arrange for an interview or testing, please advise us if you require an accommodation.

title: R&D Technical Writer - IDC - Entry Professional
description:
As a Technical Writer, you will create clear, concise, and comprehensive high\-quality technical documentation for various products of Automation \& Communication Product group within Grid Automation Business Unit of Hitachi Energy.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Do you enjoy writing and turning complex technical concepts into clear, structured documentation?
   

  

 We are looking for a technical writer to join our User Documentation team in Bangalore. You will be part of a highly motivated, energetic, enthusiastic, collaborative, ever\-learning team who are proud of their work at Hitachi Energy.
   

  

 You will be part of the team which creates and maintains technical documentation for various products of Automation \& Communication product group within Grid Automation Business Unit of Hitachi Energy.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with subject matter experts (SMEs), product managers, engineers, and quality assurance teams to gather information, understand product functionality, and accurately translate complex technical concepts into easily understandable content.
   

  

 Your work will play a key role in making our technology accessible and usable for internal teams, customers, and partners worldwide.

* You will have opportunity to interact with subject matter experts (SMEs), product managers and others to translate complex technical concept into easily understandable content.
* Conduct thorough research and analysis to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of all documentation.
* Adhere to established documentation standards, style guides, and terminology to maintain a consistent brand voice and quality across all deliverables.
* Review and edit documentation for grammar, spelling, punctuation, clarity, and adherence to technical specifications.
* Handling translation co\-ordination activities for various languages like German, French, Spanish, Czech, Japanese and others.
* Create / edit images in Visio and Snagit editor.
* Enthusiastically learn AI tools (GPT, Copilot, etc) for authoring and review.
* Manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks and meeting deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Continuously seek opportunities to improve documentation processes, tools, and content quality.
* Participate and identify areas for documentation improvement.
* Utilize various authoring tools, content management systems (CMS), and version control software effectively.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or a related field.
* 2\-5 years of proven experience as a Technical Writer, preferably in the energy, industrial automation, or software development sectors.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a strong command of English grammar, style, and vocabulary.
* Proficiency in creating clear, concise, and user\-friendly technical documentation for diverse audiences.
* Experience with various documentation tools such as Oxygen XML, or similar.
* Familiarity with DITA XML, preferably Tridion Docs or similar, structured authoring, and component content management systems (CMS) is highly desirable.
* Ability to understand and interpret complex technical concepts and specifications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.
* Knowledge of electrical engineering and power systems will be a significant advantage.

title: Process Enablement Expert (Global MLR Process & Governance Lead)
description:
**About Astellas** 




  





 Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com.
 



  





**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?** 




  





 We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
 



  





**Astellas’ Global Capability Centres – Overview** 




  





 Astellas’ Global Capability Centres (GCCs) are strategically located sites that give Astellas the ability to access talent across various functions in the value chain and to co\-locate core capabilities that are currently dispersed. Our three GCCs are located in India, Poland and Mexico.
 



  





 The GCCs will enhance our operational efficiency, resilience and innovation potential, enabling a timely response to changing business demands.
 



  





 Our GCCs are an integral part of Astellas, guided by our shared values and behaviours, and are critical enablers of the company’s strategic priorities, sustainable growth, and commitment to turn innovative science into VALUE for patients.
 



  





**Working Environment and Location** 




  




* This is a permanent role based in our Global Capability Centre in Warsaw, Poland or the Global Capability Centre in India and hybrid working with the expectation for some office presence. Flexibility may be required in line with business needs. Candidates must be located within a commutable distance of the office.
* At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility Guidelines.



  





**Purpose and Scope** 




  




* The Process Enablement Expert serves as the critical link between MLR technology platforms, global processes, and the teams who create and approve content. This role is responsible for developing, embedding, and monitoring global MLR standards and governance to ensure repeatable, compliant execution and measurable value delivery across Astellas.
* The scope of this role spans regions and geographies, with significant impact on the global content operating model. The role is accountable for MLR process integrity, governance oversight, documentation, and enablement, ensuring that process standardisation drives efficiency, risk reduction, predictability, and operational value. The role also acts as a key contributor and subject\-matter partner to Content Enablement led solutions (including MLR AI), ensuring solutions are compliant, scalable, embedded into BAU operations, and deliver tangible business value.
* This role sits within the Content \& Channel Enablement Chapter, contributing deep process and governance expertise to enable scalable, compliant content operations across the organisation. As part of this chapter, the Process Enablement Expert plays an active role in the Content Foundations Value Team, partnering closely with Content \& Channel Enablement, technology, and operations to ensure foundational processes deliver measurable business value. Through this value team model, the role focuses not only on process integrity and compliance, but on VALUE delivery\- driving efficiency, reducing risk, improving predictability, and enabling sustainable reuse and scale across our content operations.



  





**Role and Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and continuously improve global MLR processes, standards, and governance
* Drive process simplification, standardization, and scalability across regions
* Ensure compliance, reduce risk, and improve operational efficiency
* Lead MLR governance, monitoring, escalations, and corrective actions
* Analyze operational data and translate insights into process improvements
* Oversee management and remediation of high\-risk and non\-compliant materials
* Maintain global MLR SOPs, policies, training content, and documentation

title: Consulting Sr Associate, Air quality
description:
**ERM** 
 is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
   

  

 Our
 **Consulting Delivery Hub** 
 (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high\-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
   

  

 As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
   

  

**Why this role matters?**
 As a
 **Consulting Senior Associate \- Air Quality** 
 , you will support ERM's North American Air Quality team by delivering high\-quality permitting, emissions inventory, and regulatory reporting services for industrial, energy, pharmaceutical, technology, and chemical sector clients. Working closely with ERM consultants, technical specialists, and client stakeholders across North America, you will help ensure regulatory compliance, data integrity, and timely delivery of regulator\-ready submissions. This role plays a key part in enabling scalable global project delivery by supporting complex environmental compliance programs with accurate technical analysis, streamlined documentation, and consistent quality standards.
   

  

**What your impact is?**
* Deliver accurate and regulator\-ready permitting and compliance documentation that supports clients in meeting federal, state, and local air quality requirements.
* Develop and maintain traceable emissions inventories, calculations, and reporting workpapers that improve data quality, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance.
* Support the preparation of environmental submissions including Title V permits, NSR/PSD applications, Annual Emissions Statements, EPCRA Tier II, and TRI reports across multiple North American jurisdictions.
* Apply structured QA/QC processes to enhance data integrity, reduce compliance risks, and ensure consistency across client deliverables.
* Collaborate with global ERM teams, client stakeholders, and technical specialists to maintain project schedules, resolve data issues, and drive efficient delivery outcomes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned, enhancing templates and SOPs, and supporting knowledge development across the Air Quality practice.


**What will you bring?**
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Environmental, or Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Science, or Chemistry, with coursework or exposure in air regulations, mass balance, or environmental data analysis.
* 1–3 years in NA air permitting or regulatory reporting with exposure to CAA, state permitting programs, and EPCRA Tier II/TRI reporting fundamentals; internships and co\-ops in industrial EHS or consulting.
* Emissions estimation, factor selection, and activity data QA in Excel, with strong attention to traceability and unit conversions per NA program needs.
* Working knowledge of Title V, NSR/PSD basics, NSPS/NESHAP applicability concepts, AERR inputs, and state annual emission statements.
* EPCRA Tier II/TRI fundamentals: chemical thresholding, mixtures, de minimis, SDS interpretation, and calculation documentation.
* Clear written communication for technical narratives and regulator\-ready submissions, responsive coordination with clients, regulators, and subcontractors in a remote delivery model supporting.


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills \& Competencies**
* Experience supporting North American air permitting and regulatory reporting programs across multiple states or industries.
* Exposure to environmental compliance management systems such as Cority, ACTS, or similar platforms.
* Experience using Power BI, data visualization tools, or automation technologies to improve reporting and compliance workflows.
* Professional certifications, advanced coursework, or postgraduate qualifications related to Air Quality, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, or Sustainability.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Permitting support**
* Draft permit application content for Title V operating permits, state construction permits, and minor/major NSR/PSD, including process/equipment descriptions, emissions calculations, monitoring and recordkeeping plans, and applicability matrices referencing NSPS and NESHAP/MACT where relevant, ensuring state\-specific forms and attachments are complete and aligned with guidance such as NJDEP requirements where applicable.
* Coordinate inputs for dispersion modeling with senior modelers, prepare input data packages (stack parameters, release types), and maintain crosswalks linking model assumptions to application narratives and response\-to\-comment drafts for reviewer use, ensuring NA regulatory scope.
* Conduct desktop control\-technology research from public determinations and vendor literature to support preliminary BACT/LAER writeups for junior and senior reviewer refinement, keeping citations and change logs up to date per team SOPs.


**Regulatory reporting**
* Build traceable emissions inventories and reporting workpapers using client activity data, approved emission factors, and calculation templates, producing state annual emission statements, AERR inputs, Title V compliance/periodic reports, MACT/NESHAP periodic reports, and deviation logs as required for NA programs, with clear QA/QC checks and version control.
* Support EPCRA Tier II and TRI Form R/NA preparation by performing chemical thresholding, de minimis and mixture evaluations, SDS data extraction, and unit/stoichiometry conversions with senior oversight, documenting assumptions and data lineage clearly for audit readiness as emphasized by the SME JD.
* Reconcile permit, criteria/HAP, and GHG datasets to ensure consistency across submissions and client internal records, preparing evidence folders suitable for agency or client audits within NA jurisdictions, and flagging inconsistencies early for senior review and resolution.


**Quality and delivery**
* Execute structured QA/QC using checklist\-based reviews, cell protection, traceability notes, and exception flags in standardized Excel templates; maintain issue and action logs to track corrections and regulator comments, reflecting the SME’s discipline on data integrity and auditability.
* Maintain document control with consistent filenames, versioning, hyperlinks to source evidence, and regulator\-ready PDF packages with bookmarks and indices, supporting efficient review cycles with clients, regulators, and subcontractors per SME practice.
* Coordinate with client technical contacts, NA regulators when requested by senior staff, and subcontractors for data validation or specialized analyses; schedule and document communications and follow\-ups to maintain submission timelines


**Collaboration and learning**
* Participate in internal trainings on Title V, NSR/PSD, MACT/NESHAP, EPCRA Tier II/TRI, and state annual emissions statements; apply learning to improve calculations and templates, in line with SME guidance about the practice scale and expectations.
* Share lessons learned and template improvements with peers, contribute to frequently asked questions and SOP updates, and support onboarding for junior colleagues.

title: Electromagnetic Engineer - Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Application Engineer (Electric Motors)** 




**Company:** 
 Mecwin Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. 
 



**Work Location:** 
 Mecwin Corporate Office, Yeshwanthpur, Bengaluru 
 



**Experience:** 
 3–4 years 
 



**Qualification:** 
 B.E./B.Tech or M.Tech in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
 



  





**About Mecwin** 




 Mecwin Technologies is a Bengaluru\-based engineering and manufacturing company specialising in customised electric motors, powertrain solutions and advanced engineering products.
 



 Mecwin designs and manufactures AC Induction, BLDC, PMDC, PMSM, EESM and Axial Flux motors for applications across:
 


* Electric vehicles
* Aerospace and defence
* Industrial equipment
* Off\-highway and agricultural equipment
* Material\-handling systems
* Drones and eVTOL applications
* Automation and robotics
* Pumps and specialised OEM applications



 With an experienced in\-house engineering team and manufacturing facility in Bengaluru, Mecwin supports customers from concept and motor design through prototyping, validation and series production.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Mecwin is looking for an Application Engineer with strong technical knowledge of electric motors. The candidate will act as the technical bridge between customers and Mecwin’s Sales, Business Development, Design, NPD, Manufacturing, Quality and Testing teams.
 



 The Application Engineer will support the complete process—from understanding the customer’s application and preparing the technical solution to motor development, validation, customer approval and production handover.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Understand customer applications, operating conditions and technical requirements.
* Convert customer requirements into clear motor specifications and engineering inputs.
* Support the Sales and Business Development teams during customer enquiries, technical discussions and proposal preparation.
* Participate in motor selection, sizing, feasibility assessment and application engineering.
* Coordinate with the Design and NPD teams for customised motor design and development.
* Review parameters such as power, torque, speed, duty cycle, efficiency, thermal limits, voltage, current, IP protection, insulation class and environmental conditions.
* Support RFQ evaluation, technical feasibility studies, BOM preparation, costing and project timeline estimation.
* Prepare technical proposals, datasheets, product specifications, drawings, test plans, compliance documents and technical presentations.
* Possess strong knowledge in at least one of the following motor technologies:
* AC Induction Motors (ACIM)
* BLDC Motors
* PMDC Motors
* PMSM Motors
* Axial Flux Motors
* Understand the complete motor manufacturing process, including winding, stator and rotor manufacturing, insulation, magnet assembly, machining, balancing, motor assembly and final testing.
* Participate in prototype development, testing, validation and performance improvement.
* Analyse test results and coordinate corrective actions for technical or performance deviations.
* Support root\-cause analysis and resolution of motor failures, field issues and customer complaints.
* Coordinate with Manufacturing, Quality, Purchase and Supplier Development teams to ensure product manufacturability and quality.
* Support product industrialisation and smooth transfer from prototype to series production.
* Understand relevant certification and compliance requirements, including BIS, IS, IEC, UL, CE and ATEX.
* Handle customer technical visits, design reviews, factory visits, audits and pre\-dispatch inspections at Mecwin.
* Travel to customer locations and manufacturing plants to study applications and understand installation conditions.
* Support the business team throughout the customer journey—from enquiry and development to testing, approval and production.
* Maintain technical records, revision controls, meeting minutes, action trackers and project documentation.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination between the customer and internal teams.
* Provide post\-development technical support during product trials, installation and initial field performance.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 



* Sound understanding of electric motor design, development and application engineering.
* Knowledge of electromagnetic, mechanical and thermal aspects of motors.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and customer technical documents.
* Knowledge of motor performance testing, validation methods and test equipment.
* Understanding of motor control systems, drives and controllers will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with CAD, motor\-design or engineering\-analysis software will be preferred.
* Knowledge of DFMEA, PFMEA, DVP\&R, APQP and PPAP will be an added advantage.
* Understanding of quality systems and structured problem\-solving methods such as 8D and root\-cause analysis is desirable.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident in presenting technical solutions to customers and internal teams.
* Strong coordination, documentation and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Customer\-focused, responsible and result\-oriented.
* Able to manage multiple development projects and priorities.
* Willing to travel across India as required.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving engineering and manufacturing environment.
* Capable of taking ownership of technical activities and meeting committed timelines.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn new motor technologies and applications.



  





**Why Join Mecwin?** 



* Work on multiple electric motor technologies under one organisation.
* Gain exposure to customised and next\-generation motor\-development projects.
* Work on applications across EV, aerospace, defence, industrial, agricultural, automation, robotics and off\-highway sectors.
* Participate in the complete product\-development cycle—from customer requirement to series production.
* Work closely with experienced motor designers, NPD engineers, manufacturing specialists and business leaders.
* Directly interact with OEM customers and understand real\-world engineering applications.
* Gain practical exposure to motor design, manufacturing, testing, validation and certification.
* Opportunity to work on import\-substitution and “Made in India” engineering programmes.
* Strong learning environment with opportunities for technical and professional growth.
* Opportunity to take ownership, contribute ideas and grow with Mecwin as the company expands in India and global markets.
* Performance\-based career growth and opportunities to take up larger technical and customer\-facing responsibilities.



  





**Key Objective** 




 To provide complete technical support to customers and Mecwin’s business teams, ensuring that every motor requirement is correctly understood, engineered, validated and successfully transferred into series production.

title: English Transcript Reviewer & Trainer
description:
**Role:** 
 Senior English Transcript Reviewer/Proofreader/Trainer
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai, Tamil Nadu · Full\-time
 



**Reports to:** 
 Operations Manager
 



 CTC: 4\.5\-5LPA
 



**About the Role** 




 We run a
 **high\-accuracy, human\-driven English transcription review operation** 
 . Reviewers
 **listen to raw audio from scratch** 
 and deliver clean, accurate, client\-ready transcripts—working on platforms and to strict quality standards similar to TranscribeMe.
 **We rely on skilled human ears, strict style\-guide adherence, and manual proofreading rather than AI/automated draft editing.** 




 As Trainer, you own how quickly and how well new joiners reach production standard. You will build our team of Reviewers who
 **transcribe** 
 , correct, and finalize audio files to a client\-ready bar. You will design and run onboarding, coach on clean\-verbatim style and English grammar, calibrate the team to a single standard, and grow reviewer capability as we scale from a small pilot team to \~90 seats.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* **Onboard New Reviewers:** 
 Deliver structured training on
 **human transcription techniques** 
 , platform/tool navigation, clean\-verbatim rules, speech tags (inaudible, crosstalk, etc.), speaker labeling, timestamps, and researching names and terms.
* **Own the Curriculum:** 
 Build and maintain training materials, the house style guide, and a certification/assessment path; keep them current as client style guides change (US vs. Commonwealth English, file\-specific rules).
* **Coach English Fundamentals:** 
 Teach grammar, punctuation, spelling, and formatting to one consistent standard; run targeted refreshers on recurring error patterns.
* **Develop Senior / Lead Reviewers:** 
 Identify strong performers and grow them into senior reviewer roles who can guide others and hold the quality bar as the team expands.
* **Run Calibration:** 
 Hold regular
 **manual proofing sessions** 
 so all reviewers
 **transcribe and format** 
 the same file the exact same way; track and close inconsistencies between reviewers.
* **Own Ramp\-Quality Metrics:** 
 Monitor and report time\-to\-productivity, accuracy/rejection rate, critical\-error rate, and rework rate against the hiring ramp.
* **Pick Up New Domains Fast:** 
 Absorb new subject areas and client accounts quickly and turn them into clear training material (e.g., US legal transcription conventions).



**Must Have** 



* **Excellent Command of English:** 
 Near\-native grammar, punctuation, and spelling (US and Commonwealth), with strong reading comprehension and a
 **sharp ear for difficult audio** 
 .
* **Manual Transcription \& Proofreading Background:** 
 Hands\-on experience doing
 **manual audio transcription** 
 , proofreading, or quality control, with deep familiarity in clean\-verbatim rules.
* **Fast Domain Learner:** 
 Able to absorb a new subject or style guide and teach it clearly within days, not weeks.
* **Coaching Instinct:** 
 Patient, structured, and able to provide actionable feedback that drives measurable behavioral change.
* **Detail\-Obsessed:** 
 Comfortable holding a
 **strict human quality standard** 
 and working toward defined accuracy targets.



**Nice to Have** 



* Exposure to US legal / court transcription conventions—verbatim vs. non\-verbatim, speaker labels, bracketed notation (e.g., \[phonetic], \[indiscernible]), and numeral/formatting rules.
* Hands\-on experience with TranscribeMe, Rev, GoTranscript, Verbit, or similar platforms as a
 **manual transcriber** 
 or reviewer.
* Experience handling varied English accents (US, UK, Australian, Indian) and low\-quality audio files.
* Prior experience standing up
 **human training operations** 
 for a new or scaling team.



**Success in the First 90 Days** 



* New reviewers reliably reach production accuracy within the defined ramp window.
* A documented house style guide, training deck, and certification test are fully live.
* At least one internal Senior Reviewer cohort is trained and holding the quality standard independently.
