title: Training Associate
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Training Associate is part of a global function called Operations and Processes – Training and Communications. This is a global role that supports training delivery to over 2000 Research \& Development (R\&D) employees across Haleon’s R\&D organisation.
   

  

 The Training Associate role manages the relevant processes to assist the R\&D organization with onboarding and training its employees across R\&D sites, and countries in accordance with industry requirements. It collaborates with functional leads, business processes and systems owners to develop and deploy effective, engaging and learner\-focused training for R\&D employees.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Manage process to ensure appropriate training is assigned to all R\&D employees including assessing training content requirements as roles change and evolve, or as individuals change responsibilities. Training assignments include, but are not limited to written standards, ways of working, system training, product information where applicable and capability training.
* Maintains training assets in a validated learning management system for all R\&D employees ensuring training is assigned in line with job requirements and completed on time.
* Create and roll out engaging, high\-quality training materials by using various training design tools to enable deployment of business processes, systems, product overview, industry guidelines, technical capabilities etc.
* Ensure all current R\&D procedures are maintained in their current version and assigned to ensure that R\&D colleagues are trained in line with industry requirements.
* Partner with the Process, Standards \& Documentation team to support the development and delivery of learning that enable business readiness and effective adoption.
* Subject matter expert for training processing and applications, providing support to colleagues as needed.
* Develop and report training metrics to drive training compliance and monitoring to ensure audit/inspection readiness.
* Provide audit and regulatory inspection support across R\&D by providing timely documentation and supporting the implementation of effective corrective and preventative actions (CAPA) to meet required timelines.


***Why you?***
**Basic Qualifications:**
**Essential**
* College / university degree in science\-related field with 5 years pharmaceutical and/or consumer healthcare/goods industry knowledge and experience
* Minimum 3 years in training and communication.
* Confidence working with learning management systems, digital tools and Microsoft Office package
* Experience developing training materials using training content development tools and software
* Team player with strong written communication skills and attention to detail
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of defined deliverables.


**Preferred**
* Experience working in a regulated or compliance‑driven environment.
* Experience supporting audit, assessment, or CAPA activities.
* Enhanced customer service orientation and ability to communicate professionally to diverse cross\-functional non\-technical and technical audiences.
* Experience working with cross‑functional, regional, or global stakeholders.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-10\-08
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
   

  

**Note to candidates**
 The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

* Help scope and move new business opportunities forward with enterprise prospects across travel, employee benefits, BFSI/NBFC and lending, and pension/insurance players.

 You'll be working alongside the solutioning lead, founders and CBO on a near\-daily basis, so this role has an unusually high amount of visibility and room to grow into a broader BD/solutions leadership track as we scale.

**Job Description**
**Mactores** 
 is the agent\-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward\-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
   

  

 As a Partner Solutions Architect, you own that documentation across all of our partnerships, not just AWS. You're given project and architecture details by the delivery team, and you turn them into the competency documentation each partner program requires, and into case studies you can explain and defend to a partner reviewer, to a prospect, to anyone asking "what did Mactores actually ship here."
   

  

 AI tools are fair game for drafting; the bar is on accuracy and whether it holds up under questioning. Do this well, and the natural next step is a presales architect role, taking these case studies and this partner fluency directly into prospect conversations.
   

  

**What you’ll do?**
* Create and maintain competency documentation across all of Mactores' partnerships AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI using project and architecture details provided by the delivery team.
* Produce the technical validation write\-ups, architecture diagrams, and case study documentation each partner's competency and service delivery program requires.
* Build a working command of Mactores' case studies well enough to explain them clearly the problem, the architecture, the outcome to partner reviewers, prospects, or internal stakeholders.
* Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, while owning the accuracy and review\-readiness of the final document.
* Keep documentation format and quality consistent across partners and engagements.
* Flag gaps in the project details you're given when they're not sufficient to produce audit\-ready documentation.
* Work against fixed deadlines tied to partner program renewal and review cycles.


**What we’re looking for?**
* 2–3 years of experience in technical documentation, solutions architecture, or a related role touching AWS and/or modern data/AI platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI).
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture concepts enough to read a design across different platforms and document it accurately.
* Strong technical writing skills; comfortable turning raw project detail into a document that reads cleanly to an external reviewer.
* Comfortable explaining technical case studies out loud, not just writing them this role grows toward customer\-facing work.
* Familiarity with diagramming tools (draw.io, Lucidchart, or similar) for architecture diagrams.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of a documentation workflow, without leaning on them for accuracy you haven't verified.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to hold a deadline without supervision.

**Biochemistry Subject Matter Expert (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to build smarter, more scientifically rigorous AI models — and we need expert biochemists to make it happen. Your deep knowledge of molecular biology, enzyme kinetics, and metabolic systems will directly shape how AI reasons through complex life science problems.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed to fit around your existing commitments. No prior AI experience is required — just your scientific expertise.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Create advanced biochemistry questions spanning protein folding, nucleic acid chemistry, proteomics, metabolic flux, and drug\-target interactions to rigorously test AI performance
* Author Gold\-Standard Solutions — Write precise, step\-by\-step technical responses that serve as benchmarks for high\-level scientific reasoning in AI systems
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated biochemical pathways, molecular structures, and quantitative proofs for scientific accuracy and adherence to established standards
* Identify Reasoning Failures — Spot logical errors in AI reasoning — such as incorrect stoichiometry, misapplied stereochemistry, or flawed mechanistic logic — and provide structured feedback to improve model performance
* Work Independently — Complete task\-based assignments asynchronously, on a schedule that works for you


**Who You Are**
* PhD\-level expertise in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a closely related discipline (completed or in final stages)
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more core areas: structural biology, enzymology, cellular metabolism, bioinformatics, or molecular genetics
* Ability to communicate complex biochemical and chemical concepts clearly and precisely in written form
* High attention to detail when reviewing chemical equations, molecular mechanisms, and experimental protocols
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote setting
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or scientific peer review
* Familiarity with computational biochemistry tools such as PyMOL, AlphaFold, or BLAST
* Background in science writing, curriculum development, or technical communication


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and institutions
* Fully remote and asynchronous — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Gain firsthand exposure to how advanced large language models (LLMs) are trained and evaluated
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with a global network of domain experts
* Meaningful work — your contributions directly improve AI accuracy in scientific domains that matter
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Technical Trainer
description:
We are looking for a Construction Technology specialist with a keen inclination towards contributing and scaling up training and technical content for the internal Learning \& Development (L\&D) team. We are looking for a specialist with an expertise in Construction Technologies and BIM tools to design, develop, and deliver high\-quality training programs. The role focuses on enabling new joiners and existing teams to understand end\-to\-end construction processes, interpret construction drawings and effectively use BIM tools. We are looking for an individual who has strong background in construction technology and is keen and passionate about delivering learning content to ensure learner’s engagement and effectiveness in their roles.
 



 The candidate will collaborate closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), translate technical knowledge into structured learning content, and facilitate engaging training sessions with an eye on performing effectively, reducing errors, and supporting business objectives.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:**





* Assess training needs through surveys, interviews, and job analysis, SME meetings
* Develop customized materials and deliver in\-person training on technical topics related to the processes/ software/ tools used in construction management, such as:
* Construction Engineering, Design Coordination, Model Authoring, Shop drawings generation, Model based clash coordination, Quantification, 4D Sequencing, Procurement, Information Management, Project Controls etc.
* Application of VDC tools such as Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, Tekla, Bluebeam Revu, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.
* Work with SMEs to capture domain expertise and convert it into structured learning modules.
* Design and deliver in\-person/virtual technical training programs for a large group of employees
* Develop learning content like manuals, slide decks, e\-learning modules, and design interactive sessions
* Provide post\-training support and follow\-up to reinforce learning, application on projects and answer ongoing questions
* Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and revise content as needed
* Stay current with evolving technological trends in Construction Industry and update training offerings accordingly
* Track and report on learner progress and training outcomes



  





**Essential Skills \& Qualifications:**



* Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of construction technology/management field (etc.).
* Ability to read, interpret, and explain construction drawings (ASMEP) and related documents such as submittals, RFIs, PCI etc.
* Expert understanding of construction processes throughout various phases of construction (Bidding, pre\-construction, construction, closeout and handover) and interdependence within the processes.
* Strong hands\-on experience with BIM Tools (Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam, etc.)
* Instructional Skills: Ability to teach, present, facilitate, and adapt to different learning styles, translate technical concepts into user\-friendly instructions
* Communication: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills to simplify complex subjects.
* Collaboration: Ability to collaborate and work effectively with a diverse group of SMEs, trainees
* Tools: Familiarity with modern training tools



  





**Experience:** 
 Min 4\+ years of experience on Construction Projects with a keen interest towards contributing to training initiatives and learning and development
 



  





**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree (master’s is preferred) in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction Management
 



  





**About Virtual Builder Group**




 The Virtual Builder Group works as an integrated partner with general contractors and subcontractors across the full construction lifecycle. The team supports bidding, preconstruction, execution, and closeout using well\-defined technology workflows.
 



 The group aims to make construction processes more efficient and predictable through consistent use of data and digital tools. The focus is on improving coordination, reducing rework, and strengthening decision\-making at every stage. Looking ahead, the team is committed to advancing automation and predictive analysis by using historical data. This mindset helps project teams move from reactive problem\-solving to proactive planning, resulting in better project outcomes.
 



  





**About vConstruct**




 We are a team of enthusiastic construction engineering and technology experts who are passionate about increasing the predictability of building better products by applying smarter processes while striving for faster delivery. We provide services and solutions to the Construction Industry in the area of Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Project Controls Management, Accounting and Software Development. On any given day, we make an impact on several large\-scale construction projects across the globe through our services and solutions.
 



 Since we started in 2013, we are at a continuous lookout for talent driven by the vision to transform the construction industry by the use of technology.
 



 We are a subsidiary of
 **DPR Construction** 
 , a USA based technical builder that specializes in highly complex projects in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Advance Technology, Higher Education and Commercial buildings.

title: Programme Associate-Technology Futures (Solar Manufacturing)
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description:
**Purpose** 




 CEEW's Technology Futures team works towards mainstreaming appropriate global and indigenous technologies that can deliver energy security and sustainable economic growth at scale. The team's work spans clean energy technology manufacturing, critical minerals, and the evolving geopolitics and governance of clean energy technology collaboration, and has previously informed India's G20 presidency\-led work on global renewable energy supply chains.
 



 CEEW seeks to hire a suitable candidate to lead the Technology Futures team's technical research on solar manufacturing, covering the end\-to\-end value chain — from polysilicon and ingot/wafer production to cell and module manufacturing, and associated bill\-of\-materials (BOM) components. The candidate in this role will lead technological assessments of manufacturing processes, equipment and materials used across the value chain, while also tracking the policies, regulations, industrial strategies, technology partnerships, and geopolitics that shape solar manufacturing competitiveness across major global markets, including the US, EU, China, Southeast Asia, and India.
 



 The candidate will also evaluate emerging cell and module technologies (such as HJT, BC, and perovskite/tandem cells) and their manufacturing readiness, and guide the technical rigour of the team's research outputs. The role also involves tracking technology partnerships, licensing arrangements, and analysing how manufacturing incentives, trade measures, and geopolitical developments — such as export controls and trade disputes — shape the global solar manufacturing landscape.
 



 The candidate must have a strong technical/engineering background in solar PV manufacturing, along with the ability to engage with the policy, trade, and geopolitical dimensions of the sector. In addition to the duties and responsibilities outlined below, the candidate should be prepared, as and when necessary, to take on additional responsibilities and respond to ongoing events and developments in the sector.
 



 CEEW offers an intellectually challenging and conducive work environment, with a focus on research rigour, innovative thinking, and strategic outreach. We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented individual who would be excited to take research to action. We recommend that applicants visit the Technology Futures page for more details about our projects.
 



**Job duties and accountabilities** 




**Research and programme assistance** 



* Lead technical assessments of manufacturing processes, equipment and materials across the entire solar PV value chain — from polysilicon and ingot/wafer to cell and module manufacturing.
* Track industry technology roadmaps, such as the International Technology Roadmap for Photovoltaic (ITRPV), to anticipate shifts in dominant cell architectures and manufacturing processes. Based on this — evaluate emerging and next\-generation solar cell and module technologies, such as HJT, BC, and perovskite/tandem cells, and assess their manufacturing readiness levels (MRLs), which includes timelines to commercial\-scale manufacturing.
* Assess the timelines, capital costs, and production downtime associated with transitioning an existing manufacturing line from one cell technology to another (for instance, PERC to TOPCon), including equipment retrofit versus greenfield trade\-offs and yield ramp\-up curves, and track changes in bill\-of\-materials (BOM) and their cost implications.
* Map domestic and global supply chains for solar manufacturing inputs and equipment, including dependencies on critical minerals, and assess technology licensing and intellectual property considerations that shape manufacturers' adoption of new technologies.
* Track and analyse policy, regulatory, and geopolitical developments — including manufacturing incentive schemes, customs duties and trade measures, export controls, and technology partnerships between countries — across major solar manufacturing geographies, and assess their impact on manufacturing competitiveness.
* Use AI tools to accelerate literature review, data synthesis, and analysis of quantitative data, such as production capacities, investments, trade flows, and costs, enabling quick\-turnaround of research outputs for the team and stakeholders.
* Lead the drafting of high\-value technical research briefs and reports.



**Stakeholder engagement** 



* Engage extensively with equipment manufacturers, module, cell, and ingot/wafer producers, industry associations, government agencies, and international bodies to collect data, understand technical and policy priorities and challenges, and validate research findings.
* Track and build relationships around technology partnerships, joint ventures, and industry collaborations relevant to global solar manufacturing.
* Lead stakeholder consultations and workshops, and represent CEEW in relevant industry, technical, and policy forums.



**Selection Criteria** 




**Qualification** 



* A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering — mechanical, materials science, chemical, or renewable energy — or a related technical discipline, with strong exposure to photovoltaic or semiconductor manufacturing.
* A minimum of 5 years of relevant technical experience in solar PV manufacturing, technology assessment, or related industry/research roles.
* Hands\-on or professional experience with solar PV manufacturing processes, equipment, or engineering — for instance, with a manufacturing company, equipment provider, or technical research institution — is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with techno\-economic modelling, cost analysis, or manufacturing process simulation tools is preferred.
* Exposure to industrial or trade policy, geopolitics, or manufacturing/supply chain management relevant to clean energy — through coursework, prior roles, or otherwise — is highly desirable.
* Past experience working with secondary trade and investment datasets, such as UN Comtrade or WITS (World Integrated Trade Solution), is an advantage.



**Skills** 



* Strong technical and engineering understanding of solar PV manufacturing processes, machinery and materials, and an ability to analyse policy, regulatory, and geopolitical developments and assess their implications for manufacturing competitiveness.
* Proficiency in tools such as techno\-economic analysis, multi\-criteria decision analysis, sensitivity analysis, decision trees, or Monte Carlo simulations is preferred.
* Familiarity with bottom\-up manufacturing cost models published by institutions such as NREL (National Renewable Energy Laboratory) and Fraunhofer ISE.
* Familiarity using AI tools, such as large language models and AI\-assisted research and analysis platforms, to speed up research workflows and produce quick, high\-quality outputs.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences, and present findings in a clear and accurate manner, both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment.



 CEEW operates in a dynamic environment, and the candidate will be required to show flexibility in undertaking a variety of tasks.

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Why This Role Exists**




 The Project Engineer – Operations role exists to strengthen how construction projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered by ensuring that accurate, timely, and actionable information flows seamlessly across teams. This role transforms design data, BIM models, and project documentation into clear guidance that supports predictable outcomes, reduces risk, and improves decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 By proactively identifying issues, improving constructability, and supporting disciplined workflows, the Project Engineer enables project teams to move from reactive problem\-solving to confident execution.
 



**Responsibility and Focus Areas:** 




**Document \& Models Management** 
 – Understand, analyze, and manage the versions of construction documents \& models on cloud platform ensuring the latest and greatest information is available to field team. The process can involve various Project Management Platforms like ACC Build, Procore, Bluebeam etc.
 



**RFI Management** 
 – Early identification of the potential RFI’s (Request for Information) on a project through Drawings \& Model based review and coordination, also understanding the raised RFI to identify appropriate details and portions of drawings impacted by RFI and link the same on the drawings for every stakeholder’s awareness.
 



**Submittal Management** 
 – Understanding the project specifications and interpreting it to create submittal log. Assist the project team in creating, tracking, and managing the submittal on Project Management Platforms
 



**Change Management** 
 – Through the updated Drawings and Models, assisting the project in tracking and reflecting the cost changes (due to changes in Drawings, RFI or any other factor) on the Project Management Platforms. Also, generating a scope change report by comparing the revised drawings against the current set of drawings, to help the project teams in validating cost changes.
 



**Construction Document \& Design Review** 
 – Review various construction documents like Design Drawings, Construction Drawings, Shop Drawings, Submittals and RFIs in the preconstruction phase to identify inconsistencies, incomplete information, and constructability issues.
 



**Model Based Coordination** 
 – Leveraging BIM, identify and resolve spatial and temporal conflicts between trades virtually thereby preempting them in the field which could be costly and can derail the project schedule. Identify data inconsistencies using Navisworks.
 



**Quality check** 
 models for completeness, accuracy and constructability based on design drawings and construction know\-how. Use automation wherever possible.
 



 Use
 **Data Visualization** 
 means to track metrics, indicators for project progress, and quality.
 



**Process Improvement \& Innovation** 




 • Identify opportunities to improve workflows and tools.
 



 • Partner with innovation teams on automation and AI initiatives.
 



 • Document lessons learned and best practices.
 



**A day in this role** 




 The day begins with reviewing priorities, open items, and any risks that need attention. You look at model updates, documents, and change requests to ensure the information going to the team is accurate and current. Short conversations with project managers, engineers, and field teams help align what needs to move first. You support client check ins by preparing updates or clarifying next steps. You guide junior team members on technical questions or workflow challenges. You spend time coordinating with cross functional groups so information flows without gaps. You also explore improvements in the way work is done by trying new tools or refining steps that can reduce rework. Before wrapping up, you capture key learnings, update trackers, and prepare for what the next day will require.
 



**What You Should Bring** 




 · Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
 



 · 2\-5 years of experience in construction operations and/or BIM
 



 · Strong understanding of construction lifecycle.
 



 · Strong understanding of building systems and proficiency with tools such as Revit, Navisworks, Revizto, BIM 360 or ACC, and Procore.

We provide services and solutions to the Construction Industry in the area of Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Project Controls Management, Accounting and Software Development. On any given day, we make an impact on several large\-scale construction projects across the globe through our services and solutions.
 



 Since we started in 2013, we are at a continuous lookout for talent driven by the vision to transform the construction industry by the use of technology.
 



 We are a subsidiary of DPR Construction, a USA based technical builder that specializes in highly complex projects in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Advance Technology, Higher Education and Commercial buildings.

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - Investor Relations - MarComms (Financial Operations)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are seeking a high\-caliber professional to join our Marketing Communications team under the Communications group, in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram office. This team produces fundraising materials and investor\-focused communications that are integral to firm’s fundraising, client service, and asset retention efforts across investment strategies. The role sits at the intersection of investment expertise, strategic communications, and storytelling, helping translate complex investment concepts into clear, compelling narratives for sophisticated institutional audiences. The successful candidate will serve as a key contributor to the firm's content and communications platform, partnering closely with investment professionals, product specialists, investor relations teams, legal, and senior leadership to create institutional\-grade communication materials that reflect analytical rigor, strategic clarity, and intellectual sophistication.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 You will draft, review, and refine investor\-facing communications that support both existing and new investment products, developing content for strategy presentations, product materials, investment insights, fundraising documents, and investor updates. You will translate complex investment strategies, portfolio positioning, risk frameworks, and performance drivers into clear, structured, and compelling institutional communication, while maintaining high\-quality content libraries to support efficient and scalable documentation. You will elevate the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of messaging across investor\-facing materials, and support the preparation of investor diligence materials, consultant questionnaires, and RFP responses as needed. You will partner with portfolio managers, product specialists, and senior investment professionals to distill investment views into concise and engaging narratives, helping shape how the firm communicates investment opportunities, competitive differentiation, and market perspectives to institutional investors. You will challenge and refine content to ensure clarity, precision, and audience relevance. You will build robust working relationships across investment, investor relations, legal, compliance, finance, and senior management teams, navigating complex stakeholder environments and synthesizing diverse perspectives into cohesive communications. You will drive content projects from concept to completion while managing multiple priorities and deadlines. You will leverage technology and AI\-enabled tools to enhance content creation, maintenance, and distribution processes, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency while preserving quality, accuracy, and intellectual rigor.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree from a top\-tier institution in journalism, communications, English literature, economics, finance, business or public policy or a related discipline
* 2–5 years of experience creating published content, investment communications, market commentary, thought leadership, or investor\-facing materials within financial services, business media, investment publishing, or related industries
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and persuasively
* Solid editing, proofreading, and content development capabilities with meticulous attention to detail
* Demonstrated ability to manage projects independently and collaborate effectively across functions and seniority levels
* Robust critical thinking skills and intellectual curiosity, particularly regarding financial markets and investing
* Readiness to submit writing samples and complete a writing assessment as part of the interview process


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience authoring market commentary, investment insights, thought leadership content, white papers, published articles, newsletters, or other analytical content
* Exposure to asset management, hedge funds, alternative investments, private markets, capital markets, wealth management, or institutional investing
* Experience working directly with investment professionals, portfolio managers, product specialists, or senior business stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to simplify sophisticated financial concepts for professional audiences
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, and Excel


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/AnaSrAnaMarCommsJuly26
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.

* Develop and continuously improve proposal processes, tools, templates, and best practices to increase efficiency, quality, and win rates.

* Collaborate with Business Development and leadership teams to understand Federal opportunities and develop proposal strategies aligned with customer requirements.
* Support the development of
 **proposal themes, differentiators, solution messaging, and competitive positioning** 
 .
* Work closely with technical and delivery teams to ensure proposed solutions are realistic, differentiated, and aligned with customer objectives.
* Coordinate proposal contributors, SMEs, technical resources, executives, and external partners throughout the proposal lifecycle.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to proposal managers, writers, coordinators, and other proposal team members.



  





**Strategic Partnerships \& Teaming** 



* Support relationships with
 **Federal prime contractors, small businesses, and technology partners** 
 .
* Coordinate with teaming partners to gather required proposal content, past performance, resumes, corporate information, and technical inputs.
* Ensure partner contributions are integrated into proposals in a consistent, compliant, and compelling manner.
* Support teaming and subcontracting opportunities that strengthen Federal proposal responses.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
* **8\+ years of experience in Federal proposal management and development within the IT Services industry.**
* Proven experience leading
 **complex U.S. Federal Government proposals** 
 from solicitation through final submission.
* **Strong hands\-on Federal proposal writing and editing experience is required.**
* Demonstrated ability to personally develop
 **executive summaries, technical and management approaches, past performance narratives, staffing approaches, win themes, discriminators, and other proposal sections** 
 .
* Strong understanding of U.S. Federal procurement processes,
 **FAR/DFARS, Federal evaluation criteria, and contract vehicles** 
 .
* Experience with
 **IDIQs, GWACs, BPAs, Task Orders, RFPs, and RFQs** 
 .
* Strong understanding of Federal IT Services and government contracting.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional proposal teams and manage multiple proposals simultaneously.
* Excellent
 **writing, editing, communication, leadership, organization, and stakeholder management skills** 
 .
* Ability to translate complex technical and business concepts into
 **clear, persuasive, and customer\-focused proposal content** 
 .
* Experience working with Federal teaming partners and subcontractors preferred.
* **APMP and/or Shipley certification preferred.**



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience supporting
 **U.S. Federal civilian agencies and/or DoD** 
 .
* Experience with major Federal contract vehicles, IDIQs, GWACs, and BPAs.
* Experience leading
 **Pink Team, Red Team, Gold Team, and compliance reviews** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of
 **Shipley/APMP proposal development methodologies** 
 .
* Demonstrated history of improving proposal quality, processes, and
 **Federal win rates** 
 .
* Experience managing multiple concurrent Federal proposals with aggressive submission deadlines.

title: Script Writer
description:
**About Theory Labs** 




 Theory Labs is a video studio that solves brand communication problems. We make short\-form ads, SaaS explainer commercials, AI\-generated short films, launch trailers, and brand videos for clients across crypto, fintech, and SaaS. Small team, fast cycles, work that ships.
 



 The role
 



**You write the words behind everything we make. That means:** 



* Scripts for 15–90s short\-form ads, SaaS explainers, AI short films, and launch trailers
* Research before writing — the client's product, their competitors, their audience, and what's currently working on the platform the video is going to.
* Original concepts, not just execution of a brief. You bring angles the client didn't ask for
* Scripts written to our production constraints: shot count, AI generation limits, what the editor can actually build.
* Direct collaboration with the producer, editors, and clients — including live rewrites in review calls.
* Fast turnarounds. First drafts in 24–48 hours is normal here.



**What you need to be able to do** 




**Not credentials. These are the results:** 



* Write a hook that holds attention past three seconds, repeatedly, not by luck.
* Structure a 30\-second ad and a 5\-minute film with equal control — different tools, same discipline.
* Explain a complex product in one sentence a stranger understands.
* Shift voice between brands without every script sounding like you.
* Write to a visual constraint and know the difference between a line that reads well and a line that plays well on screen.
* Research a niche you know nothing about and sound credible in it by the next day.
* Kill your own lines when the edit says they don't work.

title: Lending Documentation Specialist
description:
**Job Summary**
* The Lending Documentation Coordinator position is primarily to support the various business units for the Non\-Standard Documentation and, where applicable, Standard Documentation process in accordance with the Credit Documentation Process \- General Roles and Responsibilities and any further guidance from the Global Head, LDU.
* It is a critical role in supporting multiple business units across Corporate, Commercial \& Institutional Banking and ensuring client delivery through management of the Non\-Standard and Standard Documentation processes. Working closely with the Regional Head LDU, this role oversees a broad, holistic perspective of transaction management challenges and requirements in the region.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**
* Support the Regional Head LDU to set and implement the vision, strategy, direction for LDU regionally, consistent with the vision and strategy for LDU Global and in support of the Group's strategic direction and growth aspirations.
* Non\-Standard Documentation Process:
* Reviewing/checking bespoke / externally prepared loan documentation for complex, structured or syndicated transactions.
* Ensuring the financing structure and documentation is in compliance with the terms and spirit of the relevant credit approval and the Bank’s policies and procedures (including Operational Risk).
* Working closely with internal legal counsel and engaging and liaising with external counsel where required.
* Reviewing and confirming satisfaction of all required finance documentation, including Conditions Precedent, Conditions Subsequent and legal registrations perfection requirements, policy requirements and approvals via formal handover confirmation to the Credit Risk Control team for the authorisation of client limits.
* Standard Documentation Process:
* Drafting and negotiation of contractual, security and parental support documentation covering uncommitted and committed bilateral facilities in line with credit approvals.
* Drafting and negotiating local and global guarantees within Region and for the wider Bank network.
* Ensuring the financing structure and documentation is in compliance with the terms and spirit of the relevant credit approval and the Bank’s policies and procedures (including Operational Risk).
* Setting and collating all condition precedent/subsequent documentation.
* Engaging external counsel in relation to capacity and authority opinions and ensuring the review and sign of all legal opinions where required.
* Drafting corporate resolutions / reviewing constitutional documentation.
* Reviewing and confirming satisfaction of all required documentation, policy requirements and approvals via formal handover confirmation to the Credit Risk Control team for the authorisation of client limits.


**Business**
* Be a business partner to and independent guardian of the business, achieving the right balance.
* Single point of contact for any transactional escalations and remediation contact.
* Be a business partner to and independent guardian of the business, achieving the right balance.
* Utilise knowledge of business products and execution / funding processes undertaken in region to work with regional / cross\-regional business and functions to respond to transaction\-related questions.
* Work closely with stakeholders to ensure smooth integration of LDU processes with other processes of the Bank. In particular:
* Ensure that Legal and LDU work in an integrated fashion;
* Work closely with LDU in other regions to reduce duplicative work and ensure logical allocation of work (proposing exceptions to R\&R where necessary);
* Ensure that hand\-offs between Credit Risk Control and LDU are smooth and efficient;
* Resolve all roadblocks and any points requiring clarity, in collaborative fashion between LDU centres or between Legal and LDU or LDU and CRC.
* Adhere to LDU KPIs, ensuring that these are within thresholds.


**Processes**
* Identify process improvement initiatives / opportunities to drive efficiency across LDU.
* Implement and adhere to standardised operational excellence processes.
* Ensure completion of the LDU Data Activity Tracker in accurate and timely manner to facilitate preparation and management of Management Information including reports and dashboards.
* Support all control checks undertaken by LDU under the Operational Risk Framework (ORF).
* Ensure all LDU management information is updated/supplied promptly and accurately as required by the Regional/Global Heads, LDU.


**Risk Management**
* Mitigate possible risk and escalate to relevant stakeholders on potential identified risks.
* Ensure timely implementation and adherence to the Operational Risk Framework.
* Ensure Control Sample Test reviews are performed in a timely manner.
* Ensure all audit issues are handled in timely and appropriate manner.


**Governance**
* The maintenance of a robust control environment to ensure:
* The execution of documentation is approved by LDU in accordance with the Bank’s policies and the Credit Documentation Process \- General Roles and Responsibilities therefore ensuring the Bank is not exposed to unnecessary legal, commercial or regulatory risks.
* The timely processing of documentation and handover of condition precedent documentation to enable limit activation and collateral RWA to optimise revenue generation / return on tangible equity. Ensure the timely processing of any deferred conditions precedent / subsequent.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* Client Businesses covered by LDU
* Relationship Managers
* Global Credit Markets
* Credit Risk Approvers / Analysts
* Client Managers
* Legal
* Credit Documentation Unit (CDU) / Credit Risk Control (CRC)
* Global Lending Services
* Stressed Assets Group


**Skills And Experience**
* Manage Conduct
* Manage Risk
* Manage People
* Products and Processes
* Bank Lending
* Business Partnering
* Process Management


**Qualifications**
* Degree in legal, finance or business administration studies
* Legal qualification or equivalent extensive work experience.
* Languages: English
* Relevant experience in a similar finance documentation and transaction management role in the relevant market enabling day\-to\-day responsibilities to be carried out with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-moving, demanding environment whilst maintaining high quality output, good analytical skills, risk\-based approach and excellent attention to detail. Strong organisational and prioritising skills are essential.
* Strong team player with excellent communication skills in order to effectively liaise with and develop close working relationships with stakeholders and business partners, across various jurisdictions.
* Good level of experience of international loan and security documentation (including LMA, LSTA, APLMA).
* Good level of knowledge of the Bank’s products (including Project \& Export Finance, Leveraged \& Acquisition Finance, Shipping, Subscription Finance, Commercial Real Estate) in relation to documentation.
* Detailed knowledge of the Bank’s relevant policies and procedures.
* Ability to quickly assimilate complex syndication and bilateral lending deals and product structures.
* Good knowledge of minimum acceptance criteria and collateral verification requirements.
* Good knowledge of the Bank’s standard template documentation.
* Good level of drafting and negotiation skills.


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

**Social Media Content Writer \& Strategist** 




  





**Location:** 
  Hyderabad, Telangana
 



**Work Mode:** 
  Full\-time, On\-site
 



**Working Days:** 
  Monday–Saturday
 



**Working Hours:** 
  10:00 AM–6:00 PM
 



**Experience:** 
  1–3 years
 



**Salary:** 
  ₹20,000\+ per month, depending on experience and suitability
 



**Probation:** 
  3 months
 



  





**About We Connect** 




 We Connect is a Hyderabad\-based professional event management company delivering end\-to\-end solutions for brands and organizations. Our work spans corporate events, exhibitions, promotions, convergence programs, loyalty initiatives, sports events, seminars and other experiential marketing initiatives.
 



 We work closely with clients to understand their objectives and create experiences that are tailored to their brand, audience and business requirements. By bringing multiple aspects of event planning and execution together, We Connect provides clients with a cohesive, single\-point solution for their event and marketing needs.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a 
 **Social Media Content Writer \& Strategist** 
  with 1–3 years of experience who can take ownership of the written content and creative direction behind our social media presence.
 



 This is primarily a 
 **social\-media\-focused role** 
 . You will be responsible for researching, developing and writing content that is engaging, relevant and aligned with the objectives of both We Connect and our clients.
 



 The ideal candidate is someone who can look beyond simply "writing a caption." We are looking for a creative thinker who can understand an audience, identify what makes a piece of content interesting, develop content ideas and translate marketing objectives into compelling social\-media communication.
 



 You will work closely with the Marketing and Design teams and, when required, interact with clients to understand their brand, marketing strategy and communication objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Social Media Content \& Strategy — Primary Responsibility** 



* Develop creative and engaging social\-media content ideas for We Connect and its clients.
* Write captions, hooks, scripts, post copy, campaign copy and other social\-media content.
* Develop content themes and concepts based on brand objectives, target audiences and current trends.
* Research social\-media trends, formats, conversations and relevant industry developments.
* Contribute to social\-media content calendars and campaign planning.
* Adapt content and messaging for different platforms and audiences.
* Work with the Design team to translate written concepts into effective visual content.
* Develop content that encourages audience engagement, retention and interaction.
* Review existing content and identify opportunities to improve its creativity, relevance and performance.
* Understand basic social\-media performance indicators and use learnings to improve future content.
* Maintain consistency in brand voice, tone and messaging across social channels.
* Think creatively about how events, campaigns and client work can be transformed into engaging social\-media stories.



**Event \& Client Content** 



* Develop written content around corporate events, exhibitions, brand activations, seminars and other events.
* Occasionally attend or support events to understand the experience and identify content opportunities.
* Work with event teams to gather relevant information, stories and details for content development.
* Understand client marketing objectives and translate them into appropriate content.
* Occasionally participate in client discussions to understand their brand positioning, campaigns and communication requirements.
* Develop content that communicates the value, impact and experience of events rather than simply describing them.



**Website, Blog \& Case Study Content** 




 While social media is the primary focus of this role, you will also contribute to the company's wider digital content requirements, including:
 


* Website pages and updates.
* Blog articles and thought\-leadership content.
* Event and campaign case studies.
* Landing\-page copy.
* Supporting digital marketing content.



**Research \& Content Development** 



* Independently research clients, industries, audiences, competitors, events and relevant topics.
* Identify useful information and trends that can inform content ideas.
* Fact\-check information before publication.
* Turn research into original, useful and engaging content.
* Continuously explore new creative approaches to digital communication.



**SEO \& CMS** 



* Apply basic on\-page SEO principles to website and blog content.
* Understand keyword placement, headings, readability, meta descriptions and internal linking.
* Experience with WordPress or another CMS is preferred but not mandatory.
* Experience with tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, keyword research tools or similar platforms will be considered an advantage.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Essential** 



* 1–3 years of experience in content writing, social\-media content, digital marketing, advertising, agency or related fields.
* Excellent written English and strong command of grammar, structure and tone.
* Strong creative writing ability.
* Ability to develop original ideas rather than relying solely on established content formats.
* Strong research skills and the ability to independently understand unfamiliar topics.
* Ability to write for corporate audiences while maintaining creativity and engagement.
* Strong sense of deadlines and punctuality.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned work and follow it through to completion.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Marketing, Design, Event and Client teams.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Hyderabad.
* A portfolio of relevant writing/content work is 
 **mandatory** 
 .



**Preferred / Advantageous** 



* Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, English, Marketing, Advertising or a related field.
* Experience working with corporate brands or agencies.
* Experience in event management, experiential marketing or advertising.
* Experience with WordPress or another CMS.
* Basic understanding of SEO and digital marketing analytics.
* Familiarity with social\-media trends and emerging content formats.
* Experience using content research, analytics or productivity tools.
* Experience working with designers to develop social\-media content.



  





**The Kind of Person We're Looking For** 




 We are looking for someone who is:
 



**Creative** 
  — You should be comfortable developing ideas that go beyond conventional or repetitive content formats.
 



**Punctual** 
  — Content and campaigns operate around deadlines. We expect you to plan your work and deliver on time.
 



**Ownership\-driven** 
  — We want someone who doesn't need to be told every small step. You should be willing to research, think, ask questions and find solutions.
 



**Collaborative** 
  — Content at We Connect is developed alongside Marketing, Design, Events and clients. You should be comfortable exchanging ideas and taking feedback.
 



**Adaptable** 
  — Every client, campaign and event can be different. We value people who can change their approach according to the situation.
 



**Not overly restrictive** 
  — We value creative thinking. If you are someone who can only work within rigid formats or needs a predetermined formula for every piece of content, this may not be the right role for you.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within the first six months, success in this role would mean:
 


* Social\-media content is consistently delivered on time.
* Content demonstrates strong creativity and an understanding of the intended audience.
* Social\-media content shows improving audience engagement and viewer retention.
* We Connect's social presence has a consistent and recognizable voice.
* Client content accurately reflects their brand and marketing objectives.
* Clients are satisfied with the quality and relevance of the content produced for them.
* The writer can independently research a brief and develop strong content ideas without excessive supervision.
* The Marketing and Design teams can work efficiently with the writer to turn ideas into finished content.



  





**Working Environment** 




 This is a 
 **full\-time, on\-site position in Hyderabad** 
 , working Monday to Saturday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
 



 Event and client requirements may occasionally require work beyond standard working hours. Any additional hours will be compensated according to company policy.
 



 Details regarding additional employee benefits and other employment terms will be discussed during the hiring process.
 



  





**Growth** 




 The role provides an opportunity to grow into positions such as:
 


* Senior Content Writer
* Content Strategist
* Marketing Lead



 Growth will be based on performance, ownership, creative ability and the individual's contribution to the company's marketing and content function.
 



  





**Application Requirements** 




 Applicants should submit:
 


1. Updated CV/Resume.
2. Writing portfolio containing relevant social\-media, web or marketing content.
3. Examples of social\-media writing where possible.



 Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a writing assessment focused on:
 


* Social\-media writing
* Web writing
* Creativity
* Ability to understand a brief and develop an original content approach



  





**Candidates with strong writing ability and creative thinking are encouraged to apply, regardless of whether their educational background is directly related to content or marketing.**

title: Polymers Application Development Technologist - Advanced
description:

 Help grow our ProxximaTM polyolefin thermoset system business. These resin formulations are based on cyclic C5 monomers and other proprietary monomers and additives.

* Willing and able to travel domestically and internationally.
* Strong interpersonal, analytical and communication skills.

title: ICM Training Analyst
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
 Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward\-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
   

  

 At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an ICM Training Analyst, you will support the Global Training \& Awareness Lead in delivering and scaling the crisis training and scenario\-based exercise programme within Integrated Crisis Management (ICM). You will be a key member of the ICM team within Global Business Resilience (GBR), Corporate Security, collaborating closely with the Global Training \& Awareness Lead, ICM leads, and senior stakeholders across the function. You will help increase the frequency, diversity, and quality of crisis exercises — with particular emphasis on AI\-specific scenarios that prepare leadership for an increasingly AI\-driven threat environment. As a team of self\-starters, you can work with impact alongside our vibrant people and culture, all while enjoying unmatched learning opportunities.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Support the design and build of crisis exercise scenarios under the direction of the Programme Lead, across emerging risk areas including cyber, geopolitical, and operational threats.
* Support the development of AI\-specific crisis scenarios — such as model misuse, AI\-enabled cyberattacks, and AI system failures — helping equip leadership to anticipate and respond to the risks of an increasingly AI\-driven threat environment.
* Support the preparation and delivery of executive tabletop exercises and briefings, including presenting content and capturing outcomes and actions.
* Design clear, professional presentation material and engage confidently with senior stakeholders across GBR and Corporate Security.
* Produce exercise materials — scenario narratives, injects, facilitation guides, pre\-reads, and polling content — to a consistent, high\-quality standard.
* Maintain exercise trackers, evidence folders, and artefacts to agreed standards, and support programme tracking, governance, delivery\-readiness checks, and validation of IRT orientation data.
* Maintain programme content and platforms — including web and intranet pages — and administer ServiceNow records and attachments, maintaining data integrity across systems.
* Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work.


**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* Experience in programme coordination, training and exercise support, business resilience, crisis management, or a closely related discipline (typically 3–6 years).
* A confident communicator and presenter, comfortable engaging and presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Strong organisational skills with meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to data integrity.
* Proficiency with ServiceNow, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft 365 / Teams, intranet / web content, and PowerPoint.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, \& Own It


**These will help you succeed**
* Familiarity with, or strong interest in, the AI risk landscape — including model misuse, AI\-enabled attacks, and AI system failures.
* Experience supporting scenario or content design for training and exercises.
* A background or interest in security, risk, business resilience, or crisis management.
* Confidence supporting or facilitating workshops and tabletop exercises.


**Work model \- Hybrid**
 We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position which requires attendance in Bangalore/Chennai office 3\-4 days a week. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programmes.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
   

  

 We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Machinical Engineering - Connected Physical Products and IOT - Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 At PwC our Consulting professionals from Physical Product Development \& Manufacturing (PPDM) team partner with clients across diverse industries to address critical business challenges and drive transformation in how products are designed, engineered, and manufactured. The team delivers impact through strategic advisory and implementation services in the areas of Connected Physical Products, Digital Engineering, Product Development Excellence, Digital Manufacturing and Manufacturing Excellence \- enabling organizations to design, develop, manufacture, and optimize products more efficiently across the entire product lifecycle.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Associate with Mechanical Engineering background to join our Connected Products Team, responsible for the design, development, validation, and launch of innovative connected hardware products across product lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in mechanical product development, consumer electronics, IoT devices, smart products, and high\-volume manufacturing.
   

  

**Position Requirements**
 Candidates should demonstrate
 **substantial experience and / or knowledge** 
 in one or more of the following areas
   

  

**Product Design \& Engineering**
* Design and develop mechanical systems and components for connected products from concept through production.
* Create and maintain 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and product documentation.
* Drive design reviews, tolerance analyses, and engineering change management.

title: Technical account manager
description:
**About Refold**
 Refold is building the next\-generation AI platform that replaces enterprise integration and consultants. We're pioneering autonomous AI agents that understand complex enterprise systems, generate production\-ready code, and operate at a scale no consulting firm can match. Today, we're starting with integrations—a $50 B market. Tomorrow, we're building towards a world where AI agents handle any complex cognitive work.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia \& Abhishek Kumar, who sold their previous startup to Netmeds; they have also been featured in Forbes 30 under 30\. They have experience at organisations such as Nomura, Jio Mart, Insta Mojo, IIT Kharagpur, and IIT Roorkee. We are funded by marquee investors, including Eniac Ventures, Tidal Ventures, Karman Ventures, Ahead VC \& Better Capital.
   

  

 We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Enterprise Delivery Lead is the single point of contact who owns the customer journey from kickoff to go\-live and beyond, as the steward of account health, adoption, and success. Sitting at the intersection of program management, customer success, and technical account management, you orchestrate complex, AI\-native integration delivery so customers don't just go live — they adopt, expand, and succeed.
   

  

 You're technical enough to lead the conversation and run technical account management. Your edge is exceptional communication and structured program management. You own onboarding, scoping, planning, adoption, and escalations; partner with the Architects and FDEs who build, and surface expansion signals to the Growth team. We're looking for an outstanding communicator and program manager who thrives in ambiguity and holds the business and technical picture at once.
   

  

 Team: Small, high\-impact delivery team working closely with Architects, Engineers, Product Support, and Founders. You own: Onboarding, scoping, project planning, implementation, adoption, success, escalations, and account health. You'll work with: CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and integration leaders at Fortune 500 and high\-growth Saa S companies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Own Enterprise Delivery \- Own the enterprise relationship from kick\-off to go\-live \& beyond — managing expectations and maintaining executive alignment. Think like a strategic advisor. Challenge assumptions, pressure\-test what was scoped, and recommend the approach that actually solves the customer's core business problem — not just the one that was asked for. Lead onboarding and scoping. Run post\-sales discovery and alignment workshops to refine requirements, success metrics, and a delivery plan that survives contact with the customer's real systems. Own planning and execution. Plan and manage implementation phases, milestones, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication across multiple concurrent engagements. Drive adoption and value realisation. Make sure delivered integrations are actually adopted and track the outcomes that matter, against a clear account\-health framework. Drive expansion and product direction \- Spot and surface expansion opportunities to the growth team, relay customer feedback and platform gaps to Product and Engineering.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Abilities**
 5–8 years in technology consulting, solution delivery, program management, customer success, or technical account management. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management — this is the core of the role. You build trust and drive alignment with everyone from engineers to C\-level executives. Strong, structured program and project management across multiple concurrent enterprise engagements — milestones, dependencies, risks, and crisp status communication. A success\-and\-adoption mindset — you measure yourself by whether the customer adopts, expands usage, and realises value, not just whether the project shipped. Enough technical fluency to lead integration discussions, run technical account management, and challenge assumptions — you don't need to write code, and you have the Architects as your technical depth. A structured thinker who's comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex enterprise environments. A track record of building long\-term, trusted relationships through clarity, confidence, and results.
   

  

**Nice To Have**
 Familiarity with AI / agentic concepts and how AI\-native integration platforms deliver value. Solid understanding of enterprise integrations, workflows, or automation platforms. Experience with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce, or Workday. Familiarity with i Paa S or workflow automation platforms (Workato, Boomi, Mule Soft, Zapier, Merge). Background in management consulting, digital transformation, or business systems analysis. Startup or early\-stage company experience.
   

  

 Why Join Refold AI?
   

  

 Fast\-growing seed\-stage company (raised $6\.5 M from Eniac Ventures \& Tidal Ventures) Founding team opportunity to shape engineering culture and technical direction from day one Cutting\-edge AI \+ infrastructure tech solving complex, high\-value enterprise problems Early traction with Fortune 500 clients and high\-growth software companies Direct line of sight to leadership and future engineering management path Work with a small, exceptional team that ships fast and celebrates bold ideas
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 We're a small, fast\-growing team, and we're intentional about building an inclusive culture from day one. We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don't discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. If you're excited by our mission, you belong here.
