title: Techno functional analyst
description:
**About SAR Transport:** 




  






 SAR is one of the leading Logistics companies in India in the supply chain and logistics industry on the international level. SAR Logistics is 1000\+ people strong and one of its kind on the national and international level in the logistics domain. The annual turnover of the group company is estimated at around INR 2200 Cr\+. The organization has been working continuously to provide customer satisfaction to its clients by providing various services and offers to its loyal customers who are working in the same domain. Reliability and years of experience have made the company stand where it is now.
 




  





**Job Description:** 





 SAR runs a two\-part Strategy structure: this function identifies problems and specifies solutions; a separate Data \& Technology team builds them. You are the critical link between the two — you don't write code, but the quality of what gets built depends entirely on the quality of what you specify.
 




  






 You'll be embedded in a business or zone, expected to understand its Sales, Operations and Finance processes deeply enough to diagnose real problems — not symptoms — and translate them into requirement documents precise enough that a developer can build against them without needing to ask twenty follow\-up questions.
 




  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* Run periodic reviews with Sales/Ops/Finance stakeholders to track business health, closure of action items and adoption of solutions.
* Map current\-state processes across Sales, Operations and Finance for your assigned business — directly working with function heads
* Track and interpret the core business metrics by segment: Volume, Revenue, GP, EBITDA, PBT, AR ageing, AP ageing etc.
* Write detailed business and functional  requirement documents for the Data \& Technology team, covering data sources, logic, edge cases, and what “done” looks like.
* Own the loop end\-to\-end: requirement → UAT → rollout → adoption tracking. A shipped solution nobody uses is not a completed task.
* Identify the root cause behind a problem — not just the dashboard someone asked for — before proposing a fix.



  





**Qualification:** 




**Preferred Background** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in CRM/ERP/TMS/WMS implementation, internal IT\-business liaison roles, or business/process analyst roles within logistics, manufacturing, or another operationally intensive industry.
* A demonstrated track record of writing functional or requirement specs that a development team actually built from — not just process slides.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets fluency; working familiarity with SQL, Power BI, or low\-code tools is a strong plus.
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Tally, or similar) and working knowledge of financial statements
* Comfort with shadowing sales and ops teams on the ground, not just analyzing exports from a desk.
* Prior exposure to freight forwarding, logistics, or supply chain is a plus but not mandatory if the process\-to\-spec muscle is strong.
* Experience with IT projects/ digitalization is an added advantage.

title: Electronic Systems Product Specialist
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
 Investigates electronic application and systems problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Processes include system specification, modeling and simulation, calibration, Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP\&R), and troubleshooting. Application of tools for simulation, calibration, and product life maintenance required. Obtains input from customers, technical and product teams, manufacturing engineers, supplier partners, and other stakeholders to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Makes decisions in the areas of electronic and electrical system design, requirements, calibration, and test that impact the quality and performance of calibrated subsystems and feature classes of electronic subsystems. Responsible for review of less\-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient design. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Design and Application of Mechatronics Systems \- Specifies electronic hardware and interconnections that measure and control systems; applies electronic hardware and interconnections in Cummins' products.
   

  

 Machine Integration and Optimization \- Combines various parts or sub\-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem\-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.
   

  

 Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements.
   

  

 Product Problem Solving \- Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
   

  

 Product Verification and Validation Management \- Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
   

  

 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Systems Thinking \- Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
   

  

 Builds networks \- Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

 Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls \- Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
   

  

 Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Provide technical and application engineering support to Marine , Pump and defence customers/OEMs by understanding customer requirements, supporting engine and electronic system integration, managing calibration\-related activities, and ensuring successful execution of customer projects. The role serves as the primary technical interface between OEM customers and Cummins cross\-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.

title: Hardware Functional Safety (FuSa) Specialist
description:
**Enabling a software\-defined, electrified future.**
 Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading\-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software\-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here .
   

  

**Mission of the Role** 
**:** 
 The Functional Safety Specialist is responsible for ensuring that automotive electronic systems comply with ISO 26262 and related safety standards. The role involves safety concept creation, hazard analysis, safety requirements engineering, technical safety architecture, verification planning, and supporting hardware/software teams through the full safety lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Functional Safety Lifecycle Management
* Lead and execute activities across the ISO 26262 V\-model safety lifecycle, from concept phase to SOP.
* Develop and maintain the Functional Safety Plan, timelines, and work products.
* Ensure processes are followed and all safety artifacts are created and reviewed.
* Safety Analysis \& Concept Development
* Perform Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and derive ASIL levels.
* Develop Functional Safety Concept (FSC) and Technical Safety Concept (TSC).
* Define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and safety requirements (FSR/TSR).
* Requirements Engineering
* Write, review, and maintain functional and technical safety requirements.
* Ensure bi\-directional traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and validation.
* Support system, hardware, and software teams to interpret and implement safety requirements.
* Hardware \& Software Safety
* Collaborate with hardware architects to define safety mechanisms for MCU, PMIC, watchdog, self\-tests, power domains, fault handling, etc.
* Support software teams in designing safety\-compliant drivers, boot, diagnostics, and monitoring logic.
* Review MCU safety manuals, safety architecture, and vendor documentation (e.g., Infineon Traveo II, NXP, Renesas).
* Safety Analysis \& Verification
* Conduct and review FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, Dependent Failure Analysis.
* Calculate FIT rates, single\-point fault metrics, and latent fault metrics.
* Create safety validation plans and support unit/integration/system\-level testing.
* Audits, Assessments \& Compliance
* Prepare safety case documentation for customer and auditor reviews.
* Work with internal/external assessors (TÜV, Exida, OEM auditors).
* Support ASPICE, cybersecurity (ISO 21434\), and quality\-compliance alignment.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Provide training and guidance to development teams on ISO 26262 processes.
* Work directly with system architects, hardware designers, software teams, testing, quality, cybersecurity, and program management.
* Participate in design reviews and ensure safety considerations are incorporated early.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of ISO 26262 Part 2–12 and full safety lifecycle.
* Expertise in safety analyses: FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA.
* Understanding of safety architecture for MCUs, SoCs, and automotive ECUs.
* Experience with safety mechanisms: lockstep CPUs, watchdogs, ECC, BIST/MBIST, CRC, voltage monitoring, clock monitoring, safe states, etc.
* Experience with requirements management tools: DOORS, Polarion, Jama, etc.
* Working knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware design, and automotive software development.


**Domain Knowledge**
* Automotive electronics: clusters, body control, powertrain, ADAS, infotainment, or battery systems.
* Exposure to ASPICE, ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity), and OEM\-specific safety processes.
* Experience
* 5–15 years of experience in automotive embedded systems.
* Minimum 5\+ years in Functional Safety roles.
* Experience delivering at least one safety\-critical product to SOP.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Certified Functional Safety Engineer/Professional (TÜV, Exida).
* Experience with safety implementation on MCUs like Infineon Traveo II, NXP S32, Renesas R\-Car, TI Hercules.
* Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or related engineering field.
* Experience with model\-based development (MATLAB/Simulink).


**Visteon Culture:** 
 If you thrive in a fast\-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk\-taking, and continuous learning help us keep up with the ever\-changing landscape of our industry and be Market leaders. At Visteon you can be more.

description:
At POD \- Josh Technology Group, we are seeking a Client Engagement professional to drive platform adoption and digital transformation across partner universities. This role serves as the primary strategic interface for senior academic leadership, leading end\-to\-end onboarding and tailored training. The primary objective is to own the total user experience, ensuring seamless adoption and high client satisfaction throughout the institutional lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Executive and academic stakeholder management: function as the primary strategic interface for senior academic leadership, including Deans, Heads of Departments, Examination Controllers, and Placement Directors, building long\-term partnerships, aligning platform capabilities with institutional goals, and proactively resolving operational blockers.
* On\-ground onboarding and rollout: lead end\-to\-end institutional onboarding across diverse academic functions (academics, examinations, assessments, placements, and alumni relations), customizing deployment models to match each institution's administrative hierarchy and academic calendar.
* Tailored on\-ground training programs: design and deliver interactive, role\-based training sessions, both on\-ground and virtual, for faculty, administrative staff, and students, to ensure a smooth transition from legacy manual processes to platform workflows.
* Change management and capability building: guide academic staff through digital transformation, creating quick\-reference guides, self\-serve toolkits, and best\-practice frameworks that build internal self\-sufficiency across departments.
* Cross\-functional institutional support: oversee day\-to\-day operations across all platform modules, whether managing semester exam logistics, continuous internal assessments, alumni network tracking, or corporate engagement, ensuring seamless platform adoption in every use case.
* Proactive escalation and query resolution: establish robust SLA\-driven support protocols to resolve complex user queries and platform issues swiftly, maintaining high system availability and minimal operational friction during critical academic cycles.
* User usage and health monitoring: monitor key product usage metrics, such as active faculty logins, assessment completion rates, and alumni engagement frequency, to track institutional health, identify low\-adoption departments, and run targeted intervention strategies.
* Structured Voice of Customer (VoC) loops: gather actionable feedback directly from faculty, students, and administrators through structured surveys and focus groups, translating raw user experience insights into functional feature requests for the product and engineering teams.
* Persuasive product demonstration and advocacy: maintain deep, expert\-level product knowledge to comfortably demonstrate new features, modules, and platform enhancements to existing leadership or potential partner institutions.
* End\-to\-end user experience ownership: take full accountability for total user satisfaction across both administrative power users and the general student body, ensuring the platform consistently delivers a friction\-free experience.


 About Company: Josh Technology Group was launched in 2009 and it has been 13 years since our inception \& we have been profitable from day 1 \& aspire to reach new heights. JTG has successfully created and launched more than 100 products, spread across various industries, and is working on many more exciting new ones. We act as CTO offices for various companies across the globe. When we say CTO offices, we kind of own the product end\-to\-end. description:
**Company Description** 
 Jitsan Filter Industries is a leading manufacturer and supplier of industrial filtration and process equipment, including filter bags, hydraulic filters, pipe strainers, heat exchangers, and agitator tanks. The company serves a diverse range of industrial clients that rely on reliable, high\-quality products to support critical operations. In addition to manufacturing, Jitsan Filter Industries provides installation services to ensure effective implementation and performance of its solutions. Team members work in a setting that values technical accuracy, customer satisfaction, and long\-term partnerships. The organization offers opportunities to grow within the industrial and engineering services sector.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Tender Executive role based in Kolkata. The Tender Executive will be responsible for identifying relevant tender opportunities, collecting and reviewing tender documents, and coordinating with internal teams to gather technical and commercial information. The role involves preparing tender proposals, quotations, and supporting documentation, ensuring compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. The Tender Executive will maintain tender trackers, follow up on submissions, update management on tender outcomes, and support negotiation activities when required. Daily tasks also include maintaining accurate records, working with sales and operations teams, and supporting customer communication related to tenders and bids.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong tender management skills, including tender search, document review, bid preparation, and submission tracking.
* Proficiency in documentation and data management, including maintaining tender records, preparing reports, and organizing supporting materials.
* Solid communication and coordination abilities to work effectively with sales, technical, and operations teams, as well as external stakeholders.
* Basic understanding of industrial products such as filters, strainers, heat exchangers, and related equipment, with willingness to learn technical specifications.
* Comfort with using office productivity tools (e.g., MS Word, Excel, email) and online tender portals or procurement platforms.
* Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Relevant educational background, such as a degree or diploma in business, commerce, engineering, or a related field.
* Prior experience in tendering, sales support, or industrial supply is an advantage but motivated entry\-level candidates may also be considered.

title: Documentation Specialist
description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**



Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45\+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.



Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.


**About Amtech**



Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.



With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.


**Our Employee Value Proposition**



At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:


**Purpose**



Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission\-critical enterprise software used by industry\-leading organizations.


**Growth**



Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross\-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.


**Culture**



Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people\-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.


**Innovation**



Engage with cutting\-edge technologies, including AI\-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

  


**Role Description**



We are looking for a Senior Documentation Specialist to own the customer\-facing documentation experience for Amtech's ERP and MES products. You will be the person who turns complex manufacturing workflows — estimating a corrugated order, scheduling a corrugator run, tracking WIP through conversion, closing the loop to invoicing — into documentation our customers actually use and trust.



This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You will write and maintain user guides, in\-application help, release notes, and how\-to content; you will also set the standards, style, and structure that all Amtech product documentation follows. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Implementation, and Support, and you will be expected to learn our customers' world — the plant floor, the order lifecycle, the way a packaging manufacturer actually operates.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Documentation ownership**


* Plan, write, edit, and maintain the full library of customer\-facing documentation for Amtech's ERP and MES products, including user guides, configuration and administration guides, quick\-reference materials, and in\-application help.
* Own the release notes process end to end — partner with Product and Engineering each release cycle to capture what changed, why it matters, and what customers need to do about it.
* Audit existing content on a regular cadence; retire what is stale, rewrite what is unclear, and close gaps that show up in support tickets and customer feedback.

**Standards and structure**


* Establish and enforce a documentation style guide, terminology standards, and content templates so that everything Amtech publishes reads as one voice.
* Define and improve the information architecture of the help center — how content is organized, searched, versioned, and navigated across product lines and releases.
* Administer and improve the documentation toolchain and publishing workflow; recommend improvements to tooling, single\-sourcing, and reuse.

**Collaboration and subject\-matter expertise**


* Partner with Product Managers, developers, QA, implementation consultants, and support engineers to gather source material, validate technical accuracy, and get ahead of upcoming releases.
* Use the product yourself. Build a working understanding of packaging manufacturing operations and of how Amtech customers configure and run the system in production.
* Participate in release readiness and go\-to\-market planning to ensure documentation ships alongside the software, not after it.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to document AI\-enabled capabilities as they ship, making new intelligence features understandable and trustworthy to customers.

**Quality and measurement**


* Define quality standards for documentation and review the work of other contributors — writers, product managers, and engineers who contribute content.
* Track documentation effectiveness using search analytics, page performance, support ticket deflection, and direct customer feedback; use that data to prioritize the roadmap.

**SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**


**Required Qualification**


* 6\+ years of professional experience in technical writing, product documentation, or technical communications, with a substantial portion producing customer\-facing content for a software product.
* Demonstrated experience documenting enterprise software — ERP, MES, supply chain, or comparable operational systems.
* A portfolio of published documentation you can walk us through, showing how you explain complex, multi\-step workflows to a non\-technical operational audience.
* The ability to take an engineer's explanation of a feature and turn it into instructions a plant scheduler can follow on the first read — precise, plain, and logically sequenced, with no step assumed.
* A rigorous eye for editing: you cut what is unnecessary, catch inconsistent terminology, and hold a large content library to one standard.
* Proven experience owning documentation standards — style guides, templates, terminology, and information architecture — not just executing against someone else's.
* Hands\-on experience with a component content management or help\-authoring platform — MadCap Flare, Paligo, Heretto, Document360, Zendesk Guide, Confluence, or comparable — including publishing, versioning, and single\-sourcing across product lines.
* Proficiency with screen capture and image editing tools for clear, consistent visual documentation.
* Comfort working directly with software: navigating a complex application, reading a spec, testing a workflow, and validating your own instructions against the product.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent releases and competing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Engineering, Information Science, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Direct experience documenting ERP and/or MES platforms, especially in a manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with packaging, corrugated, folding carton, label, or other discrete or process manufacturing operations.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing and business concepts such as specifications, routings, scheduling, WIP tracking, inventory, order\-to\-cash, and shop\-floor data collection.
* Experience with docs\-as\-code workflows (Markdown, Git, static site generators) or structured authoring (DITA, XML).
* Experience producing video walkthroughs, product tours, or e\-learning content alongside written docs.
* Exposure to API or integration documentation.
* Comfort using AI tools to accelerate drafting, editing, and content audits — with the judgment to know where human verification is non\-negotiable.
* Interest in structuring documentation for machine consumption as well as human readers, so content can reliably feed in\-product AI assistants and search.
* Experience supporting a global customer base, including localization or translation workflows.
* Background in a SaaS or hybrid on\-premise/cloud software environment with a regular release cadence.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**



Hybrid role based out of Amtech's Bengaluru office, with roughly three days per week on\-site, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Support colleagues across our India and North America teams. Occasional travel for customer site visits, industry events, or company meetings.


**Why Join Amtech**



At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world\-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross\-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

 Break. Believe. Build.
   

  

 Break stuff, break assumptions, break the thumb rule.

* Dissatisfaction with mediocre work
* Ability to multi\-task and handle a dynamic working environment
* Resilient attitude to bounce back after failing

Today, our platform powers high\-utilisation commercial vehicles \- from three\-wheelers to intercity buses, making electric mobility rapid, more reliable and more affordable than petroleum.
   

  

 Founded by Arun Vinayak (Founding Partner \& Former Chief Product Officer, Ather Energy), Exponent is a 250\+ member team of passionate builders solving some of the toughest engineering challenges in energy.

**Position Overview**
 The Consultant, Regulatory Operations will support the preparation, formatting, compilation, publishing, validation and dispatch of regulatory submissions in accordance with applicable regional requirements, internal procedures and project timelines. This role is responsible for assisting with submission\-ready document preparation, eCTD publishing activities, technical validation checks and lifecycle submission support for dossiers such as IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, amendments and responses, as applicable.
   

  

 The position requires hands\-on support in regulatory document conversion, hyperlinking, bookmarking, PDF quality checks, eCTD sequence preparation, validation using approved tools, and submission dispatch through relevant health authority gateways under the guidance of senior team members. The role also involves coordination with CMC Regulatory Affairs, Labelling, Clinical, Quality and other cross\-functional teams to ensure timely collection, organization and processing of documents while maintaining accuracy, compliance and audit\-ready documentation standards.
   

  

**WORK LOCATION:**
 Bangalore
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 (This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or changed as necessary.)
   

  

* Prepare, convert, format and quality check regulatory documents, including clinical, nonclinical, CMC, labelling and administrative documents, to ensure they are submission\-ready and compliant with applicable formatting standards.
* Perform document\-level activities such as PDF conversion, hyperlinking, bookmarking, pagination checks, document property verification, file naming checks and technical readiness review as per internal procedures and submission requirements.
* Support compilation and publishing of assigned regulatory submissions in eCTD format using approved publishing tools under the guidance of senior team members.
* Assist in preparation of regulatory submissions including IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, amendments, supplements and responses to health authority queries, as applicable.
* Perform eCTD sequence preparation, document placement, leaf title checks, metadata review and lifecycle operator checks in accordance with regional regulatory requirements and internal checklists.
* Conduct technical validation of assigned submissions using approved validation tools and support resolution of validation errors or warnings in coordination with senior team members.
* Support dispatch of submissions through applicable health authority gateways or portals such as FDA ESG, EMA Gateway/Web Client, MHRA Submissions Portal and other regional systems, as required.
* Maintain accurate publishing records, validation reports, submission acknowledgements, dispatch confirmations and related documentation to ensure audit\-ready traceability.
* Coordinate with CMC Regulatory Affairs, Labelling, Clinical, Quality and other cross\-functional teams for timely receipt, review, organization and processing of documents required for regulatory submissions.
* Track assigned publishing activities, timelines, pending documents, validation status and submission milestones, and provide timely updates to senior team members and stakeholders.
* Follow applicable ICH guidelines, regional eCTD specifications, internal SOPs, work instructions, naming conventions, quality checklists and document management requirements while performing assigned activities.
* Escalate document quality issues, publishing challenges, validation errors, missing inputs, timeline risks or technical system issues in a timely manner to ensure submission continuity and compliance.
* Support routine use of regulatory operations tools such as Lorenz DocuBridge, Lorenz e\-validator, ISI Toolbox, Adobe Acrobat Pro, RIM systems and document management systems for assigned activities.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives, standardization of publishing practices, checklist updates and digitization activities within Regulatory Operations, as assigned.


**Education**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:**
* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, regulatory affairs, biotechnology, or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in regulatory publishing, regulatory operations, eCTD compilation, submission formatting, validation, or related pharmaceutical/biologics regulatory submission activities.
* Hands\-on experience in regulatory document preparation, PDF conversion, hyperlinking, bookmarking, pagination checks, file naming checks, document property verification and submission\-readiness review.
* Working knowledge of eCTD publishing activities, including sequence preparation, document placement, leaf title review, metadata checks, lifecycle operator checks and technical validation support.
* Experience using publishing, validation and document management tools such as Lorenz DocuBridge, Lorenz e\-validator, ISI Toolbox, Adobe Acrobat Pro, RIM systems or equivalent tools.
* Basic understanding of ICH guidelines, regional eCTD specifications, health authority submission requirements, internal SOPs, quality checklists and document management practices.
* Ability to support submission types such as IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, amendments, supplements and responses to health authority queries, as applicable.
* Experience supporting technical validation checks and assisting in resolution of validation errors, warnings, document quality issues and publishing\-related queries under guidance.
* Good coordination skills with the ability to work with CMC Regulatory Affairs, Labelling, Clinical, Quality and other cross\-functional teams for timely receipt and processing of submission documents.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, timeline orientation and ability to maintain audit\-ready publishing records, validation reports, acknowledgements and dispatch confirmations.
* Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide timely updates, escalate issues appropriately and work effectively under supervision in a deadline\-driven environment.


**Skills And Attributes**
* Prior exposure to regulatory publishing activities for multiple regions such as US, EU, UK, Canada and other international markets.
* Working familiarity with health authority gateway or portal submissions, including FDA ESG, EMA Gateway/Web Client, MHRA Submissions Portal, CESP or other regional submission portals.
* Experience supporting lifecycle management submissions, including variations, renewals, amendments, supplements, annual reports and responses to health authority questions.
* Familiarity with submission tracking, acknowledgement tracking, validation report archival, dispatch confirmation maintenance and audit\-ready publishing documentation.
* Basic knowledge of regulatory information management systems, document management systems and electronic submission archive practices.
* Awareness of publishing quality control practices, including peer review checklists, technical document checks, folder structure verification and sequence readiness checks.
* Ability to support process improvement, standardization, automation or digitization initiatives within Regulatory Operations.

title: Data Governance Associate
description:
**Job Description**
 Are you ready to make data your playground? Join a team where your technical skills, creativity, and curiosity will help shape how HR data is classified, secured, and delivered across the enterprise. If you thrive on variety, love solving complex problems, and want to make a real impact, this is the role for you!
   

  

 As a Data Management Associate in HR, you'll be the driving force behind how our organization classifies, secures, and unlocks the power of data. You'll architect robust access control models, organize and elevate HR data assets, and champion data as a product—making information discoverable, trusted, and ready for action. Collaborating with Data Owners, Product Owners, Engineering and business leaders, you'll deliver high\-impact presentations, streamline governance, and continuously improve our data processes. If you're ready to innovate, influence, and transform how data empowers our people, this is the opportunity for you.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Support roadmap execution by gathering inputs, documenting decisions, tracking milestones, and maintaining risk and dependency logs and release checklists.
* Assist with role and access design for HR and employee data — documenting policy patterns clearly enough that engineering teams can implement them without follow\-up.
* Maintain the entitlement taxonomy (data products, assets, attributes, concepts, sensitivity tags), flagging inconsistencies and keeping documentation current across teams.
* Develop working knowledge of the firm's enterprise data platform entitlement model — how access is structured at the object, row, and column level — sufficient to document requirements and validate implementations.
* Support data classification maintenance by keeping sensitivity tier definitions accurate and linking business glossary terms to physical data assets. Document how enterprise identity groups map to data platform access roles, flagging mismatches or accounts that fall outside governed structures.
* Develop familiarity with entitlement and governance tooling in use (e.g., Immuta, Collibra) — enough to document configurations, support testing, and produce end\-user guidance.
* Write clear, build\-ready requirements — user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data definitions — that engineering teams can act on directly.
* Coordinate and facilitate stakeholder working sessions, demos, and training, making entitlement concepts accessible to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Track and report entitlement metrics (time\-to\-entitle, recertification rates, SQL performances) and surface trends or anomalies to the product lead.
* Ensure audit logging and compliance requirements are reflected in requirements and release artifacts; understand what evidence a controls review needs.
* Maintain SOPs for entitlement operations — access requests, approvals, recertifications, exceptions — in line with firmwide standards.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* 2\+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, data governance, access controls, or risk and controls — ideally in a data\-heavy environment.
* Working understanding of Role\-Based (RBAC) and Attribute\-Based (ABAC) access control — what they are, when each applies, and how policies translate into platform configurations.
* Familiarity with enterprise data platforms and fair understanding of SQL.
* Basic understanding of data classification — sensitivity tiers, tagging, and how classification drives access policy. Comfortable working with data dictionaries and business glossaries.
* Able to read data queries and table definitions well enough to review access configurations and identify obvious entitlement gaps — deep technical expertise is not required.
* Proven ability to produce precise, actionable requirements — user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria — that engineering teams can build from without back\-and\-forth.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another highly regulated environment.
* Exposure to an enterprise data or analytics platform — how access is structured, how users and groups are provisioned, and how data consumption is governed.
* Familiarity with entitlement or governance tools such as Immuta, Collibra, or equivalent, even in a contributor or analyst capacity.
* Comfort reviewing technical specifications and participating in testing alongside engineering teams.
* Willingness to learn new concepts with a problem solving mindset.


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. * clinical workflows
* application logic
* permissions
* configuration
* customer data
* statuses
* integrations
* operational workflows
* users and roles

This role owns the design, transformation, governance, and continuous improvement of business processes supporting Roundel, SD\&M, and PG\&M.
   

  

 Operating at the intersection of Business, Product, Technology, and Operations, this role partners with cross\-functional stakeholders to design future\-state workflows for new services, establish governance frameworks, standardize operating practices, and translate evolving business needs into scalable operational capabilities.
   

  

 This role has evolved to take strategic ownership of enterprise process design and workflow transformation, enabling a scalable and integrated operating model across Services \& Monetization while improving execution speed, strengthening governance, reducing operational inefficiencies, and supporting increasing business complexity, new service offerings, revenue growth, and Long\-Range Plan (LRP) objectives.

 Process Strategy \& Operational Excellence

 Workflow Design \& Transformation

 Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Governance

 Product \& Business Enablement

* Support launch readiness for new services by ensuring operational processes, governance, documentation, and stakeholder enablement are in place.

 Process Performance \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define, own, and continuously improve KPIs and operational health metrics measuring process effectiveness, operational efficiency, quality, throughput, adoption, and service performance.
* Develop executive\-ready dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into operational performance, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Monitor process performance and proactively recommend enhancements based on business needs, stakeholder feedback, and operational data.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement using Lean principles, process excellence methodologies, and best practices while proactively identifying operational risks and driving sustainable improvements.


**About You**
* 5–7 years of experience in Process Excellence, Business Transformation, Operations Strategy, Program Management, Business Consulting, Process Improvement, or related analytical roles.

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
**Associate, Enterprise Onboarding** 




  





**ABOUT SHESHI** 




**Bringing Sanctity to Numbers** 




  





 Sheshi is a Financial Operating System, the governed infrastructure layer that converts raw financial data into results that organisations can completely trust. Governed, auditable, period\-locked, and traceable to the source.
 



  





**We are headquartered in Bangalore, building an enterprise\-grade product for the global market.** 




  





 Bringing an enterprise customer onto Sheshi means getting their account structure right, entity hierarchies, chart of accounts, reporting frameworks, and consolidation setup all configured correctly before they go live.
 



  





 Where a customer needs prior years of financial history brought in, that has to be migrated and validated with equal rigour.
 



  





 As Associate, Enterprise Onboarding, you are part of the team that makes this happen, grounded in real accounting expertise, working directly with customers to structure, configure, and validate their accounts for go\-live.
 



  





**WHY SHESHI** 




**What Makes This Role Worth Doing** 




  





**Work with real consequence.** 
 How you structure and configure an account shapes the customer's entire experience of Sheshi from day one.
 



**Direct customer engagement from day one.** 
 You work with customers directly during onboarding.
 



**A growth path with no fixed ceiling.** 
 Strong performance opens the door to more complex accounts, more ownership, and eventually leading a team of your own.
 



**A team that moves fast.** 
 Onboarding here is about getting customers live quickly and correctly.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**What You Will Own** 




  





**Account Structuring and Configuration** 



* Configure chart of accounts, entity hierarchies, reporting structure, and close settings for assigned customer accounts.
* Work on multi\-entity, multi\-GAAP, and multi\-currency configurations as customer complexity requires.



**Consolidation Setup** 



* Support consolidation configuration, intercompany relationships and group reporting structure, under your Lead's guidance as you build capability in this area.



**Historical Data Migration and Validation** 



* Migrate historical MIS and statutory financials for assigned customers where required, following the team's established methodology.
* Validate migrated data against the customer's original financials until it fully reconciles; escalate complex discrepancies to your Lead.



**Direct Customer Engagement** 



* Engage customers directly to understand entity structure, gather financial data, and validate configuration and accuracy.
* Move the onboarding forward at pace, flag issues early and resolve them directly.



  





  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Your Background and Strengths** 




  





**Experience** 



* 3–4 years in financial reporting, accounting, or ERP or any financial systems implementation.
* Exposure to financial system configuration, multi\-entity reporting, or reconciliation is strongly preferred.
* Comfortable working directly with customers to gather and validate financial and structural data.



**Functional Depth** 



* Strong grounding in accounting fundamentals, IndAS, Schedule III, and financial statement preparation.
* Ability to configure financial systems accurately, chart of accounts, entity structures, and reporting hierarchies.
* Ability to reconcile financial data with precision and identify discrepancies confidently.
* Willingness to build capability in multi\-entity, multi\-GAAP, and consolidation configuration over time.



**How You Work** 



* You bring rigour to every account you structure and configure, treating it with the seriousness the customer's trust deserves.
* You engage customers directly and move things forward without waiting on unnecessary handoffs.
* You flag issues and status proactively, your Lead should never be surprised by your accounts.
* You are looking to grow, taking on more complexity and ownership as you prove capability.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with financial systems implementation or SaaS onboarding.
* Exposure to consolidation, intercompany eliminations, or multi\-currency reporting.
* Prior client\-facing experience in a finance or accounting context.

title: Demand Generation Intern
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
   

  

 Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
   

  

 Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top\-tier global investors, 60\+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
   

  

**About The Demand Generation Team**
 Demand Generation owns how these buyers find Leucine before sales ever talks to them. We run it like an engineering programme, not a content mill: every channel has a locked methodology, a baseline, a numeric goal, a task list and a weekly measurement loop. Our work lives in an internal command\-center dashboard with dedicated centers for SEO, Social Media and Events, plus goal tracking across all three.
   

  

 One principle you must be comfortable with from day one:
 **Demand Gen suggests keywords, pages, changes and ideas. The website and content team writes the copy and builds the pages.** 
 You will not be ghost\-writing blog posts. You will be doing the research, analysis and specification work that tells the content team exactly what to write and why.
   

  

**The role**
 You will spend of your time on SEO, Social Media, Events and early outbound work. You will work alongside the Demand Gen lead using our internal tooling (Google Search Console, GA4, DataForSEO, PageSpeed Insights, Webflow, Supabase\-backed dashboards and Claude Code automation) to move real numbers on real product pages.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* SEO (primary focus)


 Our SEO programme runs product by product through an eight\-phase pipeline: Kickoff → Seeding → Discovery → Filtering → Conversion Audit → Baseline \& Goal → Planning → Tasks → Execution. You will work inside every phase.
   

  

* Keyword research and shortlisting
* Build seed keyword lists for a product across our five seed types: core topic, customer pain, competitor brand, regulatory anchor and persona job\-to\-be\-done. Every seed must trace to real evidence (sales calls, FDA data, competitor pages, customer language), not guesses
* Expand seeds into a candidate pool using DataForSEO (multi\-mode, dual\-region India \+ US sweep), then run the junk filter and manually review every remaining row. Expect pools of several hundred keywords where 60 to 80% is noise
* Reduce the reviewed pool to 3 to 5 primary pillar keywords plus 15 to 30 supporting cluster keywords using our five\-stage funnel and weighted scoring rubric. Document the rationale for every keep and every cut
* Baseline, goal and weekly measurement
* Freeze a 28\-day baseline of impressions and clicks per product page from Google Search Console. Our success bar is 3× clicks against baseline
* Own the Monday numbers: pull GSC impressions and clicks, DataForSEO rank positions and task closure counts, compute week\-over\-week deltas against the locked baseline, and flag pages that are gaining impressions but not clicks (a title/meta problem, not a win)
* Maintain the Rank Tracker and product funnel views in the dashboard so the team sees one source of truth
* Page planning and task creation
* Map every filtered keyword to a target page and a role (pillar page vs supporting page). Build the full page list for the product and identify which of our four SEO pillars is the bottleneck on each page:
* Technical Foundation (indexability, speed, mobile, canonicals)
* Search Intent \& Content Quality (right query, depth, unique evidence)
* On\-Page Optimization (H1, title, meta, schema, internal links)
* Off\-Page Authority (backlinks, mentions)
* Audit each planned page against all four pillars and turn every gap into a task with Action, Pillar, Priority, Effort and a measurable win condition
* Change specs and handoff to the website team
* Write structured change specifications for the website team: exact current and target strings for meta titles, meta descriptions, canonicals, schema markup, keyword insertions and internal links, each with a priority and a constraint on what must be preserved. No vague "improve the page" notes
* Suggest new pages where keyword gaps exist: target keyword, suggested title tag and meta description, page structure and internal\-link targets. You specify; the content team writes
* Re\-scan the live site after the website team ships and verify each change was applied as specified. Mark resolved changes and chase the ones that are not
* Site migration (leucine.io → leucine.ai)
* We are mid\-way through migrating our old domain to the new one. You will help work the URL\-mapping table: match old URLs to new destinations, decide redirect vs keep\-live vs retire based on 16 months of GSC query data, and flag pages that need to be built new before a redirect can go live
* Set up and verify 301 redirects in Webflow, confirm the destination page is indexed, and check that rankings on the old URL transfer rather than drop
* Write migration briefs for the website team: per page, the action (build new vs update existing), the suggested keywords and where each goes, the suggested title and meta, and the page structure
* Conversion and technical health
* Read GA4 to find where product\-page traffic leaks (high exits, no CTA clicks, form abandonment) and record per\-page findings with where, why, evidence and recommended action
* Run PageSpeed Insights and Core Web Vitals checks on priority pages and log technical fixes as Pillar 1 tasks
* Help with our early Generative Engine Optimization work: llms.txt compliance, passage citability, and tracking which keywords trigger AI Overviews
* Social Media (LinkedIn) — secondary
* Help assemble LinkedIn post kits for campaigns and events: one company caption plus tailored reshare takes for each of our leadership voices, packaged with the creative
* Produce post graphics (announcement cards, countdown cards, recap carousels) using our locked brand design system and templates
* Run the weekly Monday ingest of LinkedIn analytics CSV exports into the Social dashboard and confirm every CTA link carries the correct UTM tags
* Mine our internal knowledge base and FDA Tracker data for content ideas and log them in the content\-ideas backlog
* Events — secondary
* Research and qualify pharma industry events against our ICP: who attends, which companies, sponsorship tiers and cost, and whether the expected qualified meetings justify the spend
* Build attendee dossiers for qualified events: company ICP tier, recent FDA inspection history from FDA Tracker, prior CRM contact, and public profile notes for introductions
* Support the before/during/after event campaign plan, the execution task list and the activity log as organiser emails and replies come in
* Our event success metric is sales\-qualified leads booked. You will help track meetings completed and cost per meeting after each event
* Outbound — early stage
* Our outbound channel (cold email via Instantly / Heyreach, TAM building via Clay) is scaffolded but not yet live. You will help stand it up: build target account and contact lists from FDA Tracker's inspection database filtered against our ICP, and help set up the first campaign\-tracking views (reply rate, meetings booked per sequence)


**What You Will Learn**
* How a B2B SEO programme is actually run against numbers: seeding, discovery, filtering, baselining, planning, tasking, shipping and measuring, on live product pages with real traffic
* Hands\-on fluency with Google Search Console, GA4, DataForSEO, PageSpeed Insights and Webflow
* How to run a domain migration without losing rankings
* How AI tooling (Claude Code, structured skills and automated gate reviews) is used to run marketing operations as repeatable pipelines
* How pharma quality and manufacturing buyers search, think and buy, and how FDA inspection data drives go\-to\-market


**Requirements**
**Must have**
* Final\-year student or recent graduate in marketing, business, engineering, life sciences or a related field, or equivalent self\-taught experience
* Working understanding of how search engines rank pages: intent, on\-page factors, technical basics, backlinks
* Comfortable in spreadsheets and with reading hundreds of rows of data carefully. Much of this role is disciplined review, not creative flair
* Clear written English. You will write specifications and briefs that another team executes without asking follow\-up questions
* Curiosity about a technical B2B domain. You do not need pharma knowledge on day one, but you need to want to learn what a Form 483, a deviation or a cleaning validation is


**Nice to have**
* Hands\-on time in Google Search Console or GA4, even on a personal or college project
* Exposure to any keyword tool (DataForSEO, Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Keyword Planner)
* Familiarity with Webflow or any CMS
* Basic markdown and comfort working in a terminal or with AI coding assistants
* LinkedIn content or design experience (Canva, Figma)


**Benefits**
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting\-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high\-performing team building innovative AI\-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Complimentary Meals \& Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Potential opportunity for a full\-time role based on performance and business requirements

title: Study Start-up Associate (Site Activation Specialist)
description:
**Job Overview**
 Primary contact with investigative site(s) during site start\-up activities and maintenance with responsibility for collection of the required investigator and essential documents for a study, to ensure EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authority and any other local applications are made within the timelines agreed with project management and Site Readiness team and that documentation meets the specifications required by applicable regulations and sponsor. Proactively interacts with EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authorities to provide guidance regarding requirements. Maintain awareness of current regulatory standards related to submissions. Serve as local expert in project start\-up activities for a particular country or region. Act as a ‘knowledge resource’ to mentor and train new hires and less\-experienced department colleagues if suitable.
   

  

**Summary Of Responsibilities**
* Maintain awareness of regulatory legislation, guidance, and practice in the assigned countries.
* Coordinate, collect and organize data and information required by EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authority including but not limited to the preparation of study documentation such as the country application form and cover letter for sponsor review as applicable.
* Compile and prepare routine submission filed to IRB/IEC/Third body/Regulatory Authorities (e.g., INDs/CTAs) and liaise with them as applicable regarding submission/approval.
* Liaise with internal and external vendors in the generation of Regulatory Authority submissions (as applicable).
* Perform a review of final submission documents as applicable.
* Ensure that all assigned start\-up and maintenance activities are on track, in accordance with client expectations and budget and in compliance with applicable laws and guidelines, regulatory requirements, ICH/GCP, SOPs and quality standards
* Prevent and escalate study issues appropriately and in a timely fashion.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management depending upon country and situational requirements with proper supervision \[if applicable].
* In Country specific tasks (Global):
* Serve as primary contact for investigative sites and ensure documents required are collected in a timely manner.
* Collect and track all the necessary documents required and perform a quality review, formatting, and compilation of the final documents for effective and compliant site activation and maintenance without supervision.
* Ensure high quality documents are filed and systems are updated on an ongoing and timely basis, making Fortrea ready for an audit at any time.
* Participate in team and project meetings as applicable.
* When needed, assist in the strategy definition for Site Activation and provide accurate projections and timelines to study teams.
* Review and customize country and site\-specific patient informed consent forms for compliance with local requirements and protocol. Proactively resolve informed consent issues and other potential difficulties with study sites.
* May support the negotiation of site contracts and budgets with sites, if applicable and track progress of contract and budget milestones/developments, intervening and escalating as appropriate.
* Proactively identifying and escalating to Submission Leads any risk to meeting deliverables.
* Notify the Submissions Lead of hours identified as Out\-of\-Scope or overburn.
* Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) tasks (specific centralized role for EU):
* Assist in the upload of submission documentation to, interacting with and monitoring of all notifications and alerts in CTIS to ensure all milestones and events for the trial are met within the timelines mandated.
* Performs all other duties as needed or assigned.


**Qualifications (Minimum Required)**
* University/College degree (life science preferred), or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriate accredited institution (e.g., nursing certification, medical or laboratory technology) AND 2 years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations.
* Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.
* In lieu of the above requirement, candidates with a High School Diploma or equivalent AND a minimum of 2 years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations will be considered.


**Experience (Minimum Required)**
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in clinical development or start\-up/ regulatory process.
* Working knowledge of ICH, RA, IRB/IEC, and other applicable regulations/guidelines; familiarity with investigator start\-up documents and contract/budgets negotiation process; previous interaction with operational project teams and investigative sites.
* Demonstrated understanding of research protocol requirements and proven ability to communicate them/educate others about them.


**Physical Demands/Work Environment**
* General Office Environment.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid\-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.
 



 As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting\-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.
 



 This role will act as the pivotal, hands\-on technical authority driving the performance and standardization of Armstrong Fluid Technology's control solutions. Operating at the intersection of continuous innovation and regional execution, this role requires practical expertise in industrial automation—specifically PLCs, HMIs, and robust network protocols. You will be instrumental in executing technical responsibilities within the core product development team, while simultaneously serving as the primary engineering backbone for our regional sales, service, and production operations. As key member of the product development team, you will be supporting the sales inquiries, supporting service team to reduce onsite resolution times for field issues, and ensure our optimization deployments are highly standardized, scalable, and built on reliable technical foundations.
 



 This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to strategic technology initiatives that directly impact product performance, customer satisfaction, and long\-term business growth.
 



**Key Accountabilities** 




**Job Accountability** 



* Standardization \& Product Development: Drive the continuous standardization of optimization products across the India and APAC regions, actively collaborating with global product development to ensure field\-tested, repeatable configurations are integrated into the core R\&D roadmap.
* Pre\-Sales Engineering Support: Act as the dedicated regional technical authority for the sales team, accelerating sales cycles by unblocking complex technical inquiries, advising on customer system requirements, and verifying robust automation architectures.
* Advanced Field Troubleshooting: Provide rapid, hands\-on diagnostic support for the regional service team, taking direct technical ownership of complex onsite escalations to significantly reduce Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) and minimize customer downtime.



**Job Accountability** 



* Industrial Automation Execution: Develop, program, and troubleshoot comprehensive automation architectures, utilizing deep expertise in PLCs, HMIs, and diverse industrial network protocols to ensure optimal performance of field installations.
* Coordinate changes to control logic, configuration, and system documentation to ensure smooth integration.
* Participate in testing, validation, and deployment activities to ensure performance and reliability.



**Job Accountability** 



* Support the implementation of advanced control features and system enhancements.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to create and monitor development and rollout plans for new platform capabilities.
* Coordinate changes to control architecture, firmware, and network configurations.
* Participate in design reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.



**What We’re Looking For** 




 To thrive in this role, you should bring:
 



**Education and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Control Systems, Automation Engineering, or a related field
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in control systems engineering, industrial automation, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience with Carel and JACE PLC platforms, control logic programming, and system integration.
* Deep experience in HVAC application systems and implementation of control features is an asset.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, Ethernet/IP, Bacnet) and system testing methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to work in cross\-functional teams and contribute to large\-scale engineering initiatives.



**Technical Skills** 



* Industrial Automation \& Control Systems
* PLC Programming background utilizing Ladder logic, Functional Block, Structured Texts.
* HMI Design \& Development
* Control Logic Design \& Troubleshooting
* Network and Communication protocols
* Industrial Networking: Modbus, Ethernet/IP, BACnet
* Network Troubleshooting \& Configuration
* HVAC industry experience is an asset
* Knowledge of different control algorithms and models is an asset (PID control)



**Soft Skills** 



* The capability to simplify complex problems, conduct root cause analysis, and provide clear, well\-thought\-out recommendations.
* Team\-oriented leadership skills with a proactive approach.
* An ability to communicate openly and authentically in all situations.



**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?** 




 By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid\-flow technology while upholding Armstrong's commitment to sustainability. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.
