title: Documentation Specialist
description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**



Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45\+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.



Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.


**About Amtech**



Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.



With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.


**Our Employee Value Proposition**



At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:


**Purpose**



Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission\-critical enterprise software used by industry\-leading organizations.


**Growth**



Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross\-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.


**Culture**



Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people\-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.


**Innovation**



Engage with cutting\-edge technologies, including AI\-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

  


**Role Description**



We are looking for a Senior Documentation Specialist to own the customer\-facing documentation experience for Amtech's ERP and MES products. You will be the person who turns complex manufacturing workflows — estimating a corrugated order, scheduling a corrugator run, tracking WIP through conversion, closing the loop to invoicing — into documentation our customers actually use and trust.



This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You will write and maintain user guides, in\-application help, release notes, and how\-to content; you will also set the standards, style, and structure that all Amtech product documentation follows. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Implementation, and Support, and you will be expected to learn our customers' world — the plant floor, the order lifecycle, the way a packaging manufacturer actually operates.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Documentation ownership**


* Plan, write, edit, and maintain the full library of customer\-facing documentation for Amtech's ERP and MES products, including user guides, configuration and administration guides, quick\-reference materials, and in\-application help.
* Own the release notes process end to end — partner with Product and Engineering each release cycle to capture what changed, why it matters, and what customers need to do about it.
* Audit existing content on a regular cadence; retire what is stale, rewrite what is unclear, and close gaps that show up in support tickets and customer feedback.

**Standards and structure**


* Establish and enforce a documentation style guide, terminology standards, and content templates so that everything Amtech publishes reads as one voice.
* Define and improve the information architecture of the help center — how content is organized, searched, versioned, and navigated across product lines and releases.
* Administer and improve the documentation toolchain and publishing workflow; recommend improvements to tooling, single\-sourcing, and reuse.

**Collaboration and subject\-matter expertise**


* Partner with Product Managers, developers, QA, implementation consultants, and support engineers to gather source material, validate technical accuracy, and get ahead of upcoming releases.
* Use the product yourself. Build a working understanding of packaging manufacturing operations and of how Amtech customers configure and run the system in production.
* Participate in release readiness and go\-to\-market planning to ensure documentation ships alongside the software, not after it.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to document AI\-enabled capabilities as they ship, making new intelligence features understandable and trustworthy to customers.

**Quality and measurement**


* Define quality standards for documentation and review the work of other contributors — writers, product managers, and engineers who contribute content.
* Track documentation effectiveness using search analytics, page performance, support ticket deflection, and direct customer feedback; use that data to prioritize the roadmap.

**SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**


**Required Qualification**


* 6\+ years of professional experience in technical writing, product documentation, or technical communications, with a substantial portion producing customer\-facing content for a software product.
* Demonstrated experience documenting enterprise software — ERP, MES, supply chain, or comparable operational systems.
* A portfolio of published documentation you can walk us through, showing how you explain complex, multi\-step workflows to a non\-technical operational audience.
* The ability to take an engineer's explanation of a feature and turn it into instructions a plant scheduler can follow on the first read — precise, plain, and logically sequenced, with no step assumed.
* A rigorous eye for editing: you cut what is unnecessary, catch inconsistent terminology, and hold a large content library to one standard.
* Proven experience owning documentation standards — style guides, templates, terminology, and information architecture — not just executing against someone else's.
* Hands\-on experience with a component content management or help\-authoring platform — MadCap Flare, Paligo, Heretto, Document360, Zendesk Guide, Confluence, or comparable — including publishing, versioning, and single\-sourcing across product lines.
* Proficiency with screen capture and image editing tools for clear, consistent visual documentation.
* Comfort working directly with software: navigating a complex application, reading a spec, testing a workflow, and validating your own instructions against the product.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent releases and competing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Engineering, Information Science, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Direct experience documenting ERP and/or MES platforms, especially in a manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with packaging, corrugated, folding carton, label, or other discrete or process manufacturing operations.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing and business concepts such as specifications, routings, scheduling, WIP tracking, inventory, order\-to\-cash, and shop\-floor data collection.
* Experience with docs\-as\-code workflows (Markdown, Git, static site generators) or structured authoring (DITA, XML).
* Experience producing video walkthroughs, product tours, or e\-learning content alongside written docs.
* Exposure to API or integration documentation.
* Comfort using AI tools to accelerate drafting, editing, and content audits — with the judgment to know where human verification is non\-negotiable.
* Interest in structuring documentation for machine consumption as well as human readers, so content can reliably feed in\-product AI assistants and search.
* Experience supporting a global customer base, including localization or translation workflows.
* Background in a SaaS or hybrid on\-premise/cloud software environment with a regular release cadence.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**



Hybrid role based out of Amtech's Bengaluru office, with roughly three days per week on\-site, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Support colleagues across our India and North America teams. Occasional travel for customer site visits, industry events, or company meetings.


**Why Join Amtech**



At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world\-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross\-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: Hardware Functional Safety (FuSa) Specialist
description:
**Enabling a software\-defined, electrified future.**
 Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading\-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software\-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here .
   

  

**Mission of the Role** 
**:** 
 The Functional Safety Specialist is responsible for ensuring that automotive electronic systems comply with ISO 26262 and related safety standards. The role involves safety concept creation, hazard analysis, safety requirements engineering, technical safety architecture, verification planning, and supporting hardware/software teams through the full safety lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Functional Safety Lifecycle Management
* Lead and execute activities across the ISO 26262 V\-model safety lifecycle, from concept phase to SOP.
* Develop and maintain the Functional Safety Plan, timelines, and work products.
* Ensure processes are followed and all safety artifacts are created and reviewed.
* Safety Analysis \& Concept Development
* Perform Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and derive ASIL levels.
* Develop Functional Safety Concept (FSC) and Technical Safety Concept (TSC).
* Define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and safety requirements (FSR/TSR).
* Requirements Engineering
* Write, review, and maintain functional and technical safety requirements.
* Ensure bi\-directional traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and validation.
* Support system, hardware, and software teams to interpret and implement safety requirements.
* Hardware \& Software Safety
* Collaborate with hardware architects to define safety mechanisms for MCU, PMIC, watchdog, self\-tests, power domains, fault handling, etc.
* Support software teams in designing safety\-compliant drivers, boot, diagnostics, and monitoring logic.
* Review MCU safety manuals, safety architecture, and vendor documentation (e.g., Infineon Traveo II, NXP, Renesas).
* Safety Analysis \& Verification
* Conduct and review FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, Dependent Failure Analysis.
* Calculate FIT rates, single\-point fault metrics, and latent fault metrics.
* Create safety validation plans and support unit/integration/system\-level testing.
* Audits, Assessments \& Compliance

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
Technical Product Support Engineer
 



  





**Type of Work:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai, India
 



  





 Kaleris is a private equity\-backed software company focused on supply chain optimization. We are hiring Technical Product Support Engineers to join our Global Customer Support team supporting Terminal Operating System products including N4, Master Terminal and Octopi.
 



  





 Role Purpose
 



 The Technical Product Support Engineer serves as a product expert for Kaleris/Navis solutions and works directly with customers to diagnose product\-related issues, answer functional and technical questions, and ensure successful use of the software. This role bridges customers, Product Management, Engineering, and Services teams through technical analysis and customer advocacy without performing software development or production operations activities.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Gain expertise in product functionalities, configurations, and workflows across multiple modules through structured product training, internal documentation, knowledge bases, and hands\-on learning.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer\-reported issues related to product functionality, root\-cause\-analysis, workflows, configurations, business use cases and customer\-facing technical support.
* Own customer support cases from initial triage through resolution, ensuring timely communication, documentation, and follow\-up.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues in test environments, isolate root causes, and determine whether issues are related to product defects, configuration, integrations, or customer processes.
* Analyze application logs, system artifacts, product behavior, and configuration data to identify probable causes and recommended actions.
* Answer customer questions using product documentation, case history, knowledge bases, release notes, and internal resources.
* Act as the voice of the customer by communicating product feedback, enhancement requests, and recurring issues to internal teams.
* Participate in a global support escalation rotation for critical business\-impacting product issues, focusing on investigation and resolution management rather than infrastructure operations.
* Engage with designated customer accounts through support reviews, issue discussions, project go\-live support, and service meetings.
* Apply strong analytical thinking and technical troubleshooting skills across multiple technologies and product areas.
* Learn and support new products, technologies, and service offerings.
* Work in shifts and collaborate with global teams as required.
* Travel occasionally and work extended hours when business needs require.



  





 What This Role Is Not
 


* Not a software development role or responsible for modifying product source code.
* Not a production or infrastructure operations support role.
* Not responsible for application deployments, release management, server administration, monitoring, or database administration.



  





 Requirements
 



  





 Education
 



 Engineering Degree (B.E/B.Tech ) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines (or) BCA and MCA full time, with CGPA 7\.5 or higher.
 



  





 Experience
 


* 2\-4 years of experience in Technical Product Support (Level 2 or 3\), Enterprise Software Support, Customer Support Engineering, or similar customer\-facing technical support roles supporting commercial software products.
* Knowledge of Navis SPARCS, Navis N4/XPS or experience in container terminal operations is an advantage.
* Experience primarily focused on production operations or infrastructure support is not aligned with this role.



  





 Technical Skills
 


* Strong analytical and technical troubleshooting skills across enterprise applications and technologies.
* Ability to learn complex software functionality and independently support customers across a broad range of features and use cases.
* Ability to read and interpret application logs, stack traces, XML configurations, and client\-server application behavior.
* Experience working with Java\-based enterprise applications, XML, Apache technologies, and client\-server architectures is preferred.
* Understanding of relational databases and web\-based enterprise solutions.
* Familiarity with Core Java or Groovy for troubleshooting and understanding application behavior is advantageous but not required. The role does not involve software development responsibilities.



  





 Soft Skills
 


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong customer\-service orientation.
* Detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and assertive communicator.
* Strong learning agility, leadership potential, time management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in global and virtual teams.

description:
**Job Title**
 Project Coordinator
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 This role is responsible for the coordination between various stakeholders of the project and preparing management information reports. This includes working closely with the project head and other team members of the project.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Prepare various reports including daily, weekly, monthly project reports.
* Provide administrative support to project managers, including scheduling meetings, preparing presentations, preparing agendas, and taking minutes.
* Assist project managers in planning and executing construction projects.
* Assist in the coordination of permits, inspections, and approvals required for construction projects.
* Monitor project progress and track milestones to ensure timely completion.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, including contracts, drawings, specifications, permits, etc.
* Communicate project status to stakeholders and escalate issues, as necessary.
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress and ensure compliance with safety and quality standards.

* Prepare risk log and track the same in the project.

* Assist the project manager in the pre\-construction phase and post\-construction of the project.

title: Lead. Application Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
**Who we are?**
 Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since.
   

  

 Today, we offer the world’s largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play. This is where Johnson Controls comes in, helping drive the outcomes that matter most. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make your buildings smarter. Sustainability is a top priority for our company.
   

  

 We committed to invest 75 percent of new product development R\&D in climate\-related innovation to develop sustainable products and services. We take sustainability seriously. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Johnson Controls Digital Solutions is looking for an experienced engineer with a deep knowledge on building technologies including BMS, VMS, and Access Control etc.
   

  

 As a member of the Global Center of excellence the Presales technical lead will help customers to make technology decisions, implement best practices for asset management and overall facilitate transforming buildings into smart connected entities.
   

  

 This role requires a blend of technical expertise, customer service, and sales skills to effectively support potential clients and the sales team in understanding, evaluating, and adopting the company's digital products and solutions. You are obsessed with driving continuous process improvements to optimize solution and deliverables in presales process.
   

  

**How You Will Do It**
* Develop and implement pre\-sales strategies that align with the organization’s business goals \& targets.
* Review opportunity inputs, requirements and specifications; should be able to capture the Digital Solution scope and understand the complete requirements of the customer.
* Drive RFP/RFI responses, preparing technical solution writeups, compliance matrices, BoQs, Hardware sizing calculations, and architecture diagrams tailored to customer use cases across global markets.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product management, and engineering, to ensure alignment and effective Solution development.
* Translate customer pain points and site realities into solution architectures, integrating PLC/SCADA systems and BMS Platforms (Metasys, Niagara, DDC, JACE or similar) with analytics platform, digital twins, and enterprise FM platforms to demonstrate clear business outcomes.
* Design and present tailored solutions that demonstrate the value and benefits of the digital products and services.
* Conduct requirement workshops, technical discovery sessions, and PoCs, ensuring alignment of customer expectations with solution capabilities, integration pathways, data models, KPIs, and future‑state architecture.
* Lead and mentor design teams during solution shaping; guiding them on OT and IOT protocols, data ingestion, middleware integration, and standard deployment patterns used during customer demo and Proof of Concepts.
* Preparation and participation for Gate 0 calls / review meetings with JC Branch sales team for technical queries, scope clarifications, compliance and record minutes of meeting.
* Understand inter\-dependence and lead cross\-functional teams towards technical solutions for multi\-tiered systems.
* Clarify, prioritize and drive solution commitments as well as establish and maintain clear chains of accountability.
* Adherence to proposal \& estimation process and guideline to select proper Digital Solution Applications/offering to come up with the technical solution.
* Preparing technical proposals, cost estimates ensuring it meet the customer requirement and provide competitive advantage to JCI.
* Develop solutions specific dashboards, reporting frameworks, and data modeling strategies as part of presales demonstrations, highlighting portfolio‑level insights and operational benefits.
* Provide technical leadership to coordinate, prioritize and deliver proposal, commercials in pre\-sales process.
* Articulate goals, desired outcomes, risks/issues and mitigation plan clearly in pre\-sales process.
* Clearly qualify out of the box solutions and possible customizations needed.
* Provide feedback to product management and development teams regarding customer needs and market demands


**What We Look For**
* 8\-10\+ years’ experience as Presales engineer and delivering proposals, commercials in overall Bid process.
* Expertise in Solutioning, designing and delivering building technology Solutions e.g. BMS, Security, Fire and Lighting.
* Hands\-on experience in SCADA Platforms (WinCC, Iconics, Ignition or similar) and PLC programming is preferred.
* Experience in IoT Gateway configuration and Device Onboarding to cloud is a must have.
* Knowledge of different types of OT/IT network protocols like BACnet, Modbus, OPC, MQTT, SNMP, AMQP and other protocols.
* knowledge of HVAC or Industrial Process Control systems, IT\-OT Integrations, API integrations.
* Knowledge of L2 and L3 Networking, Switching, Servers, Virtualization concepts and Clustering.
* knowledge of cloud IoT platforms and services (MS Azure is preferred)
* Familiar with Energy Management, Cloud based Analytics tools, Digital Twin, Digital asset management and BRICK schema concepts.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities in an energizing and fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working with industry leaders to understand current technology trends and relevancy.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and new product features.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new products and technologies.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in using Integrated software and digital communication tools.
* Ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and customer\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

description:
**Job Title**
***Service Proposal Engineer***
**Job Code**
**JOB SUMMARY**
**Reports to the Service Proposal Sub Regional Team leader / Head of Proposal Management**
 The Service Proposal Technician is responsible for developing cost effective Nutrition and Health (N\&H) Recommended Spares Quotations (RSQ) and simple service proposals which are based on proven methods that meet or exceed customer needs. Proposal Technicians are the bridge between the commercial function, the project delivery team, supply chain and service execution, collaborating across these functions in order to build a robust proposal deliverable to the customer.
   

  

 The Proposal Technician may also assist the commercial team to identify technical specifications of customers and to present our solution.
   

  

 The Proposal Engineer will follow all SPXFLOW internal processes and procedures and ensure that the service proposals, which generally includes costs estimates, proposal text and maintenance schedule, are completed in a compliant and timely manner.
   

  

**Principle Duties And Responsibilities**
* Collaborate closely with the Commercial function to ensure customer requirements are clearly defined and understood, and that a detailed RFQ analysis has been completed as required
* Understands and follows all SPXFLOW N\&H internal governance and proposal approval processes e.g. QIA, LEAF, LOAF
* Ensure scope is defined clearly and accurately, as required in accordance with customer and corporation request
* Use calculation software for equipment sizing
* Prepare the detailed costing (equipment \& services) using the appropriate tool
* Build relationships with other internal departments to obtain the necessary sub\-quotations or cost estimates
* Consult subcontractors in accordance with Supply Chain Management IDEF processes and procedures
* Identify and share all potential risks during governance gates events (cost, scope, KPI's, etc.)
* Support completion and review of all documents required for LEAF/LOAF submission
* Support completion of final quotation document and the associated handover pack
* Ensure proposals are submitted to internal and external customers in a right and performant timing
* Logs all cost, price and scope changes between quotation revision.
* Maintain a strong relationship and trust with Commercial Organization
* Participates in Execution Handover meetings
* Lessons Learnt feedback on closure


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Knowledge of process categories within Nutrition \& Health (Food \& Beverage Industry)
* Knowledge of N\&H Industry maintenance activities (Food \& Beverage Industry)
* Technical knowledge and experience in preparing and executing small / medium N\&H service proposals
* Financial awareness and understanding of key cost components and margin build up
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Self\-motivated, good learning ability
* Strong team player
* Results oriented
* Customer focused
* Proven discretion with confidential information/documents
* Ability to priorities own work under general guidance
* Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and professionalism
* Strong computer skills including expertise in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Fluent in writing, reading, and speaking English.


**Education And Experience**
**Required Education / Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university; Engineering, Food Technology, or related discipline
* 5 \- 8 years’ related industry experience; education and/or training in Proposals, Process Engineering or Project Management; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and MS Project


**Desirable**
* Preferable to have good knowledge of the SPX Product range
* Maintenance Operations trained
* Health, Safety \& Environmental awareness
* Speak and write fluent English. Other Languages such as Danish, French, Spanish and/or German is an advantage

**About The Team**
 The Cognizant Workday Practice Global Delivery Center is growing across all skill levels and Workday functional areas —and this is your chance to be part of it!
   

  

 Join a dynamic team where you’ll work with exciting clients, expand your Workday skills, and take advantage of engagement opportunities that keep you connected and inspired. If you’re ready to grow your career in a collaborative, innovative environment, we’d love to have you on board.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a part of the Workday Integrations team, you’ll serve as the Workday expert with knowledge of design, configuration, testing, and deployment. You’ll independently be managing work on multiple projects in various phases and conducting sessions with customers to analyse their business requirements. You’ll be leveraging your expertise to provide recommendations and develop solutions for our customers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work directly with key business and IT stakeholders to confirm requirements, consider design alternatives, facilitate discussions, and ultimately drive requirements sign\-off.
* Evaluate, communicate, and coordinate the technical impacts of application configuration decisions.
* Create detailed system interface specifications, field mapping, and system process designs following CS Methodology.
* Facilitating design workshops with customers for AMS and Implementations projects.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy integrations required to meet business requirements.
* Facilitate knowledge transfer and educate clients on developing and operating interfaces to and from a SaaS platform.
* Track issues and risks, communication status and escalate concerns to project management.

* Experience in different aspects of Workday Integrations such as WD APIs, EIB, Connectors, Document Transformations, Workday Studio, and Workday CCTPPTM
* Project experience in a technical or techno\-functional role on one or more ERP implementation and post go\-live projects
* 3\+ years of experience working in Integration.
* Demonstrated proficiency with web service technologies (REST, JSON, SOAP, HTTP, SSL, PGP, SAML, etc.,)
* Exceptional written and verbal communication capabilities; able to communicate effectively with diverse people and individuals at various levels within the organization

title: Senior Digital Health Technologies Specialist
description:
The Senior Digital Health Technologies (DHT) Specialist is responsible for working directly with the DHT Manager to provide technical and general administrative support for assigned Digital Health Technology studies including but not limited to; managing and overseeing license agreements, supporting with managing translations, Confidentiality Disclosure Agreements (CDA), compliance monitoring, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, including either direct participation in UAT execution or oversight of UAT activities, documentation management (IRB/EC \& TMF) and study decommissioning. Possessing strong attention to detail, effective communication skills and robust organizational abilities, the Senior DHT Specialist will work collaboratively with other business units (e.g. Clinical Trial Management, Procurement, Legal, Finance), external vendors and Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) to ensure timely completion of all study related activities.
   

  

**Job Duties**
* Provides general day\-to\-day digital tool and technologies support working with vendors and internal cross functional teams
* Ensure smooth study operation with strong communication skills escalating any project operational risks to the DHT manager
* Reviews and monitors compliance for assigned studies, and escalates issues related to compliance to the DHT manager, contributes to compliance action plan development and implementation
* Drives UAT strategy, planning, execution, issues management and oversight by reviewing test plans, drafting UAT plans, scripts, and relevant documentation, directly participating in sponsor\-level testing activities when applicable.
* Supports the DHT Manager, with digital tools and technology research to determine appropriate copyright holder of any COA instruments and establish licensing requirements
* Secure necessary Digital tool and technology permissions and license agreements (with the ability to review terms and conditions) to ensure alignment with new and/or updated license agreements through collaboration with.
* Track and communicate licensing and/or contract agreement status and serve as central point of contact for internal and external stakeholders for licensing and/or contract agreements in clinical trials
* Review and ensure payment of licensing invoices in coordination with internal functions..
* Support end to end translation process for supported digital tools and technologies.
* Track and maintain database of license holders, ensuring compliance with terms and conditions of relevant contracts
* Provide support for problem resolution between licensing holder and study team
* Participates in Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) revisions or departmental initiatives
* Proactively recommends process improvement initiatives for the department
* May require up to 25% travel


**Job Requirements**
* General knowledge and awareness of systems development processes
* Ability to acquire working knowledge of copyright law and licensing/permission requirements for digital tools and technologies
* Effective verbal and written communication skills
* Proactive and self\-disciplined, ability to meet deadlines, effective use of time, and prioritization
* Ability to proactively recognize project challenges, implement action plans, and escalate risks in a timely manner
* Strong organizational and attention to detail
* Ability to support and build collaborative relationships both internally and externally
* Basic familiarity of clinical drug development preferred


**Minimum Years Of Experience**
 Bachelor’s degree and minimum of 4\+ years relevant industry experience.

**The Content Specialist Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Content Development \& Optimization \- Develop, write, and refine high\-quality content for digital marketing assets including emails, landing/webpages, campaign materials, and ecommerce/product content. Ensure all content is aligned with campaign messaging, audience needs, and brand voice. Optimize content for discoverability and engagement across digital channels using best practices in content structuring and search optimization.
* Ecommerce Content \& Product Experience \- Develop and maintain ecommerce and product\-focused content that supports product discovery, understanding, and conversion.


 Create clear, structured, and informative product descriptions, value propositions, and supporting content aligned with user intent and business objectives. Ensure consistency and accuracy across product content, and optimize content presentation for usability and digital experience.

Work closely with campaign managers and content strategy lead to translate requirements into clear, accurate, and effective content deliverables. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and timely delivery across all assigned tasks.

Contribute to and leverage structured content repositories, ensuring proper organization, version control, and alignment with content standards. Identify opportunities to reuse and adapt existing content.

Set up and manage automated content workflows, including audience segmentation, dynamic content insertion, and nurture journeys. Collaborate with campaign and marketing operations teams to enable personalized content experiences based on user behavior, lifecycle stage, and preferences. Ensure content is structured and tagged appropriately to support automation, scalability, and targeted delivery across campaigns.

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field

* Strong understanding of SEO/GEO/AEO fundamentals and content optimization for digital discovery
* Experience writing for multiple formats including campaign content, emails, landing pages, and ecommerce/product content
* Ability to interpret briefs and translate them into structured, high\-quality content with minimal iterations
* Familiarity with content reuse, modular content approaches, and content management systems

* Ability to manage multiple deliverables and work collaboratively across teams with minimal supervision

 As a Customer Support Engineer, you are the first human our users reach when something isn’t working, and the person who makes sure they leave the conversation reassured, understood and back on track.  You’ll operate within an AI Agent\-first organisation, where AI tools are embedded into daily workflows and every team member is expected to use them proactively to work faster and better.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Own the first\-line response to customer queries and issues across all support channels, providing timely, empathetic, and clear communication.

* Triage incoming issues: distinguish user error, configuration, and genuine product defects, gathering the right detail (steps to reproduce, device, screenshots, logs) before escalating.

* Act as the voice of the customer internally \- surfacing recurring pain points and themes to product and engineering to drive improvements.
* Manage and prioritise the support queue in Jira, keeping tickets accurate, up to date, and within response and resolution targets.
* Maintain and grow the support knowledge base and help content in Confluence (FAQs, troubleshooting guides and canned responses).
* Keep accurate records of customer interactions and issue handling, consistent with the expectations of a regulated health product.
* Collaborate closely with clinical / regulatory, QA, and engineering to ensure customer facing answers about health features are accurate and appropriate.
* Leverage AI agents and tools to draft and refine responses, summarise and cluster tickets, surface relevant knowledge base content, and automate routine support tasks.



  





**Skills \& experience:** 




**Must\-Have Background** 



* 3\+ years in a customer support, technical support, or customer success role, ideally for a software, SaaS or app\-based product.

* Comfortable navigating mobile and web apps and basic technical concepts such as logins and authentication, app settings, and common error patterns.



  





**Troubleshooting \& Technical Aptitude** 



* A strong troubleshooting mindset \- methodical, curious, and good at narrowing down a problem and reliably reproducing it.
* Able to capture the right diagnostic detail and write defect tickets that engineers can act on without back\-and\-forth.
* Comfortable using AI tools (LLMs, AI\-assisted help\-desk and knowledge tools, and AI\-powered workflows).



  





**Communication \& Mindset** 



* Excellent written and verbal communication \- able to explain things simply and patiently to non\-technical users.

* Sound judgment around sensitive health information and the discretion a regulated product demands.



  





**Benefits:**

* Flexible working hours with remote work options.
* A vibrant, collaborative team environment.

 Helfie.ai is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Medical Writer
description:
**Overview**
 Cactus Life Sciences is a remote\-first organization, and we embrace an "accelerate from anywhere culture". You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
   

  

 If you are looking for challenging and rewarding work which combines your understanding of medical science and aptitude for writing into one unique job, the Medical Writer role is for you. This is an opportunity to grow your career and make a greater impact on the lives around you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Use scientific expertise to develop (write, proofread, and data\-check) high\-quality, client\-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client needs with excellent attention to detail under the guidance of the scientific leads.
* Liaise and build trusting and professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas \- learning to anticipate their needs.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.
* Attend client and other external meetings and support senior team members as needed.
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans.
* Ensure all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting\-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Share best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the medical communications team.


**Qualifications And Prerequisites**
* 1\-3 years of experience in relevant fields of scientific writing.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Should have experience working on publications.
* Experience working on gastric cancer publications would be preferable.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail and excellent language skills.
* Excellent communication skills, especially with the clients.
* Ability to adapt writing style to different materials and target audiences.
* Basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office.


 Application Process
   

  

 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process will include two
 **Technical Interviews** 
 with the Hiring Managers, and a
 **Technical Assessment,** 
 where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the
 **HR Interview.** 
 All interactions will be conducted virtually via
 **MS Teams.**
**Equal Opportunity**
 Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
   

  

**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
 The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
   

  

 AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose\-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
   

  

 We believe in Human\-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline \- science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
   

  

 You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
   

  

**About CACTUS**
 At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

 Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future\-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

**Job Description**
**Mactores** 
 is the agent\-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward\-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
   

  

 As a Partner Solutions Architect, you own that documentation across all of our partnerships, not just AWS. You're given project and architecture details by the delivery team, and you turn them into the competency documentation each partner program requires, and into case studies you can explain and defend to a partner reviewer, to a prospect, to anyone asking "what did Mactores actually ship here."
   

  

 AI tools are fair game for drafting; the bar is on accuracy and whether it holds up under questioning. Do this well, and the natural next step is a presales architect role, taking these case studies and this partner fluency directly into prospect conversations.
   

  

**What you’ll do?**
* Create and maintain competency documentation across all of Mactores' partnerships AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI using project and architecture details provided by the delivery team.
* Produce the technical validation write\-ups, architecture diagrams, and case study documentation each partner's competency and service delivery program requires.
* Build a working command of Mactores' case studies well enough to explain them clearly the problem, the architecture, the outcome to partner reviewers, prospects, or internal stakeholders.
* Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, while owning the accuracy and review\-readiness of the final document.
* Keep documentation format and quality consistent across partners and engagements.
* Flag gaps in the project details you're given when they're not sufficient to produce audit\-ready documentation.
* Work against fixed deadlines tied to partner program renewal and review cycles.


**What we’re looking for?**
* 2–3 years of experience in technical documentation, solutions architecture, or a related role touching AWS and/or modern data/AI platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI).
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture concepts enough to read a design across different platforms and document it accurately.
* Strong technical writing skills; comfortable turning raw project detail into a document that reads cleanly to an external reviewer.
* Comfortable explaining technical case studies out loud, not just writing them this role grows toward customer\-facing work.
* Familiarity with diagramming tools (draw.io, Lucidchart, or similar) for architecture diagrams.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of a documentation workflow, without leaning on them for accuracy you haven't verified.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to hold a deadline without supervision.

title: Technical Editor
description:
**Reporting to \- Head of Publishing Operations** 




  





**About Packt** 




 Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals. We are a technical publisher and learning provider with over 400 staff based across the globe, primarily in India and the UK. Our products have global relevance, and our multimedia portfolio includes over 7,000 books, e\-books, audiobooks, and video courses.
 



 For more details, visit www.packtpub.com.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a technical editor, you will work in partnership with content creators and editors to create high\-quality products on time, according to the publishing plan. You own the product’s technical accuracy, working with the content creator and other internal stakeholders from the delivery of the first draft of the content to publication. The TE is an editorial quality\-control role. The goal of editorial is to raise the revenue performance of every product by understanding content creator and user needs and the market we're publishing into.
 



 The role is ideal for methodical thinkers who can carry out efficient and purposeful code testing, using excellent technical skills. You will adopt an advisory role with content creators, using firm and diplomatic communication to help them understand the technical concerns that you have. This will lead to accurate technical content that allows readers to easily learn about new technologies and develop new skills.
 



 The TE will, in addition to the above, work on different product types to ensure they all meet the standards expected by our customers. These product types may be derived products, such as an audiobook or course based on a book. They may be new products created through market and user research.
 



 This demands a strong focus on quality from TEs: you will understand the level of quality our customers expect and own this on your products. To do this you will have to seek customer feedback throughout the editorial process and apply this during your testing. It is vital you keep track of new tech releases and user trends.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Technical:** 



* Ensure technical accuracy of the content: test all code in the product, as well as all code in the code bundle, ensuring they match
* Follow along with all examples and steps in the product
* Address any other technical concerns you find in the book (technical facts, references, screenshots, architecture, approach, and so on)
* Ensure code indentation is accurate and that the code remains consistent throughout the content
* Verify content coverage thoroughly to ensure technical accuracy
* Perform quality checks on code\-related Amazon reviews, errata, and GitHub issues
* Manage book repositories on GitHub and resolve any reader queries alongside the customer care team
* Support the team to improve code repositories and code\-testing systems
* Research technology innovations to deepen your tech. knowledge in your vertical’s topic area
* Connect to users and research to deepen your knowledge of users in your vertical’s topic area
* Keep up with market changes that could impact the delivery or success of a product, for example, tech. version updates and competing titles



  





**Editorial:** 



* Function as a reader advocate for your book from a technical point of view
* Query the author if any part of the code isn’t clear
* Provide a technical health check for the portfolio director to facilitate accurate planning and time allocation
* Carry out user research and market analysis to elevate your work
* Work with technical reviewers to ensure technical accuracy of the content and code. Use this to build up an understanding of the book and its audience
* Own the technical quality of a product: sign off the technical aspects of a product for production; advise on whether a product is suitable for cancellation
* Navigate the optimum balance of quality and timeliness in dialog with the rest of the product team
* Apply the Packt styles to the content and ensure the formatting follows the Packt style sheet



**Author/Expert management:** 



* Provide detailed and constructive feedback to content creators using the appropriate tone to suggest the necessary actions that will ensure that the technical content matches the proposition and meets Packt’s quality standards
* Build positive yet challenging relationships to get the most from content creators



  





**Who You Are** 




 You are a logical, efficient technical editor with a strong passion for creating high\-quality, technical content. You possess a good understanding of technology and are skilled at code testing. You work collaboratively with authors, editors, and technical reviewers, balancing high standards with commercial and product goals. You thrive in dynamic environments and continuously seek to optimize processes and workflows to deliver exceptional content.
 



  





**Must\-have skills:** 



* Technology testing: good working knowledge of at least one technology to the level that you can test code and examples in that domain area
* Quality assurance: rigorous attention to detail with a proven track record of ensuring content quality, accuracy, and consistency
* Technical content understanding: strong ability to interpret and convey complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences
* Research: the ability to get up to speed on an unfamiliar technology so you can test and evaluate technical content in that topic
* Author relationship management: the ability to build relationships with authors, providing constructive feedback and ensuring their vision is realized
* Stakeholder communication: good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders



  





**Good\-to\-have skills:** 



* Process optimization: ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements in quality\-control processes and workflows
* Adaptability: ability to adapt quickly to changing requirements and navigate ambiguity in fast\-paced environments



  





**Why Work at Packt** 




 We are a global and remote\-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We are a fun place to work but with a focus on performance and personal development providing opportunities for personal growth and career progression. We try to achieve this by:
 


* Ensuring a positive working environment for all team members, supportive of flexible and remote work.
* Supporting individual development through growth opportunities and internal mobility.
* Encouraging social collaboration within teams and communities and knowledge\-sharing.
* Fostering a culture that supports a healthy work\-life balance.



 We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by:
 


* Providing a broad range of benefits and initiatives.
* Advocating a healthy lifestyle where wellbeing is seen as an essential responsibility.
* Celebrating success stories and encouraging peer\-to\-peer recognition.
* Fostering a culture of self\-development.
* Providing a work environment where the best idea wins, and challenges are encouraged.



  





**Benefits:** 




 You will also have access to a range of flexible benefits that are designed to help you make the most of your time with us.
 



 Bonus scheme
 



 5 day working week
 



 25 days annual holiday (plus bank holidays)
 



 Flexible hours: choose how, when, and where you work within India
 



 Training programs and Certification
 



 Group Medical Insurance
 



 Wellness initiatives
 



  





**Salary Range \- INR 25 \- 60K fixed pay per month (skills and/or experience dependent)** 




  





**Disclaimer: Packt does not authorize any third\-party consultancies, influencers, or agencies to offer employment opportunities on our behalf. We are not involved in any financial transactions with these parties. Our hiring process is managed internally, and all applications should be made through the official procedures outlined in our job listings.**

title: Process Engineer - AI Automation & Business Process Management
description:
**At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA** 




  





 Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.
 



 AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto\-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.
 



  





 CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognized for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022\. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.
 



  





 AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading \& liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back\-office, product management, technology \& engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.
 



  





**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)** 




  





 At AMINA India, we are looking for an experienced professional to lead end‑to‑end process discovery, redesign, and AI\-driven automation across critical business functions, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and measurable impact. The role also champions compliant, well\-governed solutions while driving adoption through close collaboration with stakeholders, delivering sustainable, high\-value transformation.
 



  





**Your AMINA To\-Do List** 




  





**Discover, map and redesign processes** 



* Run process\-discovery workshops with teams across compliance, onboarding, operations, treasury, and client services.
* Produce clear, accurate process maps (BPMN or equivalent) and document the inputs, decisions, controls, and hand\-offs in each workflow.
* Redesign and optimize the process at hand, preparing it for potential automation / AI integration
* Identify automation candidates and quantify the opportunity — FTE saved, cycle\-time reduction, error\-rate impact, and cost.



**Design and build AI\-driven automation** 



* Translate process pain points into automation solutions using LLM\-based workflows, integration platforms, and APIs.
* Build, test, and iterate on automations — from document extraction and drafting assistants to alert triage, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Engineer reliable prompts and pipelines, design the human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and evaluate AI output quality with real test sets rather than vibes.
* Track token usage, run\-cost, and ROI per initiative, and make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy and model\-selection decisions.



**Keep it compliant and governed** 



* Design every automation so the accountable human still owns the decision — especially in regulated processes (KYC/AML, transaction monitoring, reporting).
* Work with Compliance, Risk, and IT to ensure solutions meet control, audit, data\-protection, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain documentation, change logs, and a clear inventory of what's automated, who owns it, and how it's monitored.



**Drive adoption** 



* Partner with business owners to pilot, refine, and roll out automations — and to get genuine buy\-in, not shelfware.
* Build internal momentum for AI adoption in a risk\-aware environment, navigating IT and security gatekeeping constructively.
* Train users, write SOPs, and hand over solutions in a maintainable state.



  





**Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:** 




  




* 4–10 years of experience in Business Process Management, Process Improvement, Automation, or Operational Transformation.
* Proven experience analyzing, redesigning, and optimizing business processes using structured methodologies (e.g., BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma, Process Mining).
* Strong stakeholder management and requirements\-gathering skills across business and technical teams.
* Hands\-on experience with AI and workflow automation tools, including LLMs, APIs, and integration platforms (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier).
* Practical understanding of prompt engineering, AI evaluation, and implementation of appropriate controls and guardrails.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages and data analysis.
* Experience within banking, fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.
* Understanding of financial\-services processes such as KYC, AML, onboarding, payments, reconciliation, or regulatory reporting.
* Knowledge of risk, controls, audit requirements, and regulatory compliance considerations.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge business, compliance, and technology stakeholders.
* Self\-starter with a pragmatic, delivery\-focused approach and the ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.



 Preferred
 


* Experience with crypto, digital assets, or blockchain\-related processes.
* Familiarity with FINMA, MiCA, AML, or similar regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with RAG, AI assistants, agentic workflows, Process Mining, or RPA tools. German language skills are a plus.



  





**Why We’re Awesome** 




  





 We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank.
 **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!** 




  





 Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

Title : Product Intern
   

  

 Location : Mumbai

**About Upstox**
 At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing simple, powerful, and for everyone. We’re one of India’s fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first\-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We’re not just moving fast, we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high\-energy, high\-impact environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

 The Role: Product Intern – US Stocks
   

  

 You’ll join the US Stocks Product team and help build and scale products that enable Indian investors to invest in the US stock market.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, 0\-to\-1 product role where you’ll work across product discovery, research, competitive intelligence, partner evaluation, and integrations. You’ll work closely with design, engineering, growth, and external partners to turn ideas into products that customers can use. You won’t inherit a finished playbook, you'll help build it.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Write and refine PRDs and help drive features from idea to launch — scoping requirements, chasing open questions, and keeping execution on track.
* Run competitive intelligence across Indian and global US\-stock investing platforms. Track what competitors are building, break down their features, and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.

* Identify and evaluate vendors and partners required for the product, including market data, trading infrastructure, payments, compliance\-related services, and other third\-party solutions.

* Work closely with Design, Engineering, Growth, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements into execution.
* Roll up your sleeves on the groundwork: research, analysis, documentation, partner coordination, testing, and the unglamorous wiring that turns an early idea into a real product.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Very hands\-on with AI. You use AI daily to research, prototype, analyze, draft, and move faster — and you’re constantly figuring out new ways to use it.
* Strong ownership. You take a problem and run with it end to end, without needing constant hand\-holding.

* Sharp product sense and genuine curiosity about investing, financial products, and how users interact with them.

* Strong written communication. You can take a messy problem and turn it into a clear, structured document.

 Why This Role Rocks
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast\-moving US Stocks Product team, building products that open up global investing opportunities for Indian investors.
   

  

 You’ll get hands\-on exposure to 0\-to\-1 product building, global investing, fintech partnerships, integrations, competitive intelligence, and product execution — while owning real problems and seeing your work go live.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI").

 Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin.

description:

BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. The R\&I vertical brings together a dynamic team of subject\-matter\-experts, sector analysts, management consultants, researchers, and editorial experts to deliver critical intelligence that empowers clients to stay ahead of market trends and adeptly navigate shifting macro and geo\-political dynamics.
 



 Research \& Insights team provides bespoke research, and data and analytics led solutions, to our practice teams and enterprise clients, helping them drive topline performance and unlock operational efficiencies. title: Assistant Manager - Product Delivery
description:
Assistant Manager – Product Delivery
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 At IDfy, a great product only creates value when it actually lands \- deployed, adopted, and working in the real world. As our Assistant Manager – Product Delivery, you'll be the person who makes that happen: turning client requirements into working solutions, translating messy real\-world problems into clean product outcomes, and owning delivery end\-to\-end from the first conversation to go\-live. If you love figuring out "what the client actually needs, how to solve it, and how to ship it" \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**We're The Perfect Match If You**
* Have 1–3 years of experience in a client\-facing implementation, SaaS delivery, solutioning, or technical project role.
* Have worked directly with enterprise clients and juggled multiple stakeholders and workstreams without dropping the ball.
* Are AI\-first and hands\-on \- you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and solve smarter.
* Bring a can\-do attitude \- when someone says "this is tricky," your first instinct is "let's figure it out."
* Communicate with clarity and influence \- equally comfortable aligning a client's HR team and rallying internal Product \& Engineering.

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of IDfy's products for clients \- from requirement understanding through solutioning, UAT, and go\-live \- within agreed timelines.
* Get deep into the client's employee onboarding journey and HRTech ecosystem to spot process and product gaps before they become delivery issues.

* Partner across teams to balance what the client wants against what's buildable, scalable, and on\-time.
* Act as the key point of contact across the delivery lifecycle, keeping clients and internal Product / Engineering / Sales / CX aligned.
* Run multiple client implementations at once \- tracking dependencies, risks, blockers, and timelines, and prioritizing by client impact and business criticality.
* Spot recurring patterns and push to standardize and improve how delivery gets done.


 Why IDfy
   

  

 At IDfy, we don't just build products \- we build trust infrastructure for the digital economy. In this role, you'll sit at the frontline of how that trust actually reaches clients: owning delivery, shaping solutions, and working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Product and Engineering.
   

  

 If you've ever wanted to turn delivery puzzles into product wins \- this is your playground.

description:

Job responsibilities:

* Share best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the medical communications team.


\#LI\-Remote
Qualifications and prerequisites:
* 1\-3 years of experience in relevant fields of scientific writing.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Should have experience working on publications.
* Experience working on gastric cancer publications would be preferable.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail and excellent language skills.
* Excellent communication skills, especially with the clients.
* Ability to adapt writing style to different materials and target audiences.
* Basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office.

The final round will be the **HR Interview.** All interactions will be conducted virtually via **MS Teams.**

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.


 AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose\-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.


 We believe in Human\-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline \- science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.


You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.

  


About Us:

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.


Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future\-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.
