title: Electronic Systems Product Specialist
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
 Investigates electronic application and systems problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Applies and improves electronic application and systems development processes and tools. Processes include system specification, modeling and simulation, calibration, Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP\&R), and troubleshooting. Application of tools for simulation, calibration, and product life maintenance required. Obtains input from customers, technical and product teams, manufacturing engineers, supplier partners, and other stakeholders to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Makes decisions in the areas of electronic and electrical system design, requirements, calibration, and test that impact the quality and performance of calibrated subsystems and feature classes of electronic subsystems. Responsible for review of less\-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient design. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Design and Application of Mechatronics Systems \- Specifies electronic hardware and interconnections that measure and control systems; applies electronic hardware and interconnections in Cummins' products.
   

  

 Machine Integration and Optimization \- Combines various parts or sub\-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem\-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.
   

  

 Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements.
   

  

 Product Problem Solving \- Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
   

  

 Product Verification and Validation Management \- Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
   

  

 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Systems Thinking \- Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
   

  

 Builds networks \- Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

 Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls \- Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
   

  

 Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Provide technical and application engineering support to Mining and Construction OEMs by understanding customer requirements, supporting engine and electronic system integration, managing calibration\-related activities, and ensuring successful execution of customer projects. The role serves as the primary technical interface between OEM customers and Cummins cross\-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as the primary technical contact for Industrial Markets segments Construction and Mining OEM customers.
* Work closely with OEMs to understand vehicle/equipment requirements and translate them into Cummins engine and system requirements.
* Support application engineering activities for Industrial Markets segments mining and Construction projects from concept through production.
* Review customer requirements and identify engine, aftertreatment, and electronic control system impacts.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering, Calibration, Controls, and Systems teams to define and implement required changes.
* Identify calibration requirements and support calibration development, validation, and deployment activities.
* Support engine electronic system integration, including ECM configuration and troubleshooting.
* Provide expertise on CAN communication architecture, J1939 communication protocols, and electronic system interfaces.
* Support OEM harness design, electrical integration, and validation activities.
* Review customer electrical schematics and ensure compliance with Cummins integration guidelines.
* Manage product releases, documentation updates, and engineering change activities through Cummins PLM processes.
* Support project planning, milestone tracking, issue resolution, and customer deliverables.
* Participate in customer meetings, technical reviews, validation activities, and field issue investigations.
* Support new product introductions and ongoing product improvement initiatives within the Mining and Construction segments.

description:

Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award\-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. 
 



 Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:
 


* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025\) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025\) – E\+E Leaders Awards.*

**How We Work** 




 Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.
 



 We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.
 



 Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity \& Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.
 



**About the Role** 




 Energy Exemplar is the leader in energy market/system simulation software, with its two platforms: PLEXOS and AURORA. These software platforms have a significant presence in global markets. We are seeking a confident, self\-motivated and professional person for the role of Energy Market Analyst in our Support Division. The company has consistently grown its global client base and the successful candidate will have many opportunities to interface with a diverse mix of clients with the goal of enhancing their software user experience.
 



**Responsibilities:**

 •    Assist Account Management with Retention calls and visits with clients
   

 •    Assist in preparation and presentations for energy related tradeshows and conferences
   

 •    Travel to client sites as required
 



**Qualifications, Skills \& Experiences:**
 •    Bachelor’s degree: Electrical Engineering, Another Engineering Degree, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Applied Math, Physics, or related field.
   

 •    Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to research and learn new techniques
   

 •    Ability to articulate the business problem to be analyzed, quickly identify the critical elements of the problem, achieve a high\-quality answer in a timely fashion, and synthesize answers to resonate with decision makers
   

 •    Excellent communication skills, including strong verbal, presentation, and technical writing abilities
   

 •    Team player, with the ability to be a self\-starter and work independently as needed.
 



**Education:**
 •    2 to 4 years of demonstrated working knowledge of power plant operations, electricity and gas markets.
   

 •    Knowledge of fundamental energy market analysis, capacity markets, environmental markets, demand side management/energy efficiency, electric utility resource planning approaches
   

 •    Demonstrated working knowledge of SaaS products and experience troubleshooting issues with Cloud offerings
   

 •    Demonstrated capability of effectively communicating complex ideas and analysis verbally, in document format (Word), and in presentation format (Power Point).
   

 •    Experience with computer and database management languages such as VBA, Python and SQL
   

 •    Working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.)
   

 •    Experience with power market production cost and expansion planning models.

As the technical and product expert for our AI\-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Consultant role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimization.

 Strategic Skills \& Expertise

title: Manager / Assistant Manager - Estimation
description:
**About Zeeco**
 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, delivering innovative technologies for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes process burners, power burners, boiler burners, duct burners, thermal oxidizers, flares, vapor recovery systems, incinerators, and combustion control systems. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco provides customized combustion solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Zeeco is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Estimation Engineer** 
 with
 **10 to 15\+ years of experience** 
 in preparing techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of combustion equipment, burner management systems, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, and project costing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing customer enquiries, interpreting technical specifications, coordinating with engineering and procurement teams, obtaining vendor quotations, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals for global projects.
   

  

 Candidates with either a
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or
 **Instrumentation \& Control Engineering** 
 background and extensive experience in industrial combustion equipment are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Technical Review**
* Review customer RFQs, ITBs, specifications, datasheets, PFDs, P\&IDs, burner schedules, and other project documents.
* Evaluate process requirements, fuel characteristics, combustion duty, control philosophy, emissions, and applicable design standards.
* Identify technical clarifications, scope gaps, deviations, and commercial risks before proposal submission.


**Estimation \& Costing**
* Prepare accurate techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner packages.
* Develop Bills of Materials (BOM) covering burners, fuel trains, BMS/CCS, PLC/HMI, instrumentation, valves, electrical, mechanical, and bought\-out items.
* Estimate engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, logistics, commissioning, and documentation costs.


**Vendor \& Proposal Management**
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations for technical compliance, pricing, and delivery.
* Coordinate with procurement to optimize vendor selection and project costing.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, including cost sheets, assumptions, exclusions, and deviations.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate with Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, and Manufacturing teams to validate technical and commercial inputs.
* Review engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrument schedules to support accurate estimation.


**Cost Optimization \& Bid Support**
* Identify value engineering opportunities and cost\-effective technical solutions while ensuring compliance with customer specifications.
* Support customer clarification meetings, bid evaluations, negotiations, and project handover following order award.


**Estimation Database**
* Maintain estimation databases, standard costing, historical pricing, and vendor cost records to improve estimation accuracy and proposal competitiveness.


**Technical Expertise**
**The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of:**
**Combustion Systems**
* Process, Boiler, Power, and Duct Burners
* Low NOx, Ultra Low NOx, Gas, Oil, Dual\-Fuel, and Multi\-Fuel Burners
* Burner sizing, fuel selection, combustion principles, and emissions requirements


**Fuel Train \& Mechanical Systems:**
* Fuel gas and liquid fuel trains
* Pressure regulators, safety shut\-off valves, control valves, vent valves, filters, and strainers
* Burners, dampers, registers, skid\-mounted systems, piping, and fabricated assemblies


**Instrumentation \& Controls:**
* Burner Management Systems (BMS) and Combustion Control Systems (CCS)
* PLC/HMI\-based control systems
* Flame scanners, ignition systems, pressure, temperature, and flow instrumentation
* Control valves, actuators, and combustion safety interlocks


**Estimation \& Proposal Engineering:**
* Interpretation of RFQs, P\&IDs, datasheets, burner schedules, and technical specifications
* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages


**Codes \& Standards:**
 Working knowledge of applicable combustion and industrial standards, including
 **NFPA 85/86** 
 ,
 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME** 
 ,
 **IEC** 
 , and
 **ISA is preferred.**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Instrumentation \& Control Engineering.
* 10–15 years of experience in estimation, proposal engineering, or applications engineering for industrial combustion systems.
* Experience working with burner OEMs, combustion equipment manufacturers, EPC companies, or industrial heating solution providers.


**Preferred Industry Background**
* Industrial Burner Manufacturers
* Combustion Equipment OEMs
* Boiler Manufacturers
* Process Heater OEMs
* Furnace Manufacturers
* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical
* Refining
* Power Generation
* EPC Organizations
* Industrial Heating Equipment Manufacturers


**Desired Competencies**
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen.
* Excellent understanding of combustion systems and process heating applications.
* Ability to interpret complex customer specifications and translate them into accurate cost estimates.
* Strong analytical and cost modelling skills.
* Excellent negotiation and vendor management capabilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries with tight bid submission deadlines.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Self\-driven with a strong focus on accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement.

 This is a highly cross\-functional role with a strong focus
 **on understanding and improving the product** 
 . You will research markets and competitors, study how AI and software products work, analyses user and industry needs, and translate your findings into product ideas, strategic recommendations, and structured execution plans.
   

  

 The role is ideal for someone who enjoys diving into unfamiliar subjects, understanding how products and businesses work, experimenting with technology, and turning large amounts of information into clear, actionable insights.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Work closely with the founders on product research, product strategy, feature exploration, and new initiatives.
* Study our product and related workflows to identify product gaps, improvement opportunities, potential features, and new use cases.
* Research AI, legal\-tech, SaaS, and software products to understand their features, workflows, UX, capabilities, positioning, and use cases.
* Conduct research across markets, companies, products, competitors, customers, and emerging technologies.
* Analyze competing AI and legal\-tech products across their business models, customers, pricing, funding, features, and market positioning.
* Build structured research databases, competitor matrices, market maps, feature comparisons, and product analyses.
* Speak to or study potential users and customers to better understand their workflows, pain points, behaviors, and requirements.
* Convert research and user insights into product recommendations, feature ideas, strategic briefs, and actionable next steps.
* Analyze information to identify trends, gaps, opportunities, and strategic insights.
* Experiment extensively with AI tools and emerging technologies to understand how they can be incorporated into the product.
* Create clear presentations, spreadsheets, documents, product notes, and strategic briefs.
* Support the founders on high\-priority projects across product, strategy, market intelligence, and business initiatives.


**What We're Looking For**
* Tech / Engineering graduates with 24 years of experience, or MBA graduates with 02 years of experience.
* Strong interest in product, technology, AI, software, and business strategy.
* Strong research, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand software products deeply including their features, workflows, user experience, and underlying use cases.
* Highly proficient with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and similar platforms , and comfortable using AI extensively in everyday work.
* Ability to independently explore and learn unfamiliar industries, technologies, and products quickly.
* Strong written English and the ability to structure and communicate complex information clearly.
* Comfortable working extensively with spreadsheets, presentations, documents, and research tools.
* Curious, detail\-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of open\-ended assignments.
* Comfortably operating in a fast\-moving environment where priorities may evolve as the product and company grow.


**Who This Role Is Best Suited For**
 You are a strong fit for this role if you naturally enjoy:
   

  

* Exploring new AI software products to understand how they work.
* Comparing different products and analyzing why one product performs better than another.
* Breaking down ambiguous problems and designing research approaches to solve them.
* Identifying product improvements, feature gaps, and better user workflows.
* Using AI tools to research, write, prototype, and solve problems faster.
* Turning scattered information into clear, structured insights.


**Growth Progression**
 As the company grows, this role can evolve into broader ownership across
 **product management, product strategy, business strategy, market intelligence, growth, and other high\-priority initiatives,** 
 depending on the individuals strengths and interests.
   

  

 The role offers significant exposure to 0\-to\-1 product building and the opportunity to work closely with the founders on decisions that directly shape the product and company.

title: Manager, Quality – Digital Systems
description:
**Role Summary:**
 The Manager, Quality – Digital Systems is a business\-facing role that serves as the primary point of contact between RQA’s digital quality systems and the stakeholders who depend on them, with working technical depth in Veeva eQMS administration and GxP\-regulated system operations anchoring that work. This role is accountable for the reliable administration and continuous improvement of Veeva eQMS processes, including access management, business administration, release coordination, and reporting. The successful candidate will bring enough configuration fluency \- understanding vault object relationships, shared versus instance\-specific configuration, and the downstream consequences of proposed system changes \- to translate technical trade\-offs into clear guidance for stakeholders and support faster, better\-informed decisions on enhancement requests and system design questions.
   

  

 The successful candidate must communicate clearly across technical and business audiences, understand stakeholder needs, assess business and technical trade\-offs, and support technology decisions that advance quality operations and broader business objectives. Beyond day\-to\-day operations, this role independently represents the RQA Digital Systems team within cross\-functional programs and enterprise initiatives, scoping RQA’s responsibilities within a given program and developing and driving the execution plan on behalf of the team. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, maintaining clear situational awareness across assigned responsibilities and bringing issues and decisions forward proactively.
   

  

 This position requires strong communication and analytical skills, working Veeva domain knowledge, genuine curiosity about applying AI and emerging technology to quality operations, and the ability to operate effectively in a regulated pharmaceutical environment — both as a business partner and as an accountable owner of complex, cross\-functional work.
   

  

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Veeva eQMS Operations \& Administration**
* Serve as the primary business administrator for Veeva eQMS on behalf of Regulatory Quality Assurance.
* Triage and resolve business admin requests requiring business\-level judgment, partnering with technical teams on complex issues.
* Own access request intake and provisioning across RQA’s digital systems environments.
* Support Veeva release coordination through UAT, business approvals and communications, and production deployments.
* Maintain and continuously improve job aids, quick reference guides, and user\-facing documentation for Veeva eQMS and integrated supporting tools, keeping materials current across system releases.
* Develop, prepare, and deliver reporting across functional areas.


**eQMS Systems Expertise \& Advisory**
* Provide guidance on Veeva vault configuration options in support of business needs, including object relationships, shared configuration dependencies, and the downstream impact of proposed changes, partnering with technical teams to fill configuration depth as needed.
* Support the triage and formulation of eQMS enhancement requests, providing business context and impact assessment alongside stakeholder needs and operational impacts to inform prioritization and decision\-making.
* Stay current on Veeva platform developments and GxP digital systems best practices, especially with respect to emerging AI technologies, applying that knowledge to identify and champion opportunities to modernize system design and operations.
* Participate in eQMS governance forums, representing RQA Digital Systems’ interests and staying current on platform developments.


**Cross\-Functional Program Support**
* Independently represent the RQA Digital Systems team within enterprise programs and initiatives requiring digital systems support, scoping team responsibilities, developing execution plans, and delivering against them.
* Maintain clear ownership of workstream status and decisions; proactively surface blockers or escalation points to leadership.
* Coordinate with Pfizer Digital and cross\-functional teams to support enterprise quality data integrity and system continuity efforts.


**Reporting \& Data Operations**
* Issue clear and timely communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned on timelines and expected outcomes.
* Execute periodic data extracts and reporting tasks, including basic dashboarding and data queries, in support of regulatory and quality operations, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and appropriate documentation.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation and user guidance for current and legacy quality systems to ensure operational continuity.
* Gather, synthesize, and prepare materials for stakeholder communications and leadership briefings, translating system and data insights into accessible formats.


**Transformation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively identify opportunities for meaningful process improvement and digital transformation within RQA’s quality systems operations, bringing both technical grounding and operational context to proposed solutions.
* Apply practical AI knowledge to evaluate use cases, partner with technical teams, and drive adoption of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Contribute to and support broader organizational transformation initiatives, including AI integration into quality workflows, eQMS process redesign, and platform evolution.
* Stay current on Veeva platform capabilities, GxP digital systems trends, and regulatory expectations, applying emerging best practices to improve the team’s operations and delivery.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field with 5\+ years of relevant industry experience; advanced degree preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear documentation, user\-facing guidance, and stakeholder\-ready reports.
* Demonstrated experience working directly and iteratively with business stakeholders to understand their underlying needs and workflows.
* Working knowledge of Veeva Vault eQMS or a comparable enterprise quality/GxP system, including working knowledge of vault object relationships and configuration dependencies.
* Demonstrated, hands\-on curiosity about AI\-enabled tools, automation, or advanced analytics, with concrete examples of applying them to improve processes and drive innovation.
* Experience in a GxP\-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment with demonstrated understanding of quality management system processes.
* Proven ability to operate autonomously and collaboratively on complex, cross\-functional work.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; able to assess the downstream impact of system changes and translate business needs into actionable decisions.


**Preferred:**
* Basic coding, scripting, and/or dashboarding experience (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Spotfire, or similar).
* Background as a Veeva Vault business administrator, business analyst, or similar business\-technology liaison role.
* Experience with Veeva Vault configuration in a pharma or CRO setting, including participation in system releases, eQMS governance forums, or enhancement request management.
* Familiarity with Pfizer enterprise data and/or source systems.
* Exposure to data platforms – Snowflake, DSS/Dataiku – or related data engineering tools.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate or similar automation tools.


 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
   

  

 To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI\-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

title: Technical Service Specialist-Coatings Solutions
description:
**Technical Service Specialist – Coatings Solutions**
**Location: Multiple Locations Across India**
 Help Customers Transform Performance Through Technical Excellence
   

  

 Are you passionate about coatings technology, customer success, troubleshooting complex technical challenges, and driving continuous improvement?
   

  

 At Axalta, our Technical Service professionals play a critical role in helping customers maximize quality, productivity, and performance. Working at the intersection of technology, innovation, and customer engagement, Technical Service Specialists provide expert support across a wide range of industries, including Automotive OEM, Commercial Vehicles, Industrial Manufacturing, Agricultural Equipment, Construction Equipment, Rail, and Automotive Refinish.
   

  

 This evergreen opportunity is designed to build our pipeline of technical talent for current and future openings across our Mobility, Industrial, and Refinish businesses throughout India.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Technical Service Specialist, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, helping them optimize coating processes, resolve technical challenges, and successfully implement new products and technologies.
   

  

 Technical Support \& Customer Success
   

  

* Provide expert technical support for coatings products and application processes.
* Partner closely with customers to improve product performance, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Investigate and resolve product, process, color, and application\-related issues.
* Act as a trusted technical resource for key customer accounts.


 Product Implementation \& Commercialization
   

  

* Support the launch and implementation of new products and technologies at customer facilities.
* Conduct product trials and validation activities in collaboration with Technology and Commercial teams.
* Drive product approvals and specification wins with OEM and industrial customers.
* Support successful commercialization of innovative coating solutions.


 Process Improvement \& Standardization
   

  

* Analyze customer coating processes and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Develop and implement standard operating procedures and best practices.
* Drive process consistency, quality improvements, and productivity enhancements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across customer operations.


 Training \& Technical Development
   

  

* Deliver technical training programs for customers, distributors, bodyshops, OEMs, and production teams.
* Conduct audits and process reviews to ensure compliance with recommended application standards.
* Share technical expertise and best practices to improve customer capabilities.


 Project \& Relationship Management
   

  

* Build strong relationships with customers at multiple organizational levels.
* Coordinate cross\-functional projects involving Sales, Technology, Operations, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely execution of customer initiatives.
* Maintain regular communication regarding technical performance, project milestones, and improvement opportunities.


 Data Analysis \& Reporting
   

  

* Monitor application performance, paint consumption, process data, and quality metrics.
* Analyze technical data and provide recommendations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Prepare technical reports, findings, and improvement plans.
* Support data\-driven decision making through accurate performance tracking and reporting.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Ideally Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Paint Technology, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.


**Experience**
* 3\-8 years of experience in technical service, coating applications, manufacturing processes, product development, or related technical\-commercial roles.
* Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
+ Coatings and Paints
+ Automotive OEM
+ Commercial Vehicles
+ Automotive Refinish
+ Industrial Manufacturing
+ Agricultural Equipment
+ Construction Equipment
+ Rail Transportation


 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Knowledge of coating technologies, paint formulation, and application processes.
* Understanding of manufacturing and coating line operations.
* Experience supporting product launches, trials, and process improvements.
* Exposure to troubleshooting color, appearance, and application\-related issues.
* Experience working with customers in a technical support environment.


 Professional Skills
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to build trust and credibility with customers.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; CRM experience is an advantage.


**Additional Requirements**
* Customer\-focused mindset with a passion for delivering technical excellence.
* Ability to work independently and travel extensively based on business needs.
* Experience in multicultural and matrix environments is an advantage.


 Why Join Axalta?
   

  

**At Axalta, You'll Have The Opportunity To**
* Work with leading global and regional manufacturers across diverse industries.
* Gain exposure to innovative coatings technologies and advanced manufacturing environments.
* Develop both technical and commercial expertise through challenging customer\-facing projects.
* Collaborate with talented colleagues across Technical, Commercial, Operations, and R\&D functions.
* Build a rewarding career in a company that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.
* Make a direct impact on customer success, product performance, and business growth.


 Join Our Technical Talent Community
   

  

 We are continuously seeking talented technical professionals who are passionate about coatings, manufacturing excellence, and customer success. By applying to this evergreen opportunity, you'll be considered for current and future Technical Service roles across our Mobility, Industrial, and Refinish businesses throughout India.
   

  

**Our Company**
 Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever\-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.
   

  

 Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia\-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140\+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.
   

  

 Axalta may use technology\-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain aspects of the recruitment and selection process. These tools may be used to help manage applications, identify job\-related qualifications, and assist recruiter review. All hiring decisions involve human oversight and review.

 : We take candidate safety seriously. If you believe you’ve encountered a fraudulent job posting claiming to represent our company, please include a link or screenshot and report it to TA\-Support\-Center@axalta.com.
   

  

 We consider an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience to determine final salary. This role is eligible for benefits such as health insurance and paid time off. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.
   

  

 While this position is not currently open, we are building a talent pool for future opportunities and will keep your resume on file.

 R\&D, Product Lifecycle Management, Commercial Awareness, Business Partnership, Collaboration, Partnership building, Collaborator, Ability to challenge the status quo, Propose improvement, Accountability, Adaptability, Analytical, Formulation, Science, Chemistry.

 About GCTC
 



 The Global Counter Terrorism Council (GCTC) is a premier international think tank focused on shaping global policy and strategic responses to contemporary challenges in counterterrorism, national security, and international relations.
 



 Founded with the mission to promote peace, security, and stability in the global order, GCTC works to build collaborations between governments, policy experts, civil society, and private sectors. Known for its research\-driven approach, GCTC offers data\-backed insights, policy recommendations, and innovative solutions to some of the world's most pressing security and governance challenges.
 



 Beyond counterterrorism, GCTC organizes high\-level conferences and strategic dialogues on emerging technologies, sustainable development, diplomacy, and public policy, facilitating capacity building and cross\-sectoral partnerships.
 



  





 Mission of GCTC
 


* Advance India's leadership in counter\-terrorism, governance reform, and digital sovereignty.
* Serve as a bridge between policymakers, academia, youth, industry, and civil society.
* Generate actionable knowledge through policy dialogues, white papers, and strategic consultations.
* Support India's role in shaping a secure, inclusive, and technologically advanced global order.



 Impact of GCTC So Far
 



 ✅
 **350\+** 
 National and International Conferences Convened
 



 🧾
 **750\+** 
 Policy Reports and Strategic White Papers Published
 



 🤝
 **300\+** 
 Senior Stakeholders Engaged Across Government, Military, Academia, and Civil Society

 Youth Leaders and Fellows Reached Through Capacity\-Building and Public Engagement
 



 🌐 Strategic Partnerships with Think Tanks, Ministries, Missions, and Universities in India and Abroad
 



  





 Internship Overview
 



 The Research Coordinator Internship is a
 **13\-month, full\-time, in\-person opportunity** 
 based in
 **Noida (Delhi NCR)** 
 . The selected intern will play an active role in GCTC's policy research, conference coordination, stakeholder engagement, and institutional development while working closely with senior government officials, military leaders, diplomats, policymakers, academics, and industry experts.
 



 Outstanding performers will be given preference for suitable full\-time opportunities at GCTC upon successful completion of the internship, subject to organisational requirements.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Primary Responsibilities
 


* Plan and execute national\-level conferences, seminars, and strategic dialogues on security, defence, governance, public policy, and emerging technologies.
* Liaise with Ministries (MHA, MoD, MEA), senior military officers, diplomats, policymakers, universities, and partner institutions.
* Coordinate speakers, prepare programme material, manage logistics, documentation, and conference execution.



 Research \& Policy
 


* Prepare event reports, policy briefs, strategic papers, concept notes, and background documents.
* Track developments relating to national security, foreign policy, governance, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies.
* Assist in post\-event reporting, media outreach, and institutional communication.



 Institutional Support
 


* Support research publications, editorial work, and digital campaigns.
* Assist with youth leadership initiatives, capacity\-building programmes, and international collaborations.



 Eligibility \& Qualifications
 



 Applicants should preferably possess:
 


* A Master's degree (completed or final year) in Political Science, International Relations, Strategic Studies, Public Policy, Law, Defence Studies, or a related discipline.
* Excellent research, analytical, communication, and English writing skills.
* Strong organisational and interpersonal skills with the ability to coordinate high\-level programmes.
* Prior internship, research, or event management experience will be an added advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. Knowledge of Canva or similar design tools is desirable.
* Willingness to work full\-time in person from the GCTC office in Noida.



**Exceptional Candidates:** 
 While preference will be given to applicants pursuing or holding a Master's degree, outstanding candidates with a Bachelor's degree who demonstrate exceptional research aptitude, writing skills, professionalism, leadership potential, and a strong commitment to public policy, governance, and national security may also be considered.
 



  





 What You Will Gain

* **Performance\-Based Completion Incentive of up to ₹3,500 per month** 
 , payable as a
 **lump sum upon successful completion of the 13\-month internship** 
 . The incentive will be awarded based on the intern's overall performance, commitment, professionalism, attendance, quality of work, discipline, and contribution to GCTC's programmes and activities. The final incentive amount shall be determined solely at the discretion of GCTC.
* Hands\-on experience in planning and executing prestigious national conferences and strategic dialogues.
* Direct exposure to senior government officials, diplomats, military leaders, policymakers, academics, and industry experts.

**Application for Research Coordinator Internship – Immediate Joining – \[Your Name]**

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
**About the role:** 





 Zeltis works on communicating the Government of West Bengal’s schemes, initiatives, events and priority messages to the people of the State through simple, accessible video and graphic content.
 





 We are looking for a
 
**Senior Copywriter** 

 who can anchor the written word in that process. The job is to take policy; often dense, technical and written for administrators and turn it into language that a farmer in Purulia, a student in Siliguri and a homemaker in Howrah can easily understand. This is not advertising for its own sake; it is public communication and it carries the weight and responsibility of the Government’s voice.
 





 The role is suited to someone who reads and analyzes the news out of genuine interest, who can tell the difference between a claim and a fact and who can write a line that lands without ever overstating or understating what the Government has actually said. 
 





 At Zeltis, we are looking for someone who brings curiosity, clarity and editorial judgement to every piece of content they write.
 




**Experience:** 

 3 to 5 years minimum prior experience as a content writer in governance, political, journalistic, research\-driven or critical/analytical environments. Candidates from newsrooms, policy institutions, think tanks, research organisations, editorial desks or long\-form publications will be strongly preferred, as the role demands accuracy and depth alongside creative flair.
 




**Key responsibilities:** 



* Translate scheme documents, policy notes, press releases and departmental briefs into clear, simple, people\-facing copy in Bengali and English.
* Write scripts (explainers, reels, testimonials, event films), voice\-over copy, graphic and creative copy, campaign taglines and punchlines.
* Produce copy that reads natively, with the idiom, rhythm and cultural texture appropriate to each, rather than a literal rendering of the other.
* Proactively ideate content and campaigns; identify communication opportunities before they are assigned and propose the narrative angle for them.
* Manage narrative consistently across campaigns and ensure the Government's initiatives are communicated positively, accurately and in a single coherent voice.
* Brief and work alongside the design, motion and video teams; ensure copy and visual treatment work together rather than in parallel.
* Deliver rapid\-response copy during announcements, events, launches and time\-sensitive situations.
* Act as the final quality check on outgoing copy to ensure factual accuracy, official nomenclature, scheme names, figures, spellings, grammar and tone.
* Guide and review the work of junior copywriters and maintain the unit's style and terminology standards.
* Maintain strict confidentiality on all unreleased communication, data and internal material.



**Essential skills and requirements:** 



* **Genuine understanding and interest in governance and policy:** 

 Demonstrable understanding of, knowledge of, or serious interest in governance, public policy and welfare delivery. Follows news \- State, local and National as a daily habit and can hold an informed conversation about the same.
* **Understands the sensitivity of government communication:** 

 Understands that government communication is not just another brand of communication. Appreciates the protocols, the factual discipline, the political and administrative sensitivities involved and the lines that must not be crossed. Exercises judgement about what can be said, how and when.
* **Simplification for the layman:** 

 Proven ability to convert technical, administrative and policy language into simple, everyday terms; copy that connects with a general audience across literacy levels, age groups and districts, without diluting or misrepresenting the facts.
* **Language command:** 

 Fluency in Bengali and English, publication\-standard writing, with the ability to write original copy. Hindi proficiency is optional but desirable.
* **Keen eye for detail and error identification:** 

 Catches factual slips, wrong figures, wrong scheme names, grammatical and typographical errors and inconsistencies in tone before anything goes out. A single error in government communication carries a disproportionate cost.
* **Creative writing and punchline ideation:** 

 Can produce memorable, sharp, quotable lines and headlines; slogans, hooks, taglines, captions that travel well on social platforms.
* **Proactive ideation and narrative management:** 

 Brings ideas to the table unprompted. Thinks in terms of campaigns and arcs, not one\-off posts and can shape a sustained positive narrative around the Government's work.
* **Availability and work commitment:** 

 Government work is unpredictable and often urgent. The role requires genuine willingness and enthusiasm to work beyond designated hours, including evenings, weekends and public holidays, when the situation demands.



**Good to have:** 



* Ad copywriting experience: Experience in writing campaign copy, print, OOH, digital and film.
* Agency experience: Familiarity with client servicing, brief\-taking, deadline culture and working within a creative team.
* Creative writing credentials: Published work, long\-form storytelling, literary or scripting background.
* Working knowledge of social media platform policies: Community guidelines, content restrictions and compliance requirements across Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube and WhatsApp.
* Understanding of platform algorithms: What drives reach, retention and engagement and how copy choices affect distribution.



  





**Remuneration: I** 

 ndustry standard, commensurate with experience, portfolio and interview performance
 




***This is an on\-site role and the candidate must travel to and work from the office***




  





***Applicants are requested to apply at***
*hr@zeltis.co.in* 
***along with submission of any one assignments mentioned below (Pick any one):***



1. *There is a lot of negative publicity surrounding Annapurna Yojana owing to the delay in payments. Even though the reason is logical administratively speaking, common people do not understand that. Hence, your task is to prepare a one\-minute content script for a video that will be published through Government or Department page; positively promoting the Annapurna Yojana which is not misleading \[in Bengali]*
2. *Write a video script on PM Surya Ghar Yojana with the intention of urging people to apply for the scheme through listing out its benefits. Common people find it boring to look through the pages of scheme documents, guidelines and websites; hence write the script in a manner like it appeals to the layman with the lucrative side of the scheme; without any half information or misinformation \[in Bengali]*

title: Project Engineer - Seat Development
description:
Role Title: Project Engineer – Seat Development
 



 Location: Kolkata
 



 Department: Product Development / R\&D
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Role Summary \- We are looking for someone who can own the entire lifecycle of a seat: concept → design → development → validation → certification → customer handling → vendor management → tooling → final delivery. This role is for someone who can take a seat from a rough idea on paper to a fully certified, customer\-approved product ready for production. The person should be able to interact confidently with OEMs, vendors, testing agencies, and internal teams. They will handle design, development, documentation, certification, costing, and timelines end\-to\-end.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Key Responsibilities**



  





 1\) Product Design \& Engineering
 



  




* Understand customer requirements, technical standards, and application needs (Automotive, Railways, Defence, Marine, etc.).
* Create concept designs, 2D drawings, 3D models, BOM, and specifications.
* Select materials, mechanisms, foam compositions, trims, and structural components.
* Ensure manufacturability, durability, ergonomics, and safety compliance.



  





 2\) Customer Interaction \& Project Ownership
 



  




* Attend customer meetings, collect technical inputs, and translate them into design actions.
* Present concepts, drawings, prototypes, and test results to clients.
* Manage timelines, technical queries, and revisions.
* Ensure customer satisfaction from kick\-off till SOP (start of production).



  





 3\) New Product Development (NPD)
 



  




* Develop prototypes, coordinate with in\-house teams and external vendors.
* Plan and execute trials, fitments, and pilot builds.
* Generate DVP (Design Validation Plan), DFMEA, PFMEA, and related NPD documents.
* Improve designs based on testing, feedback, and production learnings.



  





 4\) Certification \& Compliance
 



  




* Coordinate for testing and certification with agencies like – ARAI / VRDE / ICAT / RDSO / DGQA / Navy / DGCA (depending on seat type).
* Prepare documentation needed for homologation or qualification.
* Ensure compliance with relevant standards (AIS, BIS, RDSO manuals, etc.).
* Track certification timelines and manage corrective actions, if any.



  





 6\) Documentation \& Reporting
 



  




* Maintain project timelines, revision history, ECNs, drawing releases.
* Prepare project tracker reports for management and customer reviews.
* Maintain clear documentation for smooth handover to production.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Degree in Mechanical / Automobile Engineering.
* 6–8 years of experience in automotive or seating industry.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong knowledge of 3D CAD tools (SolidWorks / Creo / Catia).
* Experience with mechanisms, kinematics, ergonomics, and material selection.
* Understanding of testing, certification, and industry standards.
* Good communication skills for customer\-facing discussions.
* Ability to handle multiple projects and deliver under timelines.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Hands\-on approach
* Curious mindset and problem\-solving attitude
* Comfort in visiting customer sites and vendor locations
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ownership mentality — “finish what you start”



  





**Why Join?** 




  




* Opportunity to build world\-class seating solutions across automotive, railway, marine, and defence sectors.
* Direct exposure to end\-to\-end development, not just one piece of the puzzle.
* Freedom to innovate and implement your ideas.

title: SENIOR PROJECT COORDINATOR
description:
**ABOUT US:**




  





 Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high\-volume manufacturing.
 



  





 As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end\-to\-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost\-effective, high\-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.
 



  





  





**JOB SUMMARY:**




  





 As a Senior Project Coordinator within our Project Management Office (PMO), you will act as the operational backbone for active satellite manufacturing and mission delivery cycles. Partnering directly with Project Managers and engineering leads, you will drive execution discipline, eliminate cross\-functional bottlenecks, and ensure mission milestones transition seamlessly from CAD models to cleanroom assembly and launch manifests.
 



  





 Your core operational mandate is predictability: maintaining airtight milestone tracking, accelerating internal procurement loops, and ensuring documentation meets rigorous aerospace standards. In this role, your success will be measured by on\-time milestone delivery rates (OTD), schedule variance reduction, and data accuracy across our PMO toolstack.
 



  





  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**




  




* **Drive Schedule \& Milestone Integrity:** 
 Partner with Project Managers to maintain comprehensive work\-breakdown structures (WBS), track critical\-path deliverables, and flag schedule variances before they impact integration timelines.
* **Streamline Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Serve as the day\-to\-day liaison between systems engineering, cleanroom manufacturing, quality assurance, procurement, and external launch partners.
* **Lead PMO Governance \& Meeting Cadence:** 
 Own sprint ceremonies, technical review agendas, and cross\-team standups; capture high\-signal minutes of meeting (MoM) and aggressively drive action\-item closure.
* **Maintain Technical Documentation \& Metrics:** 
 Centralize technical baseline documents, flight readiness paperwork, and engineering change requests (ECRs) while building real\-time status dashboards for executive review.
* **Proactive Risk \& Blocker Resolution:** 
 Surface manufacturing delays, component lead\-time anomalies, and integration risks early; run root\-cause follow\-ups to implement mitigation strategies.
* **Coordinate Technical Procurement \& Logistics:** 
 Expedite technical purchase requisitions (PR/PO workflows) for mission\-critical parts and coordinate precision logistics for aerospace\-grade hardware and testing campaigns.



  





  





**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR ?**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics, or similar) or Business Administration/Operations Management.
* 1–2 years of hands\-on project coordination or PMO experience in a fast\-paced, engineering\- or manufacturing\-driven environment.
* Working proficiency with industry\-standard project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Project, Asana, or ClickUp).
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with a track record of managing multiple competing deadlines without dropping operational details.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, comfortable interfacing with senior engineering specialists and external vendors.



  





  





**NICE\-TO\-HAVES:**




  




* Prior exposure to the Space, Aerospace, Defense, or Precision Hardware Manufacturing sectors.
* Foundational understanding of satellite subsystems, avionics, payload integration, or cleanroom manufacturing workflows.
* Familiarity with hardware product lifecycle stages (PDR, CDR, TRR, and flight integration).



  





  





**WHY JOIN US ?**




  




* **Front\-Row Seat to the NewSpace Revolution:** 
 Work on physical flight hardware destined for orbit from India’s first commercial satellite mass\-production hub.
* **Accelerated Career Trajectory:** 
 Receive hands\-on mentorship from veteran aerospace program managers, developing deep domain expertise across space mission lifecycles.
* **High\-Impact, Zero\-Red\-Tape Culture:** 
 Experience the speed of a high\-growth tech disruptor paired with the manufacturing infrastructure of an aerospace leader.
* **Collaborative Ecosystem:** 
 Join an ambitious, multidisciplinary team of space enthusiasts, engineers, and builders dedicated to making space accessible globally.

title: GDS Ecosystem Formations Lead Analyst - Supervising Associate
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title** 
 : GDS Ecosystem Formations Lead Analyst
   

  

**Job Span** 
 : Ecosystem and Alliances Program – All Alliances
   

  

**Function** 
 : GDS ES Growth \& Innovation
   

  

**Skill Level:** 
 High
   

  

**Sub Function** 
 : GDS Alliances Partner Program CoE
   

  

**Job Summary**
 EY’s Ecosystem Relationship Enablement (ERE) team leads the formation of new alliances and ecosystem relationships across geographies. The team works closely with Service Line leadership, Independence, Risk Management, Quality, GCO and other stakeholder groups to ensure that each relationship completes the required governance, review and approval steps.
   

  

 The GDS Ecosystem Formations Lead Analyst will provide end\-to\-end program management, operational and administrative support to the global ERE formation function. The role will help:
   

  

 Co\-develop and operationalize a scalable support delivery model for the ERE formation function, coordinating with relevant EY stakeholders throughout the relationship formation lifecycle.
   

  

 Strengthen the existing formation process by simplifying workflows and communications, enabling greater scale and creating a more seamless experience for business teams seeking to establish new relationships.
   

  

**Essential Functions Of The Job**
* Provide end\-to\-end program management support for the ecosystem formation process, coordinating across onshore and GDS teams within the Ecosystem Service Bureau and facilitating effective handoffs between teams.
* Guide EY business teams through the required process steps, documentation and approvals for forming a new ecosystem relationship.
* Conduct first\-level reviews of intake forms, business cases and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy and quality; work with requestors to address gaps and validate additional information.
* Develop and maintain practical checklists, guidance and frequently asked questions based on recurring issues and stakeholder needs.
* Perform research using EY systems and external sources to pre\-populate templates, validate information and support due\-diligence activities.
* Respond promptly to requests and queries from business teams, the ERE team and other stakeholders, providing clear guidance on process status, requirements and next steps.
* Schedule and participate in stakeholder meetings to track progress, clarify dependencies and confirm next steps for specific relationships.
* Capture concise meeting notes and clearly document action items, owners and target dates; follow up with responsible teams to support timely completion.
* Draft high\-quality emails and other communications for the ERE formation team, and consolidate relevant documentation for meetings, reviews and stakeholder communications.
* Maintain accurate and current records in the Ecosystem Relationship Management System (ERMS), the system of record, and prepare periodic status reports for relationships in formation.
* Maintain an organized documentation repository, archive records appropriately and improve information sharing across stakeholder groups.
* Drive adherence to quality\-control procedures by tracking required Risk Management activities and approvals in close collaboration with onshore and GDS stakeholders.
* Complete post\-formation activities, including drafting relationship summaries for Discover, updating distribution lists and documentation, and coordinating kickoff calls for newly established ecosystem relationships.
* Ensure that the ecosystem formation process and supporting documentation are reviewed, updated and refreshed regularly.
* Identify opportunities to educate global stakeholders, strengthen awareness and promote consistent adherence to the ecosystem formation process.
* Champion continuous improvement by identifying bottlenecks, recommending practical solutions and introducing more efficient ways of working.
* Drive simplification and automation across the ecosystem formation lifecycle, leveraging agentic AI and other digital capabilities to enable smarter, faster and more efficient ways of working while maintaining appropriate quality, risk and governance controls.


**Knowledge and Skill Guidance**
* Strong organizational, program and project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to distill complex issues, articulate risks and clearly communicate process requirements and expectations.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders across geographies, time zones and virtual teams.
* Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, including organizational structures, operating models and management information systems, is advantageous for internal candidates.
* For internal candidates, knowledge or understanding of EY’s risk\-management, Independence, Quality and approval processes; for external candidates, practical knowledge of risk, independence, compliance and governance mandates within a Big Four or comparable professional\-services firm.
* Strong research and due\-diligence capability, supported by rigorous attention to detail and a commitment to first\-time quality.
* Proven ability to identify and resolve issues independently, conduct root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable mitigation measures that prevent recurrence.
* Demonstrated capability in continuous process improvement, simplification and automation, including the ability to identify suitable use cases for agentic AI and other digital solutions that improve speed, quality, scalability and stakeholder experience.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and other common business productivity tools.


**Other Guidance**
**Academics \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Science, Commerce or a related discipline.
* Master of Business Administration or an equivalent postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* 9\+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in an individual\-contributor role involving engagement with senior onshore stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience in a strong program management environment; exposure to alliance or ecosystem relationship formation, governance or operations is preferred.


**Working Hours**
* The role requires regular overlap with US Eastern or Central time zones. The ability and willingness to work these hours is a mandatory requirement.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

To discuss patient complaints with respective ward staff to prevent the same in future. To escalate the complaint to reporting supervisor. To enter the data comments/suggestions of collected feedback forms in the feedback form analysis sheet. To provide up-to-date billing to IP patients/relatives and facilitate payments of any outstanding amount as per hospital policy. To coordinate with concerned departments (consultant, nursing, pharmacy etc.) for patient discharge. To provide the provisional final IP bill to the patients. title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**About Neo** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia** 
 — Co\-Founder of Zeta, Radix, and Titan —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native, work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the role** 




 Neo is seeking a Senior Technical Writer to join our Product Documentation team and take ownership of how Neo's products explain themselves \- through feature docs, user guides, knowledge base articles, FAQs, release notes, and any other technical writing we publish for the outside world.
 



 At Neo, documentation isn't a support function bolted onto the product \- it's a product surface in its own right, and a community asset that accelerates adoption by helping people learn and trust Neo. We run docs\-as\-code and docs\-as\-a\-product: writing lives in Git, ships through review like any other product change, and is held to a real quality bar, built in close partnership with Product and Engineering.
 



 You read specs closely enough to catch what they leave out, understand what a user actually needs to know, and write it clearly. You don't stop at drafting one page at a time, you build the systems behind it: the skill files and prompt templates that let AI tools generate consistent first drafts from PRDs and tickets, grounded in a tone and style you've codified so every draft, human or AI, sounds like Neo.
 



 This is a hands\-on, build\-the\-system individual contributor role that calls for a combination of strong editorial judgment and an automation mindset.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Write \& organize** 



* Read PRDs and engineering specs closely, and translate them into clear, concise documentation \- user guides, knowledge base articles \- organized with clean, findable information architecture



**Set the standard** 



* Define and maintain Neo's documentation style guide, voice, and tone; and hold every contributor to it
* Own end\-to\-end documentation quality (completeness, accuracy, consistency, tone) across every Neo product, and report on documentation health (coverage, freshness, usage) on an ongoing basis



**Partner \& advocate** 



* Flag issues with the underlying feature, not just the docs, when something won't serve users well or a spec lacks the detail needed for accurate documentation; partner closely with PMs and engineers to close those gaps and stay aligned with the release roadmap



**Build the system** 



* Set direction for Neo's AI\-powered documentation automation \- skill files, prompt templates, scripts \- deciding what to automate and how it should scale; maintain and evolve these systems as products and doc formats change



  





**Skills** 



* Technical fluency to read, question, and explain PRDs and API specifications directly with engineers and PMs, understand and document Neo's APIs and MCP tools, and ensure the accuracy of every customer\-facing doc that depends on them
* Strong written communication \- this is a writing\-first role requiring the editorial judgment to set the bar for others, plus experience defining or maintaining a style guide, voice/tone standard, or review process, and the instinct to know when something's ready to publish
* Strong project\-management instincts \- able to plan, prioritize, and carry a complex documentation project to an accurate, polished finish, with working knowledge of tools like Jira, Linear, or Notion
* Hands\-on experience with AI \- not just prompting in the moment, but building the reusable system behind it (skill files, prompt templates, context files) so AI can produce consistent, on\-brand first drafts without constant re\-prompting
* Systems\-thinking mindset \- with automation instincts, able to design processes that scale as the team and product surface grow



  





**Experience** 



* 5\+ years writing technical documentation, with a solid understanding of version control and experience managing documentation systems
* 1–2\+ years owning editorial standards or leading a documentation function for a team \- ideally at a B2B SaaS or product company
* Track record partnering with product and engineering teams to close documentation gaps and improve PRD quality
* Computer science/ background
* Nice to have: experience contributing to or maintaining an open source project
* Nice to have: a public writing track record on technical or documentation topics \- a blog, newsletter, or bylined guest posts
