title: Technical Writer – Hardware Interface Compliance & Certification
description:
**Job Requirements**
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are looking for a
 **Technical Writer specializing in Hardware Compliance and Certification** 
 to document, structure, and drive the formal certification deliverables for our silicon and platform interfaces. In this role, you will work at the intersection of Hardware Engineering, Silicon Validation, and external standards bodies (such as the MIPI Alliance) to produce clear, audit\-ready compliance documentation.
   

  

 You will be responsible for translating complex electrical, timing, and protocol validation data for
 **I2C, SPI, QSPI, and MIPI (C\-PHY/D\-PHY, CSI/DSI)** 
 into rigorous Compliance Test Plans, Conformance Statements, Certification Filing Packages, Application Notes, and Hardware Errata.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Certification \& Compliance Documentation:
+ Author, curate, and maintain formal compliance test reports, Implementation Conformance Statements (ICS), and Test Assertion Sheets for I2C, SPI, QSPI, and MIPI (C\-PHY, D\-PHY, CSI\-2, DSI\-2\) interfaces.
+ Prepare and package end\-to\-end technical documentation required for formal certification submissions, interoperability workshops (e.g., MIPI Plugfests), and third\-party audit labs.
+ Maintain up\-to\-date compliance matrixes mapping internal validation test results directly to official standards specifications (MIPI Alliance specs, NXP I2C specifications, JEDEC/vendor QSPI norms).

* Engineering Collaboration \& Data Synthesis:
+ Partner closely with Silicon Validation, Signal Integrity (SI), PHY Design, and Embedded Firmware engineers to extract raw test data, oscilloscope captures, and protocol traces.
+ Synthesize raw test outputs into structured, clear documentation (including pass/fail criteria, electrical margins, setup/hold limits, eye\-diagram analyses, and timing diagrams).
+ Document protocol edge cases, hardware errata, and register\-level workarounds for customer integration manuals and Silicon Errata sheets.

* Developer \& Customer Enablement Collateral:
+ Draft technical application notes, hardware integration guidelines, and pinout/routing compliance checklists for customer reference designs.
+ Create precise, high\-quality timing diagrams, state machine charts, and interface connection schematics using tools like Visio, Draw.io, or WaveDrom.

* Process \& Document Lifecycle Management:
+ Own the document review and release lifecycle via Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, ensuring all certification records meet traceability and version\-control requirements.
+ Track active specification changes within standards bodies (e.g., updates to MIPI CSI/DSI specs) and proactively identify required revisions in internal documentation.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 3–6\+ years of technical writing experience within the semiconductor, consumer electronics, or embedded hardware industries, with a focus on hardware compliance, silicon validation, or interface specifications.


**Domain \& Technical Knowledge**
* Interface Literacy: Strong conceptual and functional understanding of serial and high\-speed I/O interfaces:
+ I2C \& SPI/QSPI: Bus topology, clock stretching, rise/fall times, multi\-IO modes (Single/Dual/Quad/Octal SPI), timing constraints.
+ MIPI Standards: Familiarity with PHY architectures (D\-PHY, C\-PHY) and upper\-layer protocols (CSI\-2, DSI\-2\), including High\-Speed (HS) vs. Low\-Power (LP) transitions and lane configuration guidelines.

* Interpretation of Hardware Data: Ability to read and accurately interpret:
+ Scope captures (eye diagrams, jitter metrics, rise/fall profiles).
+ Timing diagrams, bus state machines, and register bitfield maps.
+ Official industry conformance documents and test suites.

* Tooling Mastery:
+ Standard authoring platforms: Markdown, AsciiDoc, DITA/XML, MadCap Flare, FrameMaker, or Confluence.
+ Version control systems: Git, Perforce, or SVN.
+ Timing/diagramming tools: WaveDrom, timing diagram editors, Visio, or Illustrator.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience writing formal certification filings or conformance test plans for standards consortiums (MIPI Alliance, USB\-IF, PCI\-SIG, or VESA).
* Basic understanding of automated test logs (e.g., Python test runner logs, SCPI/VISA test report outputs).


 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.

title: Automotive Functional Safety Staff Engineer - Digital DesignWare IP
description:
**Job Title**
* Automotive Functional Safety Staff Engineer \- Digital DesignWare IP


**We Are**
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

**You Are**
 You have spent years in the automotive safety world and you know that a well\-written safety case is not just paperwork, it is the difference between a chip that ships and one that sits in legal review for six months. You understand ISO 26262 not as a checklist but as a framework for making defensible engineering decisions under uncertainty.
   

  

 You are comfortable translating a vague customer requirement into a Technical Safety Concept that actually works, and you can explain to a hardware team why their design choice affects ASIL classification without making it feel like a lecture. You do not wait for complete specs to start safety planning. You work with what you have, ask the right questions, and build a safety argument that holds up under scrutiny. At Synopsys, you will work on automotive IP that powers the next generation of vehicles, and the safety work you do will matter.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain ISO 26262 work products including Technical Safety Concept, FMEDA, FTA, DFMEA, DFA, Safety Plan, and Safety Case for Digital DesignWare IP
* Collaborate with IP development teams and automotive customers to align functional safety deliverables with project timelines and ASIL requirements
* Evaluate customer quality, functional safety, and reliability requirements, translating them into actionable engineering guidance
* Design and implement automation scripts to streamline safety analysis workflows, including FMEDA and fault injection reporting
* Lead quality and functional safety reviews, generating detailed reports with findings and recommendations for design improvements


**The Impact You Will Have**
* Ensure Synopsys Automotive IP meets ISO 26262 compliance and achieves ASIL B, C, and D certification for safety\-critical automotive applications
* Accelerate customer time to market by delivering complete, audit\-ready safety documentation that reduces integration risk
* Drive measurable improvements in safety process efficiency through automation, reducing manual analysis time across IP families
* Support development of differentiated automotive IP solutions that meet stringent safety demands of ADAS, autonomous driving, and electrification platforms
* Elevate Synopsys' reputation as a trusted partner in automotive safety, strengthening customer confidence and market share


**What You'll Need**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with 8\+ years of relevant experience, or Master's degree with 5\+ years
* Formal training and hands\-on expertise in ISO 26262 functional safety standards, including direct experience developing safety work products for ASIL B, C, or D applications
* Demonstrated experience with semiconductor development flows and digital design at the IP or SoC level
* Proficiency in English for technical writing and cross\-functional collaboration with global teams
* Proven track record qualifying embedded hardware or hardware/software systems to ISO 26262 ASIL levels, including ASIL D
* Experience with ISO 26262 Part 5, hardware description languages like Verilog or VHDL, AEC Q100, or scripting languages such as Python is a plus


**Who You Are**
* You can take a 200\-page customer safety requirement document and pull out the three things that actually affect your IP architecture, then explain them to a design lead in a 10\-minute conversation
* Organized and detail\-oriented, you manage multiple safety deliverables across product lines without losing track of dependencies or deadlines
* You push back constructively when a safety plan is missing critical information or a design decision creates an unmitigated safety risk
* Comfortable working across time zones, you build trust with customers and colleagues through clear communication and follow\-through


**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
 You will join a high\-performing, globally distributed IP team that is at the forefront of automotive safety and reliability innovation. The team collaborates closely with product development, quality assurance, and customer engineering groups to deliver world\-class automotive IP solutions. Together, you will champion functional safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and support customers in deploying safe, reliable automotive products.
   

  

**Rewards And Benefits**
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Senior Associate Technology Risk Prompt Engineer
description:
**About Us**
**Standard**
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Prompt Engineering in our Risk, Group Technology team, you will operate as a hands\-on partner to Senior Managers, Risk Managers, and fellow Associates to deliver decision\-useful monitoring and automation across material Technology and Information Security (Cyber) risk themes.
   

  

 You’ll combine hands\-on data analysis and evidence collation with governed automation and AI\-assisted drafting to improve timeliness, consistency and quality of insights.
   

  

 You’ll build, test and maintain prompt and retrieval patterns, co\-pilot agents and workflow automations using approved tooling (where authorised), while learning and applying required data governance, access controls, privacy and information security and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, logging, version control and audit\-ready artefacts (prompt versions, test evidence and runbooks) to support reviews, thematic work, and other Line 2 oversight and analysis tasks.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location: Bengaluru
   

  

 Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**
**What will your day look like?**
 As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Prompt Engineering, you will:
   

  

* Supporting delivery of the insights plan by translating priority insight routines into a practical delivery backlog of automation and agent use\-cases (as agreed with the Senior Manager, Technology Risk Insights)
* Working with Risk Officers and SMEs to capture repeatable workflows (report refreshes, evidence collation, control attestations,issues tracking) and translating them into clear automation/agent requirements with agreed acceptance criteria
* Building and maintaining insight assets (datasets, definitions, lineage notes, dashboards and briefing packs) that provide timely,trusted insight on control effectiveness, resilience outcomes, risk\-in\-change and remediation progress
* Building and maintaining workflow automations (data extraction, transformation, scheduling, approvals and notifications) to improve timeliness, reduce manual effort and increase consistency of risk reporting and insight delivery
* Supporting integration with existing platforms (reporting datasets, SharePoint/Teams and risk tooling) and contributing to userguidance and adoption (how\-to guides, training snippets, support triage and continuous improvement)
* Coordinating with Technology, Cyber, Risk, Data and Internal Audit stakeholders on analytics, automation and agent use\-cases,definitions, thresholds and evidence expectations to improve consistency and reduce duplication
* Continuously improving templates, automations and agent behaviours to increase consistency, timeliness and decisionusefulness;documenting lessons learned and maintaining a clear change log of updates
* Supporting uplift tracking (e.g., PACT\-aligned measures) by automating evidence collation and improving repeatability of reporting outputs
* Operating as a hands\-on specialist, demonstrating strong documentation and quality discipline so automations and agents are safe, repeatable and supportable


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* Experience in automation, engineering delivery, analytics engineering, risk analytics or a similar role, with evidence of delivering workflow solutions used by business teams
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering and building AI\-assisted workflows/agents using approved tooling (e.g., Microsoft Copilot ecosystem) including evaluation, guardrails and iteration based on user feedback
* Strong data skills: ability to work with structured and semi\-structured data, define data quality checks and build reliable refresh pipelines for recurring reporting (e.g., SQL and data wrangling)
* Experience with workflow automation and integration tooling (e.g., Power Automate), scripting (Python preferred) and/or APIs, plus strong documentation and runbook discipline
* Experience delivering solutions for Technology Risk, Cyber Risk, Operational Risk or governance/reporting teams within Financial Services
* Working understanding of risk and control concepts (e.g., technology/cyber risk, operational risk, issues/incidents, control testing) and the ability to translate policy/standards into practical checks within an agent or workflow
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills: ability to capture pain points, prototype solutions and deliver fit\-for\-purpose outcomes; comfortable taking guidance and escalating risks and blockers early
* Tertiary qualifications in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems), or equivalent practical experience.


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**So why join us?**
 ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
   

  

 We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
   

  

 We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
   

  

 To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 124055

title: Technical Account Manager -MendixRapidMiner (MXRM), India
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
   

  

 This role is
 **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** 
 with responsibilities as single post\-sale technical owner of adoption and scale across the customer's footprint in the four products of the specialized GTM for Software, Data and AI — the ICX trio (Mendix, Graph Studio, AI Cloud) and SLC. The mission is to convert sold software into realized technical value and grow that footprint, account by account, holding only a basic understanding of the wider Siemens portfolio — enough to spot and route adjacent opportunities.
   

  

 Advisor\-first: guide adoption, drive the customer's software, data and AI teams to self\-sufficiency, and own the architectural view of how these products fit their landscape. Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders — CIO/CTO, enterprise architects and key business stakeholders — as the account's strategic technical advisor. Ring\-fenced from owning commercial, support and delivery — contribute deep technical input on architecture and implementation, never the process.
   

  

 Every TAM is a technical practitioner — hands\-on capable and credible in the products and the customer's architecture, able to prototype and prove things in the tooling. How much a TAM builds themselves, versus pulls Specialists in for the heavy build, varies with their product depth and the account. Every TAM is also well trained in the use of generative AI in day\-to\-day work, applying it to work faster and raise the quality of their output.
   

  

 A gated resource on designated accounts only (strategic designation, expansion potential or technical complexity — not ARR), spanning the industrial and non\-industrial customer base; intensity scales with the stakes of the account. The TAM is the field's channel into the Product organization — the natural bridge to the Field CTO — carrying structured voice\-of\-customer upstream into the roadmap and roadmap context back. Primary technical contact for the account; never the commercial or retention contact.
   

  

* Essential Functions
* Technical Account Strategy \& Planning
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders — CIO/CTO, enterprise architects and key business stakeholders — as the account's strategic technical advisor.
* Run joint technical account planning with the AE, Partner AE and Partner Manager; align adoption and footprint\-growth priorities.
* Maintain a current view of the customer's software architecture and landscape; advise how the four products integrate, partnering with customer\-side and Siemens architects.
* Translate the sold solution into a technical adoption roadmap aligned to the customer's software, data and AI strategy.
* Responsible for capturing the above in a Customer Adoption Plan, and drive progress, collaboration and alignment based on that.
* Adoption \& Technical Execution
* Run the technical kickoff with the customer's software, data and AI teams; turn the sold solution into an adoption plan and hand\-shake with Expert Services on implementation.
* Drive adoption enablement (workshops, office hours) toward customer self\-sufficiency; run a recurring technical account\-review cadence, tracking adoption health and surfacing risks early.
* Get hands\-on to prototype use\-cases and lightly integrate to unblock rollouts — how much depends on your product depth and the account; pull Specialists in for heavy build.
* Collaborate with Expert Services (Siemens or partner), who own implementation — align on adoption and surface needs, never own delivery.
* Footprint Growth \& Bid Support
* Surface and shape new technical use\-cases; design for the next workload and scale.
* Spot opportunities across the four products and wider Siemens portfolio; route them to the account team and hand qualified commercial signal to the AE.
* Contribute deep technical input on architecture and implementation to bids and RFx (typically expansion on covered accounts); the sales/bid team owns the process.
* Internal Operations \& Orchestration
* Track adoption health and technical pipeline for covered accounts; contribute to account planning and internal reviews.
* Orchestrate across AE / Partner AE / Partner Manager / Specialists / Expert Services; triage when to pull Specialists.
* Use and promote internal tools to capture and reuse materials.
* Knowledge Sharing \& Mentoring
* Build an internal knowledge network and share adoption best practices.
* Contribute to adoption playbooks, reference architectures and supporting tools.
* Coach and mentor other TAMs and team members.
* Field Signal \& Product Feedback
* As the field's channel into Product, capture structured field signal from live adoption and feed it to the Field CTO; carry roadmap context back to the customer.
* Represent the customer's technical needs and adoption blockers internally; escalate and advocate.
* General \- Uphold Siemens' integrity, culture, values and compliance (health, safety, quality); complete required administration including timely expenses; undertake other reasonable duties as required.
* Outcomes \& Measures \- What a successful TAM delivers, per function area — outcomes, not activity.


 Function area: Technical Account Strategy \& Planning
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): A current, shared technical account plan and architecture view the account team acts on
   

  

 Function area: Adoption \& Technical Execution
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Sold software reaches productive use; the customer's teams become self\-sufficient
   

  

 Function area: Footprint Growth \& Bid Support
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): New technical use\-cases surfaced and qualified; expansion is technically de\-risked
   

  

 Function area: Internal Operations \& Orchestration
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Account team, Specialists and Expert Services orchestrated without gaps or duplication
   

  

 Function area: Knowledge Sharing \& Mentoring
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Adoption know\-how compounds across the team rather than living in one head
   

  

 Function area: Field Signal \& Product Feedback
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Structured field signal reliably reaches Product; customers see themselves in the roadmap
   

  

**Role Interfaces**
 The TAM is the technical hub of the post\-sale account team. It hands qualified expansion signal, adoption status and technical input to the Account Executive (who owns the commercial deal, negotiation and quota) and takes back commercial strategy and account priorities. It aligns adoption with Expert Services (Siemens or partner), who own implementation and delivery — never the TAM. It triages and pulls Specialists for deep engineering and heavy build, feeds adoption\-health signal to Renewal Specialists (who own renewals and retention), and partners with Partner AE / Partner Managers on joint planning without managing the partner commercial relationship. It advises customer\-side architects on how the four products integrate into their landscape without owning their architecture decisions, and is the standing bridge to the Field CTO, carrying field signal upstream and roadmap context back. The wider customer\-success apparatus — QBRs, CSAT/NPS, success plans, upsell targets, renewals — sits with the AE, Renewal Specialists (and a CSM where engaged), never the TAM.
   

  

**We welcome applicants who meet the following criteria:**
* Product \& technical depth
* Deep expertise in the adoption and account discipline
* Adoption breadth across all four products
* Hands\-on technical capability — practitioner\-level depth; able to prototype, demo and work in the products (required of every TAM; how much you build yourself varies by product depth and account)
* Software, data \& AI delivery practices
* Wider Siemens portfolio awareness
* Account \& consultative
* Technical account planning
* Architectural advisory \& landscape mapping
* Senior stakeholder relationship management (CIO/CTO, enterprise architects, business stakeholders)
* Customer enablement \& facilitation
* Footprint growth / use\-case shaping
* Technical input to bids \& RFx
* Ways of working
* Orchestration \& cross\-team collaboration
* Voice\-of\-customer / structured feedback capture
* Communication \& storytelling
* Coaching \& mentoring
* Growth mindset \& self\-development
* Skilled, day\-to\-day use of generative AI to work faster and improve quality
* More hands\-on (deployment\-leaning) TAMs — additional
* Deeper retained expertise in one product
* Build and integrate more directly — spend more time hands\-on and pull Specialists in less


**Education \& Experience**
* A relevant university degree (computer science, software engineering, data/AI or related) or equivalent practical experience.
* A track record in post\-sale technical roles — solution/adoption consulting, technical account management, solution architecture or forward\-deployed engineering — with hands\-on familiarity with modern software, data and AI delivery.
* Depth in one or more of the four products is valued; breadth across them is built on the job. Genuine hands\-on technical capability is required of every TAM — credible practitioners who can get into the detail, not relationship managers; the amount of build work expected varies by product depth and account. Level\-specific requirements (years, depth, scope) are deferred to the future levelling pass.


**Working Conditions**
* Normal office or home\-office environment, with travel to customer sites as the account requires.
* Must be willing and available to work the core hours required for the role and its account coverage.


**We are Siemens**
 A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! We offer a comprehensive reward package which includes a competitive basic salary, bonus scheme, generous holiday allowance, pension, and private healthcare.
   

  

 Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us
   

  

**Please note that, due to the current integration framework, this opportunity is currently available exclusively to employees of Altair and DISW. While there is a possibility that the position may be made available to all Siemens employees through a future external posting, this is not guaranteed. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation during this transitional period. This communication does not constitute a promise or guarantee of future employment opportunities beyond the current scope.**

title: Integration Engineer (SDK)
description:
**About Bureau** 




  





 Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision\-making engine, powered by a 1 billion\+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
 



  





 Bureau has raised $50M\+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
 



  





**Why Bureau?** 




  





 Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
 



  





 We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
 



  





**About the Role \- Integration Engineer** 




  





 Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges? Join our team as an SDK Integration Engineer and be at the forefront of our clients' success. In this role, you will serve as the technical bridge between our SDK products and our clients, guiding external development teams through seamless Web and Mobile SDK integrations. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including Core Engineering, Product, Sales, and Solutions—to ensure a frictionless customer experience.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing** 



* **Integration Support:** 
 Lead the resolution of SDK integration queries, acting as the primary technical contact and subject matter expert for customers.
* **Customer Experience:** 
 Elevate Customer satisfaction through proactive onboarding support, architectural guidance, and quick resolution of integration blockers.
* **Code\-Level Troubleshooting:** 
 Diagnose complex implementation issues by debugging client code, analyzing network requests, and reviewing SDK behavior across Web and Mobile platforms.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with SDK Engineering and Product teams to channel feedback, report bugs, and advocate for SDK usability and performance improvements.
* **Technical Consulting:** 
 Partner with pre\-sales and onboarding teams to provide technical demonstrations, feasibility assessments, and best practices for integrating our SDKs into diverse technology stacks.
* **Documentation \& Resources:** 
 Create, maintain, and enhance comprehensive SDK documentation, integration guides, code snippets, and fully functional sample applications (via GitHub) to streamline client onboarding.
* **Integration Tooling \& Automation:** 
 Build and maintain internal tools, scripts, and automated workflows to validate client implementations, scale support operations, and reduce time\-to\-resolution.
* **Proactive Analytics \& Optimization:** 
 Utilize advanced analytics and monitoring tools to proactively detect emerging platform issues, identify systemic integration trends, and optimize our self\-service developer portals.
* **Project Management:** 
 Contribute to strategic technical projects that enhance the overall customer journey and add value to the organization's API/SDK ecosystem.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* **Experience:** 
 2–6 years in SDK Integration, Developer Support, Solutions Engineering, or Mobile/Web Development, preferably in a B2B SaaS.
* **Web \& Mobile Proficiency:** 
 Deep understanding of Web technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML/CSS) and Mobile ecosystems (native iOS/Swift/Objective\-C, native Android/Kotlin/Java, or cross\-platform frameworks like React Native/Flutter).
* **Advanced Debugging Skills:** 
 Expertise in using developer tools (Chrome DevTools, Xcode, Android Studio), network proxies, and API testing platforms (Postman, cURL) to troubleshoot complex integrations.
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to developer audiences as well as non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Scripting \& Automation:** 
 Strong programming foundation with the ability to use languages like Python, Node.js, or Shell to build automation workflows, integration scripts, and sample applications.
* **Infrastructure \& Monitoring:** 
 Experience working with REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring/observability tools (e.g., Grafana, New Relic, Datadog, AWS).
* **Developer Focus:** 
 A developer\-first mindset paired with strong problem\-solving skills and a passion for creating world\-class technical documentation.
* **Tools:** 
 Hands\-on experience with issue tracking, version control, and support tools (e.g., Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Zendesk, FreshDesk).
* **Flexibility \& Empathy:** 
 Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, working flexible hours when necessary, and handling technical escalations with a mix of empathy and confidence.



  





 If you’re ready to make a significant impact and grow in a challenging yet rewarding environment, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





**Our Culture** 




  




* We hire self\-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most



  





**Compensation** 




  




* Competitive salary \+ potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

title: Applied Value Engineer - EAM-EMEA
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**The Role:**
* As an Applied Value Engineer(EAM) you are pushing the envelope in solving business\-critical problems for our customers. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.


**The work you’ll do:**

title: Product Expert – Safety & Medical
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Product Expert – Safety \& Medical** 
 is accountable for all aspects of the Safety and Medical technology ecosystem, including business and technical analysis, backlog management, agile delivery, operational performance, enhancements, replacements, and future capability roadmaps.
   

  

 The Product Expert partners closely with Safety, Medical Affairs, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and Digital \& Technology teams to deliver and continuously improve technology solutions that support pharmacovigilance, adverse event management, signal detection, risk management, medical information, scientific engagement, evidence generation, and regulatory compliance.
   

  

 In addition, the Product Expert is responsible for all business\-as\-usual (BAU) activities within the Safety and Medical landscape, ensuring reliable, compliant, and uninterrupted operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Strategy \& Enablement**
* Develop and maintain the technology vision and roadmap for Safety and Medical capabilities aligned to Haleon's R\&D and Consumer Health strategy.
* Partner with Safety, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Clinical, and Innovation PPM teams to identify digital opportunities that improve operational efficiency, compliance, and scientific decision\-making.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, AI\-enabled solutions, automation opportunities, and advanced analytics capabilities within the Safety and Medical domains.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.


**Demand Management**
* Collaborate with senior business stakeholders to manage and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, compliance requirements, patient safety considerations, and strategic objectives.
* Balance investments across innovation, operational excellence, compliance, and technical debt reduction.


**Product Delivery \& Continuous Improvement**
* Lead delivery, enhancement, and lifecycle management of Safety and Medical technology platforms.
* Develop and maintain product roadmaps in partnership with Product Managers and business stakeholders.
* Ensure successful execution of projects, releases, and enhancements using Agile methodologies.
* Drive automation and process optimization opportunities across Safety and Medical functions.


**Safety, Quality \& Compliance**
* Ensure all technology solutions supporting Pharmacovigilance and Medical Affairs comply with applicable regulations, quality standards, and internal governance requirements.
* Support GxP validation, audit readiness, inspection preparedness, data integrity, and computer system validation activities.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, controls, and risk management processes are maintained.


**Service Management**
* Own operational performance and service management processes for Safety and Medical applications.
* Manage vendor relationships, support escalations, issue resolution, platform upgrades, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics are consistently achieved.


**Data, Analytics \& Insights**
* Enable reporting and analytics capabilities that provide insights into adverse event trends, safety signals, medical inquiries, scientific engagement, and operational performance.
* Partner with Data \& Analytics teams to deliver dashboards, metrics, and AI\-enabled insights.
* Ensure effective data governance and data quality standards across Safety and Medical platforms.


**Change Management \& Adoption**
* Drive adoption of new capabilities through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and change management activities.
* Champion agile ways of working and continuous improvement across cross\-functional teams.
* Build stakeholder confidence by demonstrating measurable business value and operational outcomes.


**Essential**
**Qualifications \& Skills**
* 8 \- 14 years of experience in relevant field.
* Expert knowledge of Pharmacovigilance, Drug/Product Safety, Medical Affairs, and Medical Information processes.
* Experience with one or more industry\-leading Safety and Medical platforms such as:
* Veeva Safety
* ArisGlobal LifeSphere
* Oracle Argus Safety
* MedDRA
* Medical Information platforms
* Medical Content Management systems
* Signal Detection and Risk Management solutions
* Strong understanding of:
* Pharmacovigilance regulations
* GxP compliance
* Computer System Validation (CSV)
* Data Integrity principles
* Global Health Authority requirements
* Experience managing SaaS and enterprise technology products.
* Experience working within Agile product delivery methodologies.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Safety, Medical, Clinical, Regulatory, and Quality functions.


**Preferred**
* Experience supporting AI and automation initiatives within Safety or Medical Affairs.
* Familiarity with:
* Safety signal detection and management
* Risk Management Plans (RMPs)
* Aggregate reporting processes
* Medical Insights generation
* Scientific content management
* Experience with Power BI, Azure, Snowflake, or advanced analytics platforms.
* Experience managing global vendors and strategic technology partners.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-09\-26
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

title: Technical Content Writer – STEM & Robotics
description:
**About the Role** 




 You’ll work at the intersection of
 **technology, education and product development** 
 .
 



  





 Your role is to understand how technology works and turn that understanding into learning experiences that students can explore, build and learn from.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who is curious, comfortable learning new topics and able to explain technical concepts in a simple and structured way.
 



  





 You do not need to come in knowing everything. What matters more is your ability to
 **research, understand a topic properly and think about how it can be taught better.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Research deeply** 
 into robotics, electronics, drones, programming and other STEM technologies before creating content around them.
* Work with
 **technical documentation, books, engineering resources and real\-world applications** 
 to build a strong understanding of each concept.
* **Design complete learning journeys** 
 by deciding what students should learn, in what order and how each concept should connect to the next.
* Create
 **hands\-on projects, experiments and activities** 
 that help students learn by building and doing.
* Develop student learning resources such as
 **lesson plans, worksheets, activity guides, experiments, assessments and instructional content.**



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Good research ability
* Interest in technology, STEM and education
* Ability to understand technical concepts and explain them clearly
* Curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar topics
* Logical thinking and attention to detail
* Ability to think of different ways to explain or teach a concept
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of your work



  





**Good to Have** 



* Background in Engineering, Science, Education, English or a related field
* Basic knowledge of robotics, electronics or programming
* Exposure to technical writing, educational content or curriculum development
* Experience with project\-based or hands\-on learning



  





**Who Should Apply?** 




**Freshers are strongly encouraged to apply.** 




  





 We are looking for someone who enjoys researching unfamiliar topics, understanding how things work and finding simple ways to explain them.
 



  





 Previous experience in robotics or curriculum development is not mandatory. What matters more is your ability to
 **learn independently, ask good questions and turn what you learn into clear, practical content.** 




  





**Application Process** 




 If shortlisted, you will be given a short activity to help us understand how you research, think and explain a technical concept.
 



  





**We are not looking for textbook answers.** 
 We want to understand your approach to learning and problem\-solving.

description:

 Are you a seasoned structural engineer with deep expertise in Tekla Structures who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and guiding clients toward operational success? Trimble is seeking an Onboarding and Implementation Specialist to join our Professional Services team in India. **About Us**
 Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose\-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
   

  

**Our Division:** 
 Trimble's Professional Services team provides the strategic framework, technical onboarding, and implementation rigor that enable engineering and detailing firms to maximize ROI from their software investments across the structural lifecycle.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 Reporting directly to the Manager of Professional Services, Training \& Onboarding (India), you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for net\-new and existing Tekla Structures accounts across India. You will have full ownership over discovery meetings, workflow customization, and client success roadmaps. Working at the intersection of sales, customer support, and global product development, you will play a central role in conveying real\-world customer feedback directly back to core engineering teams to influence future software capabilities.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* End\-to\-End Onboarding Execution: Lead full\-lifecycle software onboarding and implementation programs for new and existing clients utilizing Tekla Structures (Steel and Concrete configurations).
* Workflow Discovery \& Problem Solving: Conduct deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to analyze client requirements, troubleshoot output customization challenges, and engineer tailored structural detailing workflows.
* Implementation Collateral \& Best Practices: Develop high\-grade onboarding materials, system configurations, and best\-practice guidelines that empower clients to adopt optimal structural detailing standards.
* Project Delivery \& Client Tracking: Help clients establish realistic deployment milestones, deliver ongoing technical guidance to protect timelines, and meticulously track project deliverables and engagement logs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Value Advocacy: Serve as the primary onboarding anchor across Sales, Support, and Product Development teams, while actively presenting the value of Professional Services to prospective clients.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Tekla Structures Deep\-Dive Expertise: 4–5 years of direct, hands\-on experience using Tekla Structures across Steel and Concrete modules.
* Domain \& Industry Experience: 6–7 years of hands\-on structural detailing and design experience with strong domain mastery in structural steel and reinforced concrete workflows.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Communication \& Engagement: Fluent written and spoken English with exceptional interpersonal skills to command credibility across client C\-suites and job\-site engineering teams.
* Independent Execution: Strong diagnostic capability to troubleshoot software issues independently, manage tight schedules, and drive project success with minimal supervision.


**Bonus Points For**
* Multilingual Capability: Fluency in spoken Hindi to engage effectively across diverse regional client bases in India.
* Global Design Codes: Direct experience executing structural detailing projects according to international engineering codes and standards.
* Customer\-Centric Mindset: Highly organized, detail\-oriented approach with an eagerness to learn complementary Trimble software products.


**Logistics**
* Location: Chennai.
* Job Type: Full\-Time.


 Why You'll Love Working With Us
   

  

 At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
   

  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.


****How to Apply:****
 Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.
   

  

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
 At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: Content Creator — Learning & Development
description:
**Role Summary** 




 You will build everything the trainers teach. That means the material for the 5 trainer\-led hours, the case packs managers use for the 2 practice hours, the self\-paced module on the LMS, and the tests we run before and after. The one thing only you can do: you decide how it gets taught. That is the value of this seat. The trainer tells you what the problem is and what the training must cover. You decide the rest — which real situation to use, which practice activity, which example, how the test is built. A vague need comes in from the trainer. Something that actually teaches goes out. This is not typing up someone's notes. When the 30\-day check says the work did not change, you rewrite it. Our content has to work at four levels — the common NIAT standard, the role track, the campus\-specific piece, and the single module given to one person for their own gap. Everything is taught remotely, so the material has to hold attention over video and also make sense on its own when nobody is teaching it. The hard part is how we judge this work. Content here is not judged on whether the deck looked good. It is judged on whether people worked differently afterwards, checked on a real sampled case.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Start from the trainer's brief — The trainer hands you the problem, the topic and what a person must be able to do at the end. That is your starting point every time. If the brief is thin, go back and ask. Do not guess.
 



 ● Decide how it will be taught — This is your call. Pick the real situation the session is built around. Pick the practice activity. Pick the example. Decide what people do in the room, not just what they hear. Sit in classes, listen to recorded calls and read tickets yourself so the examples are real ones.
 



 ● Build the trainer\-led material — Write the content for the 5 trainer\-led hours, made for remote teaching, in a form a trainer can pick up and run.
 



 ● Build the manager practice packs — Write the 2\-hour practice packs that a line manager, not a trainer, has to run with their own team. These have to work in the hands of someone who has never trained anyone.
 



 ● Build the self\-paced module — Every taught module also exists as recorded content. This is what lets the self\-paced hour run for \~900 people without adding trainers.
 



 ● Load the content into the platform yourself — You made it, so you put it in. Keep it tidy and keep the versions straight. Pulling reports back out is the Coordinator's job, not yours. TO CONFIRM: LMS — repurpose the existing learner product, or use something light like Notion. Not yet decided, no request raised. Build the content so it can move to either one without being rewritten from scratch.
 



 ● Write the tests, before and after — Build the check we run before training to size the gap, and the check we run after training to see whether the person can now do the work. The after check tests ability, not attendance. Build it at the same time as the module, not weeks later. There is no baseline today, so building one we can defend is the first piece of work.
 



 ● Set the rule for the individual module — Decide which module a person gets when a test shows a particular gap, so nobody has to sort this by hand.
 



 ● Make a campus version — Produce the campus\-level version of the material, because one common programme will not work across 40 campuses.
 



 ● Fix the content when the follow\-up says it did not work — When the 30\-day check shows the work did not change, that is a content problem as much as a training one. Find the weak part, rewrite it, and put the new version into the next cycle.
 



 ● Rebuild from what comes back — Take what trainers and managers report and fix the weak parts every cycle. Go and ask the most junior person in the system directly, instead of waiting for feedback to climb three levels.
 



 ● Use AI where it helps — Use AI for first drafts, question banks and pulling themes out of recordings. The call on what to teach stays with a person. We are not making this content AI\-first.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 ● Has written training or teaching material that somebody else taught from, and can show the pack that person was handed.
 



 ● Has built material for a non\-trainer to run — a teacher's guide, a manager's discussion pack — and can say what they changed to make it work in those hands.
 



 ● Has built tests, seen the results come back, and rewritten the test because of what the results showed.
 



 ● Has put content on an LMS or a learning platform and can say what made people finish it or drop it.
 



 ● Has built content by watching the actual work — sitting in a class, listening to calls, reading tickets — not from a written brief alone.
 



 ● Has made the same content in several versions for different groups, and can explain what changed between them.
 



 ● Has worked to a fixed monthly calendar where the content had to be finished before the session, not during it.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 ● Has made video or recorded content.
 



 ● Knows Telugu or Hindi in addition to English.
 



  





**Growth Path** 




 Next designation: Senior Content Creator (Level 2\). You earn it when other people teach from your material and it works in their hands, and the 30\-day check holds for three cycles in a row.
 



 Compensation

title: Trainer- HTML , CSS , Javascript
description:
**Company Description** 
 Naresh i Technologies (NareshIT) is a leading software training institute specializing in software training, project guidance, IT consulting, and technology workshops for individuals and corporate clients. With comprehensive classroom and eLearning platforms, including detailed content and HD video tutorials, the institute focuses on delivering flexible, high\-quality learning experiences. NareshIT supports learners with free placement services through weekly campus drives, job\-guarantee programs, internships, and real\-time project exposure on advanced technologies. Serving global companies across banking, financial services, insurance, telecommunications, technology, media, and education, NareshIT designs and mentors talent to create competitive advantage. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Ameerpet, Hyderabad, the organization operates offices and training institutes in Hyderabad and Chennai.
   

**Role Description** 
 The MERN Stack Trainer will deliver structured, hands\-on training on MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js to students at the Hyderabad campus in an on\-site, part\-time capacity. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include preparing lesson plans, creating practical examples and assignments, conducting interactive classroom sessions, and guiding learners through coding exercises and project work. The trainer will clarify concepts, answer technical questions, evaluate student performance, and provide feedback to help learners build strong MERN stack foundations. The role also involves updating course content to align with current industry practices, participating in technology workshops, and coordinating with the academic team to support placement\-focused training.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong MERN stack development skills, including proficiency in MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js.
* Candidates should possess solid front\-end web development skills, such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design practices.
* Candidates should possess back\-end and API development skills, including RESTful services, authentication/authorization, and integration with databases.
* Candidates should possess practical experience with version control (Git), build tools, and debugging and testing of web applications.
* Candidates should possess effective teaching, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics in a clear, structured manner.
* Candidates should possess strong classroom management and mentoring abilities to guide diverse groups of learners and support project\-based learning.
* Relevant industry experience as a full\-stack or MERN stack developer and prior training or teaching experience are highly beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, is preferred.

title: Manager QPPV Office
description:
**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Ensure the end\-to\-end maintenance, development and submission of the UK PSMF/sPSMF and support that of the EU PSMF.
* Support the development, management and implementation of deviations and associated CAPAs across the Patient Safety organization
* Support inspection and audit operations, including CAPA development, tracking and management
* Support the development, implementation and dissemination of PS procedures
* Support QPPV in meeting legislative requirements as per relevant legislation
* Any other activities to support the QPPV office as assigned


**Person Specific / Special Tasks**
* Ensure the end\-to\-end maintenance of the UK PSMF working with the appropriate local and global stakeholders for the Core and Annex documents. This includes lead authoring and update of the UK PSMF, and Pharmacovigilance System Summary (sPSMF) for the pharmacovigilance system of Sandoz. This includes the management of cross\-functional contributors of the Sandoz PSMF and independent identification of changes to the global PV system which require an update particularly to the UK PSMF in close collaboration with Operations Manager, QPPV Office.
* Work closely with Operations Manager, QPPV Office to ensure accurate representation of the Sandoz PV system in line with regulatory requirements and incorporate identified changes into the PSMF in a timely manner.
* Track timely provision of information from stakeholders for UK/EU PSMF production, escalating issues to the Operations Manager, QPPV Office. Format and publish final PSMF, ensuring consistency.
* Support Operations Manager, QPPV Office in provision of documents required by CPSRs to create local PSMFs / Pharmacovigilance Subsystem Files (PSSFs) as required. Support Operations Manager, QPPV Office in tracking of submission of PSMF documents as required.
* Ensure UK and EU PSMF are inspection\-ready and be the key point of contact in audits and inspections for the UK PSMF and support for EU PSMF.
* Support the QSO in ensuring processes and procedures are developed on time and efficiently supporting streamlining of PV processes.
* Support Head of Audits and Inspections from preparation to CAPA implementation.
* Review process based on experience, feedback and requirements, lead continuous process improvement.


**Essential Requirements**
 What you’ll bring to the role:
   

  

* Eight years experience in pharmacovigilance preferably gained in a European environment within Drug Safety Department, Drug Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Development or Quality Assurance
* Good knowledge of European regulatory requirements preferentially relating to pharmacovigilance
* Pharmacovigilance systems, or similar GxP experience (covering compliance, databases, procedures, QA, training)
* Experience in the area of audits/inspections by various Health Authorities
* Proven track record of successful project management, excellent communication skills and organisational and administration skills
* Proven ability to work and handle multiple tasks independently and effectively
* Excellent negotiation, conflict resolution, decision making, problem solving, communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills.
* Results driven, self\-starter with proactive working style, committed and accountable, transparent working style also under pressure.
* Excellent planning, organizational and computer skills


 Why Sandoz?
   

  

 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us!

The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. * Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.

**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.

* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**

description:
**Electrical Engineering Expert (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to make AI smarter — and we need electrical engineers to help get there. As an Electrical Engineering AI Trainer, you'll stress\-test cutting\-edge language models against real, advanced engineering problems, expose their weaknesses, and help build the next generation of technically rigorous AI.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role — work on your schedule, from anywhere.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Craft advanced electrical engineering problems spanning circuit analysis, power systems, signal processing, electromagnetics, embedded systems, and control theory to push AI models to their limits
* Author Gold\-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions that serve as benchmarks for AI learning and evaluation
* Audit AI Outputs — Review and assess AI\-generated code, circuit diagrams, and mathematical proofs for technical accuracy, safety, and compliance with engineering standards (IEEE, NEC, etc.)
* Sharpen AI Reasoning — Identify logical gaps and flawed reasoning in AI responses, then provide structured feedback to improve model performance on complex engineering tasks


**Who You Are**
* Currently pursuing or have completed a Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a closely related field
* Strong foundational expertise in one or more core domains — VLSI, control systems, telecommunications, power electronics, or signal processing
* Able to explain highly technical concepts clearly and precisely in writing
* Meticulous with mathematical equations, circuit logic, and technical documentation
* Self\-directed and comfortable working asynchronously
* No prior AI experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or AI evaluation workflows
* Familiarity with simulation tools (SPICE, MATLAB, etc.)
* Background in academic or industry research


**Why Join Us**
* Work on genuinely cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research teams
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and workload
* Freelance autonomy with the backing of a professional, global team
* Gain rare, hands\-on exposure to how advanced large language models are built and trained
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Senior Associate
description:
**About Us** 




 The Spine Foundation is a non\-profit organization dedicated to delivering free, high\-quality spine care to underprivileged communities in rural India. Founded over 25 years ago by a team of committed spine surgeons, the foundation focuses on alleviating chronic pain, limited mobility, and loss of livelihood caused by spinal disorders. Through specialized camps and outreach programs, it provides essential diagnostics, surgeries, and rehabilitation to individuals who otherwise could not afford such care. A volunteer network of leading Indian spine surgeons ensures patients receive expert treatment and a real chance to regain independence. In addition to clinical services, the foundation actively promotes spinal health awareness and preventive education to enable long\-term community well\-being.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Spine Foundation is looking for a highly committed and mature professional to work closely with Dr. Shekar Bhojraj and shadow him across his institutional, clinical, field, donor, partner and stakeholder engagements.
 



 This is a senior coordination and documentation role designed to support continuity, capture institutional knowledge, strengthen follow\-up systems and enable more structured planning around Dr. Bhojraj’s work. The role is not a conventional Executive Assistant or Research Associate position. It requires someone who can understand the purpose of TSF’s work, observe closely, document meaningfully, coordinate with multiple stakeholders and support the translation of conversations into clear action points.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Shadowing Dr. Bhojraj’s Work** 




 Accompany or closely support Dr. Bhojraj across meetings, visits, discussions, field engagements, hospital and doctor interactions, partner meetings and other institutional activities. The person will be expected to understand the context, capture key points and ensure that important conversations are not lost.
 



**2\. Documentation of Conversations and Engagements** 




 Prepare concise and useful notes from meetings, field visits, calls and stakeholder interactions. This will include recording key decisions, commitments, follow\-up points, relationship context and any strategic issues that require attention.
 



**3\. Stakeholder Coordination** 




 Liaise regularly with doctors, hospitals, field teams, partners, donors, advisors, board members, consultants and other stakeholders connected with TSF’s work. The person should be able to communicate professionally, follow up respectfully and ensure that coordination does not remain dependent only on Dr. Bhojraj.
 



**4\. Planning, Scheduling and Follow\-up** 




 Support planning and scheduling of Dr. Bhojraj’s meetings, visits and travel\-linked engagements. This includes coordinating with relevant people, preparing briefs before meetings, ensuring that background information is available, and tracking follow\-up after each engagement.
 



**5\. Institutional Memory and Continuity** 




 Help TSF build stronger institutional memory around Dr. Bhojraj’s relationships, decisions, field insights and strategic directions. The person should be able to organise information in a way that helps the wider team, leadership and advisors take work forward with clarity.
 



**6\. Support to Strategic and Operational Priorities** 




 Work closely with Dr. Bhojraj and other identified team members or consultants to support planning around institutional priorities, donor conversations, centre\-level engagements, doctor networks, camps, outreach visits and emerging opportunities.
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should have:
 



 • A Master’s degree in social work, public health, development studies, management, hospital administration, rural development or a related field.
 



 • 5\-8 years of relevant experience, preferably with exposure to both grassroots work and management\-level coordination.
 



 • Prior experience working closely with senior leadership, founders, trustees, doctors, programme heads or institutional leaders.
 



 • Strong understanding of community\-based work, health systems, rural development or social sector institutions.
 



 • Excellent documentation, note\-taking and synthesis skills.
 



 • Ability to capture not just minutes of meetings, but the larger context, relationships, concerns and follow\-up actions.
 



 • Strong coordination and interpersonal skills.
 



 • Ability to manage sensitive conversations with maturity and discretion.
 



 • Comfort with travel and accompanying leadership for field visits, stakeholder meetings and institutional engagements.
 



 • Good written and spoken communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of Marathi or other regional languages will be an added advantage.
 



 • High level of integrity, patience, humility and commitment to the cause of equitable spine care.
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 The person must be deeply aligned with TSF’s mission and should be comfortable working in a role that requires observation, listening, coordination and quiet leadership. They should be proactive without being intrusive, organised without being bureaucratic, and sensitive to the clinical, human and institutional dimensions of Dr. Bhojraj’s work.
 



 This role is suitable for someone who is passionate about public health and social impact, and who sees value in helping an institution strengthen continuity around a founder’s vision, relationships and way of working.
 



 Reporting and Working Relationship
 



 The person will work closely with Dr. Bhojraj and coordinate with identified members of the TSF team, doctors, external advisors and consultants as required. The role will require regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders and will involve both office\-based and travel\-linked responsibilities.
 



 Expected Outcome of the Role
 


* Over time, the role should help TSF ensure that Dr. Bhojraj’s work, relationships, insights and decisions are better captured, followed through and institutionalized. The position is intended to strengthen continuity, coordination and leadership support as TSF prepares for its next phase of growth and sustainability.



  





**Salary/Compensation** 




 Will commensurate based on the experience
 



  





**Additional Information:** 
 This role requires frequent travel, field visits, and close accompaniment of senior leadership, often involving long and unpredictable working hours. Considering these operational requirements, preference may be given to male candidates.

 Experience of DevOps tools and promote automation.

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
