 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for people with expertise in
 **Oracle GRC Senior Consultant** 
 to join our
 **EY\-GDS GRC Technology Team** 
 . This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Reviews materials and supports in meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to understand and gather business / functional requirements, undertaking client assessments and building relationships with business stakeholder.
* Builds relationships and collaborates with the wider team to understand business requirements and translates these into complex technical requirements.
* Produces technical specifications to guide system architectural design and development and conducts quality assurance tasks to ensure completeness of requirements, peer reviewing the work of more junior members of the team.
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and forms recommendations for system and technical components based on understanding of business requirements, reviewing and supporting with process modelling and improvement.
* Contributes to the design and review of test cases to ensure tests adequately meet the requirements and coordinates with infrastructure and operations teams to resolve system issues, contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project.
* Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.
* Contributes to business case development and completes RFP responses, exploring and experimenting with new and existing data to tackle defined business problems .


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
* Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 3 to 7 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:
* 
+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role\-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre\-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions .
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power\-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk \& Compliance) \& Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

description:
Requisition Id: 1745550
   

  

 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world.  : Associate Consultant\-TMT\-Business Consulting Risk\-CNS \- Risk \- Process \& Controls \- Mumbai
   

  

**TMT :**
 Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media \& Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
   

  

 We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise\-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M\&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.
   

  

**CNS \- Risk \- Process \& Controls :**
 EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
   

  

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
   

  

 Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
   

  

 Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* Strong understanding of digital media business models and risk\-related process and control frameworks. Proficient in using MS Office tools to analyze, organize, and present business and risk data effectively. Ability to support process and controls assessments, identifying gaps and documenting control weaknesses. Working knowledge of PowerBI for data visualization and preparation of concise, insight\-driven management outputs.

* Data Analysis (2\+ years)

 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. title: Project Leader and Trainer (Maritime)
description:
Highly motivated and detail\-oriented ERP Operations \& Support Specialist to manage the daily operations, support, and continuous improvement of our PAL ERP system, with a focus on maritime. This role involves managing PMS\-related projects across the fleet, ensuring consistency and efficiency, and working closely with internal teams and ERP vendors to ensure smooth system performance. Hands\-on experience with ERP systems (preferably PAL), a solid understanding of planned maintenance in maritime operations, and strong interpersonal skills to lead user training, documentation, and system implementation projects. A service\-driven mindset, analytical thinking, and excellent communication skills are key to success in this position.

* Planned Maintenance System (PMS)
* QHSE
* Voyage
* Drydock

* Proficient in project management and helpdesk platforms.
* Analytical mindset with a strong focus on quality and detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.

This role supports two complementary priorities within SIGMA: AI\-enabled Market \& Competitive Intelligence and the operational execution of Digital Sales programs.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-oriented professional for a dual\-role position supporting Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%) and Digital Sales PMO and Administration (50%).
   

  

 The successful candidate will help transform traditional market and competitive intelligence into an AI\-enabled function through Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, intelligent research workflows, and Copilot\-based solutions. In parallel, the individual will provide PMO and operational support for Digital Sales programs, ensuring effective governance, coordination, reporting, process administration, and execution management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines hands\-on AI implementation experience with strong program management, stakeholder coordination, business operations, and administrative capabilities. The individual must be comfortable building and scaling AI capabilities while delivering disciplined operational execution across the two workstreams.
   

  

 Indicative role allocation: 50% MCI AI Enablement \| 50% Digital Sales PMO and Administration
   

  

**Primary Roles And Responsibilities**
 Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%)
   

  

* Lead the adoption and operationalization of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent automation solutions across the Market \& Competitive Intelligence function.
* Design, build, deploy, administer, and continuously improve AI\-powered intelligence agents that support competitive intelligence, customer intelligence, market research, executive briefings, and knowledge discovery.
* Develop and manage AI\-enabled research workflows that integrate approved internal repositories, external data sources, analyst content, and enterprise knowledge assets.

* Establish and apply AI governance, evaluation, risk\-management, responsible\-AI, and quality\-assurance processes to ensure trusted, compliant, source\-backed, and business\-ready intelligence deliverables.
* Partner with MCI and business stakeholders to identify, prioritize, prototype, and implement AI use cases that improve research productivity, insight generation, knowledge access, and decision support.
* Build and maintain AI knowledge repositories, prompt libraries, reusable agent components, templates, documentation, and best practices that enable scalable intelligence operations.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, models, and industry developments to identify opportunities or innovation and continuous improvement within the intelligence function.
* Define, measure, and report AI adoption, usage, output quality, productivity improvements, business outcomes, and operational effectiveness across supported initiatives.
* Develop AI\-driven reporting, automated intelligence updates, executive insight experiences, and self\-service knowledge\-delivery capabilities, while acting as a subject matter expert for Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI agents, prompt engineering, research automation, and intelligent workflow design.


 Digital Sales PMO and Administrative Support (50%)
   

  

* Provide PMO support for Digital Sales initiatives, including planning, scheduling, action tracking, dependency management, governance, and delivery coordination.
* Maintain project plans, roadmaps, milestone trackers, RACI matrices, risk and issue logs, decision records, and success metrics for assigned programs.
* Coordinate meetings and operating cadences, prepare agendas and pre\-reads, document decisions and actions, and follow up with owners to support timely closure.
* Coordinate global Digital Sales stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to maintain alignment, visibility, and execution against agreed priorities.
* Prepare and maintain dashboards, status reports, leadership updates, and other operational communications using accurate and current program data.
* Support process administration, documentation, knowledge repositories, intake and prioritization workflows, access requests, and other recurring operational activities.
* Track program risks, issues, dependencies, and change\-management or adoption activities, escalating items that require leadership attention.
* Support the administration and operational governance of Digital Sales tools and platforms, including user access, vendor coordination, license or usage tracking, adoption reporting, and issue follow\-through.


**Required Experience**

* Experience designing, implementing, administering, or supporting AI\-enabled business processes, agents, knowledge repositories, or research solutions.
* Experience establishing or applying AI governance, evaluation, responsible\-AI, quality\-assurance, and adoption practices in a business environment.
* At least 3 years of experience supporting enterprise programs, PMO activities, strategic initiatives, cross\-functional operations, or Digital Sales programs.
* Strong organizational and program\-coordination skills, including experience managing plans, schedules, actions, risks, dependencies, documentation, and recurring governance cadences.
* Experience creating executive reports, dashboards, presentations, operational metrics, and concise business communications.
* Experience coordinating senior stakeholders and global, cross\-functional teams across Sales, Digital Sales, Product Management, Pre\-Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or Technology functions.
* Ability to balance AI initiatives and operational workstreams, work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver consistently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, confidentiality, and follow\-through.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related program\-management certification.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Power BI, or similar AI, automation, and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting Digital Sales, sales operations, seller productivity, sales technology, or AI transformation programs.
* Exposure to enterprise software, automation, AI, cloud, data, infrastructure, workload automation, AIOps, observability, DevOps, or mainframe markets is desirable.


 CA\-DNP

description:
**About the Organization** 






  





 Swaniti Initiative is a social enterprise that is working at the intersection of climate, governance and last mile delivery. We believe that while the willingness and resources exist, there are fundamental gaps in the execution within communities that is the biggest crisis in the climate movement. Accordingly, Swaniti works with sub national governments to conduct micro planning exercises with consultations with community and key stakeholders to understand the pathways forward, provide technical assistance to sub national governments to provide support in program implementation and support in monitoring and delivery of programs.
   





  





 Swaniti has been working across multiple geographies in the global south to unlock capital. Our three core metrics include unlocking public capital, ensuring last mile communities are directly benefited and creating systemic changes in the public service systems. While we are continuing to focus on impact, it is critical to have a lead who has a deep understanding about monitoring, evaluation and learning. Our intention is to create an institutional capability to measure and document the scale of our impact and look at how learning can be replicated across the institution.
   





  





  





 Position Overview
   





  





 We are looking for an enthusiastic and versatile Generalist with strong writing skills and a solid background in research, climate and sustainability, environmental issues, and governance. The ideal candidate should be familiar with environmental policies, climate change mitigation strategies, and governance frameworks.
   





  





 The role offers the opportunity to be involved in a wide range of activities, including research and report writing with focus on sustainability and environmental governance in Andhra Pradesh.
   





  





  





 Roles \& Responsibilities
   





  





 1\. Develop high\-quality research documents, along with need assessment, situation analysis, data analysis, brainstorming with relevant stakeholders.
   





  





 2\. Coordinate, manage, and draft comprehensive research paper on community readiness.
   





  





 3\. Take innovative and research driven perspective on framing recommendations and policy insights for sub national stakeholders.
   





  





 4\. Work with organizational leadership with the state administration to operationalize the feedback that is being collected within communities to promote sustainable practices and environmental governance.
   





  





 5\. Organize and execute events, seminars, and roundtable discussions etc. and provide any additional support to build out capabilities.
   

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  


**Requirements** 
  





**Candidates with prior professional experience in the development sector, particularly in areas such as climate change, sustainability, environmental governance, public policy, community development, or government engagement, will be preferred.** 
  





**Qualifications:**

* At least 2–3 years of professional experience in research, climate change, environmental governance, sustainability in the field of energy efficiency or the energy conservation program with the MSME.

* Strong command of both English and Hindi is necessary for this role.

title: Associate Consultant – Sustainable Health
description:
Last date of application: 31st Oct 2026
   

  

**About Tarutium**
 Tarutium Global Consulting (pronounced as taru\-shee\-yum) delivers transformative insights, strategies, and solutions to drive sustainable, resilient, and inclusive global progress. Our mission is to \`bridge the Science\-Institutions\-Society interface with a core agenda of providing transformative solutions to the development challenges. Established in 1996 by eminent development professionals, it caters to a diverse range of bilateral and multi\-lateral agencies, government departments, corporations, and other development organizations through research, technology, solution innovations, and implementation support. Over the past two and a half decades, Tarutium has undertaken policy analysis, strategy development, action research, technical assistance, program design, project management support, assessments, and evaluations. We have addressed various institutional, financial, economic, social, and technical issues across diverse public systems, cultures, and corporate formations.
   

  

 Tarutium works in Africa, the Middle East, South Asia, and Southeast Asian countries like Afghanistan, Indonesia, Nepal, Bhutan, Maldives, UAE, Eswatini, Bangladesh, Tanzania, Myanmar and others. The organization is committed to quality, accuracy, and succinctness in its consulting and advisory services. Tarutium’s team of professionals has extensive national and international experience and a strong network of advisors, consultants, partner institutions, and associations worldwide. Our expertise spans critical sectors such as climate, disaster management, sustainability, infrastructure, urban services, social impact, economic growth, entrepreneurship, behaviour change, health, and more. By focusing on innovation and collaboration, we empower businesses, governments, foundations, and institutions with the knowledge, solutions, and tools they need to thrive in an ever\-changing global landscape.
   

  

 For more information, visit our website
 **www.tarutium.com**
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Tarutium Global Consulting, through its Centre for Sustainable Health, is committed to advancing evidence\-based and equitable health solutions across India and globally. The organization works at the intersection of science, policy, and community systems, focusing on priority areas that address emerging and persistent health challenges. Tarutium’s key thematic areas include oral health; maternal and child health; and climate and health—covering disease surveillance, air quality, heat\-health, and climate\-sensitive diseases; occupational health; mental health; wellness and nutrition; senior health; and the integration of health and technology. These focus areas are approached through a systems thinking lens and implemented across both urban and rural contexts.

 He/she will perform the following functions:

**Project Management**

* Collaborate with other practice areas and regional units to operationalize strategic plans, offering both logistical and technical inputs.
* Demonstrate accountability in decision\-making, efficient resource management, and adherence to organizational values.

* Align work practices with Tarutium’s culture and leadership expectations.

**Knowledge Works**
* Lead and support in knowledge creation and dissemination through articles, case studies, blogs, and technical papers in reputable platforms.
* Organize and actively participate in conferences, workshops, and seminars to connect with and contribute to academic and professional communities.


**Job Specification: Qualification \& Experience**
* Postgraduate or Professional degree in Public Health/BDS/Health Management or any other discipline relevant to this role from reputed institutes
* At least minimum 1\-3 years’ experience in the climate, health, and nutrition sector especially with national and international organizations.

title: MEP Tendering
description:
**Company Description** 
 Amber Electrotech Ltd, founded in 1958 as an electrical contracting agency, has grown into a comprehensive turnkey solution provider for a wide range of electrical projects. The company delivers internal and external electrification and substation services, including high\-end and conventional solutions, and has expanded to a business of approximately $20 million. With a passionate team of engineers, Amber Electrotech focuses on providing best\-in\-class electrical services at competitive prices while consistently exceeding customer expectations. As a diversified turnkey provider, the company offers electrical techno\-commercial solutions and is equipped to manage stringent S.I.T.C requirements and related clearances from relevant electrical authorities.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site MEP Tendering role based in Okhla. The role involves preparing and reviewing tender documents, BOQs, and cost estimates for MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with client specifications. The MEP Tendering professional will coordinate with engineering, procurement, and project teams to gather technical inputs, clarify scope, and optimize pricing and solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include analyzing drawings and specifications, obtaining vendor quotations, preparing techno\-commercial offers, and supporting negotiations and bid submissions. The role also includes maintaining tender documentation, tracking deadlines, and contributing to continuous improvement of tendering processes and templates.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of MEP systems, including electrical distribution, HVAC, plumbing, and related building services.
* Experience in tendering, estimation, and BOQ preparation for MEP or electrical turnkey projects.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and standards.
* Proficiency with MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with estimation or project management software.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or related Engineering discipline.
* Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and clients.
* Prior experience in contracting or turnkey solution companies, especially in S.I.T.C projects, is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Okhla and manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously.

title: Computer Engineering
description:
**Computer Engineering — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
 We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI models. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep technical knowledge is exactly what's needed to make these systems smarter, more accurate, and more reliable.
   

  

 You'll stress\-test advanced language models on complex hardware and systems topics, expose their failure modes, and help build the ground\-truth solutions that shape how AI reasons about computer engineering.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Create advanced computer engineering scenarios spanning RISC\-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, hardware\-software co\-design, embedded systems, and more
* Author Gold\-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams that serve as benchmarks for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated code (C/C\+\+, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and OS kernel implementations for technical accuracy, efficiency, and standards compliance
* Improve AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in AI\-generated reasoning — such as race conditions, memory leaks, or timing constraint violations — and provide structured feedback to improve model performance


**Who You Are**
* Pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science (hardware focus), or a closely related field
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of: Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems
* Able to communicate complex hardware concepts and low\-level software logic clearly in writing
* Highly detail\-oriented — comfortable working at the level of bit operations, clock cycles, and technical documentation
* No prior AI experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, data quality, or AI evaluation workflows
* Proficiency in engineering tools such as MATLAB, ANSYS, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with IoT, networking, distributed systems, or hardware security domains


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and institutions
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with experts worldwide
* Gain rare, firsthand exposure to how advanced LLMs are built and trained
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Business Performance Analyst
description:
**Business Performance Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 What if your business expertise and leadership skills could directly shape how AI understands commerce, finance, strategy, and operations? We're looking for experienced Business Performance Analysts to lead and mentor a team of analysts creating high\-quality, business\-focused content that trains the next generation of AI models.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of people management, analytical rigour, and subject matter expertise. No prior AI experience required — your business background is what matters.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts and Content Specialists producing business\-domain content for AI training
* Allocate tasks, manage workflows, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs
* Conduct quality assurance reviews and continuously refine team processes for greater efficiency
* Provide constructive performance feedback, hands\-on coaching, and ongoing team development
* Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, delivering regular progress updates
* Guide the creation of case studies, business scenarios, and structured analytical content across domains including finance, policy, e\-commerce, and operations


**Who You Are**
* Experienced team leader with a strong track record of managing and developing analysts or specialists
* Deep practitioner in business analysis, consulting, or a related domain — you know your subject inside out
* Sharp analytical thinker who can evaluate the quality, logic, and accuracy of business content
* Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex ideas into structured, actionable feedback
* Self\-directed and organised — you manage priorities well and deliver without hand\-holding
* Creative and lateral thinker who can approach business problems from multiple angles
* No prior AI or tech experience required


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience
* 2\+ years of direct team management experience
* 3–6 years of experience in business analysis, management consulting, content strategy, or domain\-focused project work
* Strong research, analytical, and critical evaluation skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Nice to Have**
* Master's degree or MBA in a relevant business or quantitative discipline
* Experience with data annotation, content evaluation, or quality assurance systems
* Background in case study writing, academic content, or structured business research
* Familiarity with AI tools or large language model workflows as an end user


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, leadership\-level work
* Gain rare, hands\-on exposure to how advanced AI models are trained and evaluated
* Contribute to work that shapes how AI reasons about business, finance, and strategy at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ruddersoft delivers end\-to\-end Automatic Identification \& Data Collection (AIDC) applications and products, specializing in RFID, barcode solutions, and customized software development. The company supports end users with complete project lifecycles, from site assessment to deployment, and offers dedicated IT/RFID consultancy services. Ruddersoft focuses on SMART RFID\-based tracking and tracing solutions designed to improve visibility, accuracy, and operational efficiency. Applicants joining Ruddersoft will be part of a team developing innovative, technology\-driven solutions for real\-world data capture and automation challenges.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Technical Content Writer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ghaziabad. In this position, you will research AIDC, RFID, barcode, and related software topics and translate complex technical information into clear, accurate, and engaging content. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include writing product documentation, user guides, technical blog posts, case studies, website content, and marketing collateral that aligns with Ruddersoft’s solutions and brand voice. You will collaborate with engineers, product managers, and sales teams to gather information, ensure technical correctness, and maintain consistency across all content. The role also involves editing and proofreading materials, optimizing content structure, and contributing to content strategy for digital channels.
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong technical writing and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in clear, accessible language.
* Experience creating content for technology domains such as RFID, barcode systems, AIDC solutions, or enterprise software (blogs, white papers, product sheets, FAQs).
* Proficiency in editing and proofreading, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and consistency across all written materials.
* Familiarity with digital content practices, including basic SEO principles, web formatting, and collaboration with design or marketing teams.
* Ability to conduct structured research, interview subject matter experts, and synthesize technical information into well\-organized content.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong attention to detail and organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Technical Communication, English, Journalism, or a related discipline.
* Prior experience in a technical writing or technical content role within IT, software, or industrial automation is preferred.
* Comfort working on\-site in Ghaziabad, collaborating cross\-functionally, and managing multiple content projects and deadlines.

title: TECHNICAL CONTENT SPECIALIST – PHYSICS & ENGINEERING Research | Technical Editing | PowerPoint | Technical Graphics
description:
We are an 80\-year\-old U.S.\-based technical consulting firm. We are developing professional online courses and certificate programs in acoustics, noise and vibration control, applied physics, and related technical fields.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Technical Content Specialist to work directly with our senior technical experts. The experts will develop the technical course content; your role will be to research, edit, organize, illustrate, and professionally present that material.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Research technical topics using credible academic and professional sources.
* Edit technical content for clarity, consistency, grammar, and professional presentation.
* Develop high\-quality PowerPoint presentations from technical material provided by experts.
* Create and improve technical graphics, diagrams, illustrations, charts, and tables.
* Prepare and format course notes and supporting documents in Microsoft Word.
* Use Excel for calculations, charts, tables, and data presentation.
* Assist with examples, exercises, quizzes, references, and supporting course material.
* Use AI and modern productivity tools effectively for research, editing, graphics, and content preparation.
* Work directly with senior technical professionals through review and revision.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bechler, master’s or higher degree in Physics or Applied Physics preferred. Mechanical Engineering, Acoustics, or closely related technical disciplines will also be considered.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience.
* Strong understanding of physics, particularly waves, frequency, energy, measurement, and basic mathematics.
* Excellent written and spoken English with strong technical editing ability.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word, with good Excel skills.
* Strong technical research skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop professional technical graphics and visual presentations.
* Ability to understand technical information and communicate it clearly without changing its technical meaning.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.



  





 Experience with Canva, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, technical illustration, video editing, MATLAB Python, e\-learning, or AI\-assisted content tools is an advantage.
 



  





**Working Hours** 




 You will be working with Technical Expert based in US and often travels to different time zones. There the working schedule will be US Pacific time (India Nights) mainly along with adjustments to other time zones as required.
 



  





**Travel** 




 This is a Hybrid position, and Candidates must be willing to travel Jalandhar, Punjab, while the Technical Expert is in India.

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

title: Manager Events and Executive Client Engagement
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 The Channel Specialist \- Events \& Executive Client Engagement is the execution backbone for priority events and executive interactions. Reporting to the offshore Channel Lead \- Events \& Executive Client Engagement, this role produces, governs, and readies all event and executive\-facing assets, ensuring accuracy, compliance, accessibility, and reuse across conferences, client summits, advisory boards, and virtual programs. The Specialist operates primarily asynchronously with structured overlap for reviews and approvals, enabling US on\-ground teams to deliver high\-impact, measurable experiences.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Execute the event content plan by developing and managing brochures, one\-pagers, booth screens, session slides, demo narratives, videos, and digital assets for in\-person and virtual events
* Build and maintain content toolkits (templates, modules, messaging snippets) with metadata, tagging, and version control to enable efficient reuse and consistency
* Support executive client engagement materials (briefing books, tailored case studies, follow\-up emails) and coordinate approvals with brand, legal, and compliance
* Partner with creative teams and agencies on copy, design, video edits, and motion assets, ensuring brand consistency, accessibility, and quality standards
* Coordinate logistics inputs for content (specs, deadlines, run\-of\-show, print/digital delivery) and own checklists/QA to ensure assets are show\-ready
* Use AI tools to draft abstracts, session descriptions, recap summaries, and asset variants within established governance; apply human review to ensure accuracy and compliance
* Track engagement metrics (asset downloads, QR scans, session attendance, booth interactions) and prepare clean reports/insight summaries for optimization
* Maintain audit trails and documentation required for regulatory compliance and internal governance processes
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* Overall, 8\+ years of experience with 7\+ years of experience in event content production, marketing communications, sales enablement, or related roles within complex/regulated environments
* Hands\-on proficiency with presentation tools (e.g., PowerPoint), event platforms, digital asset management, and basic video workflows
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted content creation and comfort adopting new tools and standardized workflows
* Demonstrated solid writing and editing skills with attention to detail for accuracy, accessibility (e.g., alt text, contrast), and brand voice
* Demonstrated solid project management and collaboration skills; ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
 \#NJP

title: Specialist, Oracle HCM
description:
**Make your mark with Thiess** 





 Every day, all around the world, Thiess supports and celebrates our people. We recognise talent, reward transparency, champion diversity and embrace change.
 



 Join us and hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.
 








**The Opportunity** 





 As Oracle HCM Application Specialist within the People Systems team, you will support and enhance Thiess's HR systems and technology landscape, applying strong technical and functional expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud configuration, integrations, and data management to deliver reliable system solutions and process efficiencies that improve the employee and leader experience across the business globally.
 




**Reporting to the Manager, People Systems, you will provide timely, high\-quality technical support to the HR team and broader business, including the scoping, implementation, and optimisation of HR systems projects to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient outcomes.** 










**As the \[Position Title], you will:** 





**Operational BAU Support** 




 • Act as the first and second point of contact for Oracle HCM issues raised by the global workforce through the ticketing system.
   

 • Be the HR domain expert and HCM functional specialist for the implemented modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals,
 



**Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.** 




  

 • Support strategy and roadmap formulation for Oracle HCM and other HR systems, supporting the Manager, People Systems.
   

 • Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.
   

 • Provide ongoing L2/L3 functional and technical support for production issues, service requests, and change requests, ensuring SLA\-driven system stability.
   

 • Make system configuration changes, correct data, and troubleshoot issues across HCM modules.
   

 • Keep clear records of resolutions, configurations, and known issues.
   

 • Escalate complex issues to Oracle Support or implementation partners (CIMIC / Oracle / WIPRO) where needed.
 



**Projects** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of HCM rollout projects, from requirements and solution design through configuration, data migration, cutover, and hypercare support.
   

 • Support the rollout of Oracle HCM across different geographies, and Thiess businesses working with regional HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
   

 • Define integration requirements between Oracle HCM and other systems, and resolve integration issues.
   

 • Take part in fit\-gap analysis and recommend target\-state design and process improvements.
   

 • Present project updates, steering committee papers, and post\-implementation reviews to leadership.
 



**Enhancements** 




 • Identify opportunities to improve systems and processes based on user feedback and recurring trends.
   

 • Support the design, testing, and roll\-out of new features, functionality, and quarterly Oracle updates.
   

 • Drive continuous HCM optimisation and automation of operational tasks and reporting.
   

 • Build and maintain reports and dashboards using BI Publisher and OTBI for actionable HR insights.
   

 • Support change impact assessment and user communication or training for new enhancements.
   

 Commercial \& Stakeholder Relationships • Look for cost efficiencies where possible, without compromising safety.
   

 • Engage others by focusing on common ground and shared objectives.
   

 • Consult with stakeholders before making decisions.
 



**People \& Leadership** 




 • Work towards plans to achieve team and business goals.
   

 • Support others to deliver results and improvements.
   

 • Coordinate effectively across teams and manage issues, conflict, and problems as they arise.
   

 • Build collaborative relationships with global HR functions.
   

 Health, Safety \& Sustainability • Understand the critical risks in your area and reassess hazards if the work area changes.
   

 • Know and apply the standards and procedures relevant to your role. Stop the job if in doubt, fix the problem, or warn others of danger.
 








**About you** 





**Formal Education** 




 • Bachelor's and/ or master's degree in technology, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
   

 • Oracle HCM Cloud certification(s) advantageous.
 



**Work Experience** 




 • 3\+ years' experience working with Oracle HCM / Fusion.
   

 • In\-depth experience with Oracle HCM modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals, Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.
   

 • Experience supporting or delivering Oracle HCM Cloud implementation projects, ideally across multiple countries spread across diverse businesses.
 



**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong domain knowledge of HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance and Talent management processes is a must
   

 • Strong technical and functional knowledge of Oracle HCM Cloud, including configuration, integrations, and data management.
   

 • Confident troubleshooting skills, able to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently within a ticketing environment.
   

 • Understanding of system integrations (e.g., middleware, third\-party HR platforms) and data governance principles.
   

 • Able to translate business requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
   

 • Proficient in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel.
   

 • Well\-developed written and oral communication, with excellent attention to detail.
   

 • Comfortable working with stakeholders across Mining Operations, HR, Payroll, IT, Finance and business leadership in different regions and time zones.
   

 • Strong understanding of HR processes and associated workflows.
 




**What's on offer** 





 At Thiess, our people are the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive \- safely, confidently and with opportunities to grow.
 


* Competitive salary package.
* Ongoing training \& development opportunities.
* A strong safety\-first culture across all operations, built on care, respect and accountability.
* Range of corporate discounts including health insurance (Medibank), travel \& retail products.







**About Thiess** 

 Thiess works with clients in Australia, Asia and the Americas in the dynamic field of open\-cut and underground mining.The pioneering spirit of our founders \- the legendary Thiess brothers \- is our legacy and inspires our vision to harness the power of people and technology to drive sustainable change. At Thiess, you will have the opportunity to play a part in the global energy transition. We are growing our commodities portfolio to include metals and minerals critical to the energy transition and developing services to enable sustainable mining.We’re creating a culture of curiosity, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous learning \- supporting our people to contribute to Thiess’ success and continued growth in sustainable mining. We’ll support you in honing your skills and developing new ones, taking on challenges and growing through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment. We offer our people ongoing technical training and development opportunities so they can reach their full potential. We also invest in the workforce of the future, with a range of programs for people starting their careers. We recognise the value of an inclusive and diverse workplace through our vision of everyone matters always. We’re focused on creating an inclusive environment to enable our people to bring their best self to work because they feel safe, included and empowered.
 **About Capability Hubs**
 Thiess’ Capability Hubs are a key part of how we deliver work globally \- connecting skilled talent with business needs to provide high\-quality, efficient, and scalable services across functions and regions. The Capability Hubs enable access to global capability, supporting business growth while strengthening consistency, performance, and value delivery across Thiess. Our Capability Hubs operate as an integrated extension of the business, working in close partnership with Service Recipients to deliver outcomes that matter. With a strong focus on service discipline, governance, and continuous improvement, the Hubs play a critical role in how Thiess operates and evolves.
 **Make your mark \- Globally, People First**
 Our Capability Hubs offer the opportunity to make your mark as part of a global business, collaborating across diverse teams to connect global capability with local delivery. You will contribute to shared success while building valuable professional experience in a supportive and respectful environment where your contribution is rewarded, and your wellbeing is valued. This experience is underpinned by four key pillars \- Global Connection, Meaningful Contribution, Career Opportunities, and a Values\-led Culture \- which define what it means to work within our Capability Hubs. You will work globally with diverse teams, broadening your perspective and deepening your expertise, while contributing to meaningful outcomes that deliver value to the business. You will also build practical experience and capability to support your ongoing career growth, within a values\-led culture where people are respected, supported, and recognised for their contribution.
 





**How to Apply**

title: Coordinator, Content Acquisitions & Operations
description:

 TMB (Trusted Media Brands) is the world's leading community\-driven entertainment company. Learn more about our brands, our data\-driven marketing solutions, our award\-winning licensing services, and much more at www.tmbi.com.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced content writer to join the Content Management team. This is a very important role, as you’ll be at the heart of our content distribution hub.
   

  

 More specifically, the coordinator’s primary focus will be to process incoming trending clips through our CMS to prepare them for wide\-scale distribution. Another key aspect of the position is that you will help optimize and maintain the metadata database that supports Jukin’s clip library and overall content operations.

title: Integration Support Coordinator
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 We are a US\-based technology advisory team that runs IT integration for private equity acquisitions \- standing up network, security, identity, applications, and connectivity for newly acquired companies. We are looking for an Integration Support Coordinator based in India to work alongside us as a true team member.
   

  

 This role turns call transcripts, notes, and open action items into clean trackers, decks, and follow\-ups. Time zone overlap with the US team is limited, so you will work mostly from recordings and written context rather than live calls \- and you will be trusted to keep the plan moving without needing to be on every call.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role \- we need someone who catches issues early, keeps every workstream up to date, and makes sure open action items get closed.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Integration Plan and Workstream Tracking**
* Maintain the master integration tracker across workstreams (network, cybersecurity, identity/devices, applications/email, connectivity, procurement)
* Update workstream status, dates, and owners after each call
* Track budget vs. actual hours by workstream and flag variances


**Call Follow\-Up and Action Items**
* Review call transcripts and recordings, extract action items, owners, and deadlines
* Log action items in the tracker and escalate stale ones
* Draft follow\-up emails and status recaps from template


**Deliverable and Deck Support**
* Build and update integration status slides for client and internal steering committee updates
* Assemble Day 1 and Day 100 plans, cutover checklists, and workstream trackers
* Maintain version control across decks for concurrent deals


**Program Management Support**
* Support running the same integration playbook across multiple concurrent acquisitions
* Track due diligence pipeline status for deals not yet in active integration
* Maintain the Context Index and file organization for integration artifacts


 What Great Looks Like:
   

  

* Turns transcripts and notes into accurate deliverables, no live call context needed
* Keeps trackers and decks current across every active deal \- no stale data
* Flags variances, blockers, and stale action items before they become problems
* Learns the playbook well enough to run it cleanly across multiple deals at once
* Communicates clearly and flags blockers or delays as soon as they come up


 What You Bring:
   

  

* 2\+ years in project/program coordination, PMO, or consulting support role \- ideally at a consulting, advisory, or professional services firm
* Comfort working from meeting transcripts and written notes rather than live call attendance
* Strong PowerPoint skills
* Comfort building and maintaining trackers, dashboards, and structured data views
* Excellent written English \- you'll be drafting emails and updates that go straight to clients
* Strong attention to detail and a low tolerance for stale or broken data
* Comfortable working independently on recurring tasks without much oversight
* Some overlap with US Eastern or Central time is preferred but not required
* Bonus: background in M\&A, IT integration, or program management


 Tools You Will Use
   

  

 Notion, SharePoint, Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), call transcript tools (Fireflies or similar), AI (Copilot, Claude, etc.) and internal communication tools. You do not need to be an expert in all of these on day one, but you should be able to come up to speed quickly.
   

  

 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
   

  

**More about Crowe:**
 Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
   

  

 Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for people with expertise in
 **Oracle GRC Senior Consultant** 
 to join our
 **EY\-GDS GRC Technology Team** 
 . This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Reviews materials and supports in meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to understand and gather business / functional requirements, undertaking client assessments and building relationships with business stakeholder.
* Builds relationships and collaborates with the wider team to understand business requirements and translates these into complex technical requirements.
* Produces technical specifications to guide system architectural design and development and conducts quality assurance tasks to ensure completeness of requirements, peer reviewing the work of more junior members of the team.

* Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.
* Contributes to business case development and completes RFP responses, exploring and experimenting with new and existing data to tackle defined business problems .


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
* Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 3 to 7 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:
* 
+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role\-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre\-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions .
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power\-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk \& Compliance) \& Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

title: Document Controller & Platform Administrator (2-4 Years Experience)
description:
**Company Description** 





 Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and
 





 developing deep large\-scale AI and ML solutions for the Construction Industry. With a focus on AI,
 





 computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction
 





 industry with our innovative AI\-powered construction management solution,
 
**“Kael”** 

 — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with
 





 real\-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform,
 
**“Observance”** 

 , uses LiDAR scanning,
 





 thermal imaging, and AI\-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as\-built
 





 intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.
 





  





**Role Description** 





 We are looking for a technically strong
 
**Document Controller \& Platform Administrator** 

 to manage the complete documentation lifecycle on our construction projects and to serve as the primary interface between the project team and our AI\-powered project management platform. This role is critical: nearly all other team members come from construction backgrounds, and this person will be relied upon to support, guide, and troubleshoot their interactions with the platform — ensuring all project data is accurate, timely, and enabling AI\-driven project intelligence. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad.
 









**Responsibilities** 




**Platform Administration \& Team Enablement** 



* Act as the primary platform interface for all team members — civil, MEP, quality, safety, and design coordinators — supporting and guiding their day\-to\-day interactions with the platform.
* Ensure all relevant project documents are uploaded accurately and on time to enable AI validation, compliance checks, and document tracking.
* Configure and maintain document workflows, approval routing, and submission trackers within the platform.
* Monitor the completeness and accuracy of data entered by team members; flag gaps or inconsistencies to the Project Manager.
* Support onboarding and ongoing training of team members on platform workflows and document management procedures.
* Troubleshoot data entry issues and guide team members in correctly using the platform for their respective functions.



**Document Management \& Control** 



* Establish and maintain the project document management system (DMS), ensuring documents are correctly named, versioned, and archived.
* Control the receipt, registration, distribution, and archiving of all project documents including drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, contracts, and correspondence.
* Manage drawing revision control to ensure all site teams are working from the current approved revision at all times.
* Coordinate document review and approval cycles with clients, consultants, and contractors; track submission and response deadlines.
* Issue document transmittals and maintain a comprehensive transmittal register.



**Compliance, Reporting \& Handover** 



* Support RERA documentation workflows, ensuring project records remain audit\-ready for regulatory filings, milestone disclosures, and delivery commitments.
* Compile and maintain statutory document registers including permits, NOCs, authority approvals, and inspection certificates.
* Prepare documentation packages for client handover, third\-party audits, and RERA compliance reviews.
* Produce periodic document status and platform activity reports for the Project Manager and client.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 2–4 years of experience in document control, IT support, enterprise platform administration, or a closely related role. Experience on construction or infrastructure projects is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong proficiency with digital document management systems (Aconex, Procore, ProjectWise, SharePoint, or equivalent).
* Comfortable learning and administering new SaaS or agentic platforms; prior experience with AI\-powered project tools is a plus.
* Ability to communicate technical platform concepts clearly to non\-technical construction professionals.
* Understanding of construction documentation workflows — drawing registers, RFI processes, submittal cycles — is preferred.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and reliable with strong MS Office skills.



  





**Work Location : Ahmedabad (On\-site)**

title: Technology Archives Manager
description:
